title_clean: Video display device and cooperative control method in video display device
abstract_clean: For establishing cooperation among an external device 30 , a video display device and a remote control terminal and to achieve cooperative operation among these devices that affords a high level of operability to a user with less burden, the video display device to which an external device and a remote control terminal that remotely operates the external device can be connected, comprising: a connection detection section configured to detect a connection of the external device to the video display device; a cooperation establishment section configured to generate a start signal for initiate an application software accepting an operation instruction to the external device on the remote control terminal when the connection detection section detects the connection of the external device; and a communication interface configured to transmit the start signal to the remote control terminal.

title_clean: Display device
abstract_clean: The application provides a display device, which comprises a display substrate, a main circuit board, a first connecting circuit board and a second connecting circuit board. The display substrate includes a base layer, an insulating layer, a first signal line, a second signal line, a first pad, and a second pad, wherein the insulating layer is on the base layer, the first signal line is on the base layer, the second signal line is on the base layer, the first pad is exposed from the insulating layer and connected to the first signal line, and the second pad is connected to a side surface of the second signal line and disposed on a side surface and a bottom surface of the base layer. The first connection circuit board electrically connects the first pad and the main circuit board, and the second connection circuit board electrically connects the second pad and the main circuit board.

title_clean: Battery swappable vehicle and battery
abstract_clean: Disclosed in the embodiments of the present application are a battery swappable vehicle and a battery. The battery swappable vehicle (100) comprises a battery compartment (10); the battery compartment (10) is arranged in the battery swappable vehicle (100); the battery compartment (10) is used for accommodating a plurality of batteries (20), and each battery (20) can independently supply power to the battery swappable vehicle (100). By means of the battery swappable vehicle (100), diversified battery swapping schemes can be provided for a user, improving battery swapping flexibility and optimizing user experience.

title_clean: Acquisition circuit with selectable switching value judgment threshold
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses an acquisition circuit with an optional switching value judgment threshold, which comprises: the circuit comprises a first interface, a second interface, a first resistor, a second interface, a second resistor, a third resistor, a fourth resistor, an operational amplifier, a voltage dividing circuit and an optocoupler; the first interface is used for accessing an external sensor; the non-inverting input end of the operational amplifier is connected with the first interface, and the inverting input end of the operational amplifier is connected with an external switching value input interface; one end of the first resistor is connected between the non-inverting input end of the operational amplifier and the first interface, and the other end of the second resistor is connected with the second interface and then grounded; the second interface is connected with external 24V voltage through a second resistor, a third resistor and a fourth resistor respectively; the voltage dividing circuit is connected with the output end of the operational amplifier and the optical coupler; the optocoupler is connected to an external central chip. The utility model can easily adjust and adapt to the threshold value of switch detection, thereby better meeting different functional and performance requirements.

title_clean: Moisture control method, device and medium for feed finished product
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a moisture control method, a device and a medium of a feed finished product, wherein the method comprises the steps of mixing feed raw materials to obtain a first feed; and adjusting the water content and cooling time of the second feed according to the water content comparison result of the second feed and the first feed, so that the water content of the second feed reaches the preset standard, and obtaining the finished feed product. The invention provides a moisture control method, a device and a medium for a finished feed product, which can accurately capture moisture change of the feed by comparing moisture contents of a first feed and a second feed, wherein the comparison is performed in real time in the production process instead of sampling detection or frequent sampling detection after the end of the production, thereby ensuring the accuracy and the effectiveness of monitoring, and solving the problem that production control elements in the feed production process are difficult to accurately control, so that the finished feed product is quickly and effectively generated.

title_clean: Porous silicon material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_clean: The invention provides a porous silicon material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) Melt mixing a silicon source and a lithium source to obtain a melt mixture; (2) Carrying out lithium removal on the molten mixture to obtain a lithium removal product; (3) And carrying out heat treatment on the lithium removal product to obtain the porous silicon material. The invention provides a preparation method with low cost, simple process and low energy consumption, and the formed silicon nano-sheets can be radially arranged in honeycomb shape in all directions of particles through lithium attachment and lithium removal to form a controllable isotropic channelized porous silicon structure. The porous silicon material prepared based on the method not only can adapt to the volume change of silicon, but also can obviously promote the rapid transmission of lithium ions, so that the material utilization and capacity exertion are not limited by particle orientation, and the porous silicon material has high surface capacity, high rate performance and excellent cycling stability, has good industrial application prospect, and can realize large-scale production.

title_clean: Retortable gluten-free pasta
abstract_clean: A gluten-free pasta product that survives retort may be formed by preparing a dough mixture with gluten-free flour and water. The dough can be extruded at a temperature and with an amount of mechanical energy effective to form an extruded pasta product having a bi-continuous matrix of protein and starch. The extruded pasta product can be incorporated into a closed retort container and subsequently retorted. The resulting retorted food product may contain gluten-free pasta that has the structural integrity and textual firmness consistent with that exhibited by traditional wheat pasta after having undergone retort despite the absence of binding gluten molecules.

title_clean: Production process of silver mirror
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a production process of a silver mirror, relates to the field of production and manufacturing of mirrors, and aims to solve the problems of short service life and low reflectivity of the silver mirror, and the key points of the technical scheme are as follows: a production process of a silver mirror comprises the following steps: cleaning and polishing glass; sensitizing; performing hypersensitization; silver plating; passivating; preheating; spraying a primer; baking the primer; spraying epoxy resin masking liquid; spraying finish paint; air cooling; pickling the surface; cleaning the surface; and (5) drying. The production process of the silver mirror can ensure the effects of long durability, high reflectivity and long service life of the silver layer.

title_clean: Cloth net brake device of grass bundling machine
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a cloth net brake device of a grass bundling machine, which belongs to the technical field of the grass bundling machine. The net belt cutting device is characterized in that an auxiliary compression roller mechanism for clamping and pressing a net belt on a net conveying guide roller is arranged on a net distributing device frame, a cutter spring hook is hinged on a cutter arm and hung on the cutter spring mechanism on the net distributing device frame, a cutter resetting mechanism is arranged at the end part of the net distributing device frame, a self-locking electromagnetic brake disc fixed on the net distributing device frame is arranged at the shaft end on one side of the net conveying guide roller, a belt wheel mechanism connected with a rolling rod of a grass binding machine is arranged at the shaft end on the other side of the net conveying guide roller, a belt wheel sleeved at the shaft end of the rolling rod of the grass binding machine is an electromagnetic brake disc for clutching, the electromagnetic brake disc for clutching and the electromagnetic brake disc for self-locking are connected with an electrical system of the grass binding machine, the grass binding machine operates, the electromagnetic brake disc for clutching is used for attracting the clutch, the electromagnetic brake disc for self-locking is loosened, and the electromagnetic brake disc for self-locking is closed after a grass is packed for one circle.

title_clean: Excircle workpiece deburring equipment
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses an excircle work piece burring equipment, including driving motor one, the mill that is connected with a driving motor output with place the platform, its characterized in that: the workpiece clamping device is characterized by further comprising a bottom plate, the upper end of the bottom plate is rotatably connected with a rotating shaft, the upper end of the rotating shaft is connected with a placing table, a workpiece body is placed on the placing table, the placing table is provided with a clamping device used for fixing the two sides of the workpiece body, the upper side of the bottom plate is provided with a driving mechanism used for rotating the rotating shaft, first supporting rods and a top plate are connected and arranged at the two ends of the upper side wall of the bottom plate, a second supporting rod is connected and arranged at the upper end of the first supporting rod, a supporting plate is connected and arranged at the lower end of the top plate, a supporting plate is connected and arranged at the lower end of the second supporting rod, and a sliding plate is arranged at the lower side of the supporting plate. Compared with the prior art, the utility model the advantage lie in: the precision of polishing is higher, avoids polishing excessive condition, presss from both sides tightly more firm when fixing the work piece body.

title_clean: Pitaya picking machine
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a dragon fruit picking machine which comprises a single fruit picking device, a multi-fruit shearing device, a fruit screening device and a chassis moving device, wherein the single fruit picking device comprises a grabbing and cutting mechanism, a pushing mechanism, a visual identification system, a lifting mechanism, an information conversion output device and a fruit receiving pipeline; the multi-fruit shearing device comprises a multi-degree-of-freedom shearing mechanism a multi-degree-of-freedom base and a multi-fruit collecting frame; the fruit screening device comprises a first pushing cylinder, a moving component fixing plate, a second pushing cylinder, OPenMV visual identification modules, a dragon fruit suction mechanism, a dragon fruit suction rotating mechanism, a moving component and an overripe fruit collecting box; the chassis movement device is used for moving and bearing the single fruit picking device, the multi-fruit shearing device and the fruit screening device. The device can meet the requirements of picking single fruits and picking multiple fruits, remove overripe or damaged fruits, realize accurate shearing, realize rapid movement in the picking process, reduce the loss and the picking cost in the picking process and improve the picking efficiency.

title_clean: Gravity sliding type tire inflation roller conveying line
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a gravity sliding type tire inflation roller conveying line, and belongs to the technical field of tire inflation conveying lines. A gravity sliding type tyre inflation roller conveying line comprises an inclined bracket and a conveying roller which is rotationally connected on a mounting plate; the tire conveying device comprises a mounting plate, a symmetrically arranged adjusting plate, a limiting roller and a limiting roller, wherein the mounting plate is fixedly connected to the top of the inclined bracket, the symmetrically arranged adjusting plate is detachably connected to the mounting plate, and the limiting roller is rotatably connected to the adjusting plate.

title_clean: Preparation method of radiation-resistant and wave-absorbing functional structure integrated ceramic matrix composite
abstract_clean: The invention relates to a preparation method of an integrated ceramic matrix composite with a radiation-resistant and wave-absorbing function structure, which comprises the steps of firstly preparing a silicon carbide (SiC) prefabricated cloth and coating slurry, secondly uniformly coating the slurry on the surface of the SiC prefabricated cloth and laminating and fixing the SiC prefabricated cloth, and finally carrying out Chemical Vapor Infiltration (CVI) process on the laminated and fixed prefabricated body to deposit a silicon nitride (Si 3 N 4 ) matrix for densification. The preparation method provided by the invention realizes the structural integration of the radiation-resistant and wave-absorbing functions of the ceramic matrix composite, so that the radiation shielding material is in service in a higher temperature environment, and the overall comprehensive performance and the high temperature environment applicability of the ceramic matrix composite are improved.

title_clean: High-permeability double-component primer and preparation method thereof
abstract_clean: The invention provides a high-permeability double-component primer, which comprises a component A and a component B which are matched for use, wherein the mass ratio of the component A to the component B is 10:1; the component A comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 20-30% of aqueous acrylic emulsion, 10-20% of aqueous hydroxyl acrylic emulsion, 10-20% of aqueous polyurethane emulsion, 0.8-1.0% of defoamer, 1.2-1.8% of dispersant, 1.5-2.5% of matting powder, 0.1-0.2% of anti-settling auxiliary agent, 0.3-0.5% of anti-sagging auxiliary agent, 4.0-6.0% of film forming auxiliary agent, 0.6-1.2% of wetting leveling agent, 2.0-3.0% of wax auxiliary agent, 0.1-0.5% of thickener and the balance of deionized water; the component B adopts modified HDI polyisocyanate. The high-permeability double-component primer paint prepared by the invention solves the problems of poor wetting, round eyes, no third dimension and the like of a base material with smaller surface tension, meets the requirements of environmental protection standards, and can permeate open pores on various different base materials to reflect the third dimension.

title_clean: Radiation generation power eliminator
abstract_clean: To provide a radiation generation power eliminator that eliminates radiation generation power of artificial radioactive materials and radioactive disease-causing agents.SOLUTION: A radiation generation power eliminator is formed by: magnetizing an aluminum pipe 1 to have the N-pole on one end and the S-pole on the other end thereof; wrapping the surface of the aluminum pipe counterclockwise from the N-pole end to the S-pole end with a zinc wire 2 A times, which is fastened with tape 3 each time being wound; similarly winding a copper wire 4 B times, a zinc wire C times, an aluminum wire 5 D times, a copper wire E times, an aluminum wire F times, a copper wire G times, an aluminum wire H times, a copper wire I times, and a tin wire 6 J times; stacking K pieces of magnets 7 in the aluminum pipe; and inserting the N-poles of the magnets into the N-pole of the eliminator, and the S-poles of the magnets into the S-pole of the eliminator.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_clean: Continuous fiber reinforced resin composite material and manufacturing method thereof, and continuous fiber reinforced resin molded product
abstract_clean: The continuous fiber reinforced resin composite material of the present invention contains continuous reinforced fibers and a thermoplastic resin, and the peak temperature of tan [delta] at the interface between the continuous reinforcing fiber of the continuous fiber reinforced resin composite material and the thermoplastic resin is 80 DEG C or higher.

title_clean: Taxol nano particle, preparation method thereof, pharmaceutical composition thereof and application thereof
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a paclitaxel nanoparticle, a preparation method thereof, a pharmaceutical composition thereof and application thereof, wherein the paclitaxel nanoparticle is prepared by wrapping a Chek2 inhibitor with a paclitaxel polymer prodrug. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, covalently connecting paclitaxel on a side chain of an amphiphilic block polymer in a sulfur bond mode to form a paclitaxel high-molecular prodrug; then the taxol macromolecule prodrug is loaded with a Chek2 inhibitor in an amphiphilic self-assembly mode to form the taxol nanoparticle. The pharmaceutical composition comprises paclitaxel nanoparticles with effective dose for preventing or alleviating, and pharmaceutically acceptable carrier. Application of paclitaxel nanoparticles in preparing medicine for protecting ovarian injury caused by chemotherapy is provided. Compared with the method of singly using the taxol, the method can greatly enhance the tumor killing effect, effectively reduce the dosage of chemotherapy drugs reaching the ovary, inhibit the oocyte apoptosis caused by the taxol and furthest protect the ovarian function of a chemotherapy patient.

title_clean: Application of compound in preparation of medicine for treating pancreatic cancer
abstract_clean: The invention provides a compound of formula (I), formula (II) and formula (III), and also relates to a preparation method of the compound, wherein the synthesis route is simple, the raw materials are easy to obtain, and the industrial large-scale production can be conveniently realized. The compound provided by the invention has an inhibiting effect on pancreatic cancer tumors, has high survival rate and small weight reduction amplitude of mice in a mouse test, has small toxic and side effects, and is a compound medicine for treating pancreatic cancer, which is expected to be industrialized. The invention also comprises a pharmaceutical composition and a preparation of the compound, and application of the compound in preparing a medicament for treating pancreatic cancer.

title_clean: Dianthus plant named ‘KLEDP19263’
abstract_clean: A new Dianthus plant designated ‘KLEDP19263’ particularly distinguished by pink double flowers with red eyes, composed in round, small sprays and an upright habit, is disclosed.

title_clean: MRNA medicine targeting CD73 and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_clean: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicines, and particularly relates to a CD 73-targeted mRNA medicament, and a preparation method and application thereof. In order to develop a CD73mRNA drug based on a lipid nanoparticle delivery system, the invention takes CD73 as a target point to prepare mRNA for various tumors, meanwhile, based on the lipid nanoparticle delivery system, the designed mRNA can deliver the CD73mRNA to a body through the lipid nanoparticle delivery system, and the immune response of the body is activated by expressing CD73 protein as an antigen; meanwhile, the generation of adenosine in the tumor microenvironment can be inhibited, the immunosuppression state in the tumor microenvironment can be reduced, and the anti-tumor effect of the body immunity can be enhanced; the mRNA realizes the curative effect of killing tumor in various tumor models, and has no obvious toxic or side effect. In addition, the combination with the immune checkpoint inhibitor can obviously enhance the treatment effect on tumors, and has good application prospect.

title_clean: Express delivery commodity circulation packing box
abstract_clean: The invention provides an express logistics circulation packaging box which comprises a box body, an air bag, a plurality of air column units and a plurality of connecting assemblies, wherein the box body is provided with a containing cavity, the box body comprises a bottom plate, a top plate and a side plate for connecting the bottom plate and the top plate, and the side plate, the top plate and the bottom plate jointly enclose the containing cavity; the air bag is connected with the side plate of the box body and is provided with an inflation and deflation hole; the air column units are connected with the air bag and communicated with the air bag, and each air column unit at least comprises one air column; coupling assembling sets up in the one end that the gasbag was kept away from to the gas column, coupling assembling and gas column one-to-one, and relative gas column can be connected through coupling assembling to make a plurality of gas columns can be parallel or alternately, and then separate the chamber that holds of box for a plurality of accommodation space. The express logistics circulation packaging box can be repeatedly used, and transportation cost is reduced.

title_clean: Multi-station winding and unwinding device
abstract_clean: The embodiment of the invention provides a multi-station winding and unwinding device, and relates to the field of multi-station winding and unwinding. Aims to solve the problem of complex arrangement of an expansion shaft in a winding and unwinding device. The device comprises a turnover shaft, a plate body, a first expansion shaft, a second expansion shaft, a first sleeve, a second sleeve, a first driving piece and a second driving piece, wherein the plate body is fixed on the turnover shaft, the first expansion shaft and the second expansion shaft are arranged on the plate body, the first sleeve and the second sleeve are respectively and rotatably sleeved on the turnover shaft, the first driving piece, the first sleeve and the first expansion shaft are sequentially in transmission connection, and the second driving piece, the second sleeve and the second expansion shaft are sequentially in transmission connection. The rotary table and the plate body are not required to be arranged at the same time, the rotation and the position exchange of the first expansion shaft and the second expansion shaft can be realized, the structure is simplified, and the problem that the existing winding and unwinding device is required to be independently provided with the rotary table and the plate body is solved.

title_clean: Scoliosis biomechanical testing method
abstract_clean: The invention provides a scoliosis biomechanical testing method, which belongs to the technical field of scoliosis testing and comprises sheep scoliosis bending and nail rod implantation. The sheep backbone bending comprises the steps of intercepting sheep backbone, fixing end covers, connecting a translation tool and a clamping tool, driving middle vertebral bodies of the sheep backbone to move so as to bend the sheep backbone, loosening intervertebral discs with the largest bending degree, filling dental tray powder for fixing, and enabling sections above and below a sheep scoliosis position to be changed into vertical, wherein nail rod implantation comprises bone nail hole drilling, bone nail implantation and bar implantation. The invention selects sheep spines to simulate human spines, has higher similarity, completely simulates human scoliosis by bending and implanting the nail rods through specific steps, and is convenient for biomechanics test on the human scoliosis.

title_clean: Material turning coding machine and material turning coding method
abstract_clean: The application relates to the field of coding equipment and discloses a turning coding machine and a turning coding method, wherein the turning coding machine comprises a rack, a feeding device, a box moving device, a positioning device, a material moving device, a rotating assembly, a driving device and a coding mechanism, wherein the feeding device, the box moving device, the positioning device, the material moving device, the rotating assembly, the driving device and the coding mechanism are respectively connected with the rack, the feeding device is used for driving a box filled with materials to be transported, the box moving device is used for moving the box of the feeding device to the positioning device, the positioning device is used for calibrating the position of the box, the material moving device is used for moving the materials in the box positioned on the positioning device to the rotating assembly, the rotating assembly is used for driving the materials to be turned to a preset posture, the driving device is used for driving the rotating assembly to rotate, so that the materials turned to the preset posture can rotate to the adjacent position of the coding mechanism, and the coding mechanism is used for coding the materials turned to the preset posture. The application mainly solves the technical problem of how to code the end, far away from the cutter head, of the cutter.

title_clean: Environment-friendly energy-saving evaporative condenser
abstract_clean: The utility model belongs to the field of evaporative condensers, in particular to an environment-friendly energy-saving evaporative condenser, which aims at the problems that the prior evaporative condenser can not recycle the water which is not evaporated after being sprayed, wastes energy and is not environment-friendly and energy-saving, and the utility model provides a proposal that comprises a base, wherein the top of the base is fixedly connected with a condenser main body, a coil pipe is arranged in the condenser main body, the top of the base is fixedly connected with a fixed seat, the fixed seat is provided with a fixed cavity, the inner wall of the top of the fixed cavity is provided with a mounting groove, and the inner wall of the top of the mounting groove is fixedly connected with a driving motor, the utility model has reasonable structure and convenient operation, can lead the water to rock enough by leading a water tank to move transversely and repeatedly, lead the water to be mixed with the air conditioning quickly, improve the cooling efficiency, further save energy and recycle the sprayed water simultaneously, the energy is saved and the environment is protected.

title_clean: Condenser device with simplified structure
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a condenser device with a simplified structure, which comprises a condenser main body, an air inlet and an air outlet, wherein the left end surface of the condenser main body is provided with the air inlet, the right end surface of the condenser main body is provided with the air outlet, a temperature insulation component is arranged in the air outlet, a protective component is arranged on the air inlet, the temperature insulation component comprises a movable bin, a fixed block, an auxiliary rod, a rotating plate, an auxiliary groove, a check washer and a temperature insulation plate, the outer wall of the air outlet is provided with the movable bin, a plurality of groups of fixed blocks are fixed in the movable bin, the fixed blocks are fixedly connected with the auxiliary rod, the auxiliary rod is rotatably connected with the rotating plate, the rotating plate is internally provided with the auxiliary groove, the auxiliary rod is provided with a plurality of groups of check washers, the check washer is fixed on the check washer, and the air outlet can be ensured not to scald hands due to high temperature in the condenser main body when in use, the practicability of the device is improved.

title_clean: Down jacket down-proof cloth with function of preventing down from falling down to pile up and agglomerate
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a down jacket velvet fabric with a function of preventing down from falling down and piling up and agglomerating, which relates to the technical field of down jackets and comprises warp yarns, velvet fabric blanks and weft yarns, wherein the velvet fabric blanks are internally provided with weft yarn velvet and warp velvet, the weft yarn velvet and the warp velvet are firmly adsorbed with the velvet of the down, the down falling down and the agglomeration can be well solved, the weft yarn velvet and the warp velvet are arranged on both sides of the velvet fabric blanks, the velvet fabric blanks are directly scraped with glue, the weft yarn velvet and the warp velvet are respectively and directly adhered with the glue, the down jacket has the advantages that the down jacket has the reinforcing effect, the delamination risk is reduced, the velvet isolating cloth blank is subjected to the velvet scraping treatment, the outside cold air is isolated outside, the internal heat is locked, the outside is wetted during raining, the internal heat is prevented from losing, the effects of warming and water proofing are achieved, the velvet isolating cloth blank is subjected to the velvet scraping treatment during clothes washing, the internal velvet can be protected from being wetted completely, and the down jacket is protected.

title_clean: Breed with exhaust device that disinfects
abstract_clean: The invention provides a sterilizable exhaust device for breeding, which comprises a cage, wherein a plurality of fans are arranged on the wall body of the cage, each fan comprises a mounting frame and an air gathering barrel, fan blades are arranged in the air gathering barrel, a central rotating shaft of each fan blade is coaxially connected with a driving motor, a plurality of spray headers are arranged in the air gathering barrel, the spray headers are connected with a main pipe through branch pipes and a water pump and an ozone generator, each spray header comprises an inner pipe and a shell, bevel gears are fixedly arranged outside the inner pipes, the bevel gears are meshed with rotating rings rotatably connected to the outer wall of the air gathering barrel, each rotating ring is meshed with a rack at the bottom of the fan, and a filter plate. The invention has the beneficial effects that: reasonable in design, simple structure, safe and reliable, from taking spray disinfection, deodorization function.

title_clean: Image display system, non-transitory storage medium having stored therein image display program, image display apparatus, and image display method
abstract_clean: An example of an image display system includes a goggles apparatus and is capable of setting an angle of view of a virtual camera disposed in a virtual space to a first angle of view or a second angle of view smaller than the first angle of view. If the angle of view of the virtual camera is set to the first angle of view, the image display system sets a parallax between an image for a left eye and an image for a right eye to a first parallax. If the angle of view of the virtual camera is set to the second angle of view, the image display system sets the parallax between the image for a left eye and the image for a right eye to a second parallax smaller than the first parallax.

title_clean: Detection method, detection system and storage medium based on artificial intelligence early warning system
abstract_clean: The invention provides a detection method based on an artificial intelligence early warning system, which comprises the following steps: and classifying the monitored objects, and selecting corresponding artificial intelligence models according to the classified categories. And selecting a training sample, and training the selected artificial intelligence model by combining manual adjustment of the residual error overrun trigger threshold range of each measuring point. And applying the trained artificial intelligence model to the monitored object. The detection method based on the artificial intelligent early warning system can reduce the false alarm rate and the missing report rate of the early warning system, so that the early warning system can better play a role. The invention also provides a detection system and a storage medium for executing the detection method.

title_clean: Silica in rock samples
abstract_clean: A method comprises determining an amount of excess silica and/or an amount of terrigenous silica in a rock sample taking into account a measurement indicative of an amount of silica in the rock sample and a measurement indicative of an amount of zirconium in the rock sample.

title_clean: Commodity adjusting method and device in live broadcast process
abstract_clean: The invention provides a commodity adjusting method and a commodity adjusting device in a live broadcasting process, which relate to the technical field of live broadcasting marketing, and are characterized in that a first purchasing condition of a first commodity in a first live broadcasting e-commerce platform is obtained; determining a target user representation according to the first purchase condition; determining a first purchase preference based on the target user representation; determining a second item according to the first purchase preference; judging whether the second commodity meets a first preset condition or not; when the first preset condition is not met, the second commodities are listed in the first live-broadcast catalog, so that the technical problems that in the prior art, live-broadcast commodities are generally fixedly pushed and selected and commodity strategies cannot be adjusted in real time according to the live-broadcast sale condition, the live-broadcast shopping experience of a user is influenced are solved, the commodity strategies can be adjusted in real time according to the live-broadcast sale condition, and the technical effects of purchase desire and live-broadcast shopping experience of the user are greatly improved.

title_clean: Photothermal hydrophobic coating and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_clean: The disclosure relates to a photothermal hydrophobic coating, a preparation method and application thereof. The photothermal hydrophobic coating comprises a first component and a curing agent component; the first component comprises a modified nanoparticle material, a photothermal absorption conversion material, a resin material and a solvent, wherein the modified nanoparticle material comprises a nanoparticle matrix and a fluorosilane coupling agent modifier; the light-heat absorption conversion material is one or more selected from carbon-based light absorption materials and inorganic semiconductor materials; the curing agent component is one or more selected from isocyanate curing agents, amine curing agents, acid curing agents and anhydride curing agents. The photo-thermal hydrophobic coating provided by the disclosure has good photo-thermal absorption conversion efficiency and can play a good role in anti-icing or deicing.

title_clean: Preparation process of composite material based on resin transfer film
abstract_clean: The invention belongs to the technical field of imprinting, and particularly relates to a preparation process of a composite material based on a resin transfer film, which comprises the following steps: step 1, carrying out surface cleaning treatment on a glass substrate to be treated; step 2, selecting a proper resin transfer film, and processing the resin transfer film according to the required shape and size; step 3, coating a layer of adhesive on the surface of the base material treated in the step 1; step 4, attaching the resin transfer film to the adhesive of the glass substrate, and curing; and 5, finishing, polishing and painting according to the requirement to obtain a final product. The glass and the resin film are adhered by the special adhesive, so that the glass has more pattern types, and also has better adhesion, high temperature resistance, water resistance and scratch resistance; and the curing of the process adopts UV light curing, so that the overall production efficiency is improved.

title_clean: Silicone elastomer for hvdc
abstract_clean: The present invention relates to a cross-linked silicone elastomer, a method for producing same and its use in high voltage direct current (HVDC) applications.

title_clean: Nanofiber membrane preparation system based on electrostatic spinning
abstract_clean: The application discloses nanofiber membrane preparation system based on electrostatic spinning, including the injection apparatus who is used for storage and quantitative injection polymer solution, receiving arrangement to and anodal electricity even injection apparatus, the high-pressure generator of receiving arrangement is connected to the negative pole electricity, injection apparatus is including spraying the driver, with the pressure-equalizing box that sprays the driver intercommunication, pressure-equalizing box lower surface demountable seal installs a plurality of shower nozzles. The utility model has the advantages of difficult blockage of the spray head, low later maintenance cost and convenient replacement; and the spinning device can be suitable for spinning polymer solutions with different viscosities by heating the pressure equalizing box, and has strong practicability.

title_clean: Circularly polarized antenna and electronic device
abstract_clean: The patent refers to the field of 'electric digital data processing'. The circular polarized antenna comprises an annular radiator, a feed assembly and a second adjusting assembly, wherein the annular radiator consists of a plurality of arc-shaped radiation sections, adjacent arc-shaped radiation sections are connected through a first adjusting assembly, the first adjusting assembly adjusts capacitance parameters between the adjacent arc-shaped radiation sections, the feed assembly is connected with a feed point, the feed point is positioned at one end of one arc-shaped radiation section, the annular radiator and the feed assembly form a first frequency band antenna to receive signals of a first frequency, the second adjusting assembly is connected with a grounding point on the annular radiator, the second adjusting assembly adjusts equivalent length of the second frequency band antenna to enable the second frequency band antenna to receive signals of a second frequency, the grounding point is positioned on one arc-shaped radiation section, and the second frequency band antenna comprises the arc-shaped radiation sections between the feed point and the grounding point and the first adjusting assembly. The circularly polarized antenna provided by the embodiment of the application can solve the problem of limited radiation angle of the traditional circularly polarized antenna.

title_clean: Display device and method of fabricating the same
abstract_clean: A display device includes a substrate including a display area having first color subpixels and a transparent area inside the display area, an array layer in the display area on the substrate, a first electrode in the first color subpixels on the array layer, a first emission assisting layer on the first electrode, an emitting material layer in the first color subpixels on the first emission assisting layer, a second emission assisting layer on the emitting material layer, a deposition preventing layer in the transparent area on the second emission assisting layer, a second electrode on the second emission assisting layer, the second electrode selectively disposed in a region where the deposition preventing layer is not disposed, an encapsulating layer on the deposition preventing layer and the second electrode, a polarizing layer in the display area on the encapsulating layer, an auxiliary equipment in the transparent area under the substrate.

title_clean: Seamless double-woven fabric for filling down
abstract_clean: A seamless double-woven fabric for filling down includes a first fabric layer including first warps and first wefts, a second fabric layer including second warps and second wefts, and a coupling part to partition a down filling part formed between the first and second fabric layers into down filling spaces. The first warp and the second warp are formed so as to be crossed to each other one time or at least two times through a coupling weft. If the number of the coupling wefts is 2 n, wherein n is an integer of 1 or more, the first and second fabric layers are arranged to be crossed about the coupling part. If the number of the coupling wefts is 2 n+1, wherein n is an integer of 0 or more, the first and second fabric layers are arranged not to be crossed.

title_clean: Artificial cilium and arrays thereof
abstract_clean: An artificial cilium device includes a substrate and a voltage-actuated cilia-shaped structure attached at a proximal end to the substrate. The voltage-actuated cilia-shaped structure has a first layer of a first material and a second layer of a second material. The second layer of the second material includes an exposed surface that causes the cilia-shaped structure to, in a working medium, (a) change shape from a first shape to a second shape responsive to application of a first voltage and (b) change shape from the second shape to the first shape responsive to application of a second voltage different than the first voltage.

title_clean: Cloth net brake device of grass bundling machine
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a cloth net brake device of a grass bundling machine, which belongs to the technical field of the grass bundling machine. The net belt cutting device is characterized in that an auxiliary compression roller mechanism for clamping and pressing a net belt on a net conveying guide roller is arranged on a net distributing device frame, a cutter spring hook is hinged on a cutter arm and hung on the cutter spring mechanism on the net distributing device frame, a cutter resetting mechanism is arranged at the end part of the net distributing device frame, a self-locking electromagnetic brake disc fixed on the net distributing device frame is arranged at the shaft end on one side of the net conveying guide roller, a belt wheel mechanism connected with a rolling rod of a grass binding machine is arranged at the shaft end on the other side of the net conveying guide roller, a belt wheel sleeved at the shaft end of the rolling rod of the grass binding machine is an electromagnetic brake disc for clutching, the electromagnetic brake disc for clutching and the electromagnetic brake disc for self-locking are connected with an electrical system of the grass binding machine, the grass binding machine operates, the electromagnetic brake disc for clutching is used for attracting the clutch, the electromagnetic brake disc for self-locking is loosened, and the electromagnetic brake disc for self-locking is closed after a grass is packed for one circle.

title_clean: Multi-station winding and unwinding device
abstract_clean: The embodiment of the invention provides a multi-station winding and unwinding device, and relates to the field of multi-station winding and unwinding. Aims to solve the problem of complex arrangement of an expansion shaft in a winding and unwinding device. The device comprises a turnover shaft, a plate body, a first expansion shaft, a second expansion shaft, a first sleeve, a second sleeve, a first driving piece and a second driving piece, wherein the plate body is fixed on the turnover shaft, the first expansion shaft and the second expansion shaft are arranged on the plate body, the first sleeve and the second sleeve are respectively and rotatably sleeved on the turnover shaft, the first driving piece, the first sleeve and the first expansion shaft are sequentially in transmission connection, and the second driving piece, the second sleeve and the second expansion shaft are sequentially in transmission connection. The rotary table and the plate body are not required to be arranged at the same time, the rotation and the position exchange of the first expansion shaft and the second expansion shaft can be realized, the structure is simplified, and the problem that the existing winding and unwinding device is required to be independently provided with the rotary table and the plate body is solved.

title_clean: Handgun cartridge with shear groove bullet
abstract_clean: A rimless cartridge comprising a case and a bullet mounted therein. In embodiments, the bullet comprises a jacket having a cylindrical body portion, an ogive portion, and a plurality of longitudinally extending paths of weakness formed in the ogive portion and defining petals there between and extending rearward from the mouth. The bullet includes a malleable core mounted within the jacket. The bullet further comprises a circumferential groove between forward and rearward circumferential indentations imparted in the body portion of the jacket.

title_clean: Cap assembly and joint pipe including the same
abstract_clean: The present invention relates to a fixing cap assembly capable of maintaining the connection of a pipe by strong binding power while facilitating connection work between the pipe and a target main body (for example, a joint pipe, a wastewater receiver, and a small manhole) to which the pipe must be connected and a joint pipe including the same. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the fixing cap assembly comprises: a fixing cap fastened to a connection portion of a main body to which at least one pipe is connected, and fixing the gap between the main body and the pipe; a washer positioned in the fixing cap, compressing a sealing member (120) interposed between the main body and the pipe as the fixing cap is fastened, and allowing the diameter thereof to be contracted and restored in a radial direction; and a binding member including a plurality of tooth-shaped protrusions fixing the pipe by pressing the outer circumferential surface of the pipe as the washer contracts, and radially protruding from the inner circumferential surface of the washer toward the outer circumferential surface of the pipe.

title_clean: Semi-solid continuous pulping system
abstract_clean: The invention provides a semi-solid continuous pulping system which comprises a large-quantity heat preservation furnace, a small-quantity heat preservation furnace, stirring equipment and a die-casting island, wherein an extraction pipeline is arranged between the large-quantity heat preservation furnace and the small-quantity heat preservation furnace, and a conveying pipeline is arranged between the small-quantity heat preservation furnace and the die-casting island. The alloy melt is extracted from the large holding furnace to the small holding furnace, the small holding furnace is utilized to improve the holding precision, and the pipeline extraction is used for transferring and transporting the slurry, so that Shang Dengxiang-closing mobile transportation equipment in the traditional pulping process is reduced, the preparation cost is reduced, and the operation is simple; the semi-solid preparation method can be used for continuously pulping, so that the pulping time is greatly saved, the production and preparation efficiency is improved, and purer alloy melt can be extracted to prepare the pulp by the method, so that the die casting with higher quality is obtained.

title_clean: Heat pump system for vehicle
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a heat pump system for a vehicle, comprising: a cooling device including a radiator and a multi-way valve connected through a first cooling water line, and circulating cooling water in the first cooling water line; a second cooling water line including a first end and a second end connected to the multi-way valve and equipped with a first water pump and an electrical component; a third cooling water line including a first end and a second end connected to the multi-way valve and equipped with a second water pump and a battery module; a cooler provided on the third cooling water line, connected to a refrigerant line of the air conditioner through a refrigerant connection line, and adjusting a temperature of cooling water circulating in the third cooling water line; and a gas injection device that selectively expands the refrigerant and selectively supplies some of the refrigerant to the compressor.

title_clean: Compressed air blower for odontological intraoral scanner end-piece
abstract_clean: The invention relates to a compressed air blower (10) formed by a pair of coupled cannulas (11A) and (11B) in the body of the end-piece (22) of the odontological scanner (20), which form a region (RL) around the opening (22B) free of any flow of saliva (F1), blood (S1) or any other fluid, as a region (RL) for collecting data and obtaining tri-dimensional/bi-dimensional undistorted images (IG) of the mouth region of the patient (PC) by means of air jets (AR) from openings (11a3) and (11b3) in the cannulas (11A) and (11B).

title_clean: Thermal liquid container system
abstract_clean: A thermal liquid container system comprising a main body, a phase change material (PCM) liner disposed within the main body having a PCM disposed therein, a liquid reservoir defined by PCM liner, a liquid dispensing partition disposed within the liquid reservoir such that the liquid reservoir is partitioned into a temperature conditioning channel and a liquid retention chamber, and a lid comprising a liquid ingress and a liquid dispensing opening, the temperature conditioning channel for placing a liquid passing therethrough in thermal contact with the PCM whereby thermal energy is exchanged between the liquid flowing through the temperature conditioning channel and the PCM such that the liquid is dispensed at a temperature that is within a desired temperature range determined by the selected PCM melting temperature.

title_clean: Improvements in biological conversion and product recovery processes
abstract_clean: The invention provides a process for reducing bio-catalytic oxidation of a product in a post-production stream. More particularly the invention provides a process for reducing bio-catalytic oxidation of an alcohol in a product stream, the product stream comprising an alcohol product, dissolved carbon dioxide, and at least one enzyme capable of oxidizing the alcohol. The invention finds applicability in fermentation processes, wherein a C1-fixing microorganism utilizes a C1-containing substrate to produce a fermentation product.

title_clean: Porous silicon material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_clean: The invention provides a porous silicon material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) Melt mixing a silicon source and a lithium source to obtain a melt mixture; (2) Carrying out lithium removal on the molten mixture to obtain a lithium removal product; (3) And carrying out heat treatment on the lithium removal product to obtain the porous silicon material. The invention provides a preparation method with low cost, simple process and low energy consumption, and the formed silicon nano-sheets can be radially arranged in honeycomb shape in all directions of particles through lithium attachment and lithium removal to form a controllable isotropic channelized porous silicon structure. The porous silicon material prepared based on the method not only can adapt to the volume change of silicon, but also can obviously promote the rapid transmission of lithium ions, so that the material utilization and capacity exertion are not limited by particle orientation, and the porous silicon material has high surface capacity, high rate performance and excellent cycling stability, has good industrial application prospect, and can realize large-scale production.

title_clean: Coumarin fluorescent probe based on benzoxazole derivative and application thereof
abstract_clean: The invention belongs to the field of chemical analysis and test, and particularly relates to a coumarin fluorescent probe based on a benzoxazole derivative and application thereof. 7-hydroxy-4-methylcoumarin-3-acetic acid and 6-bromobenzo [ d ] oxazole are dissolved in dimethyl sulfoxide solution, and the reaction solution is heated and refluxed for 3-4 hours at 70-90 ℃ under the alkaline condition of potassium carbonate. And separating and purifying the crude product by a thin layer chromatography to obtain the coumarin fluorescent probe SYL-4 based on the benzoxazole derivative. The coumarin fluorescent probe obtained by the invention can rapidly identify Biogenic Amine (BAs) in Cetyl Trimethyl Ammonium Bromide (CTAB) surfactant aqueous solution.

title_clean: Method for preparing double-layer halide perovskite film using eco-friendly solvent, perovskite film prepared thereby and energy harvesting device comprising same
abstract_clean: The present invention relates to a method for preparing a halide perovskite film having a double-layer structure and excellent piezoelectric performance by using an eco-friendly solvent, a perovskite film prepared by using the same, and an energy harvesting device comprising the same. In the present invention, by using lactate ester and monoterpene, which are eco-friendly solvents, as solvents of the halide perovskite precursor, the perovskite layers can be stably formed, and a perovskite film having very excellent piezoelectric performance can be prepared according to the formation of a double-layer structure of a three-dimensional perovskite and a zero-dimensional perovskite. Therefore, by using the present invention, an environmental pollution problem caused by the use of a solvent during the formation of the perovskite film can be solved, and the piezoelectric performance of the film can be greatly improved through optimization of materials and structure.

title_clean: Antibacterial peptide WR and hyaluronic acid coating substance and application thereof
abstract_clean: The invention provides an antibacterial peptide WR and a hyaluronic acid coating and application thereof, wherein the sequence of the antibacterial peptide WR is shown as SEQID No. 1; simultaneously provides the application of the antibacterial peptide in preparing the medicine for treating gram-negative bacteria or/and gram-positive bacteria infectious diseases; adding anionic hyaluronic acid into the solution containing the antibacterial peptide WR with the self-assembled nano structure to perform electrostatic bonding to prepare the coating. Simultaneously provides the application of the coating material in preparing the medicine for treating the infectious diseases of gram-negative bacteria or/and gram-positive bacteria in the environment of protease. The antibacterial peptide has very low hemolytic activity and eukaryotic cytotoxicity, and the enzymatic stability of the antibacterial peptide coated with the anionic hyaluronic acid is detected, and the antibacterial peptide is not completely inactivated in the presence of 0.1mg/ml papain. In conclusion, the antibacterial peptide has higher application value and has the prospect of replacing feed antibiotics.

title_clean: FAP inhibitor
abstract_clean: The present invention relates to a compound of formula (I), a pharmaceutical composition comprising or consisting of said compound, a kit comprising or consisting of said compound or pharmaceutical composition and use of the compound or pharmaceutical composition in the diagnosis or treatment of a disease characterised by overexpression of fibroblast activation protein (FAP).

title_clean: Methods Of Treating Fabry Patients Having Renal Impairment
abstract_clean: Provided are methods for treatment of Fabry disease in patients having HEK assay amenable mutations in α-galactosidase A. Certain methods comprise administering migalastat or a salt thereof every other day, such as administering about 150 mg of migalastat hydrochloride every other day.

title_clean: Composition comprising polysulfide compound
abstract_clean: To provide a composition comprising a polysulfide compound improved in stability or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, a stability improver of a polysulfide compound or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof and a method for improving the stability of a polysulfide compound or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof.SOLUTION: There can be provided a composition comprising a polysulfide compound improved in stability or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof by allowing one or more compounds selected from the group consisting of a polysulfide compound or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, a stabilizer and an unsaturated hydrocarbon compound to coexist.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_clean: Air conditioner, control method and device thereof and readable storage medium
abstract_clean: The invention discloses an air conditioner control method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring the current total current of the electricity environment where the air conditioner is located and acquiring the target frequency of the last frequency reduction operation of the air conditioner; when the total current is in a preset interval, determining the current target frequency of the air conditioner according to the total current and the target frequency of the last frequency reduction operation; and reducing the operating frequency of the air conditioner according to the determined target frequency. The invention also discloses an air conditioner control device, an air conditioner and a readable storage medium. The invention is closer to the operating characteristic of the circuit on-off device, improves the effective utilization degree of the electric quantity in the power utilization environment, and more reliably prevents the circuit on-off device from tripping.

title_clean: Detection method, detection system and storage medium based on artificial intelligence early warning system
abstract_clean: The invention provides a detection method based on an artificial intelligence early warning system, which comprises the following steps: and classifying the monitored objects, and selecting corresponding artificial intelligence models according to the classified categories. And selecting a training sample, and training the selected artificial intelligence model by combining manual adjustment of the residual error overrun trigger threshold range of each measuring point. And applying the trained artificial intelligence model to the monitored object. The detection method based on the artificial intelligent early warning system can reduce the false alarm rate and the missing report rate of the early warning system, so that the early warning system can better play a role. The invention also provides a detection system and a storage medium for executing the detection method.

title_clean: Method and system for evaluating thixotropy and structural recovery capability of slurry
abstract_clean: The application discloses a method and a system for evaluating thixotropy and structural restoration capability of slurry. The method comprises the steps of determining 1 test geometric matrix containing m multiplied by n combinations, respectively adopting the m multiplied by n combinations to carry out standard test to obtain eta-t recovery curves of the combinations, analyzing all the eta-t recovery curves, and extracting quantization parameters, wherein the quantization parameters comprise initial recovery viscosity eta 0, pre-shear viscosity eta initial, final recovery viscosity eta final, recovery degree R and recovery rate constant k, constructing 1 thixotropic index matrix, and evaluating the thixotropic property and structural recovery capacity of the slurry according to the recovery degree R% and the recovery rate constant k in the thixotropic index matrix. The application has the following technical effects of breaking through the limitation of single measurement geometry, improving the comprehensiveness and accuracy of evaluation, definitely prescribing a unified standard test flow, and remarkably improving the consistency and repeatability of test results.

title_clean: Enterprise energy intelligent monitoring analysis method and system based on multidimensional analysis
abstract_clean: The invention discloses an enterprise energy intelligent monitoring analysis method and system based on multidimensional analysis, which relate to the technical field of industrial energy efficiency management and realize dynamic sensing of environmental states in a steam pipe network area by collecting environmental disturbance data and constructing an environmental disturbance data set S and combining a thermal-wet transition index YQ and a pressure disturbance coefficient Meanwhile, the latent heat loss index Qr and the comprehensive risk score PF are introduced, quantitative analysis and risk level grading response are carried out on energy leakage of a steam pipe network, and the system has higher abnormality identification precision and risk early warning reliability through fusing environment, structure and energy consumption multidimensional factors, so that the intelligent monitoring and active management and control capability of an enterprise energy system is improved.

title_clean: Viaduct protection alarm device
abstract_clean: The utility model provides a viaduct protection alarm device, including supporting structure, supporting structure sets up on being close to the fixed knot structure of this one side of building under construction, and supporting structure extends the setting to the lateral surface of fixed knot structure (1), and this one end that supporting structure set up at fixed knot structure (1) lateral surface is connected with anticollision guard plate (2), is connected through shock absorber (3) between supporting structure and anticollision guard plate (2), and supporting structure's top sets up audible alarm equipment (4). The utility model discloses not only can carry out the early warning to colliding with the thing, can also reduce the collision impact force, and need not great space, simple to operate.

title_clean: Component rotating device of steel structure building
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to a steel construction building technical field, especially a component rotating device of steel construction building, comprising a base plate, the slide opening has all been seted up in the four corners of bottom plate top surface, the inner wall sliding connection of slide opening has flexible post, the bottom fixedly connected with buffering foot of flexible post, damping spring has been cup jointed to the outer wall of flexible post, the equal fixedly connected with backplate in both sides at bottom plate top surface middle part. The utility model has the advantages that: through having set up the spliced pole, one side fixedly connected with drive gear that the spliced pole is close to spacing bearing, a side fixedly connected with rolling bearing that the spliced pole is close to the roof, rolling bearing's outer wall fixedly connected with transmission case, one side rotation that the transmission incasement wall is close to drive gear is connected with the lead screw, drive gear and lead screw intermeshing and, can mesh with drive gear through the lead screw, thereby realize the rotation of steel, and the lead screw has the locking effect to drive gear, turned angle is more accurate, adjust more stably.

title_clean: Domestic massage armchair with projection playing function
abstract_clean: The utility model belongs to the technical field of domestic massage armchair, especially, be a domestic massage armchair with projection instant music, including massage armchair body and second spring, the intermediate position of massage armchair body is provided with the cushion, and the distolateral end of cushion installs first connecting axle to the outside of first connecting axle is provided with the back, the ejector pin is installed in the outside of back, and the end department of ejector pin is connected with first spring to the fixed block is installed to the bottom of first spring, the second spring sets up in the inside of massage armchair body, and the end department of second spring is connected with the baffle to the top of baffle is fixed with the lug, the below of baffle is provided with the chuck, and the intermediate position of chuck installs the gyro wheel to the below of gyro wheel is provided with the projector, the bottom of projector is fixed with the pinion rack. This domestic massage armchair with projection instant music, the user of being convenient for projection broadcast film, and be convenient for provide cushioning effect for the back, improve massage armchair's travelling comfort.

title_clean: Bracket capable of being adjusted rapidly
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to the technical field of brackets and discloses a bracket capable of being quickly adjusted, which comprises a movable shell, wherein the inner side of the movable shell is movably connected with a bracket body, the bracket also comprises a cover plate and a supporting block, connecting rods are vertically and fixedly arranged on two sides of the lower surface of the cover plate, and the bottom ends of the two groups of connecting rods are fixedly connected with two sides of the upper surface of the bracket body respectively. According to the utility model, through the combination of the cover plate, the handle, the connecting rod and the connecting groove, the bracket body can be pulled to move upwards in the movable shell, the use height of the bracket body is adjusted, the screw rod is reversely rotated, the supporting block can be driven to be retracted into the sliding groove, the bracket body and the insulation resistance tester can be further retracted into the movable shell under the action of gravity, the through groove is blocked by the cover plate, and the problems of inconvenience in accommodating the insulation resistance tester and adjustment of the use position of the existing bracket can be solved.

title_clean: Detachable protective cover for water supply equipment
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to the technical field of water supply equipment protection and discloses a detachable protective cover for water supply equipment, which comprises a base and a shell, wherein the shell is arranged at the top of the base, the bottom of the shell is fixedly connected with a positioning block, the positioning block is slidably connected to the middle part of the base, a spring is fixedly connected to the inside of the base, the other end of the spring is fixedly connected with a clamping block, the clamping block is contacted with the positioning block, a clamping groove is formed in the middle part of the positioning block, the clamping groove is in plug-in fit with the clamping block, a disassembling assembly is rotatably connected to the middle part of the base, the disassembling assembly comprises a rotating rod, and the rotating rod is rotatably connected to the middle part of the base. According to the utility model, the shell can be installed by only inserting the positioning block into the base, and the shell can be disassembled by rotating the rotating rod, so that the labor intensity of staff is reduced, and the convenience in assembling and disassembling the protective cover is improved.

title_clean: Electrical equipment protection device convenient to heat dissipation
abstract_clean: The utility model provides an electrical equipment protection device convenient for heat dissipation, which comprises a box body and a second fan, wherein the upper end of the box body is fixedly connected with a rain shelter, the second fan is arranged at the upper end in the box body, window holes are arranged at the left and right ends of the box body, a first clamping groove is arranged at the upper end of the window hole, a second clamping groove is arranged at the lower end of the window hole, a spring is fixedly connected with the upper end of the second clamping groove, a ventilation mechanism is clamped in the first clamping groove and the second clamping groove, the spring is movably connected with the ventilation mechanism, a bottom plate is fixedly connected with the lower end of the box body, a first filter screen is fixedly connected with the lower end of the bottom plate, and a fan hole is; through setting up heat dissipation mechanism, can make outside air inhale inside the box when the inside temperature of box risees, through the rotation of first fan with the second fan, the inside high-temperature gas that produces by electrical equipment of box passes through heat dissipation mechanism, flows from the air outlet, reaches the radiating effect.

title_clean: New energy automobile charges anti-drop mechanism
abstract_clean: The invention relates to the technical field of new energy automobiles, in particular to a new energy automobile charging anti-falling mechanism. The utility model provides a new energy automobile anti-drop mechanism that charges, is including setting up the charging head on charging gun and setting up the charging seat in the car mouth that charges, the lateral wall of charging gun is provided with the protection machanism that is used for protecting the charging head, and is provided with the anti-drop mechanism that prevents charging head drop in the charging process between charging head and the charging seat. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: this kind of new energy automobile anti-drop mechanism that charges can avoid charging the head and drop from the charging seat when charging, and the atress is more even for anti-drop effect is better, simultaneously, avoids its damage, and can carry out self-sealing protection to charging the head after charging the completion, avoids outside water stain and impurity such as dust to get into its inside easily, guarantees its result of use and life.

title_clean: Conveniently carry out heating furnace roof structure of dismouting
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a heating furnace top structure convenient for disassembly and assembly, in particular to the technical field of heating furnaces, comprising a furnace body, wherein the top end of the furnace body is provided with a furnace top, the bottom end of the furnace top is fixedly connected with two second insert blocks, and the bottom ends of the two second insert blocks are inserted into the side wall of the top of the furnace body; a plurality of telescopic parts are fixed on the outer side surface of the furnace body, and the telescopic end of each telescopic part is detachably connected with the furnace top; each telescopic part is fixedly connected with the vertical plate, and the vertical plate is fixedly connected with the outer side surface of the furnace body through a transverse plate at the bottom of the vertical plate. The second insert block is arranged at the bottom of the furnace top, so that the second insert block is inserted into the side wall of the top of the furnace body when the furnace top is placed on the furnace body, and the furnace body and the furnace top are preliminarily fixed; then set up a plurality of pars contractilis that can dismantle with the furnace roof and be connected outside the furnace body, further fix furnace body and furnace roof through a plurality of pars contractilis, easy operation makes things convenient for the dismouting.

title_clean: Film pasting device for processing paper cutlery box
abstract_clean: The utility model provides a film pasting device for processing paper cutlery boxes, which comprises a support frame, wherein a conveyor belt is arranged in the support frame, a plurality of paper cutlery boxes are placed on the conveyor belt, a positioning structure is arranged in the support frame, a glue box is fixed in the support frame, a glue spraying structure is arranged on the glue box, a pressing block is slidably matched in the support frame, an air cavity is arranged in the pressing block, a heating structure is arranged in the air cavity, a cutting structure is arranged on the periphery of the pressing block, a waste roller and a film material roller are rotatably matched in the support frame, a film material is coiled on the periphery of the film material roller, and the film material corresponds to the waste roller. According to the utility model, the positioning structure is arranged in the support frame, so that the paper cutlery box can be positioned, the film material can be contacted with the paper cutlery box, the film pasting is convenient, the heating structure is arranged in the air cavity, the glue spraying structure is arranged on the glue box, the glue box can be used for pasting films of different types, the application range of the device is enlarged, and the air cavity can be used for blowing air to enable the film material to be pressed down, so that the film pasting is performed.

title_clean: Roof rainwater collecting and processing device
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to the technical field of rainwater treatment, and discloses a roof rainwater collecting and treating device, which comprises: the top end of the main body is fixedly provided with a water inlet; the right end of the main body is fixedly provided with a fixed box filtering mechanism which is arranged in the main body; the driving mechanism is arranged in the fixed box, and the first motor is fixedly arranged at the top end of the fixed box. According to the utility model, the sliding block moves in the circular ring, the circular ring can be pushed in the sliding block moving process, the circular ring drives the pushing rod to move, the pushing rod drives the pushing plate to move, the pushing plate drives the filter box to move in the first moving groove, the filter box moves out of the main body, then the filter box is pulled out of the main body by an operator, and finally the filter box can be quickly taken out by driving the pushing plate to move, so that the phenomenon that the bolt is fixed by a bolt, rust is caused, and the bolt slides is avoided.

title_clean: Deep sea biodiversity monitoring is with filtering sampling device based on eDNA
abstract_clean: The application discloses an eDNA-based filtering and sampling device for monitoring deep sea biodiversity, which relates to the technical field of marine sediment sampling, and is characterized in that an unmanned submarine provided with a suction device is used for operation, a motor-driven fixing piece is arranged at the bottom of the submarine, an electric push rod is rotatably connected with a container shell to control the displacement of a box body piece, a sampling assembly arranged on the box body piece is composed of a rotatable fan-shaped end body, a middle body and a tail body, the rotatable fan-shaped end body, the middle body and the tail body are connected through a fixed shaft, isolation films are formed between the parts to form an isolation space, the end body, the middle body and the tail body are controlled to rotate through a miniature motor, so that the sampling assembly can twist into a coral reef to sample sediment, a sampling hose is fixed in the sampling assembly, the tail end of the sampling assembly is communicated with the suction device of the submarine, a separation net is arranged at a sampling port to filter large-particle sand stone, and a camera is arranged at the top of the end body, so that sediment inside the coral reef is conveniently observed.

title_clean: Fertile for production fermenting installation of liquid of adaptation various environment
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a fermentation device for producing liquid fertilizer, which is suitable for various environments and comprises: the upper side of the left end of the fermentation box is fixedly connected with an upper bin in a Z-shaped structure, the inner side of the upper bin is connected with a first spiral conveying rod in a clamping manner, and the upper side of the first spiral conveying rod is connected with an output shaft of a first motor; the water containing tank is positioned on the inner sides of the lower ends of the fermentation tank and the upper storage bin, and a water suction pump communicated with the water containing tank is arranged on the front side of the water containing tank; and the temperature sensor is embedded and installed on the inner side of the upper left end of the fermentation box. This adapted to various environment's fermenting installation for liquid fertilizer production is convenient for go up unloading to the device, and is convenient for add water, heat and add oxygen to the fermenting case, makes the fertile production of liquid of the adaptable various environment of device, is convenient for carry out even heating and even stirring to the fertile raw materials of liquid, makes it ferment effectually to and be convenient for filter the liquid fertilizer after the fermentation.

title_clean: Resource scheduling method, device and equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_clean: The invention provides a resource scheduling method, a resource scheduling device, resource scheduling equipment and a readable storage medium, relates to the technical field of computers, and aims to solve the problem of low algorithm operation stability in practice. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that an algorithm platform receives task expectation information of a target analysis task sent by a user; the algorithm platform identifies an expected state of the target analysis task based on the task expected information, wherein the expected state comprises addition, modification or cancellation; the algorithm platform acquires the number of analysis tasks of the currently and actually executed analysis tasks of the target algorithm corresponding to the target analysis task; under the condition that the expected state is newly increased or modified, the algorithm platform performs container expansion on the target algorithm under a first condition according to the number of the analysis tasks; and under the condition that the expected state is cancelled, the algorithm platform performs container reduction on the target algorithm under a second condition according to the number of the analysis tasks. The invention can improve the stability of the operation of the algorithm.

title_clean: Information transmitting and receiving method and device, communication device and storage medium
