abstract_clean: The present disclosure relates to an information transmitting and receiving method and device, a communication device, and a storage medium, wherein the information transmitting method includes: and sending first indication information to a network element of a core network, wherein the first indication information is used for indicating the communication device to determine information of an artificial intelligent model used by the position related information of the terminal. According to the method and the device, the communication device can send the first indication information to the network element of the core network, the communication device is indicated to determine the information of the artificial intelligent model used by the position related information of the terminal through the first indication information, so that the network element of the core network can timely learn the artificial intelligent model used by the communication device, and proper management is further carried out on the artificial intelligent model.

title_clean: Virtual infrastructure manager enhancements for remote edge cloud deployments
abstract_clean: A system is provided that includes one management cluster to manage network function virtualization infrastructure (NFVI) resources lifecycle in more than one edge POD locations, where resources include hardware and/or software, and where software resources lifecycle includes software development, upgrades, downgrades, logging, monitoring etc. Methods are provided for decoupling storage from compute and network functions in each virtual machine (VM)-based NFVI deployment location and moving it to a centralized location. Centralized storage could simultaneously interact with more than one edge PODs, and the security is built-in with periodic key rotation. Methods are provided for increasing NFVI system viability by dedicating (fencing) CPU core pairs for specific controller operations and workload operations, and sharing the CPU cores for specific tasks.

title_clean: Methods and apparatus for wireless communication using pre-configured uplink resources
abstract_clean: A method for wireless communication at a user equipment, UE, includes receiving an uplink control channel configuration including a repetition level indicator and a resource indicator for transmitting uplink control channel transmissions while in an idle mode, transitioning from a connected mode to an idle mode, determining a number of repetitions and a set of resources for transmitting uplink control channel transmissions in the idle mode based at least in part on the uplink control channel configuration, and transmitting uplink control channel transmissions according to the number of repetitions and the set of resources while in the idle mode.

title_clean: Sensor assembly and mobile terminal
abstract_clean: The invention provides a sensor assembly and a mobile terminal. The sensor component comprises at least one light emitter and at least one light receiver, wherein each light receiver at least corresponds to one light receiver; each optical transmitter is provided with an emergent surface for emitting optical signals, and the optical signals are reflected by barriers to form reflection signals; each light receiver is provided with a light incident surface for receiving corresponding reflection signals, and the included angle between the light emergent surface and the light incident surface at one side of the emergent light signals is less than 180 degrees. In the mobile terminal provided by the invention, the included angle of less than 180 degrees is formed between the light emitting surface of the light emitter and the light incident surface of the light receiver, so that the quantity of light signals received by the light receiver can be increased, and the detection sensitivity can be improved.

title_clean: Image processing apparatus and method, image capturing apparatus, control method therefor, and storage medium
abstract_clean: The invention provides an image processing apparatus and method, an image capturing apparatus, a control method thereof, and a storage medium. The image processing apparatus includes an acquisition section configured to acquire a plurality of different viewpoint images obtained by capturing the same scene from different viewpoints, and configured to acquire at least one parallax image pair having parallax by pupil division, a first generation section configured to generate a first distance image from the parallax image pair, a second generation section configured to generate a second distance image from the plurality of different viewpoint images, and an integration section configured to integrate the first distance image and the second distance image and generate an integrated distance image.

title_clean: Dome lens and guard ring for single photon avalanche diode photodetectors and related methods
abstract_clean: The present disclosure relates to dome-shaped lenses and guard rings for single photon avalanche diode photodetectors and related methods. A structure includes at least one Single Photon Avalanche Diode (SPAD), at least one dome lens located over each SPAD, and a metal guard ring surrounding each SPAD. A front side illuminated SPAD photodetector and method of forming the structure are also provided. The dome-shaped lens increases SPAD efficiency in light detection probability (PDP) and light absorption with a minimum area increase together with the metal guard ring.

title_clean: A method and an apparatus for processing a video signal
abstract_clean: The present invention is to improve the coding efficiency of a video signal. The present invention provides a simplified method for determining motion vector precision. The method and device for processing a video signal according to the present invention may improve image encoding/decoding efficiency.

title_clean: Raman spectrum-based medicine efficacy and action mechanism prediction method and system
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting drug efficacy and action mechanism based on Raman spectrum, and relates to the technical field of drug efficacy prediction, wherein the method comprises the following steps of preparing a sample to be detected, and carrying out Raman spectrum scanning on the sample to be detected to obtain corresponding Raman spectrum data; the method comprises the steps of processing Raman spectrum data to form a spectrum data set, dividing the spectrum data set to obtain a corresponding training set and a corresponding test set, constructing a prediction model, training the prediction model by utilizing the training set, evaluating the prediction effect of the prediction model by utilizing the test set, acquiring sample data of other medicines, inputting the sample data into the prediction model for prediction, analyzing cells or cell secretions stimulated by different types of immune medicines by a machine learning algorithm, and establishing a Raman spectrum database and model of the different types of medicines, thereby providing powerful support for research and development of the immune medicines and further mechanism exploration.

title_clean: Pre-targeting strategies for molecular imaging and/or radioimmunotherapy
abstract_clean: The present invention provides a method of targeted molecular imaging and/or targeted drug delivery, wherein two components or probes each interacts with one or more biomarkers on a cell and separately interact with each other to form a stable bond, such as a stable covalent bond. In certain non-limiting embodiments, at least one of the probes is photo-triggered to allow for bonding with at least one second probe. In certain non-limiting embodiments, the cell is a tumor or cancer cell. The present invention also relates to compounds, probes, and kits for use in targeted molecular imaging and/or targeted drug delivery.

title_clean: Method for estimating factor of blood coagulation abnormality
abstract_clean: Provided is a method for estimating a factor causing an abnormality in coagulation of a blood sample. In the method, 1) a parameter Ps relating to a coagulation reaction in a sample S and a parameter Pm relating to a coagulation reaction in a sample M are calculated, 2) an estimation as to whether the sample S is coagulation-factor-inhibitor-positive is carried out on the basis of Ps, and 3) a sample S that is not estimated to be coagulation-factor-inhibitor-positive in 2) is estimated to be lupus-anticoagulant-positive or coagulation-factor-deficient on the basis of Pm or on the basis of Ps and Pm. The sample S is a test blood sample having an extended coagulation time, the sample M is a mixed sample of the sample S and a sample N, and the sample N is a normal blood sample. Ps is calculated on the basis of a measurement point or time at which a coagulation reaction curve or a coagulation speed curve of the sample S reaches a prescribed value, and Pm is calculated on the basis of a measurement point or time at which a coagulation reaction curve or a coagulation speed curve of the sample M reaches a prescribed value.

title_clean: External reference for quantitative PCR detection of nucleic acids in plasma
abstract_clean: The invention provides an external reference (PLACON) for measuring the content of nucleic acid in blood plasma, a template sequence containing the external reference, a reverse transcription primer, a PCR primer, a detection kit, a using method of the kit and application of the kit in preparation of a product for detecting the nucleic acid in the blood plasma.

title_clean: Nutritional composition for safely and efficiently dissolving thrombus and lipid plaque
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a nutritional composition for safely and efficiently dissolving thrombus and lipid plaques, which comprises the following components in parts by weight: 10-20 parts of natto freeze-dried powder, 6-15 parts of red yeast rice, 10-15 parts of sheep heart peptide, 6-10 parts of honeysuckle, 6-10 parts of kudzu root powder and 1-2 parts of taurine. The nutritional composition can be converted into a product for preventing and treating cardiovascular and cerebrovascular basic diseases, and is suitable for hyperlipidemia, blood viscosity, atherosclerosis, plaque formation, blood supply insufficiency of heart, brain and whole body tissues caused by vascular stenosis and hypertension due to plaque, and the like.

title_clean: Preparation method of filamentous fungus-derived PDRN product, product and application thereof
abstract_clean: The invention relates to a preparation method of a filamentous fungus-derived PDRN product, and a product and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of suspending a filamentous fungus mycelium in a buffer solution for homogenization treatment, and then mixing and incubating the mycelium with glycoside hydrolase, protease and ribonuclease to obtain an enzymolysis mixed solution; centrifuging the enzymolysis mixed solution after high-temperature and high-pressure treatment, collecting supernatant, passing the supernatant through an ultrafiltration membrane, removing sediment from filtrate by adopting a sodium acetate ethanol precipitation method, collecting supernatant, carrying out ethanol precipitation treatment on the supernatant, and collecting sediment to obtain the filamentous fungus-derived PDRN product. The preparation process realizes the large-scale preparation of the high-yield high-purity small-molecular-weight PDRN with narrow molecular weight distribution range from the filamentous fungi for the first time, and the filamentous fungi-derived PDRN product has extremely high skin permeability and bioavailability, can more effectively penetrate through the skin stratum corneum, and plays a plurality of biological effects.

title_clean: Delosperma plant named ‘Dancing Embers’
abstract_clean: A new and distinct cultivar of Delosperma plant named ‘Dancing Embers’ is disclosed, characterized by abundant, large, reddish-orange flowers with a reddish-purple eye and cream centers occurring throughout the plant. Plants have a low, mounding habit, and are tolerant to at least USDA zone 6 as well as high heat and drought conditions. The new plant is useful for its bright flowers and low habit in the landscape garden or as a container plant.

title_clean: Yimu kang granule and production process thereof
abstract_clean: The application relates to the field of Chinese patent medicines, and in particular discloses a Yimu kang granule and a production process thereof, wherein the production process of the Yimu kang granule comprises the following steps: s1, preparing an extract to obtain the extract; s2, crushing, S3 granulating and S4 drying: continuously adding 95-100deg.C water after granulating, and drying to water content of 4-5%; s5, sieving, granulating, S6, mixing, subpackaging, S7 and packaging; by adjusting various parameters of the production process of the beneficial effects and the types and the doping amounts of various raw materials, the active content and the uniformity of the obtained beneficial effects particles are respectively 83.4-83.8% and 96.98-98.75%, and the appearance and the properties of the beneficial effects particles at the end of month 12, 18, 24 and 30 are complete and hard, so that the beneficial effects have better uniformity and stability.

title_clean: Energy-independent variable air volume system
abstract_clean: An energy independent variable air volume system comprises a plurality of variable air volume (vav) units; an energy harvesting device; a plurality of fire sensors; a control device; and a wireless communication module. It is not connected to the external power supply and it provides the electricity from the energy harvesting apparatus and the variable air volume unit, and the control device and wireless communications module are driven. When a fire is detected by any one of the fire sensors, the control device generates a fire alarm for the fire zone, shields a damper of the variable air volume unit installed in the indoor air supply duct connected to the fire zone, and opens the damper of the variable air volume unit installed in the indoor air supply duct connected to the remaining zones except for the fire zone among the zones. The present invention relates to an energy-independent variable air volume system, which is easy to install and move without a power line, and minimizes the spread of fire by controlling a duct according to a fire detection signal.

title_clean: Signal processing circuit and signal processing device
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a signal processing circuit and a signal processing device, comprising: the signal reading module comprises a detection transistor, a reference transistor, a voltage following unit and a signal acquisition unit; the voltage following unit is respectively and electrically connected with the first current source, the drain electrode of the detection transistor, the drain electrode of the reference transistor, the source electrode of the detection transistor, the source electrode of the reference transistor and the signal acquisition unit; the source electrode of the detection transistor and the source electrode of the reference transistor are also electrically connected with a second current source; the differential amplification module is electrically connected with the signal acquisition unit; the differential amplification module takes the acquired source voltage of the detection transistor as a detection voltage signal and the source voltage of the reference transistor as a reference voltage signal, and performs signal amplification to output a detection result after the amplified detection voltage signal and the amplified reference voltage signal are differentiated, so that the influence of environment and temperature on the detection transistor is eliminated, and the problem that the ion concentration is difficult to accurately detect is solved.

title_clean: Determining state of charge, molarity and oxidation state in a flow battery and controlling a flow battery
abstract_clean: A system and method for measuring the state of charge (SOC), molarity and concentrations of active species and oxidation state of a flow battery, such as a Vanadium Redox Flow Battery (VRFB). A reference electrolyte is circulated through a reference cell in conjunction with one or both charged electrolytes (in respective conduits). The electric potential of charged electrolyte relative to a reference electrolyte is measured. This measurement is directly convertible to SOC. An equation allowing for the calculation of the molarity, concentration of vanadium ions on both anolyte and catholyte sides of the flow battery and oxidation state is also taught. A flow battery may be controlled in response to such a determination, for example to manage oxidation state, or to charge or discharge a battery.

title_clean: Quadruple frequency device and frequency source
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a quad-frequency and a frequency source. The quad-frequency comprises: an input matching network for converting a single-ended input signal to a first differential signal; the first-stage frequency doubling module is used for carrying out frequency doubling output on the first differential signal; the interstage matching network is used for converting the frequency doubling signal into a second differential signal; the second-stage frequency doubling module is used for carrying out frequency doubling output on the second differential signal to generate a quadruple frequency signal; the output matching network is used for amplifying and filtering the quadruple frequency signal; the first-stage frequency doubling module is of a phase control stack double-push frequency doubling structure; and/or the second-stage frequency doubling module is a multi-port driving matching stack double-push frequency doubling structure. The embodiment of the invention improves the coordination capability of broadband and harmonic suppression of the quadrupler.

title_clean: Organic electroluminescent devices and material thereof
abstract_clean: A material of the organic electroluminescent devices is provided. The material comprises a structure represented by following Formula (I): ; wherein Ar 1 and Ar 2 are individually selected from substituted aryl group of 6 to 18 carbon, unsubstituted aryl group of 6 to 18 carbon, substituted aromatic ring or unsubstituted aromatic ring. The aromatic ring includes N atom. n is 2 or 3.

title_clean: Resin composition
abstract_clean: The invention provides a resin composition capable of obtaining a cured product which can inhibit the occurrence of flow marks and warping after molding and has excellent adhesion of a heat-peelable adhesive tape. The solution of the present invention is a resin composition comprising (A) a curing agent and (B) an inorganic filler, wherein the component (A) comprises: the hydroxyl group-containing silicone compound (A-1) has a content of 0.5 mass% or more and less than 5 mass% of the component (A-1) when the nonvolatile components other than the component (B) in the resin composition are 100 mass%, and a content of 60 mass% or more when the total nonvolatile components in the resin composition are 100 mass%.

title_clean: Zinc oxide powder, dispersion, paint, and cosmetic
abstract_clean: A zinc oxide powder in which a BET specific surface area of the powder is 8 m 2 /g or more and 65 m 2 /g or less, an apparent specific volume measured by a loose packing method of the powder is 1.0 mL/g or more and 7.5 mL/g or less, and a value indicated by (the apparent specific volume measured by the loose packing method/an apparent specific volume measured by a tapping method), which is obtained by dividing the apparent specific volume (mL/g) measured by the loose packing method by the apparent specific volume (mL/g) measured by the tapping method of the powder, is 1.50 or more and 2.50 or less.

title_clean: Conductive liquid-crystalline resin composition
abstract_clean: Provided is a conductive liquid-crystalline resin composition from which a molded article having excellent molding processability and having a low volume resistivity with less variation regardless of the thickness thereof is obtained. The conductive liquid-crystalline resin composition according to the present invention contains a liquid-crystalline resin (A), a fibrous conductive filler (B), a granular conductive filler (C), and a non-conductive filler (D). The total contained amount of the fibrous conductive filler (B) and the granular conductive filler (C) is 25-50 mass%. The mass ratio of the contained amount of the fibrous conductive filler (B) with respect to the contained amount of the granular conductive filler (C) is 0.50-3.00. The contained amount of the non-conductive filler (D) is 2-8 mass%.

title_clean: For Fe3+Nanometer channel device for ion concentration detection and electrochemical detection method
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a nano channel device for detecting the concentration of Fe 3+ ions, which comprises a nano channel for containing an electrolyte solution to be detected, wherein functional molecules are modified on the inner surface of the nano channel, and the functional molecules are specifically combined by chelating, coordinating or electrostatic attraction with Fe 3+ ions, so that the ion current flowing through the nano channel changes under the applied voltage, and the concentration of Fe 3+ ions in the electrolyte solution to be detected is detected. The invention also discloses a detection method, which realizes quantitative detection of the concentration of Fe 3+ ions by establishing a standard curve, can rapidly, efficiently and quantitatively detect the concentration of Fe 3+ ions in an unknown water sample, and can be used for water quality assessment, health monitoring and other fields because the nano channel can be recycled and reused, thereby greatly reducing the detection cost.

title_clean: Thermal insulation coating, preparation method therefor and application method thereof
abstract_clean: Disclosed are a thermal insulation coating, a preparation method therefor and an application method thereof. The thermal insulation coating comprises: a PVDF resin, a waterborne epoxy resin solution, hollow glass beads, ytterbium-modified nano powder, a diluent, polyvinyl alcohol, titanium dioxide powder, rare earth, negative ion powder and a leveling agent. According to the present invention, the PVDF resin, the waterborne epoxy resin solution and the polyvinyl alcohol are added to synergistically form a film, so that the raw materials for preparation are mixed more uniformly, the leveling property of the coating is higher, and the coating has a good thermal insulation effect; the rare earth is synergistically compounded with the hollow glass beads, the ytterbium-modified nano powder, the titanium dioxide powder and/or zirconia ceramic powder, so that the thermal insulation performance, the high temperature resistance and the like of the coating are significantly enhanced, and a thermal insulation coating, a thermal insulation agent, etc. can be prepared, which can be used for a metal surface to improve the thermal insulation performance of the metal surface; and by selectively adding the negative ion powder, the environmental quality can be improved. The coating has functional diversity and a wide application prospect.

title_clean: PLLA poly-L-lactic acid microsphere for stimulating collagen regeneration
abstract_clean: The application relates to PLLA poly-L-lactic acid microsphere for stimulating collagen regeneration, which comprises the following raw materials: the poly-L-lactic acid microsphere compound comprises poly-L-lactic acid microsphere with four molecular weights of 20-30kDa, 50-60kDa, 70-90kDa and 100-130kDa, an active type I collagen alpha 1 precursor chain compound and mannitol. The poly-L-lactic acid microsphere compound of the four different molecular weights is selected, and is difficult to degrade because the single molecular weight is large to form vascular embolism, the poly-L-lactic acid microsphere of the four different molecular weight intervals is selected, the two microspheres of small molecular weight can be well paved on the shallow dermis, the microspheres of medium molecular weight and high molecular weight can be well filled in the deep dermis, the collagen stimulation effect can be better shown, the later degradation is accelerated, and the vascular embolism is not easy to occur safely enough.

title_clean: Electrochemical polymerization-based polypyrrole micro additive manufacturing method
abstract_clean: The invention belongs to the technical field of electrochemical additive manufacturing, and particularly relates to a polypyrrole micro-additive manufacturing method based on electrochemical polymerization. The invention discloses a polypyrrole micro additive manufacturing method based on electrochemical polymerization, which can complete synthesis and forming of polypyrrole in one step and reduce the loss of leftover materials in the step-by-step processing process; meanwhile, the requirement on uniformity and continuity of micro additive manufacturing can be met, the feasibility of the application of polypyrrole in the field of electrochemical micro additive manufacturing is realized, and a new idea is provided for 3D micro additive manufacturing of conductive high polymer polypyrrole; in addition, the limitation that the traditional additive manufacturing synthesis process only can be used for plane synthesis is broken through, and the forming design of 3D polypyrrole products in different shapes can be carried out according to human will.

title_clean: Heat dissipation device
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a heat dissipation device, comprising: a first accommodating part, wherein an accommodating space for accommodating the heat exchange medium is formed inside the first accommodating part, and at least an interface is arranged on the first accommodating part and is used for communicating with a circulating channel of the heat exchange medium; a second accommodating member having an accommodating space formed therein for accommodating a heat exchange medium; the plurality of communication components are arranged in parallel between the first accommodating component and the second accommodating component, two ends of each communication component are respectively communicated with the accommodating space and the accommodating space, and each communication component is made of a heat conduction material; the heat dissipation part is arranged on the communication part, and a plurality of heat dissipation surfaces are formed on the heat dissipation part.

title_clean: Display device and method of fabricating the same
abstract_clean: A display device includes a substrate including a display area having first color subpixels and a transparent area inside the display area, an array layer in the display area on the substrate, a first electrode in the first color subpixels on the array layer, a first emission assisting layer on the first electrode, an emitting material layer in the first color subpixels on the first emission assisting layer, a second emission assisting layer on the emitting material layer, a deposition preventing layer in the transparent area on the second emission assisting layer, a second electrode on the second emission assisting layer, the second electrode selectively disposed in a region where the deposition preventing layer is not disposed, an encapsulating layer on the deposition preventing layer and the second electrode, a polarizing layer in the display area on the encapsulating layer, an auxiliary equipment in the transparent area under the substrate.

title_clean: Observation device
abstract_clean: Provided is an observation device including: a stereo image-acquisition optical system that acquires images of cells floating in a culture fluid inside a culture vessel; and an analyzer that calculates a cell density of the cells on the basis of the images acquired by the stereo image-acquisition optical system, wherein the analyzer identifies a three-dimensional position of each of the cells included in the images and calculates the cell density on the basis of the number of cells present within a predetermined three-dimensional region.

title_clean: Display device, temperature sensor and temperature sensing method
abstract_clean: The application discloses a display device, a temperature sensor and a temperature sensing method. The temperature sensor comprises a transmission unit, wherein the transmission unit comprises at least one first transistor which is connected between an input end and an output end, the control end of each first transistor is connected with a first path end, when the number of the first transistors is multiple, a second path end of a previous first transistor is connected with a first path end of a next first transistor, the threshold voltage of the first transistor changes along with the temperature, and when the transmission unit receives an effective input signal, the transmission unit generates an output signal according to the threshold voltage of the first transistor and the effective input signal. By manufacturing the temperature sensor composed of the transistor in the display device, the temperature sensor generates an output signal based on the characteristics of the transistor, the temperature sensing device in the prior art is replaced, temperature detection is realized, and the problem that the cost of the display device is overhigh is solved.

title_clean: Magnetic domain wall logic element and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_clean: Disclosed is a magnetic domain wall logic element which includes: a non-magnetic layer; and a magnetic layer formed on the non-magnetic layer. The magnetic layer includes a perpendicular magnetic anisotropy region; and a horizontal magnetic anisotropy region adjacent to the vertical magnetic anisotropy region. The magnetic domain wall logic element is operated by in-plane current of the non-magnetic layer. The magnetic domain wall logic element provided in one aspect of the present invention has advantages of implementing a logic element only by moving a domain wall, being driven by current, and having a simple structure. In addition, when the logic element is used, a data processing speed can be improved.

title_clean: Radio frequency switch circuit, radio frequency switch chip and wireless communication equipment
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a radio frequency switch circuit, a radio frequency switch chip and wireless communication equipment, wherein the radio frequency switch circuit comprises N switch sub-circuits, and each switch sub-circuit comprises a series switch unit and a parallel switch unit; the switch sub-circuit further comprises a first feedback unit and/or a second feedback unit. According to the invention, the series switch unit outputs the radio frequency signal, and the parallel switch unit blocks the inactive radio frequency signal to the ground, so that the isolation degree of the switch is increased; the harmonic part in the signal is filtered by the feedback unit, so that the second harmonic and the third harmonic generated by the switch are reduced, the linearity of the switch is effectively increased, and the aim of increasing the maximum output power of the switch is fulfilled. In addition, the sizes of the series switch unit and the parallel switch unit are greatly reduced, so that the production cost is reduced, and the method has wide practical application prospect.

title_clean: Microwave-based reset of persistent current qubits
abstract_clean: Systems and methods are provided for resetting a qubit comprising a superconducting loop and a compound Josephson junction. A first bias flux is provided to the superconducting loop. A second bias flux is provided to the compound Josephson junction. Each of the first bias flux and the second bias flux are provided such that a given excited state of the qubit is near a top of a potential barrier associated with a potential of the qubit. A continuous microwave signal is generated having a frequency equal to a transition frequency between an other excited state of the qubit and the given excited state.

title_clean: Communication control method and distributed antenna system
abstract_clean: A communication control method is performed by a distributed antenna system that controls coherent transmission between a terminal that performs communication with a signal processing device or a higher-level signal processing device via a plurality of distributed antennas that cooperatively perform coherent transmission, and includes a step of estimating, for each of the plurality of distributed antennas, a propagation delay difference in the terminal between the signal processing device or the higher-level signal processing device and the terminal, or a propagation delay difference in the terminal between the signal processing device or the higher-level signal processing device and the terminal, based on the propagation delay between the signal processing device or the higher-level signal processing device and the propagation delay between the plurality of distributed antennas and the terminal, and a step of controlling a transmission time for each of the distributed antennas in such a manner that the propagation delay difference estimated for each of the distributed antennas is within an allowable delay difference.

title_clean: Data compression system and method based on multistage series decimation filter
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a data compression system and a method based on a multistage series extraction filter, wherein the data compression system comprises a channel selector switch, a multistage extraction filter, a multistage storage switch, an extraction filter coefficient memory or a filter coefficient generator and a data memory; wherein the channel switch is connected with the first stage of the multistage series decimation filter; all stages in the multi-stage decimation filter are connected in series in sequence. When the data compression system and the data compression method based on the multistage series decimation filter are applied to online analysis of data, the system can compress prepared data according to analysis requirements, so that the efficiency of online data processing can be greatly improved when long data with high and low frequency analysis requirements are considered simultaneously is processed; on the other hand, when the application data is collected in real time, the extraction filter can output compressed data at different stages, namely the system can realize the function of classifying data at different extraction rates of channels, and the actual data storage amount can be greatly reduced through reasonable configuration selection.

title_clean: Detection method, detection system and storage medium based on artificial intelligence early warning system
abstract_clean: The invention provides a detection method based on an artificial intelligence early warning system, which comprises the following steps: and classifying the monitored objects, and selecting corresponding artificial intelligence models according to the classified categories. And selecting a training sample, and training the selected artificial intelligence model by combining manual adjustment of the residual error overrun trigger threshold range of each measuring point. And applying the trained artificial intelligence model to the monitored object. The detection method based on the artificial intelligent early warning system can reduce the false alarm rate and the missing report rate of the early warning system, so that the early warning system can better play a role. The invention also provides a detection system and a storage medium for executing the detection method.

title_clean: Access for compute nodes to a storage server through a pci express fabric
abstract_clean: A network architecture including network storage. The network architecture includes a plurality of streaming arrays, each streaming array including a plurality of compute sleds, wherein each compute sled includes one or more compute nodes. The network architecture includes a PCI Express (PCIe) fabric configured to provide direct access to the network storage from compute nodes of each of the plurality of streaming arrays, the PCIe fabric including a plurality of array-level PCIe switches, each array-level PCIe switch communicatively coupled to compute nodes of compute sleds of a corresponding streaming array and communicatively coupled to the storage server. The network storage is shared by the plurality of streaming arrays.

title_clean: Order method and device, computer storage medium
abstract_clean: The disclosure relates to an order distribution method and device and a computer storage medium, and relates to the technical field of computers. The order distribution method comprises the following steps: dividing a plurality of orders into a first order set and a second order set according to attributes; determining a first order set to be delivered according to the area where each order of the first order set is located, and delivering orders according to the first order set to be delivered; and planning a path according to the position relationship between the positions of the orders in the second order set and the position relationship between the position of each order and the position of the distribution starting point, determining a second order set to be distributed and a path to be distributed thereof, and distributing the orders according to the path to be distributed. According to the method and the device, different order distribution modes are adopted for different orders, and distribution efficiency is improved.

title_clean: Ink jet leakage-proof ink sticking device for copper pipe flaw detection
abstract_clean: The invention belongs to the technical field of copper pipe processing, and particularly discloses an ink-jet leakage-proof ink-sticking device for copper pipe flaw detection, which comprises a controller, an ink-jet box body, and an ink-jet mechanism and an isolation mechanism which are connected with the controller, wherein first through holes for passing through copper pipes are respectively formed in two sides of the ink-jet box body; the ink-jet mechanism is positioned in the ink-jet box body and used for jetting ink to the copper pipe, the isolation mechanism comprises an isolation sleeve, a transverse driving structure and a vertical adjusting structure, the copper pipe can penetrate through the isolation sleeve, the vertical adjusting structure is used for adjusting the vertical position of the copper pipe, and the transverse driving structure is used for driving the isolation sleeve to transversely move so as to isolate and open the ink-jet position on the copper pipe. According to the technical scheme, the effect of preventing ink from adhering to the surface of the copper pipe is achieved by going out of the error area achieved by the ink leakage prevention device, when the isolation mechanism is in the isolated normally closed state, if the ink leakage phenomenon which is not in the marked period occurs in the ink spraying mechanism, the isolation mechanism can effectively isolate ink, and ink is prevented from being directly sprayed to the surface of the copper pipe to form ink adhering.

title_clean: Heat energy recovery device for power engineering
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a heat energy recovery device for power engineering, which comprises a base, wherein a heat source entering box is vertically arranged at the top of the base, a heat exchange box is vertically arranged at the top of the base, a plurality of heat exchange pipes are transversely and penetratingly arranged on the side wall of the heat exchange box, a scale cleaning component is arranged at the top in the heat exchange box, an exhaust box is vertically arranged at the top of the base, a filtering component is arranged in the exhaust pipe, and an opening component is arranged at the outer side of the exhaust pipe.

title_clean: Multi-parameter thromboelastography instrument for animal coagulation function evaluation
abstract_clean: The multi-parameter thromboelastography instrument for animal blood coagulation function evaluation comprises a magnetic suspension driving and sensing module, a multi-dimensional signal processing module, a species characteristic database module, a dynamic calibration and quality control module, an artificial intelligent decision module and a multi-mode interaction output module, wherein the magnetic suspension driving and sensing module is used for realizing high-precision blood coagulation monitoring through electromagnetic driving and nanoscale displacement detection, the multi-dimensional signal processing module is used for extracting key parameters such as R values and MA values by adopting a composite algorithm, the species characteristic database module is used for storing multi-species blood coagulation data in a layered mode and supporting dynamic correction, the dynamic calibration and quality control module is used for ensuring system stability through a three-stage cascade control mechanism, the artificial intelligent decision module is used for providing blood coagulation risk evaluation and medication advice based on a hybrid neural network, and the multi-mode interaction output module is used for dynamically presenting detection results through a visual engine. The system has the characteristics of high sensitivity, anti-interference performance, cross-species adaptability and low output delay, and is suitable for coagulation function evaluation of various animals.

title_clean: Steam generating device applied to wastewater zero-emission system of coal-fired power plant
abstract_clean: The invention relates to a steam generating device applied to a wastewater zero-emission system of a coal-fired power plant, wherein a water outlet is formed in the bottom of the water supplementing tank, the water outlet is connected with an inlet of the steam generating device through a water supplementing pump, a flue gas inlet is formed in a shell of the steam generating device, the flue gas inlet is connected with an outlet of a booster fan through a pipeline, low-temperature flue gas at an outlet of the booster fan is led into the steam generating device, a first outlet of the steam generating device is connected with a flash evaporation device, a second outlet of the steam generating device is connected with a desulfurization absorption tower, the flash evaporation device comprises a flash evaporation tank, a superheated water outlet is connected with the flash evaporation tank through a pipeline, the top of the flash evaporation tank is connected with a vacuum pump, the flash evaporation tank is provided with a steam outlet, the steam outlet is connected with an evaporation concentration system through a steam compressor, and the water outlet of the evaporation concentration system is connected with the water supplementing tank through a pipeline.

title_clean: Polyene acetylene compound and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_clean: The invention relates to polyene acetylene compounds and a preparation method and application thereof. The polyene acetylene compound has a structure as shown in any one of formulas (I) to (V): the polyene acetylene compound has obvious effect of inhibiting differentiation on osteoclast induced by RANKL under 10 mu M, and does not show cytotoxicity.

title_clean: Mic-1 compounds and uses thereof
abstract_clean: The invention relates to MIC-1 compounds. More specifically it relates to compounds comprising a MIC-1 polypeptide with an N-terminal amino acid extension and a protractor wherein the amino acid extension comprises 3 to 36 amino acid residues and where the MIC-1 polypeptide and the N-terminal amino acid extension together have a calculated pI lower than 6.5. The compounds of the invention have MIC-1 activity. The invention also relates to pharmaceutical compositions comprising such compounds and pharmaceutically acceptable excipients, as well as the medical use of the compounds.

title_clean: Application of systemic inflammatory response index in prognosis evaluation of gastrointestinal diffuse large B cell lymphoma
abstract_clean: The invention provides application of a systemic inflammatory response index in prognosis evaluation of diffuse large B cell lymphoma of gastrointestinal tracts, and belongs to the technical field of disease prognosis evaluation. According to the invention, the SIRI level is found to be used as a prognosis marker of gastrointestinal diffuse large B cell lymphoma; furthermore, a new gastrointestinal diffuse large B cell lymphoma prognosis evaluation system is constructed based on SIRI and NCCN-IPI scores, can effectively predict clinical results, enriches current stratification, shows excellent distinguishing capability in the overall survival period and the progression-free survival period of patients, and has better risk distinguishing capability and layering capability than the existing NCCN-IPI scores, thereby having good value of practical application.

title_clean: Process for the manufacture of alkylamide thiazoles
abstract_clean: The present invention relates to an improved process for the manufacture of alkylamide thiazoles. This novel economic process provides a product of high purity and high yield.

title_clean: Box protection frame
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a box protective frame, including the liquid storage box body, liquid storage box body four corners department all opens and establishes to the round chamfer, and liquid storage box body front end is provided with the valve. The utility model discloses utilize the constant head tank welding that annular frame and dead lever were seted up, make annular frame and dead lever constitution protective frame, liquid storage box is located inside the protective frame, rely on protective frame to provide the protection of preventing colliding with liquid storage box, be used for consolidating the fixed strength of annular frame and liquid storage box and protect liquid storage box's partial position through the fixed plate, liquid storage box bottom is located the backup pad top, the shallow contact of base and transportation is passed through to the backup pad, use outwards take out some push pedal promotion inserted bar and remove to the backup pad depths, connect into a whole with dead lever and backup pad in proper order, carry on spacingly to liquid storage box through this kind of mode, the range of rocking when reducing liquid storage box and removing, make things convenient for the later stage to take out liquid storage box from protective frame simultaneously.

title_clean: Clamping conveying device for machining
abstract_clean: The application discloses a clamping and conveying device for machining, which relates to the field of clamping and conveying equipment and comprises a machining table, wherein two clamping rails are arranged above the machining table in parallel, first driving mechanisms for driving the two clamping rails to perform centering or separating movement are arranged on two sides of the clamping rails, elastic clamping assemblies for clamping workpieces are arranged on adjacent sides of the two clamping rails, lifting pieces for driving the first driving mechanisms to lift are arranged on two sides of the machining table, and a second driving mechanism for driving the elastic clamping assemblies to move with the workpieces is arranged on one side of the machining table. The application not only can carry out self-adaptive adjustment according to the small size difference of the same workpiece and stably clamp the workpiece, but also can adjust the clamping distance according to different types of workpieces, and has strong adaptability.

title_clean: Model for simulating movement of extraocular muscles and intraocular muscles
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a model for simulating movement of extraocular muscles and intraocular muscles, which comprises a simulated eyeball, wherein the back surface of the simulated eyeball is provided with a simulated optic nerve for limiting the position of the simulated eyeball, the surface of the simulated optic nerve is provided with a plurality of first simulated control muscles for controlling the simulated eyeball to rotate in different directions, and one side of each first simulated control muscle is fixedly connected with a reset spring. According to the model for simulating the movement of the extraocular muscles and the intraocular muscles, the reset spring, the guide rod and the fixing nut are added on the basis of the original model, when the oblique vision caused by the control muscles in a disease state is required to be observed, the fixing nut on one first simulation muscle is taken down, so that the muscle injury is simulated, the eyeball cannot be pulled by the muscle, the reset springs on other muscles can pull the eyeball to one side, the eyeball is displaced, and the condition of the oblique vision of the eyeball when the certain muscle injury of the eyeball is observed is realized.

title_clean: Gardens sapling fixing device
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to the technical field of garden maintenance equipment, in particular to a garden sapling fixing device which comprises a base, wherein the top of the base is fixedly welded with the bottom of a support member, the inner wall of the base is in threaded connection with the outer wall of the support member, the outer wall of the support member is in sliding contact with the outer wall of the support member, the inner wall of the support member is in threaded connection with the outer wall of a clamping member, the support member is sleeved on the outer wall of a sapling and is fixed, the clamping member is rotated to enable the outer wall of the clamping member to be in contact with the outer wall of the sapling, the sapling is fixed at the center of the device, the fixing member penetrates through the base to penetrate through the ground through the rotation of the fixing member, the phenomenon that the fixing device is driven to displace after the sapling is inclined is avoided, convenience is brought to use of people, meanwhile, the outer wall of the clamping member is in contact with the outer wall of the sapling through rotation of the clamping member, the sapling is fixed at the center of the device, the contact area of a trunk is increased, and irreversible damage is avoided.

title_clean: Microcapsule for embedding liquid grease and preparation method thereof
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a microcapsule for embedding liquid grease by taking sodium alginate/chitosan as a shell material and a preparation method thereof. The microcapsule uses liquid oil as core material, water-soluble sodium alginate and Ca 2+ And (3) performing crosslinking to obtain an intermediate layer, performing crosslinking of chitosan and water-soluble sodium alginate to obtain an outer shell layer, and preparing the microcapsule by using a microcapsule granulator. The average particle size of the microcapsule prepared by the invention is about 500 mu m, the microcapsule presents an obvious multilayer structure, has excellent mechanical property, oxidation resistance and slow release performance, realizes the controllable load of liquid grease, realizes the effective protection of functional grease by natural, nontoxic and degradable natural food packaging materials, and replaces petroleum-based synthetic plastics.

title_clean: Vegetable sterilizing and fresh-keeping agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_clean: The invention aims to provide a vegetable sterilization preservative and a preparation method thereof, wherein the vegetable sterilization preservative comprises the following steps: fructus forsythiae extract, chitosan, radix Scutellariae extract, Gallic acid streptostacin-vitamin complex, tea polyphenols and sterile water. The preparation method of the vegetable sterilization preservative is simple and convenient, the prepared preservative is compounded with various natural biological preservatives, can inhibit the survival of various bacteria and microorganisms, and simultaneously isolates air to make the bacteria difficult to survive, thereby realizing the sterilization and bacteriostasis effects, and the vegetable sterilization preservative has the characteristics of good sterilization and bacteriostasis effects, wide action range, lasting action time and the like.

title_clean: Use of Yr4DS gene of Aegilops tauschii in stripe rust resistance breeding of Triticeae plants
abstract_clean: Provided is a Yr4DS gene of Aegilops tauschii and use thereof in stripe rust resistance breeding of Triticeae plants. Said gene has a sequence as shown in SEQ ID NO. 1, SEQ ID NO. 3, SEQ ID NO. 5, SEQ ID NO. 7, SEQ ID NO. 9, or SEQ ID NO.10.

title_clean: A method for preparing Cordyceps
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a preparation method of cordyceps sinensis, and relates to the technical field of medicine preparation. The method comprises the steps of cooling washed cordyceps sinensis to a first temperature lower than a eutectic point to enable moisture in the cordyceps sinensis to be completely frozen to form ice crystals, performing at least one freeze-thawing cycle, thawing the frozen cordyceps sinensis at a second temperature higher than 0 ℃, cooling to the first temperature at a second cooling rate to refreeze the cordyceps sinensis, placing the cordyceps sinensis in a vacuum environment, performing at least one pressure transformation treatment, and heating and drying under vacuum until the predetermined moisture content is reached. The embodiment remarkably improves the dissolution rate of the functional substances when the cordyceps sinensis is taken by a user, improves the bioavailability of the cordyceps sinensis, and forms uniform, loose and crisp texture, thereby bringing a unique taste which is instantly melted when the cordyceps sinensis is taken in mouth, and solving the problems of hard taste and poor palatability of the traditional freeze-dried cordyceps sinensis.

title_clean: Connecting ring for plunger pump
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to the technical field of plunger pumps and discloses a connecting ring for a plunger pump, wherein an upper ring body and a lower ring body are spliced to form the connecting ring; the inner wall and the outer wall of the connecting ring are only provided with the lubricating port, compared with the prior art, the lubricating oil groove is additionally arranged, the loss of lubricating grease can be reduced, the damage to the connecting rod and the crankshaft can be avoided when the lubricating grease flows in the oil storage box, the step that the connecting ring is required to be filled with oil in real time by using the oil nozzle in the prior art is saved, the oil storage box can be moved out of the oil storage cavity, the subsequent oiling of the oil storage box is convenient, the working cost and the subsequent maintenance cost of the connecting ring, which are caused by oiling the connecting ring by using the oil pump and the oil nozzle in use, are saved, the problem that the inner oil groove, the lubricating oil groove and the crankshaft and the connecting rod are worn due to the fact that the lubricating oil is interrupted and conveyed in the prior art is solved.

title_clean: Novel brake
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a novel brake, which comprises a first shell, wherein the end face of the first shell is fixedly connected with the end face of a second shell, a rotating plate is rotatably arranged on the end face of one section of the first shell, an eccentric shaft is fixedly arranged in the middle of the end face of the rotating plate, the eccentric shaft penetrates through a through hole in the end face of the first shell to extend to the outside of the first shell, three arc-shaped passive friction plates are fixedly arranged on the other end face of the rotating plate, and a movable ring is movably arranged in the other end of the first shell.

title_clean: Step drill bit
abstract_clean: A drill bit including a shank extending along a bit axis. The bit includes a body having a proximal end, a distal end, and a body including a bit tip. The body defines a plurality of steps including a first step and a terminal step. The steps include at least 13 steps and have stop-on steps and intermediate steps. The steps include more intermediate steps than stop-on steps. Each stop-on step includes a first length measured in a direction parallel to the bit axis and being in a range between 0.1 inches and 0.25 inches. Each intermediate step includes a second length measured in a direction parallel to the bit axis and being in a range between 0.075 inches and 0.12 inches. The first length is greater than the second length. The bit includes a flute formed in the body and a cutting edge extending along the flute.

title_clean: Computer display support and rotating device and fixing device thereof
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to a display support technical field discloses a computer display support and rotary device and fixing device thereof, the support includes base and rotary device and fixing device, rotary device includes the supporting seat of fixed connection on base top, the top fixed connection locating plate of supporting seat, open the inside of locating plate has the adjustment tank, the inside rotation connection connecting seat of adjustment tank, the inside of bottom lateral wall of base glues and is connected with the slipmat, fixing device includes the backup pad of fixed connection on connecting seat top, the inside recess that opens of one end of backup pad, the inside rotation connecting screw rod of recess, the outside threaded connection fly leaf of screw rod. Through rotating the knob, the knob drives the screw rod and rotates, thereby the screw rod drives the fly leaf along the recess with fly leaf threaded connection and slides, thereby the fly leaf drives the fixed plate and reciprocates along one side of backup pad to conveniently adjust the height of display, facilitate the use, to bulky, the display that weight is big has better fixed effect.

title_clean: Material property measuring system
abstract_clean: The application relates to a research and analysis of material properties by designing a material property measuring system comprising a device for measuring properties of a transmitted test material, the device comprising an electronic board with at least one transmitter for measuring properties of the test medium, a transceiver and a power supply in a housing, and a remote device for measuring properties in the body of the test material connected thereto by means of an optimally 0.3-20 meter cable, the device comprising an electronic board with at least one transmitter for measuring properties of the test medium; the device for measuring the characteristics of the transmission test material is designed to acquire signals from a remote device, which has a sealed housing containing an electronic board with the transmitters, with a thickness of 0.5-20 mm, and to transmit the signals of all the transmitters to the digital device and/or to the cloud server by means of wireless communication. The application improves the accuracy of data measurement and transmission, the reliability of the characteristic measurement equipment under the working condition and the performance of the material property measurement system.

title_clean: Photodetection device, method for manufacturing photodetection device, and electronic apparatus
abstract_clean: The present disclosure relates to a photodetection device, a method of manufacturing the photodetection device, and an electronic device, which are capable of improving a light condensing effect of a microlens in units of pixels and improving optical characteristics. The photodetection device includes pixels each including a photoelectric conversion section that photoelectrically converts incident light, a microlens that condenses the incident light on the photoelectric conversion section, and a plurality of protrusions formed on the microlens. The pixels each include two or more of the protrusions in which at least one of a width, a height, or a density is different. The present disclosure can be applied to, for example, a solid-state imaging device or the like.

title_clean: Ultrasonic curved linear array operable in the continuous wave mode
abstract_clean: Continuous wave (CW) Doppler analysis is performed using an ultrasound system with a linear array transducer probe. The linear array may be curved or flat. The array transducer has more transducer elements than the number of channels of the beamformer of the ultrasound system. To accommodate this disparity, some of the elements of the array are multiplexed to the beamformer so that only one of a pair of elements is coupled to the beamformer at any one time. A plurality of the elements of the array transducer are not multiplexed and are coupled directly to the beamformer. During imaging both multiplexed and unmultiplexed transducer elements can be used to produce signals for an image, and during CW Doppler analysis only unmultiplexed transducer elements are used for the CW Doppler transmit and receive apertures.

title_clean: Method of generating an output signal of a PDAF pixel
abstract_clean: Disclosed is a method of generating an output signal of a PDAF pixel of an optoelectronic image sensor array, including detecting pixel signals of the pixels of the image sensor arranged within the environment of a PDAF pixel; determining a structure direction of an image structure imaged onto the image sensor from the pixel signals of at least some of the pixels arranged within the environment; and generating the output signal of the PDAF pixel, wherein, the output signal is generated in one case as an interpolation signal from the pixel signals of further pixels arranged within the environment and in another case as an amplified signal by correcting the pixel signal of the PDAF pixel with an amplification factor, wherein the output signal of the PDAF pixel is generated as the amplified signal when the structure direction differs from the first direction by less than a predefined angle.

title_clean: Glass cover plate and processing technology and application thereof
abstract_clean: The invention relates to a processing technology of a glass cover plate, which comprises the following steps: placing the planar glass substrate into a first die for texture pressing treatment to obtain 2D glass with surface textures; s2, placing the 2D glass with the surface textures into a 3D forming die for shape hot bending treatment to obtain the glass cover plate. The processing technology disclosed by the invention has good productivity and yield, and can be used for manufacturing texture patterns with sharp textures and small spacing.

title_clean: Epoxy resin composition, prepreg, and fiber-reinforced composite material
abstract_clean: The purpose of the present invention is to provide an epoxy resin composition which can be cured to obtain an epoxy resin cured product excelling in balance among flame retardancy, thermal conductivity and heat resistance, and a prepreg and a fiber-reinforced composite material using the same. The epoxy resin composition including an epoxy resin which achieves this purpose includes [A] a bifunctional naphthalene epoxy resin, [B] a phosphorus-containing curing agent, and [C] thermally conductive particles.

title_clean: Cosmetic composition
abstract_clean: To provide means that enables stable incorporation of cholesterol into an oil-based component.SOLUTION: A cosmetic composition contains (a) cholesterol, (b) isostearic acid, and (c) liquid oil with a viscosity of 50 mPa s or less at 25°C, where the mass ratio between the component (a) and the component (b) (a/b) is in the range of 1/8-1/20, and the mass ratio between the component (b) and the component (c) (b/c) is in the range of 10/1-1/1.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_clean: Anti-reflection eye protection film and preparation method thereof
abstract_clean: The invention relates to the technical field of films, in particular to an anti-reflection eye protection film and a preparation method thereof. The anti-reflection eye protection film is obtained by mixing nano hollow microspheres A and nano hollow microspheres B and then coating the mixture on the surface of a glass substrate, wherein the nano hollow microspheres A are obtained by emulsion polymerization of methyl methacrylate, hydroxyethyl methacrylate and ethylene glycol dimethacrylate by taking amphiphilic macromolecular RAFT reagent A as an emulsifying agent, and the nano hollow microspheres B are obtained by emulsion polymerization of methyl methacrylate, epoxypropyl methacrylate and ethylene glycol dimethacrylate by taking amphiphilic macromolecular RAFT reagent B as an emulsifying agent. The anti-reflection eye protection film prepared by the invention has excellent light transmittance and extremely low reflectivity, and can maintain excellent optical performance for a long time in the actual use process, so that the anti-reflection eye protection film is suitable for various application scenes, such as glasses, display screens and other optical devices.

title_clean: Patch tooling
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a patch fixture, which belongs to the technical field of mounting and comprises a driving mechanism, a transmission piece and a clamping device, wherein the clamping device is connected with the driving mechanism through the transmission piece and is used for enabling the clamping device to rotate, clamp and rotate and loosen. The invention can solve the problems of complicated paster flow and low paster efficiency.

title_clean: Clamping conveying device for machining
abstract_clean: The application discloses a clamping and conveying device for machining, which relates to the field of clamping and conveying equipment and comprises a machining table, wherein two clamping rails are arranged above the machining table in parallel, first driving mechanisms for driving the two clamping rails to perform centering or separating movement are arranged on two sides of the clamping rails, elastic clamping assemblies for clamping workpieces are arranged on adjacent sides of the two clamping rails, lifting pieces for driving the first driving mechanisms to lift are arranged on two sides of the machining table, and a second driving mechanism for driving the elastic clamping assemblies to move with the workpieces is arranged on one side of the machining table. The application not only can carry out self-adaptive adjustment according to the small size difference of the same workpiece and stably clamp the workpiece, but also can adjust the clamping distance according to different types of workpieces, and has strong adaptability.

title_clean: Copper line pay-off
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to a copper line pay-off, including frame, activity setting movable rod on the curb plate of frame and set up the reel of stepping down on the movable rod, the activity hole one side that the curb plate is used for installing the movable rod is equipped with the hole of stepping down with the activity hole intercommunication, the downthehole trigger device that is equipped with of stepping down is equipped with elasticity stop device between hole and the activity hole, elasticity stop device can prevent under the pulling force when unreeling the reel and normally unreeling that the movable rod slides to stepping down downtheholely, unreel the pulling force when the reel blocks and can strut elasticity stop device and pull the movable rod to stepping down downthehole and trigger the downthehole trigger device that steps down. The utility model discloses a set up trigger device, when the card line problem appears, the movable rod touches mutually with trigger device and triggers trigger device, makes the wire production line stop the function to avoid in time stopping and causing economic loss and safety problem because the card line.

title_clean: Aluminum plate guillootine
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses an aluminum plate guillootine, including frame, measurement structure, limit structure, compact structure, cutting structure, fixed mounting has the workstation in the frame, workstation both sides fixed mounting has compact structure, install limit structure on the workstation, measurement structure fixed mounting is on the roof, limit structure includes spacing seat, the both sides of spacing seat are rotated respectively and are connected first lead screw, second lead screw, first lead screw with the second lead screw all with slider threaded connection, slider and limiting plate fixed connection, compact structure includes the connecting seat, the support with connecting seat fixed connection, be provided with the depression bar on the support, depression bar one end and cylinder fixed connection, the depression bar other end and briquetting fixed connection. The beneficial effects of the utility model are that, realize cutting aluminum plate's accurate segmentation, aluminum plate can not produce the skew among the cutting process.

title_clean: Chemical material mixing device
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a chemical material mixing device, which belongs to the technical field of chemical production and comprises a storage tank, wherein a feed pipe is arranged at the top of the storage tank, a discharge pipe is arranged at the bottom of the storage tank, a second mixing mechanism for heating and mixing materials is arranged at the bottom of the storage tank, a first mixing mechanism for heating and mixing materials and for driving the second mixing mechanism is arranged at the top of the storage tank, the first mixing mechanism comprises a hollow transmission pipe, a plurality of hollow mixing plates are arranged at the bottom of the hollow transmission pipe, and a protective shell corresponding to the storage tank is rotatably connected at the top of the hollow transmission pipe; the invention has simple structure and convenient use, and can quickly and fully mix materials without dead angles by mutually matching a plurality of structures when in use, so that the mixing effect of the mixing device on the materials is better.

title_clean: Rice clearance integrated device
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a rice cleaning integrated device, which relates to the technical field of rice cleaning integrated devices and comprises a box body, wherein a first fixing frame is fixedly connected to the top of the box body, a second fixing frame is fixedly connected to the top of the box body, a sliding groove is formed in the top of the box body, a first rotating plate is hinged to the inside of the first fixing frame, and a limiting hole is formed in the inside of the first rotating plate. According to the utility model, rice is poured into the box body through the rice inlet, the second rotating plate is driven to rotate through the output end of the first motor, the other end of the second rotating plate slides in the limiting hole to drive the first rotating plate to rotate, the top of the first rotating plate drives the third rotating plate to slide in the sliding groove, the screening box swings in the box body, impurities in the rice are discharged into the impurity collecting box through the impurity outlet while the screening box swings, the position of the impurity collecting box is fixed by the base, and the quality of the rice is conveniently improved by sliding the sliding door out of the bottom of the screening box.

title_clean: Method for improving planting survival rate of stone mountain nursery stock
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a method for improving planting survival rate of stone mountain nursery stocks, and belongs to the technical field of forestry forestation. The method for improving the planting survival rate of the stone mountain nursery stock comprises the following steps: (1) Manufacturing fish scale pits at planting points, spraying microorganism mixed bacterial liquid in the fish scale pits, and backfilling mixed nutrient soil; (2) pretreating the seedlings; (3) Digging out the mixed nutrient soil, transplanting the pretreated seedlings, and backfilling the mixed nutrient soil; and (4) performing post-transplanting management. The seedling planting method can enable the survival rate of the biota orientalis seedlings to reach more than 95%, solve the problem of low survival rate of the seedlings transplanted on the rocky mountain with a thinner soil layer, and provide a new technology for improving the afforestation survival rate for the rocky mountain.

title_clean: Green tea manufacturing process and rolling device thereof
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a green tea manufacturing process and a rolling device thereof, and relates to the field of tea manufacturing, wherein the process comprises S1 picking, S2 selecting, S3 withering, S4 high-temperature fixation, S5 rolling shaping, S6 slow fire drying and S7 compound fire fragrance raising, the rolling device comprises a rolling disc, a rolling barrel, a driving assembly, a sealing cover and a lifting assembly, the rolling disc comprises a rolling circular plate and a coaming assembly, a cylindrical rolling groove is formed by encircling the rolling circular plate and the coaming assembly, a discharge hole is formed in the center of the rolling circular plate, a sealing cover assembly is arranged at the discharge hole, and the coaming assembly comprises a positioning ring, a rotating ring and a plurality of arc-shaped rolling strips. The invention structurally improves the rolling disc, can automatically clean the residual tea leaves on the rolling disc after rolling, reduces the labor intensity of operators on the premise of not influencing the rolling effect of green tea, improves the rolling efficiency and reduces the rolling cost of the tea leaves.

title_clean: Communication method and apparatus
abstract_clean: Provided in the present application are a communication method and apparatus. The communication method comprises: acquiring first information, wherein the first information may be used for indicating an association relationship between a data identifier and a data processing mode, the data processing mode may comprise executing one or more first functions for data processing, and/or skipping one or more second functions for data processing, and the data identifier may comprise a first data identifier; and receiving first data carrying the first data identifier, and processing the first data on the basis of the first data identifier and the association relationship; or, sending the first data carrying the first data identifier. In the present application, different first data identifiers may have association relationships with different data processing modes. Thus, a corresponding functional entity processes first data on the basis of the data processing modes corresponding to the first data identifiers. In this way, appropriate functions are selected in a targeted manner for processing different data, thereby improving the service processing efficiency and the system performance.

title_clean: Method for transmitting channel state information report, communication device, and storage medium
abstract_clean: The disclosure provides a transmission method, a communication device and a storage medium for a channel state information report, which relate to the technical field of wireless communication and can improve the compression performance of channel information. The method comprises the following steps: determining a first state parameter according to a contracted mode; or determining a first state parameter according to the mode of signaling transmission; determining second channel state information and second state parameters according to the first state parameters and the first channel state information; generating a channel state information report according to the second channel state information; and sending a channel state information report.

title_clean: Methods, systems, and computer readable media for processing quic communications in a network
abstract_clean: Methods, systems, and computer readable media for processing QUIC communications in a network. An example system includes a first network interface for receiving a QUIC connection request from a first node in the network and, in response, establishing a first QUIC connection between the first node and the system. The system includes a QUIC processing module configured for receiving, via the first QUIC connection, encrypted QUIC data including a number of streams and decrypting the encrypted QUIC data, resulting in decrypted QUIC data. The QUIC processing module is configured for extracting each of the streams from the decrypted QUIC data, resulting in a plurality of extracted streams, and packaging at least one of the extracted streams into a non-QUIC protocol format, resulting in at least one packaged stream. The system includes a second network interface for transmitting the packaged stream to a second node in the network.

title_clean: User terminal and wireless communication method.
abstract_clean: A user terminal according to an embodiment of the present disclosure comprises: a transmission unit that transmits a demodulation reference signal (DMRS) based on Ï/2-BPSK modulation in the uplink transmission of at least one of an uplink shared channel and an uplink control channel before the establishment of a wireless resource control (RRC) connection; and a control unit that establishes the RRC connection on the basis of the uplink transmission. The embodiment of the present disclosure makes it possible to appropriately perform uplink transmission using on Ï/2-BPSK modulation.

title_clean: But chemical waste gas treatment device of automatically cleaning
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to a chemical waste gas treatment technical field specifically is a but chemical waste gas treatment device of automatically cleaning, including exhaust treatment device body, servo motor, first driving motor and second driving motor, the air inlet has been installed to the side of exhaust treatment device body, the motor case has been installed on the top of exhaust treatment device body, servo motor has been installed to the inside of motor case, and servo motor's output shaft fixed mounting has a common gear.
