The utility model discloses a be provided with second driving motor and suction pump, can spray water suction outlet pipe in the middle of through the suction pump, the rethread goes out the water shower nozzle, can carry out neutralization treatment with this internal chemical waste gas of exhaust treatment device through this mode, can make the carriage carry out the oscilaltion through servo motor's rotation, through carrying out the oscilaltion with the laminating of clearance scraper blade on the inner wall of exhaust treatment device body, can clear up the inner wall of exhaust treatment device body.

title_clean: Raw material processing apparatus and processing method
abstract_clean: The present invention relates to a technique for treating a raw material such as combustible waste, and more particularly to a technique for combustion, pyrolysis and gasification treatment without releasing carbon dioxide into the atmosphere. The processing device is provided with: a fluidized bed furnace (1) having a pyrolysis chamber (6) and a combustion chamber (7) partitioned by a partition wall (10) inside; an electrolysis device (2) that electrolyzes water to generate hydrogen and oxygen; a methanation reactor (3) that generates methane from hydrogen and carbon dioxide discharged from the combustion chamber (7); a first fluidizing gas supply line (11) which supplies a first fluidizing gas into the pyrolysis chamber (6); and a second fluidizing gas supply line (12) which introduces a portion of the carbon dioxide and oxygen as second fluidizing gases to the combustion chamber (7).

title_clean: Silica in rock samples
abstract_clean: A method comprises determining an amount of excess silica and/or an amount of terrigenous silica in a rock sample taking into account a measurement indicative of an amount of silica in the rock sample and a measurement indicative of an amount of zirconium in the rock sample.

title_clean: Composite modified bentonite adsorption material and preparation process thereof
abstract_clean: The invention relates to the technical field of bentonite adsorption material preparation and discloses a composite modified bentonite adsorption material and a preparation process, wherein the preparation process comprises the following steps of S1, coarse crushing bentonite raw ore into particles, fine grinding, sieving with a 200-mesh sieve, and collecting undersize bentonite powder; the method comprises the steps of S2, adding bentonite powder and hydrochloric acid into a reaction kettle for stirring reaction, S3, washing acidified bentonite slurry with deionized water until the pH value of filtrate is=6.5-7.0 after pressure filtration, then drying a filter cake to obtain a pre-dried acidified bentonite filter cake, S4, passing the pre-dried filter cake through a rotary kiln, setting microwave heating in the rotary kiln to finally obtain heat activated bentonite, and S5, mixing the heat activated bentonite and CTAB at 70 ℃. According to the preparation process of the composite modified bentonite adsorption material, the comprehensive adsorption performance of bentonite is remarkably improved through the synergistic effect of acidification, microwave activation and organic intercalation, the microwave activation rapidly removes interlayer water and stabilizes a framework structure, and the risk of thermal collapse is avoided.

title_clean: Piezoelectric laminate, piezoelectric element, and method for manufacturing piezoelectric laminate
abstract_clean: The invention aims to eliminate the influence of crystal structures and lattice matching of a piezoelectric film layer and an electrode layer and improve the crystal orientation of the piezoelectric film layer. A laminate comprising a substrate and a laminate film provided on at least one surface of the substrate, wherein the laminate film comprises, in order from the substrate side, a1 st underlayer, an electrode layer, and a piezoelectric thin film layer, wherein the 1 st underlayer is in contact with the substrate and the electrode layer, and wherein the 1 st underlayer comprises a nitrogen compound containing at least 1 element selected from group IIIB to group VIB elements.

title_clean: Inorganic hollow nanocoils and method of manufacturing the same
abstract_clean: The present invention relates to hollow nanocoils having a three-dimensional helical structure in the form of a hollow tube and a method of manufacturing the same. The present invention provides a method of synthesizing metal nanocoils into inorganic hollow nanocoils using the galvanic replacement reaction and an electrochemical reaction including the Kirkendall effect. The inorganic hollow nanocoil structure body of the present invention can be applied to various fields such as sensors, catalysts, batteries, or gene delivery and therapy using a large surface area.

title_clean: DNA concatemers on a surface
abstract_clean: Random arrays of single molecules are provided for carrying out large scale analyzes, particularly of biomolecules, such as genomic DNA, cDNAs, proteins, and the like. In one aspect, arrays of the invention comprise concatemers of DNA fragments that are randomly disposed on a regular array of discrete spaced apart regions, such that substantially all such regions contain no more than a single concatemer. Preferably, such regions have areas substantially less than 1 μm 2 and have nearest neighbor distances that permit optical resolution of on the order of 10 9 single molecules per cm 2 . Many analytical chemistries can be applied to random arrays of the invention, including sequencing by hybridization chemistries, sequencing by synthesis chemistries, SNP detection chemistries, and the like, to greatly expand the scale and potential applications of such techniques.

title_clean: Tin oxide semiconductor and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_clean: The present invention relates to an Sn oxide semiconductor and a manufacturing method thereof. The method for manufacturing a p-type Sn oxide semiconductor according to the present invention can manufacture a p-type Sn oxide semiconductor, which has been difficult to form in the past, and can reduce manufacturing costs by using a tin (Sn) precursor, which is relatively cheaper than a metal precursor used in a conventional metal oxide semiconductor. In addition, since the p-type Sn oxide semiconductor according to the present invention corresponds to a metal oxide semiconductor, the p-type Sn oxide semiconductor exhibits uniform characteristics even in a large area, has high carrier mobility, has a wide band gap and low leakage current characteristics, and may be less toxic.

title_clean: Bicyclic peptide ligands specific for il-17
abstract_clean: The present invention relates to polypeptides which are covalently bound to molecular scaffolds such that two peptide loops are subtended between attachment points to the scaffold. In particular, the invention describes peptides which are high affinity binders of IL- 17. The invention also includes drug conjugates comprising said peptides, conjugated to one or more effector and/or functional groups, to pharmaceutical compositions comprising said peptide ligands and drug conjugates and to the use of said peptide ligands and drug conjugates in preventing, suppressing or treating a disease or disorder mediated by IL-17.

title_clean: Library of Antigen-Binding Molecules Including Modified Antibody Variable Region
abstract_clean: The present inventors have successfully prepared a library consisting essentially of a plurality of antigen-binding molecules differing in sequence from each other, the antigen-binding molecules each comprising an antibody variable region that has binding activity against a first antigen and a second antigen different from the first antigen, but does not bind to the first antigen and the second antigen at the same time. Use of the library of the present invention allows the obtainment of a variable region having enhanced ability to bind to the first antigen and the production of a bispecific antibody against the first antigen and a cancer antigen. Moreover, the present inventors have also successfully prepared an antigen-binding molecule comprising an antibody variable region that has binding activity against three different antigens, but does not bind to these antigens at the same time.

title_clean: Application of systemic inflammatory response index in prognosis evaluation of gastrointestinal diffuse large B cell lymphoma
abstract_clean: The invention provides application of a systemic inflammatory response index in prognosis evaluation of diffuse large B cell lymphoma of gastrointestinal tracts, and belongs to the technical field of disease prognosis evaluation. According to the invention, the SIRI level is found to be used as a prognosis marker of gastrointestinal diffuse large B cell lymphoma; furthermore, a new gastrointestinal diffuse large B cell lymphoma prognosis evaluation system is constructed based on SIRI and NCCN-IPI scores, can effectively predict clinical results, enriches current stratification, shows excellent distinguishing capability in the overall survival period and the progression-free survival period of patients, and has better risk distinguishing capability and layering capability than the existing NCCN-IPI scores, thereby having good value of practical application.

title_clean: Antigen epitope of protein SaCas9 and application thereof in gene editing
abstract_clean: The invention belongs to the field of biotechnology, and provides a mutant Cas9 protein, which has activity of splicing genes and the mutation of which is an epitope capable of reducing immunogenicity, and is selected from A144G, E146G, E147G, D161G, G162A, R269G, D270A, E271G, N272G, E273G, P294A, T295A, D309A, P321A, E322G, A337G, R338G, T369A, E378G or short peptide 200-208 TYIDLLETR. The invention also comprises the antigen epitope of the SaCas9 protein and the application thereof in gene editing. The dominant epitope has no influence on the cleavage functional activity of the SaCas9 protein, and the deimmunization modification of the Cas9 protein can improve the human immune response problem possibly induced by the CRISPR-Cas9 system.

title_clean: Metal-ligand complex, catalyst composition, and method for producing same
abstract_clean: The present invention provides a metal-ligand complex, a catalyst composition for ethylene polymerization comprising the same, and a method for producing an ethylene polymer using the same, wherein the metal-ligand complex of the present invention having a specific functional group introduced at a specific position has high solubility and high catalyst activity, and therefore the catalyst composition for ethylene polymerization comprising the same can produce an ethylene polymer having excellent physical properties.

title_clean: 4, 5-dihydroisoxazole derivative and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a 4, 5-dihydro-isoxazole derivative and a corresponding preparation method thereof, and the preparation method comprises the following steps: under the catalytic action of acid, reacting acetyl hydroxylamine with a compound with a structure shown in a formula (I) to prepare the 4, 5-dihydroisoxazole derivative. The preparation method of the 4, 5-dihydroisoxazole derivative provided by the invention adopts cheap acetyl hydroxylamine as a raw material, so that the raw material cost is low; the reaction condition is mild, high-temperature and high-pressure conditions are not needed, the requirement on equipment is low, the reaction speed is high, and the purity and the yield of the prepared product are high; the whole reaction process is simple, extensive and strong in tolerance, and is suitable for large-scale industrial production.

title_clean: Application of lycium barbarum glycopeptide in preparing medicament for preventing and/or treating amyotrophic lateral sclerosis
abstract_clean: The invention relates to the field of biological medicine, in particular to application of lycium barbarum glycopeptides in preparation of a medicament for preventing and/or treating amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Experimental results show that the medlar glycopeptide is applied to the preparation of the medicament for preventing and/or treating amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Specifically, the medlar glycopeptide slows down the weight reduction of the SOD1G93A transgenic mouse, prolongs the life cycle of the SOD1G93A transgenic mouse, prolongs the disease course of the SOD1G93A transgenic mouse, and down regulates the relative expression quantity of the lumbar spinal cord inflammatory factor of the SOD1G93A transgenic mouse.

title_clean: Quinoline derivative, preparation method thereof and application thereof in preventing and treating plant viruses and killing bacteria
abstract_clean: The invention relates to 2-bit alkenyl substituted quinoline derivatives, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in the aspects of preventing and treating plant viruses and sterilizing, wherein the meanings of all groups in the general formula are shown in the specification; the 2-bit alkenyl substituted quinoline derivative has the activity of resisting plant viruses and also has broad-spectrum bactericidal activity.

title_clean: Surge testing device of new energy charging line
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a surge testing device of a new energy charging wire in the technical field of charging wire leakage detection, which comprises a surge generating module, a leakage current collecting module and a main controller module, wherein the output end of the surge generating module is connected with an inner core of the new energy charging wire to be detected, an insulating layer of the new energy charging wire is connected with the leakage current collecting module, and the leakage current collecting module is connected with the surge generating module.

title_clean: Method for electrostatic discharge protection, electrostatic discharge circuit and integrated circuit
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a method for electrostatic discharge protection, an electrostatic discharge circuit and an integrated circuit. According to an embodiment, a method for electrostatic discharge protection includes dividing a voltage between a plurality of circuit nodes using a voltage divider circuit to form a divided voltage, compensating for a temperature dependence of the divided voltage to form a temperature compensated divided voltage, monitoring the voltage between the plurality of circuit nodes using a transient detection circuit to form a transient detection signal, and activating a clamp circuit coupled between the plurality of circuit nodes based on the temperature compensated divided voltage and based on the transient detection signal.

title_clean: Quantum structure incorporating theta angle control
abstract_clean: Novel and useful electronic and magnetic control of several quantum structures that provide various control functions. An electric field provides control and is created by a voltage applied to a control terminal. Alternatively, an inductor or resonator provides control. An electric field functions as the main control and an auxiliary magnetic field provides additional control on the control gate. The magnetic field is used to control different aspects of the quantum structure. The magnetic field impacts the spin of the electron by tending to align to the magnetic field. The Bloch sphere is a geometrical representation of the state of a two-level quantum system and defined by a vector in x, y, z spherical coordinates. The representation includes two angles θ and φ whereby an appropriate electrostatic gate control voltage signal is generated to control the angle θ of the quantum state and an appropriate control voltage to an interface device generates a corresponding electrostatic field in the quantum structure to control the angle φ.

title_clean: Pipelined analog-to-digital conversion circuit
abstract_clean: The application provides a pipeline analog-to-digital conversion circuit, and relates to the field of pipeline circuits. Comprising the following steps: an N-stage analog-to-digital converter, N-1 allowance amplifiers and N-1 digital filters, wherein N is an integer greater than or equal to 2; the output end of the residual quantity amplifier is electrically connected with the analog input end of the (i+1) -th stage analog-to-digital converter, and i is any positive integer smaller than N; the first-stage analog-to-digital converter is an analog-to-digital converter with a noise shaping function, and the digital output end of each stage of analog-to-digital converter behind the first-stage analog-to-digital converter is electrically connected with a digital filter respectively. Compared with the prior art, the feedforward technology is adopted, all nonideal shaping of all amplifiers can be realized, and the problems of overlarge circuit hardware and time expenditure in the prior art are avoided.

title_clean: Drainage pump control system, drainage pump control method, drainage pump control device and storage medium
abstract_clean: The invention provides a drainage pump control method which comprises the steps of obtaining a water collecting well water level, determining the number of drainage pumps to be started based on the water collecting well water level in response to the water collecting well water level meeting preset water level conditions, determining the value of a pump starting mark to be a first preset value in response to the number of the drainage pumps to be started not meeting the first preset condition, determining the value of the pump starting mark to be a second preset value in response to the number of the drainage pumps to be started meeting the first preset condition, determining a first target drainage pump based on preset starting rules, determining historical operation records of the first target drainage pumps, wherein the preset starting rules are related to all the drainage pumps, determining the value of a pump stopping mark to be the second preset value in response to the water collecting well water level not meeting preset water level conditions, sequentially determining the second target drainage pumps based on preset pump stopping rules, and sequentially stopping the second target drainage pumps until the number of the current operation drainage pumps meets the preset number conditions.

title_clean: Heat energy recovery device for power engineering
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a heat energy recovery device for power engineering, which comprises a base, wherein a heat source entering box is vertically arranged at the top of the base, a heat exchange box is vertically arranged at the top of the base, a plurality of heat exchange pipes are transversely and penetratingly arranged on the side wall of the heat exchange box, a scale cleaning component is arranged at the top in the heat exchange box, an exhaust box is vertically arranged at the top of the base, a filtering component is arranged in the exhaust pipe, and an opening component is arranged at the outer side of the exhaust pipe.

title_clean: Nozzle geometry to create rotational vortex
abstract_clean: A nozzle of a fire suppression system includes a housing. Two or more orifices in the housing emit a fire suppression agent. Each of the two or more orifices emits the fire suppression agent in a rotational vortex.

title_clean: Purging method, control module, purging device and storage medium
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a purging method, a control module, purging equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining purging instructions comprising preset purging paths and purging modes, wherein the preset purging paths comprise a plurality of paths which are sequentially arranged, and each purging mode is associated with a preset purging direction; the method includes the steps of controlling a purge device to travel along a first path from a start point of a first path in a preset purge path and to perform a purge operation in a preset purge direction, controlling the purge device to perform a transfer operation corresponding to a purge mode to transfer the purge device to a start point of a next path in the preset purge path when an end point of the first path is reached, and controlling the purge device to travel along the preset purge path from the start point of the next path and to perform the purge operation in the preset purge direction. The invention improves the blowing effect and the intelligence of blowing operation.

title_clean: Electrorheological fluid structure with attached conductor and method of fabrication
abstract_clean: A system for a footwear sole component to control an incline in between a footbed and an outsole. An incline adjuster is positioned between the footbed and the outsole. The incline adjuster has a polymeric housing having a first fluid chamber, a second fluid chamber, and a fluid transfer channel; a controller having a processor, a memory, an inertial measurement unit (IMU), and a low energy wireless communication module. The controller determines whether forces from a wearer foot on the first fluid chamber and on the second fluid chamber are creating a pressure within the first fluid chamber that is higher than a pressure within the second fluid chamber, or vice versa.

title_clean: Medicine adding device
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a dosing device, which comprises a box body, wherein a metering pump is arranged at the top of the box body, a shell is fixedly connected with the top of the inner cavity of the box body, a stirring paddle is arranged in the inner cavity of the shell, an ultrasonic generator is arranged above the shell, one side of the stirring paddle is connected with an ultrasonic transducer through a buckle, a first conduction pipe is fixedly connected with the bottom end of the shell, a second three-way joint is arranged at the bottom end of the first conduction pipe, connecting pipes are inserted at both ends of the second three-way joint, a first stop valve is arranged at the outer side of the connecting pipes, a plastic hose is arranged at one end of the connecting pipes, a filter box is symmetrically and fixedly connected below the plastic hose, a metal filter screen is detachably connected at the inner side of the filter box, non-woven fabric filter cotton, by adjusting the first stop valve, the liquid medicine is injected into the other filter tank, so that the medicine adding device can continue to work normally.

title_clean: Injection fluid quantification
abstract_clean: Methods and systems may quantify how much contrast fluid is injected into a patient by a powered fluid injector. A controller of the powered fluid injector can receive a command from a user to begin dispensing contrast fluid. The controller may determine whether a hemodynamic pressure signal is present from a pressure sensor in fluidic connection with the vasculature of the patient. The powered fluid injector may dispense a quantity of contrast fluid in response to the command. The controller may add the quantity of contrast fluid to an injection quantity if the hemodynamic pressure signal is present just prior to and/or just after the quantity of contrast fluid is dispensed. The controller may refrain from adding the quantity of contrast fluid to the injection quantity if the hemodynamic pressure signal is not present just prior to and/or just after the quantity of contrast fluid is dispensed.

title_clean: Medical device substrate with rotatable struts
abstract_clean: A medical device comprising a substrate defining a major surface, the major surface defining a plane, including a plurality of first struts extending in a first direction, the plurality of first struts interconnected with a plurality of second struts, the plurality of second struts extending in a second direction that is non-parallel to the first direction, a width of the second struts measured along the major surface being greater than a thickness of the second struts measured perpendicular to the major surface, such that when the substrate is stretched in the first direction, a middle section of the second struts rotates relative to the first struts and the middle section of the second struts bends out of the plane of the major surface. The medical device is operable to stretch and/or retract elements suitable for a particular purpose. These elements are extended and/or retracted in response to stresses applied by means of stretching and/or retracting devices, and other methods. Once the force is removed, the elements remain extended and/or retracted, or may spring back to an initial position.

title_clean: Slow release flea and tick collar
abstract_clean: An extended-release plastic matrix formulation (PMF-ExR) comprising a polyethylene-comprising polymer, a plasticizer, and at least one insecticide as active components is described. The PMF-ExR may be used in the manufacture of a wearable device for treating ectoparasitic infestations.

title_clean: Vegetable sterilizing and fresh-keeping agent and preparation method thereof
abstract_clean: The invention aims to provide a vegetable sterilization preservative and a preparation method thereof, wherein the vegetable sterilization preservative comprises the following steps: fructus forsythiae extract, chitosan, radix Scutellariae extract, Gallic acid streptostacin-vitamin complex, tea polyphenols and sterile water. The preparation method of the vegetable sterilization preservative is simple and convenient, the prepared preservative is compounded with various natural biological preservatives, can inhibit the survival of various bacteria and microorganisms, and simultaneously isolates air to make the bacteria difficult to survive, thereby realizing the sterilization and bacteriostasis effects, and the vegetable sterilization preservative has the characteristics of good sterilization and bacteriostasis effects, wide action range, lasting action time and the like.

title_clean: Dianthus plant named ‘KLEDP19263’
abstract_clean: A new Dianthus plant designated ‘KLEDP19263’ particularly distinguished by pink double flowers with red eyes, composed in round, small sprays and an upright habit, is disclosed.

title_clean: Preparation method and application of lactobacillus fermented soybean milk product filtrate
abstract_clean: The invention provides a preparation method and application of lactobacillus fermented soybean milk product filtrate, wherein modified sodium alginate is used as a carrier of immobilized lactobacillus in the preparation method of the lactobacillus fermented soybean milk product filtrate. The modified sodium alginate has a space network structure with through pore channels and high specific surface area, can greatly improve the structural stability, the pore channel utilization rate and the biocompatibility of the carrier, and provides ideal microenvironment for adsorption, loading and growth of lactobacillus. The modified sodium alginate is used as a carrier to carry out immobilization treatment on activated lactobacillus, so that the tolerance and fermentation stability of the lactobacillus can be effectively improved, the strain loss is avoided, the fermentation efficiency is improved, the active ingredients of the filtrate of the lactobacillus fermented soybean milk product are more sufficient, the effects of inhibiting inflammatory cell aggregation and relieving skin sensitivity and discomfort of the skin care product composition are obviously enhanced, and the problems of weak efficacy and poor stability of the fermentation filtrate in the prior art are solved.

title_clean: Biometric pattern control method and related product
abstract_clean: The embodiment of the invention discloses a biological recognition mode control method and a related product. The method comprises the following steps: determining a reference biometric pattern of the mobile terminal; when the reference biological identification mode is started, acquiring a target working strategy of a preset light source corresponding to the reference identification mode; and controlling the preset light source to work according to the target working strategy. The embodiment of the invention is beneficial to improving the flexibility and the safety of the mobile terminal for controlling the biological recognition mode.

title_clean: Information transmission method, information reception method, terminal, and storage medium
abstract_clean: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of information processing, and discloses an information sending method, an information receiving method, a terminal and a storage medium. In the invention, in the call waiting process, first information input in a call interface is received; and sending the first information to the communication opposite end for the communication opposite end to display in the call interface. Therefore, the user can know the reason for the opposite terminal user to make a call or not answer the call, the intercommunication information of the two communication parties in the call waiting process is realized, and the interactivity of the two communication parties in the call waiting process is increased.

title_clean: Electrophysiological (ep) map coloration by considering outliers
abstract_clean: A method includes receiving a plurality of data points including electrophysiological (EP) values measured at respective positions in at least a portion of an organ of a patient. Some of the EP values are classified as outlier values in accordance with a defined criterion. A visual representation of at least the portion of the organ is derived from the plurality of data points. The visual representation represents the EP values with respective colors, and visualizes less than all the outlier values, by performing one or both of (a) identifying outlier values that deviate from respective neighboring EP values by less than a defined deviation, and representing the outlier values using colors that match the neighboring EP values, and (b) setting for the visual representation a mapping, which maps the EP values to the colors and which excludes at least some of the outlier values.

title_clean: File access management method, system and file cabinet
abstract_clean: The invention provides a file access management method, a file access management system and a file cabinet, and belongs to the technical field of file management. The method comprises the steps of S1, obtaining identity information of a worker, identifying the identity of the worker based on the identity information, S2, controlling an electronic chip to push out when the worker is identified as a legal user, enabling the worker to use a portable device to scan the electronic chip to establish connection, S3, controlling a cabinet door of a file cabinet to be opened after connection is completed, sending file information in the file cabinet to the portable device, enabling the worker to know the file information in the file cabinet and select a file to be taken, and S4, receiving file selection information returned by the portable device, controlling a drawer corresponding to the file selection information to be opened, and enabling the worker to conveniently take out the corresponding file. By verifying the identity of the staff, the electronic chip is controlled to be pushed out after the verification is passed, so that illegal users can be prevented from being connected with the electronic chip at will to acquire file information in the file cabinet, the safety and confidentiality of the file cabinet are improved, and effective management of files is facilitated.

title_clean: Video surveillance device capable of capturing clear images without being affected by external light
abstract_clean: The present invention relates to a video surveillance apparatus. The video surveillance device according to an embodiment of the present invention may record a clear video without being affected by external light. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the video surveillance device comprises: a camera unit recording a video; an illuminance sensor unit including one or more illuminance sensors; a light source position estimation unit estimating a position of a light source based on illuminance output from the illuminance sensor, and determining back light or plain light in accordance with the position of the light source; a recording control unit changing a recording setting of the camera unit in accordance with whether the back light or the plain light is present; and a posture control unit rotating the camera unit up, down, left, and right.

title_clean: Detection method, detection system and storage medium based on artificial intelligence early warning system
abstract_clean: The invention provides a detection method based on an artificial intelligence early warning system, which comprises the following steps: and classifying the monitored objects, and selecting corresponding artificial intelligence models according to the classified categories. And selecting a training sample, and training the selected artificial intelligence model by combining manual adjustment of the residual error overrun trigger threshold range of each measuring point. And applying the trained artificial intelligence model to the monitored object. The detection method based on the artificial intelligent early warning system can reduce the false alarm rate and the missing report rate of the early warning system, so that the early warning system can better play a role. The invention also provides a detection system and a storage medium for executing the detection method.

title_clean: Regional science popularization capability evaluation method based on VIKOR method
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a regional science popularization capability evaluation method based on a VI KOR method, which relates to the technical field of science popularization capability evaluation, and comprises the steps of S1 normalizing original data by using a very poor method, S2 carrying out correlation analysis on each index by using a Spearman method, S3 utilizing a conditional generalized variance minimum selection index among indexes and S4 comprehensive evaluation analysis, constructing a science popularization capability index system by using the Spearman method and the generalized variance minimum method, integrating subjective and objective weights of each index by using a game theory combined weighting method, and determining the weights of each index. Finally, the obtained weight is used for analyzing and evaluating the science popularization capability by using a Vikor method, so that the result obtained by the Vikor method is more objective. The method is carried out step by step from index screening, weight determination and method evaluation, and a process reference is provided for the evaluation and research of science popularization capability. The method is beneficial to scientifically making scientific popularization work planning according to the actual conditions of the area in each area.

title_clean: Automatic driving voice broadcasting method and system
abstract_clean: The invention relates to an automatic driving voice broadcasting method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of initializing a system, loading a voice synthesis engine and an expert knowledge base, starting a tcp port, waiting for a tcp client to establish connection, receiving intelligent driving system information after establishing connection, carrying out reasoning analysis on the received intelligent driving system information by combining the expert knowledge base, judging whether voice broadcasting is needed, synthesizing the voice information through the voice synthesis engine if the voice broadcasting is needed, adjusting voice volume, voice speed and switching voice packets through a voice broadcasting device knob, and playing sound through in-car sound equipment and an out-car loudspeaker. According to the invention, through real-time in-car and out-car voice prompts, drivers and external traffic participants can better understand and adapt to the driving intention of the automatic driving vehicle, the trouble caused by unsmooth communication or misunderstanding is reduced, and the user experience is optimized.

title_clean: Power measurement circuit, method and device
abstract_clean: The invention relates to a power measuring circuit, a method and a device, wherein the circuit comprises a magnetic field sensing unit, a first voltage signal generating unit and a second voltage signal generating unit, wherein the magnetic field sensing unit is used for testing the magnetic field of a tested object to output a first voltage signal; the amplifying unit is connected with the magnetic field sensing unit and used for amplifying the first voltage signal and outputting a second voltage signal; the electric field sensing unit is connected with the amplifying unit, takes the second voltage signal output by the amplifying unit as a bias voltage, and is used for testing an electric field generated by the tested object to output a third voltage signal; and the processing unit is used for processing the third voltage signal to obtain the power of the measured object. The power measuring circuit and the power measuring device can finish the success rate measurement of the measured object without performing power failure treatment on the measured object and additionally installing and modifying the measured object, thereby improving the convenience of power measurement and reducing the test cost.

title_clean: Imaging device and electronic apparatus
abstract_clean: An imaging device that includes: a first substrate having a first surface and a second surface and including a sensor pixel on a first semiconductor substrate, the sensor pixel performing photoelectric conversion; a second substrate having a third surface and a fourth surface and including a first transistor on a second semiconductor substrate, the first transistor configuring a pixel circuit that outputs a pixel signal based on electric charge outputted from the sensor pixel, the second substrate being stacked on the first substrate with the first surface and the third surface being opposed to each other; and a third substrate having a fifth surface and a sixth surface and including a second transistor on a third semiconductor substrate, the second transistor configuring the pixel circuit, the third substrate being stacked on the second substrate with the fourth surface and the fifth surface being opposed to each other.

title_clean: Stereoscopic image comfort degree prediction method based on deep learning
abstract_clean: The invention relates to the technical field of stereoscopic image comfort level, and in order to solve the problem of evaluating stereoscopic image perception discomfort, the invention adopts a stereoscopic image comfort level prediction method based on deep learning to predict the stereoscopic image comfort level. According to the invention, through independently calculating the single eye pattern of the three channels of red, green and blue, the color information of the stereoscopic image is reserved, and the stereoscopic image is subjected to image clipping based on significance, so that a sample for model training is expanded, and the most focused image area of a viewer is reserved to the greatest extent. The CSP-Net model is creatively improved and optimized by adding the grouping weighted attention module, and the calculation efficiency is improved.

title_clean: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR DISPLAY FIELD COMMUNICATION PERFORMING image correction based on A deep learning algorithm AND COMPUTER PROGRAM FOR THE SAME
abstract_clean: The present specification relates to a screen-based communication method performed by a receiving device for a screen-based communication, which comprises the steps of: receiving, by the receiving device, an input image obtained by photographing a screen on which an image including a data insertion image frame into which input data is inserted and a reference image frame is displayed; correcting, by the receiving device, an image distorted from the input image based on a deep learning algorithm; converting, by the receiving device, the corrected input image into frequency domain information; and restoring, by the receiving device, the input data by subtracting the reference image frame converted into the frequency domain information from the data insertion image frame converted into the frequency domain information.

title_clean: Express delivery commodity circulation packing box
abstract_clean: The invention provides an express logistics circulation packaging box which comprises a box body, an air bag, a plurality of air column units and a plurality of connecting assemblies, wherein the box body is provided with a containing cavity, the box body comprises a bottom plate, a top plate and a side plate for connecting the bottom plate and the top plate, and the side plate, the top plate and the bottom plate jointly enclose the containing cavity; the air bag is connected with the side plate of the box body and is provided with an inflation and deflation hole; the air column units are connected with the air bag and communicated with the air bag, and each air column unit at least comprises one air column; coupling assembling sets up in the one end that the gasbag was kept away from to the gas column, coupling assembling and gas column one-to-one, and relative gas column can be connected through coupling assembling to make a plurality of gas columns can be parallel or alternately, and then separate the chamber that holds of box for a plurality of accommodation space. The express logistics circulation packaging box can be repeatedly used, and transportation cost is reduced.

title_clean: Electrical equipment protection device convenient to heat dissipation
abstract_clean: The utility model provides an electrical equipment protection device convenient for heat dissipation, which comprises a box body and a second fan, wherein the upper end of the box body is fixedly connected with a rain shelter, the second fan is arranged at the upper end in the box body, window holes are arranged at the left and right ends of the box body, a first clamping groove is arranged at the upper end of the window hole, a second clamping groove is arranged at the lower end of the window hole, a spring is fixedly connected with the upper end of the second clamping groove, a ventilation mechanism is clamped in the first clamping groove and the second clamping groove, the spring is movably connected with the ventilation mechanism, a bottom plate is fixedly connected with the lower end of the box body, a first filter screen is fixedly connected with the lower end of the bottom plate, and a fan hole is; through setting up heat dissipation mechanism, can make outside air inhale inside the box when the inside temperature of box risees, through the rotation of first fan with the second fan, the inside high-temperature gas that produces by electrical equipment of box passes through heat dissipation mechanism, flows from the air outlet, reaches the radiating effect.

title_clean: Method for calculating influence of overwater photovoltaic on water temperature of underlying closed water area
abstract_clean: The invention relates to a method for calculating the influence of overwater photovoltaics on the water temperature of an underlying closed water area, which comprises the following steps: collecting information; calculating solar short-wave radiation; calculating atmospheric long radiation received by the water surface under the photovoltaic shielding; calculating evaporation scattering; calculating the convection heat flux; calculating the outward long-wave radiant heat flux of the water body; computing t 0 Time of day free surface total heat flux; calculating influence of photovoltaics t 0 → t 1 The water temperature of the water body changes at any moment;computing t 1 The water temperature that is affected by the photovoltaic at all times. According to the method, the influence of the overwater photovoltaic power station on the water temperature change is quantitatively calculated according to local meteorological conditions and photovoltaic array layout parameters to be built aiming at the pile foundation overwater photovoltaic power station in the closed water area through a water body heat balance calculation method and a calculation formula of influence of each flux subentry influence factor on the photovoltaic array, the water temperature and the water temperature change calculated according to the method can be used as a basis for evaluating the influence of the photovoltaic power station on the water environment, and a scientific basis is provided for development and utilization of the water area after the photovoltaic power station is built in the future.

title_clean: Outer-side jacket type temperature-adjustable ozone catalytic oxidation tower
abstract_clean: The utility model provides an outer jacket type temperature-adjustable ozone catalytic oxidation tower, which comprises a catalytic tower, a protective cover, a guide pipe, a fixed pipe, a purification and cooling protective frame structure, an adjustment and protection installation fixed frame structure, an installation shell, a purification box, a filter element, a protective pipe, a dredging pipe and a protective cover, wherein the protective cover is bolted on the upper part of the catalytic tower; the guide pipe is in threaded connection with the upper part of the protective cover; the fixed pipe is in threaded connection with the lower part of the guide pipe; the purification cooling protection frame structure is arranged at the lower part of the inner side of the catalytic tower; the adjusting protection installation fixing frame structure is arranged in the middle of the left side of the catalytic tower. The utility model is provided with the fixed shell, the installation pipe, the protective shell, the supporting pipe, the protective net and the fan, which is beneficial to cooling the inside of the oxidation tower; the mounting plate, branch, the pivot is connected the rope, and the setting of guard ring, otic placode and fixed orifices is favorable to fixing the oxidation tower.

title_clean: Cyano compound and application thereof
abstract_clean: The invention relates to the technical field of organic photoelectric materials, in particular to a cyano compound and application thereof. The invention provides a cyano-containing compound, which has a structure shown as a formula I. The cyano-containing compound provided by the invention has better electron receiving capability, and meanwhile, the fluorene group with large steric hindrance is introduced to weaken the interaction among molecules, so that the cyano-containing compound is used as an electron transport material in an organic electroluminescent device, the current efficiency is improved, and the service life of the device is also greatly prolonged.

title_clean: Lithium iron phosphate positive electrode material, preparation method and application
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a lithium iron phosphate positive electrode material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method of the lithium iron phosphate positive electrode material comprises the steps of sintering a lithium iron phosphate precursor under protective gas to obtain the lithium iron phosphate positive electrode material; the lithium iron phosphate precursor is mainly prepared from a first mixture, wherein the first mixture comprises an iron source, a phosphorus source, a lithium source, a carbon source and flaky graphitized carbon nitride. The flaky graphitized carbon nitride is added in the precursor preparation step, so that a uniform coating layer is formed on the surface of the lithium iron phosphate, and the prepared lithium iron phosphate positive electrode material has small particle size, high compaction and higher charge-discharge specific capacity.

title_clean: Method for improving field nondestructive current carrying capacity of REBCO high-temperature superconducting material and treated REBCO high-temperature superconducting material
abstract_clean: The invention provides a method for improving the field nondestructive current carrying capacity of REBCO high-temperature superconducting materials and the treated REBCO high-temperature superconducting materials, and belongs to the field of high-temperature superconducting materials. The method comprises the steps of carrying out twice irradiation on REBCO high-temperature superconducting materials by utilizing a fast heavy ion beam, and changing the incidence angle of the fast heavy ions in the twice irradiation, so that columnar defects which are distributed in a crossing way are introduced into REBCO, the movement of vortex kinks is restrained, and the field lossless current carrying capacity of the REBCO high-temperature superconducting materials is improved.

title_clean: Rechargeable lithium battery
abstract_clean: Disclosed is a rechargeable lithium battery including a positive electrode containing a positive active material; a negative electrode containing a negative electrode active material; an electrolyte solution containing a lithium salt and a nonaqueous organic solvent; and a separator between the positive and negative electrodes, the separator including a porous substrate and a coating layer on at least one side of the porous substrate. The negative electrode active material includes a Si-based material; the non-aqueous organic solvent comprises a cyclic carbonate comprising ethylene carbonate, propylene carbonate, or a combination thereof, the cyclic carbonate being present in an amount of about 20% to about 60% by volume based on the total amount of the non-aqueous organic solvent; and the coating comprises a fluorine-based polymer, an inorganic compound, or a combination thereof. The rechargeable lithium battery has improved life and high temperature storage characteristics.

title_clean: Phosphoric acid ammonification evaporator and phosphoric acid ammonification neutralization system and method
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a phosphoric acid ammonification evaporator and a phosphoric acid ammonification neutralization system and a method, wherein the phosphoric acid ammonification neutralization system comprises a heat exchanger and a phosphoric acid ammonification evaporator, the phosphoric acid ammonification evaporator comprises an evaporator body and a circulating ammonium phosphate pipeline connected with the evaporator body, two sides of the evaporator body are respectively provided with a circulating ammonium phosphate inlet and an ammonium phosphate product outlet, the position of the ammonium phosphate product outlet is higher than that of the circulating ammonium phosphate inlet, the top of the evaporator body is provided with a gas outlet, the bottom of the evaporator body is provided with a circulating ammonium phosphate outlet, two ends of the circulating ammonium phosphate pipeline are respectively communicated with the circulating ammonium phosphate inlet and the circulating ammonium phosphate outlet, an ammonia inlet and an acid inlet are respectively arranged on the circulating ammonium phosphate pipeline, the ammonia inlet is positioned behind the acid inlet along the circulating direction of ammonium phosphate, a heating medium inlet of the heat exchanger is connected with the gas outlet of the evaporator body, a condensate pipeline is connected with a refrigerant inlet of the heat exchanger, and the refrigerant outlet of the heat exchanger is connected with the acid inlet through a pipeline.

title_clean: High-precision numerical control machine tool waste storage tank
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a high-precision numerical control machine tool waste storage tank, in particular to the field of machine tool machining accessories, which comprises a tank body, wherein an air pressure pipeline is communicated on the tank body, one end of the air pressure pipeline, which is positioned at the outer side of the tank body, is hermetically and elastically connected with a first movable rod, the other end of the air pressure pipeline is hermetically and slidably connected with a second movable rod, a containing plate is fixedly connected on the second movable rod, a filter plate is fixedly connected in the containing plate, a first outlet is formed in the containing plate and positioned below the filter plate, a second outlet is formed in the tank body, the filter plate can play a certain role of solid-liquid separation, waste water can flow out from the first outlet at the lower end of the containing plate, the position of the first outlet and the second outlet when being communicated is determined, the waste water can be conveniently recycled, and when the waste water and waste chips are shaken, the waste water originally positioned above the waste chips can easily enter the lower part of the containing plate, the efficiency of this design classification recovery is improved.

title_clean: Fishery disaster risk assessment method and system suitable for offshore seawater pond culture
abstract_clean: The invention provides a fishery disaster risk assessment method and system suitable for offshore seawater pond culture. The method is based on the external sea hydrodynamic elements and wind speed and combines coastal embankment to evaluate the damage risk of the seawater pond culture facilities, and firstly, the range of an evaluation object area, basic geographic information of the evaluation area and the like are obtained; then, performing hydrodynamic force calculation, including open sea hydrodynamic force calculation and aquaculture pond internal hydrodynamic force calculation, wherein storm surge and water accumulation elevation + breakwater wave climbing are used as open sea hydrodynamic force elements, and pond stem storm and water accumulation elevation + wave climbing are used as aquaculture pond internal hydrodynamic force elements; and finally, evaluating the risk hidden danger of the marine facility fishery disaster and compiling a report according to the calculated external sea hydrodynamic elements and the hydrodynamic elements in the culture pond. The quantitative relation is established based on the disaster-stricken factors of the open sea and the disaster-stricken factors in the culture pond, and a basis can be provided for pre-disaster safety evaluation, disaster risk early warning and post-disaster damage evaluation of seawater pond culture.

title_clean: High-temperature sterilization device for production of waxberry juice
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a high-temperature sterilization device for producing waxberry juice, which relates to the technical field of sterilization of waxberry juice, and aims to solve the technical problem that uniform transmission of high-temperature sterilization treatment on the waxberry juice is inconvenient in the prior art; the high-temperature sterilization device comprises a bottom plate; the upper end of the bottom plate is fixedly provided with a fixed back plate, the upper end of the fixed back plate is fixedly provided with a top plate, the upper end of the top plate is fixedly provided with a fixed seat, the inner side of the fixed seat is provided with a driving component, the upper end of the bottom plate is provided with a conveying component, the outer side of the fixed back plate is provided with a sterilizing component, and a plurality of groups of sterilizing components are arranged; this high temperature sterilization device is used in red bayberry fruit juice production carries out drive processing through drive assembly to conveying subassembly, drives red bayberry fruit juice through conveying subassembly's setting and carries out even conveying processing, carries out sterilization processing to red bayberry fruit juice through sterilizing subassembly's setting, has realized carrying out even transmission high temperature sterilization processing to red bayberry fruit juice.

title_clean: Real-time electric energy monitoring equipment of data center
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses real-time electric energy monitoring equipment for a data center, which comprises the electric energy monitoring equipment, wherein filter screens are inlaid on two sides of the electric energy monitoring equipment, a cover plate is arranged on the surface of the electric energy monitoring equipment, an installation plate is connected with the inner wall of the electric energy monitoring equipment in a sliding manner, and a sliding mechanism is arranged on the surface of the installation plate. The display screen is inlayed on the surface of apron, the surface fixed mounting of mounting panel has monitoring devices, monitoring devices and display screen electric connection. Through the setting of card pole and inserted bar, make the staff only need the pulling push-and-pull rod can take off the apron from electric energy monitoring facilities, only need insert the inserted bar in the slot simultaneously, can accomplish the installation to the apron, and then made things convenient for the staff to install and dismantle the apron, and then made things convenient for the staff to maintain electric energy monitoring facilities, improved staff's work efficiency.

title_clean: Intelligent household equipment control method and system
abstract_clean: The invention provides an intelligent household equipment control method and a system thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an outdoor image through an image acquisition device arranged outdoors; optimizing the resolution of the outdoor image; identifying weather corresponding to the outdoor image through a weather identification model; when the weather is matched with a preset first weather, a first signal is sent to the processing module; when the weather is matched with a preset second weather, sending a second signal to the processing module; the processing module judges the current state of the window, if the current state corresponds to the first signal received at present, the processing module sends the first signal to the execution device, and if the current state corresponds to the second signal received at present, the processing module sends the second signal to the execution device; the execution device executes a first action according to the first signal and executes a second action according to the second signal. The invention can improve the intelligent degree and reliability of the window opening and closing function.

title_clean: Geotechnical test for simulating slope soil stress and deformation process and slope instability process analysis method
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a geotechnical test for simulating a slope soil stress deformation process and a slope instability process analysis method, which comprises the steps of (1) carrying out uniaxial compression on a core sample under the limited lateral limit action of an annular soil body in a large sample in a metal hoop, simulating a slope soil strip stress deformation process in a downhill direction, (2) applying shear load in the same direction, forming a cylindrical shear plane between the core sample and the annular soil body, simulating the slope soil strip stress deformation process in the downhill direction, (3) synchronously testing the suction force and the water content change process in the soil sample, (4) calculating compression deformation energy and shear deformation energy based on the test curve, and deducing and defining a slope stability safety coefficient by utilizing an energy conservation principle. The invention can simulate the slope soil strips, especially the deteriorated slope soil, by using the geotechnical test, and calculate the change process of the slope soil stability safety coefficient along with the shear deformation in the stress deformation development process of 'compression-shear-instability' along the slope direction, thereby reflecting the evolution process of the slope stability more truly.

title_clean: Order method and device, computer storage medium
abstract_clean: The disclosure relates to an order distribution method and device and a computer storage medium, and relates to the technical field of computers. The order distribution method comprises the following steps: dividing a plurality of orders into a first order set and a second order set according to attributes; determining a first order set to be delivered according to the area where each order of the first order set is located, and delivering orders according to the first order set to be delivered; and planning a path according to the position relationship between the positions of the orders in the second order set and the position relationship between the position of each order and the position of the distribution starting point, determining a second order set to be distributed and a path to be distributed thereof, and distributing the orders according to the path to be distributed. According to the method and the device, different order distribution modes are adopted for different orders, and distribution efficiency is improved.

title_clean: Material feeding unit and bush pressure equipment
abstract_clean: The invention belongs to the technical field of material conveying, and particularly relates to a feeding device and bushing press-fitting equipment, which are used for conveying a material carrying box to a discharging station for discharging, wherein the feeding device is provided with a material moving station and a discharging station along a first direction, the feeding device comprises a first conveying line, a second conveying line arranged above the first conveying line and a lifting material moving mechanism arranged above the discharging station and used for lifting the material carrying box, the first conveying line receives the material carrying box at the material moving station, the first conveying line conveys the material carrying box to the discharging station and releases the material carrying box at the lifting material moving mechanism, the lifting material moving mechanism lifts the discharged material carrying box to a preset height so as to enable the material carrying box to be in butt joint with the second conveying line, and the lifting material moving mechanism is also used for transferring the material carrying box to the second conveying line, and the second conveying line conveys the material carrying box to the material moving station. The invention can improve the production efficiency and reduce the occupied space of the feeding device.

title_clean: Excircle workpiece deburring equipment
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses an excircle work piece burring equipment, including driving motor one, the mill that is connected with a driving motor output with place the platform, its characterized in that: the workpiece clamping device is characterized by further comprising a bottom plate, the upper end of the bottom plate is rotatably connected with a rotating shaft, the upper end of the rotating shaft is connected with a placing table, a workpiece body is placed on the placing table, the placing table is provided with a clamping device used for fixing the two sides of the workpiece body, the upper side of the bottom plate is provided with a driving mechanism used for rotating the rotating shaft, first supporting rods and a top plate are connected and arranged at the two ends of the upper side wall of the bottom plate, a second supporting rod is connected and arranged at the upper end of the first supporting rod, a supporting plate is connected and arranged at the lower end of the top plate, a supporting plate is connected and arranged at the lower end of the second supporting rod, and a sliding plate is arranged at the lower side of the supporting plate. Compared with the prior art, the utility model the advantage lie in: the precision of polishing is higher, avoids polishing excessive condition, presss from both sides tightly more firm when fixing the work piece body.

title_clean: Variant supersonic aircraft
abstract_clean: The invention relates to the field of general design of airplanes, in particular to a variant supersonic aircraft. The method comprises the following steps: fuselage, two wings (1) and landing gear. The variant supersonic aircraft can realize the mode conversion from a low-speed flight state to a supersonic flight state through the sweepforward changing mechanism (2), and when the aircraft is in a low-speed flight state and a take-off and landing state, the wing with the large aspect ratio at the front edge is adopted, so that the induced resistance is reduced, and the low-speed flight path is increased; in a supersonic flight state, the wing with a sharp front edge and a small aspect ratio is adopted, so that the wave resistance is reduced, and the maneuverability is improved. The airplane can well meet the use requirements of high speed and low speed, and the passenger cabin, the cargo hold, the oil tank and the landing gear hold are all arranged in the two wings (1), so that no obvious airplane body exists, and the weight of the airplane is reduced to a certain extent.

title_clean: Adjustable stop gear and corrugated paper indentation device thereof
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses an adjustable limiting mechanism and a corrugated paper creasing device thereof, which are applied to the field of paperboard limiting, and the adjustable limiting mechanism comprises a mounting bottom plate, wherein an creasing machine body is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the mounting bottom plate, four limiting connecting plates are fixedly arranged at two sides of a creasing section of the creasing machine body, an adjusting component is arranged at the top of one side, far away from a conveying belt of the creasing machine body, of each limiting connecting plate, a limiting pressing plate is connected between two sides of each limiting connecting plate in a sliding manner, and each adjusting component is in contact with the upper surface of the corresponding limiting pressing plate. According to the corrugated paper thickness mark, the adjusting rotating handle is arranged, the adjusting screw is used for adjusting, the limiting pressing plate is used for displacing, when corrugated paper is conveyed on the conveying belt of the creasing machine body, the thickness mark of the corrugated paper is observed through the mark dividing ruler, the limiting pressing plate is located right above the corrugated paper, and the adjusting component and the resetting component are used for adjusting the height of the limiting pressing plate according to the thickness of the corrugated paper, so that the corrugated paper thickness mark is high in applicability.

title_clean: Football surface pattern printing equipment is used in ball production and processing
abstract_clean: The invention relates to the technical field of printing equipment, in particular to football surface pattern printing equipment for ball production and processing, which comprises a rack, wherein a conveyor belt is rotatably arranged at the top of the rack, a plurality of limiting blocks are arranged on the surface of the conveyor belt, and a discharging frame is movably arranged between two adjacent limiting blocks. According to the invention, dust is cleaned on the printing surface of the wrapping leather through the cleaning component on one side of the fixing frame, then the printing mechanism is used for carrying out pattern printing processing on the printing surface of the wrapping leather, finally the thermosetting component on the other side of the fixing frame is used for carrying out thermosetting processing on the printing pattern on the printing surface of the wrapping leather, so that efficient printing processing on the football surface pattern is completed, the whole pattern printing process adopts automatic operation, the printing efficiency on the football surface pattern is effectively improved, and the printing processing on different patterns on the football surface can be realized through quick replacement of the pattern printing structure in the printing component.

title_clean: Wear-resistant PEEK composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_clean: The application relates to the technical field of high polymer materials, in particular to a wear-resistant PEEK composite material and a preparation method thereof, comprising the steps of adding phenylethynyl phthalic anhydride into polyether-ether-ketone powder for evaporation end-capping treatment to form end-capped polyether-ether-ketone comprising an alkynyl large end and a small end, and preparing end-capped polyether-ether-ketone with the alkynyl large end and the small end; dispersing mixed filler particles in a mixed solution containing a silane coupling agent, stirring, carrying out melt mixing treatment on the stirred composite filler and capped polyether-ether-ketone to obtain a composite melt, carrying out hot pressing on the composite melt to form a crystal structure, carrying out thermal cycle diffusion treatment on the crystal structure to obtain a heat treatment product comprising an interface diffusion layer, and carrying out scanning treatment on the heat treatment product based on pulse laser to enable the polyether-ether-ketone on the surface layer to be melted and activate the interface diffusion layer to form the wear-resistant composite material comprising the wear-resistant coating. The application solves the technical problems of weak bonding force between the wear-resistant coating and the matrix interface and easy premature stripping in the prior art, and greatly reduces the wear rate compared with the reference in the prior art.

title_clean: Method for monitoring working performance and repair efficiency of self-repairing cement-based material
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a method for monitoring the working performance and the repair efficiency of a self-repairing cement-based material, which relates to the technical field of material detection and comprises the steps of building a test platform based on acoustic emission and 2D-DIC (two-dimensional digital computer), obtaining the mechanical property, acoustic emission characteristic signals and strain fields of microcapsule self-repairing cement materials with different contents, researching the crack initiation and expansion and destruction evolution processes, analyzing a deformation failure mechanism, and providing a detection method and a theoretical basis for the research on the working performance and the repair efficiency of microcapsule self-repairing. A test platform based on acoustic emission and 2D-DIC is built, mechanical properties, acoustic emission characteristic signals and strain fields of microcapsule self-repairing cement materials with different contents are obtained, crack initiation and expansion and destruction evolution processes are researched, a deformation failure mechanism is analyzed, and an effective monitoring method is provided for research of microcapsule self-repairing working performance and repairing efficiency.

title_clean: Method for producing aromatic bis(hydroxyalkyl) dicarboxylate and method for producing recycled aromatic polyester
abstract_clean: Provided is a method for producing an aromatic bis(hydroxyalkyl) dicarboxylate by depolymerizing a polyester in the presence of a catalyst. This method for producing an aromatic bis(hydroxyalkyl) dicarboxylate by depolymerizing a polyester in the presence of a catalyst is characterized in that the catalyst is a manganese-based catalyst and the used amount of the catalyst with respect to the polyester is 20-500 mmol%. Also provided is a method for producing a polyester polymer and an intermediate thereof, wherein the polyester polymer is produced by performing re-polymerization using the aromatic bis(hydroxyalkyl) dicarboxylate as a raw material, and the polyester polymer has less coloration like a virgin product (product which is produced by polymerizing monomers without performing depolymerization).

title_clean: Blood simulation liquid for simulating coagulation process
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a blood simulation liquid for simulating a blood coagulation process, which belongs to the technical field of blood simulation and comprises sodium carboxymethyl cellulose and polyaluminium sulfate, wherein the sodium carboxymethyl cellulose and the polyaluminium sulfate are subjected to flocculation reaction, and a reaction system of the flocculation reaction comprises a 10% gelatin solution, a 2% sodium carboxymethyl cellulose solution and a 10% polyaluminium sulfate solution; or comprises sodium carboxymethylcellulose powder and polyaluminium sulfate solution. The invention can simulate the whole process of blood coagulation, the material is easy to obtain, no biological hazard exists, the test solution is relatively stable, the operation is more convenient, and a relatively stable standard model for simulating the blood coagulation process is established by a chemical method and is used for research of instruments and factory calibration thereof.

title_clean: Production process of stasis-removing phlegm-reducing decoction pieces based on calcined concha arcae
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a production process of decoction pieces for removing blood stasis and reducing phlegm based on calcined concha arcae, belonging to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicine decoction pieces, wherein the calcined concha arcae is a monarch drug, is calcined and quenched by adopting an acetic acid solution and then is easily ground into powder, and the calcined concha arcae powder is more exquisite and is convenient to disperse after ball milling; the Ganoderma extract in the dry extract powder contains ganoderan, and has anticancer effect and can prevent inflammatory cell diseases; rhizoma gastrodiae has the effect of clearing and activating the channels and collaterals, dried orange peel has the effects of regulating qi, tonifying spleen, eliminating dampness and reducing phlegm, and the dried orange peel has fragrance, so that the decoction pieces are more tasty; the concentrated solution of fructus Eriobotryae has effects of moistening lung and relieving cough, and semen Armeniacae amarum also has effects of relieving cough and asthma; the liquorice has the effects of eliminating phlegm and relieving cough and harmonizing the medicines, the fried gardenia has the effects of cooling blood and detoxifying, reducing swelling and the like, the viscosity of the prepared honey refined medicinal powder is increased after the liquorice and the fried gardenia are further fried through refined honey, the disintegration time can be increased after the liquorice and the fried gardenia are pressed into tablets, and the action time of the medicine is prolonged.

title_clean: Use of Yr4DS gene of Aegilops tauschii in stripe rust resistance breeding of Triticeae plants
abstract_clean: Provided is a Yr4DS gene of Aegilops tauschii and use thereof in stripe rust resistance breeding of Triticeae plants. Said gene has a sequence as shown in SEQ ID NO. 1, SEQ ID NO. 3, SEQ ID NO. 5, SEQ ID NO. 7, SEQ ID NO. 9, or SEQ ID NO.10.

title_clean: Device, system and method for multi-factor detection of in vitro skin tissue culture
abstract_clean: The application discloses a device, a system and a method for detecting multiple factors in vitro skin-like tissue culture, wherein a skin-like tissue culture chip receives input of culture solution, performs skin-like tissue culture, externally stimulates the skin-like tissue, outputs the culture solution after stimulation reaction to a sample processing chip, and the culture solution contains multiple cytokines; the sample processing chip processes the culture solution after the stimulation reaction with the magnetic beads and the substrate to form a mixture of the magnetic beads and the substrate, and outputs the mixture to the multi-factor detection chip, wherein the magnetic beads are coupled with a linking structure of a capture antibody-cytokine; the multi-factor detection chip is used for detecting the content of different cytokines in the mixture of the magnetic beads and the substrate. The device, the system and the method for detecting the multifactor in the in-vitro skin-like tissue culture can culture the skin-like tissue in vitro, detect the response of the skin-like tissue after the skin-like tissue is stimulated externally and have high speed.

title_clean: Preparation method of high-strength erosion-resistant polyurea composite coating
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a preparation method of a polyurea composite coating with high strength and erosion resistance, which comprises the steps of firstly preparing BNNSs, a polyurea A component and a polyurea B component respectively, then mixing BNNSs into the B component to be uniformly dispersed to prepare a mixture, and then spraying the A component and the mixture on the surface of a metal substrate through spraying equipment to obtain a composite coating after solidification; the BNNSs inherits the good thermal property and excellent lubricating property of h-BN, and has high strength, high temperature resistance, insulation and chemical stability, so that the composite coating has a wider application range. The strength of the polyurea composite coating is improved by introducing BNNSs, when the composite coating is impacted by external force, impact energy can be consumed by boron nitride particles, so that the impact resistance of the coating is enhanced, and when the composite coating is eroded by external force, the laminated BNNSs in the polyurea coating system can be used as a reinforcement body to bear part of load and can be used as a lubricant to play a role in reducing erosion.

title_clean: Lithium iron phosphate positive electrode material, preparation method and application
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a lithium iron phosphate positive electrode material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the preparation method of the lithium iron phosphate positive electrode material comprises the steps of sintering a lithium iron phosphate precursor under protective gas to obtain the lithium iron phosphate positive electrode material; the lithium iron phosphate precursor is mainly prepared from a first mixture, wherein the first mixture comprises an iron source, a phosphorus source, a lithium source, a carbon source and flaky graphitized carbon nitride. The flaky graphitized carbon nitride is added in the precursor preparation step, so that a uniform coating layer is formed on the surface of the lithium iron phosphate, and the prepared lithium iron phosphate positive electrode material has small particle size, high compaction and higher charge-discharge specific capacity.

title_clean: Dielectric barrier plasma ammonia burner and pulverized coal ammonia-doped combustion system
