abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a dielectric barrier plasma ammonia burner and a pulverized coal ammonia-doped combustion system, and belongs to the technical field of plasma application. The dielectric barrier plasma ammonia burner comprises a high-frequency high-voltage power supply and a dielectric barrier plasma generator; the medium blocking plasma generator is provided with an ammonia gas inlet and a cracking product outlet. The pulverized coal ammonia-doped combustion system comprises the dielectric barrier plasma ammonia burner, an ammonia fuel source, an ammonia/pulverized coal burner and a power plant boiler; the ammonia fuel source is sequentially connected with the dielectric barrier plasma ammonia burner, the ammonia/pulverized coal burner and the power plant boiler. The ammonia gas is partially converted into nitrogen and hydrogen by the dielectric barrier plasma ammonia burner arranged on the ammonia supply pipeline, which is favorable for ignition and stable combustion of the ammonia gas.

title_clean: Nanometer titanium dioxide network composite mesoporous carbon coated lithium manganese iron phosphate and preparation method thereof
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a preparation method of nano titanium dioxide network composite mesoporous carbon coated lithium manganese iron phosphate, which belongs to the field of lithium ion battery anode materials. The nano titanium dioxide network composite mesoporous carbon coated lithium manganese iron phosphate prepared by the invention has the characteristics of small particle size, uniform particle size distribution, high conductivity, large specific surface area and multiple active sites.

title_clean: Intelligent storage cabinet with digital management of medical supplies for pet hospitals
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to the technical field of intelligent storage cabinets, in particular to an intelligent storage cabinet for a pet hospital, which comprises a cabinet body, wherein a plurality of groups of laminates used for placing medical supplies are arranged on the inner side of the cabinet body along the vertical direction, a lifting plate is vertically and slidingly connected to the side surface of the cabinet body, a sliding seat is arranged at the bottom of the lifting plate, limiting strips used for sliding connection of the sliding seats are arranged at the bottoms of the lifting plate and the plurality of groups of laminates, a driving assembly is arranged at the bottom of the sliding seat and used for driving the sliding seat to linearly slide along the limiting strips, a scanner is arranged at the bottom of the sliding seat and used for carrying out information scanning on materials, and an SPD (serial number display) used for recording the scanning of the scanner is arranged on a cabinet door in a hospital warehouse or an operating room.

title_clean: Intelligent household equipment control method and system
abstract_clean: The invention provides an intelligent household equipment control method and a system thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an outdoor image through an image acquisition device arranged outdoors; optimizing the resolution of the outdoor image; identifying weather corresponding to the outdoor image through a weather identification model; when the weather is matched with a preset first weather, a first signal is sent to the processing module; when the weather is matched with a preset second weather, sending a second signal to the processing module; the processing module judges the current state of the window, if the current state corresponds to the first signal received at present, the processing module sends the first signal to the execution device, and if the current state corresponds to the second signal received at present, the processing module sends the second signal to the execution device; the execution device executes a first action according to the first signal and executes a second action according to the second signal. The invention can improve the intelligent degree and reliability of the window opening and closing function.

title_clean: Method of compressing and decompressing a file via cellular automata pre-processing
abstract_clean: Described herein relates to a method for pre-processing files that can improve file compression rates of existing general-purpose lossless file compression algorithms, particularly for files on which traditional algorithms perform poorly. The elementary cellular automata (CA) pre-processing technique involves finding an optimal CA state that can be used to transform an original file into a format (i.e., an intermediary file) that is more amenable to compression than the original file format. This technique is applicable to multiple file types and may be used to enhance multiple compression algorithms. Evaluation on generated files, as well as samples selected from online text repositories, finds that the CA pre-processing technique improves compression rates by up to 4% and shows promising results for assisting in compressing data that typically induce worst-case behavior in standard compression algorithms.

title_clean: Distributed replacement flow shop scheduling optimization method with preventive maintenance
abstract_clean: The invention belongs to the technical field of distributed replacement flow shop scheduling in intelligent manufacturing, and particularly relates to a distributed replacement flow shop scheduling optimization method with preventive maintenance. The method comprises the steps of dividing a population into two populations of an explorer and a developer, performing state evaluation and search action decision based on population improvement rate and diversity through Q learning, combining a multi-arm slot machine model to adaptively select eight types of neighborhood disturbance operators including a factory layer, a workpiece layer and a local layer for an individual, constructing an elite library to finish deep search after propagation diffusion, local search, competitive exclusion and population immigration iterative optimization, and finally using a heuristic algorithm global optimal solution as a heat starting point to finish final optimization through constraint planning CP model. The invention obviously improves the solving precision and efficiency of the scheduling problem and effectively balances the global exploration and local development capacity of the algorithm.

title_clean: Clamping conveying device for machining
abstract_clean: The application discloses a clamping and conveying device for machining, which relates to the field of clamping and conveying equipment and comprises a machining table, wherein two clamping rails are arranged above the machining table in parallel, first driving mechanisms for driving the two clamping rails to perform centering or separating movement are arranged on two sides of the clamping rails, elastic clamping assemblies for clamping workpieces are arranged on adjacent sides of the two clamping rails, lifting pieces for driving the first driving mechanisms to lift are arranged on two sides of the machining table, and a second driving mechanism for driving the elastic clamping assemblies to move with the workpieces is arranged on one side of the machining table. The application not only can carry out self-adaptive adjustment according to the small size difference of the same workpiece and stably clamp the workpiece, but also can adjust the clamping distance according to different types of workpieces, and has strong adaptability.

title_clean: Rotary sealing element machining equipment and machining method
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a rotary sealing element processing device and a processing method, belonging to the technical field of sealing element processing, and comprising a base, wherein two conveying shells are fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the base, two first rotating shafts are rotatably arranged in the conveying shells, conveying rollers are fixed on the outer surfaces of the first rotating shafts, the two conveying rollers are in transmission connection through a conveying belt, and side baffles are arranged on the front side and the rear side above the conveying belt; through the conveyer belt that sets up workstation and workstation both sides, use through belt and band pulley and bevel gear linkage between the pivot one of workstation both sides and the workstation, can realize that the conveyer belt goes up the synchronous rotation of unloading and workstation, and the cooperation is sheared sword, the cooperation of punching press head scraping wings and is used, realizes that the material loading is carried, the punching press, is cuted, is pushed away the synchronous continuous of material and unloading transport and goes on, and multiple processing procedure goes on in succession, and whole mechanical linkage nature is strong, effectively promotes work efficiency.

title_clean: Be applicable to different radius brake block and spout a yard device
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a code spraying device suitable for brake pads with different radiuses, which comprises a support frame, a code spraying turntable, a rotating shaft, a driving motor, a switch control turntable, a code spraying assembly and a code spraying trigger switch, wherein the code spraying turntable is arranged at the upper end of the support frame and is rotationally connected with the support frame; a plurality of clamping grooves for placing brake pads are formed in the code spraying turntable; and a plurality of code spraying control bulges which correspond to the clamping grooves one by one and are used for triggering the code spraying trigger switch are fixed on the switch control turntable.

title_clean: Direct-pressing feeding device of tablet press
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a tablet press's vertical compression material feeding unit relates to tablet press auxiliary assembly technical field, including feed opening, feed inlet and casing, the feed inlet is installed to one side on casing top, crushing structure sets up in the central position department on casing top, the feed opening is installed to the bottom of casing, the screening structure sets up the top with the feed opening inner wall, accuse material structure sets up in the below that feed inlet one side was kept away from to the casing. The utility model discloses a step motor makes the bull stick drive the driving gear and rotates, and the intermeshing through driving gear and driven gear drives driven gear and rotates, and driven gear drives afterwards and controls the flitch and rotate, and when the hole of controlling the flitch and controlling the flitch down coincided each other, the material passed through the hole and gets into the inside of feed opening this moment, has realized the purpose of ration unloading, has avoided causing the waste of material, has improved economic benefits.

title_clean: Steam generating device with pressure relief structure and household appliance
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a steam generating device with a pressure relief structure and a household appliance. The steam generating device with the pressure relief structure comprises a flow channel plate, a heating plate and a pressure relief structure, wherein the flow channel plate is provided with an opening, a first water inlet, a steam outlet and an opposite joint, a flow channel is arranged in the flow channel plate, the heating plate comprises a plate body and a heating piece arranged on one side of the plate body, which is away from the heating piece, is covered on the opening, and the pressure relief structure is connected with the flow channel plate and is provided with a pressure relief opening, and the pressure relief opening is communicated with the opposite joint. According to the steam generating device with the pressure relief structure, through the arrangement of the pressure relief structure, the excessive steam with the technical pressure can be discharged, and the use safety is ensured.

title_clean: Pipe joint
abstract_clean: To provide a pipe joint that can immediately shut off a hydrogen gas flow path at an initial stage when a plug (nozzle side member) comes out of a socket (filling apparatus side member) to prevent release of outgas. A pipe joint (100) of the present invention includes: a cylindrical nozzle side member (10) with a shutoff valve (5), in the cylindrical nozzle side member (10) being formed a passage (1A); and a cylindrical filling apparatus side member (20) with a shutoff valve (24), in the cylindrical filling apparatus side member (20) being formed a passage (21A), wherein when the nozzle side member (10) and the filling apparatus side member (20) are connected with each other, central axes of the passages (1A, 21A) of the nozzle side member (10) and the filling apparatus side member (20) do not form a same straight line, and the central axes of the passages (1A, 21A) are offset without intersecting, and the shutoff valves (5, 24) of the both members (10, 20) open to communicate the passages (1A, 21A) of the both members (10, 20) with each other, and when the nozzle side member (10) is separated from the filling apparatus side member (20) , the shutoff valves (5, 24) of the both members (10, 20) close.

title_clean: Crystallizer liquid level control system with disturbance observer and control method
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a crystallizer liquid level control system with a disturbance observer and a control method. The two-degree-of-freedom crystallizer liquid level control system formed by combining the PID controller with the set disturbance observer is formed, and the system completes the setting under the constraint of the robustness and stability of the system. The corresponding control method completes the suppressed feedback of the uncertainty disturbance of the system by solving the plug rod adjustment quantity calculated based on the PID controller and the compensation quantity calculated based on the disturbance observer observation gain regulator in each sampling period of the system. The crystallizer liquid level control system with the disturbance observer and the control method thereof have ingenious design as a whole, strong anti-interference capability, small fluctuation and strong practicability.

title_clean: Tube coupling
abstract_clean: A tube coupling is configured to connect and couple two tubes that are configured to cause a fluid to flow inside the two tubes. The tube coupling includes: a male connector including a first pipe configured to cause the fluid to flow inside the first pipe, and an insertion part having a protruding shape protruding in an axial direction that is an insertion direction; and a female connector including a second pipe configured to cause the fluid to flow inside the second pipe, and an insertion receiving part having a recessed shape recessed in the axial direction and coupled to the insertion part when the insertion part is inserted into the insertion receiving part. The insertion part includes a first spring, a first pressing member having a protruding shape, a first seal member having an annular shape, and a first outer peripheral member surrounding the first pressing member.

title_clean: Clinical anesthesia intubate auxiliary device for department of anesthesia
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a clinical anesthesia intubation auxiliary device for anesthesia department, which relates to the field of medical appliances and comprises a biting sleeve main body, wherein an installation outer frame is fixedly installed on the outer wall of the biting sleeve main body, and two side walls of the installation outer frame are fixedly connected with installation elastic binding bands so as to fix the position of the whole biting sleeve main body. According to the invention, a patient bites the biting sleeve, the tube body for inserting the tube penetrates through the limiting movable frame to penetrate into the pharyngeal portion of the patient, and meanwhile, the limiting movable frame is stirred in a homeopathic mode to drive the tongue depressor mounted with the limiting movable frame to push down the tongue, so that medical staff can perform intubation operation better, the follow-up tongue depressor needs to be detached and replaced, and the elastic plastic sheet is pushed down to enable the sawtooth block at the top of the elastic plastic sheet to leave behind the sawtooth groove matched with the sawtooth block, so that the tongue depressor can be pulled out of the mounting buckle groove, and the tongue depressor can be taken down.

title_clean: Excircle workpiece deburring equipment
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses an excircle work piece burring equipment, including driving motor one, the mill that is connected with a driving motor output with place the platform, its characterized in that: the workpiece clamping device is characterized by further comprising a bottom plate, the upper end of the bottom plate is rotatably connected with a rotating shaft, the upper end of the rotating shaft is connected with a placing table, a workpiece body is placed on the placing table, the placing table is provided with a clamping device used for fixing the two sides of the workpiece body, the upper side of the bottom plate is provided with a driving mechanism used for rotating the rotating shaft, first supporting rods and a top plate are connected and arranged at the two ends of the upper side wall of the bottom plate, a second supporting rod is connected and arranged at the upper end of the first supporting rod, a supporting plate is connected and arranged at the lower end of the top plate, a supporting plate is connected and arranged at the lower end of the second supporting rod, and a sliding plate is arranged at the lower side of the supporting plate. Compared with the prior art, the utility model the advantage lie in: the precision of polishing is higher, avoids polishing excessive condition, presss from both sides tightly more firm when fixing the work piece body.

title_clean: Pile-supported embankment multi-layer reinforcement body reinforcing technology based on numerical simulation
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a pile-supported embankment multi-layer reinforcement body reinforcing technology based on numerical simulation, which specifically comprises the following steps: establishing a numerical model of the pile-supported embankment with the multilayer reinforced ribs by using finite element software, and calculating and analyzing the working mechanism of the multilayer reinforced rib body; based on the stress-strain analysis result of each layer of reinforcement body in the reinforcement cushion layer, the strength grade of each layer of reinforcement body in the reinforcement cushion layer is optimized, and the fine design of the pile-supported reinforced embankment is guided. The invention deeply researches the cooperative bearing mechanism of the reinforcement bodies of each layer in the reinforcement cushion layer, can ensure that the strength of the reinforcement bodies of each layer is fully exerted, and effectively controls the vertical and horizontal displacement of the embankment, on one hand, the long-term stability of the pile-supported reinforced embankment can be maintained, and on the other hand, the material waste caused by the unreasonable design of the reinforcement bodies of multiple layers can be avoided.

title_clean: Rotating shaft device, folding shell and electronic equipment
abstract_clean: The application provides a rotating shaft device which comprises a supporting mechanism, a rotating assembly and a driven assembly, wherein the supporting mechanism comprises two side supporting pieces, the rotating assembly comprises a positioning seat and two rotating mechanisms, each rotating mechanism comprises a first rotating piece, a second rotating piece and a connecting piece, two opposite ends of the first rotating piece and the second rotating piece are respectively and rotatably connected with the positioning seat and the connecting piece, a first rotating axis line between the first rotating piece and the connecting piece is parallel to a second rotating axis line between the second rotating piece and the connecting piece, the driven assembly comprises two driven pieces respectively corresponding to the two rotating mechanisms, the driven pieces are connected with the side supporting pieces and the connecting pieces on the same side of the positioning seat in a sliding and rotating mode, and the side supporting pieces are connected with the connecting pieces in a rotating mode, and the connecting pieces rotate relative to the positioning seat to drive the first rotating piece, the second rotating piece and the driven pieces to drive the two side supporting pieces to be mutually bent or mutually unfolded. The application also provides a folding shell with the rotating shaft device and electronic equipment.

title_clean: Food-grade white special lubricating grease and preparation method thereof
abstract_clean: The invention discloses food-grade white special lubricating grease and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of lubricating grease; the food-grade white special lubricating grease comprises a component A and a component B, wherein the component A consists of base oil, fatty acid, calcium hydroxide and titanate; the component B consists of an extreme pressure antiwear agent, an antioxidant and a solid additive. The food-grade white special lubricating grease disclosed by the invention passes food-grade authentication, has the characteristics of high temperature resistance, water resistance, mechanical shear resistance, corrosion resistance and the like, and can be applied to medical instruments, food machinery or textile machinery.

title_clean: Production process of stasis-removing phlegm-reducing decoction pieces based on calcined concha arcae
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a production process of decoction pieces for removing blood stasis and reducing phlegm based on calcined concha arcae, belonging to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicine decoction pieces, wherein the calcined concha arcae is a monarch drug, is calcined and quenched by adopting an acetic acid solution and then is easily ground into powder, and the calcined concha arcae powder is more exquisite and is convenient to disperse after ball milling; the Ganoderma extract in the dry extract powder contains ganoderan, and has anticancer effect and can prevent inflammatory cell diseases; rhizoma gastrodiae has the effect of clearing and activating the channels and collaterals, dried orange peel has the effects of regulating qi, tonifying spleen, eliminating dampness and reducing phlegm, and the dried orange peel has fragrance, so that the decoction pieces are more tasty; the concentrated solution of fructus Eriobotryae has effects of moistening lung and relieving cough, and semen Armeniacae amarum also has effects of relieving cough and asthma; the liquorice has the effects of eliminating phlegm and relieving cough and harmonizing the medicines, the fried gardenia has the effects of cooling blood and detoxifying, reducing swelling and the like, the viscosity of the prepared honey refined medicinal powder is increased after the liquorice and the fried gardenia are further fried through refined honey, the disintegration time can be increased after the liquorice and the fried gardenia are pressed into tablets, and the action time of the medicine is prolonged.

title_clean: Dianthus plant named ‘KLEDP19263’
abstract_clean: A new Dianthus plant designated ‘KLEDP19263’ particularly distinguished by pink double flowers with red eyes, composed in round, small sprays and an upright habit, is disclosed.

title_clean: Sow anti-stress functional feed and preparation method thereof
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a sow anti-stress functional feed and a preparation method thereof, wherein the sow anti-stress functional feed comprises, by weight, 700-850 parts of a basic feed, 0.5-3 parts of probiotics, 0.01-0.05 part of yeast selenium, 5-15 parts of compound amino acid, 1-3 parts of vitamin premix, 2-5 parts of mineral premix and 10-30 parts of carrier, the probiotics are compound microbial inoculum of Saccharomyces cerevisiae, bacillus subtilis and Pediococcus acidilactici, the weight ratio of the three is 3:2:1, the viable count is more than or equal to 80 hundred million CFU/g, and the organic selenium content in the yeast selenium is more than or equal to 2000ppm. The invention has scientific formula and remarkable synergistic effect, organically combines probiotics, yeast selenium and compound amino acid, wherein the probiotics regulate intestinal microecology balance, the yeast selenium enhances the oxidation resistance of organisms, the compound amino acid supplements nutrition loss, effectively relieves the stress reaction of sows, solves the problem of limited anti-stress effect of single component, has balanced nutrition, and meets the nutrition requirements of sows at different stages.

title_clean: Milling and grinding processing machine for heating radiator
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a radiator mills and grinds processing machine, the on-line screen storage device comprises a base, the operation panel, the centre gripping subassembly, the lifter plate, elevating system, the movable plate, moving mechanism, first motor, mill the mill, the suction box, the dust catcher, the dust screen, the dust absorption pipe, the slider, two sets of fixed blocks and cloth arranging pipe, the top left side at the base is fixed to the operation panel, the centre gripping unit mount is on the operation panel, and the lifter plate passes through elevating system and is connected with the base, the movable plate passes through the moving mechanism and is connected with the bottom left side of lifter plate, the bottom at the movable plate is fixed to first motor, the output and the mill dish of first motor are connected, and the bottom right side at the lifter plate is fixed to the suction box, the right-hand member at the suction box is fixed to the dust catcher. The utility model discloses avoided through artifical manual radiator of polishing, reduced workman's intensity of labour, avoided simultaneously that a large amount of dusts cause environmental pollution in spreading the air, improved the environmental protection usability of device.

title_clean: Electrical equipment protection device convenient to heat dissipation
abstract_clean: The utility model provides an electrical equipment protection device convenient for heat dissipation, which comprises a box body and a second fan, wherein the upper end of the box body is fixedly connected with a rain shelter, the second fan is arranged at the upper end in the box body, window holes are arranged at the left and right ends of the box body, a first clamping groove is arranged at the upper end of the window hole, a second clamping groove is arranged at the lower end of the window hole, a spring is fixedly connected with the upper end of the second clamping groove, a ventilation mechanism is clamped in the first clamping groove and the second clamping groove, the spring is movably connected with the ventilation mechanism, a bottom plate is fixedly connected with the lower end of the box body, a first filter screen is fixedly connected with the lower end of the bottom plate, and a fan hole is; through setting up heat dissipation mechanism, can make outside air inhale inside the box when the inside temperature of box risees, through the rotation of first fan with the second fan, the inside high-temperature gas that produces by electrical equipment of box passes through heat dissipation mechanism, flows from the air outlet, reaches the radiating effect.

title_clean: Fiber composite fireproof air duct plate
abstract_clean: The utility model aims to provide a fiber composite fireproof air duct board, which is formed by adopting casting forming and pulp-flowing roller leveling technology, so that the structural strength of the board is greatly improved, meanwhile, a structural support frame is adopted, the strength of the board is further enhanced, and then, through staggered arrangement of a first sound insulation hole and a second sound insulation hole, sound insulation cotton is filled, so that the sound insulation effect of the board is enhanced, the production cost is finally reduced, and meanwhile, the production efficiency is improved.

title_clean: Radiator and air conditioner
abstract_clean: The application provides a radiator and an air conditioner, which comprise a first radiating part, a second radiating part and a connecting part, wherein the connecting part comprises a first section and a second section, the first section is arranged on the first radiating part, the second section is arranged on the second radiating part, and the connecting part can be bent so as to enable the first radiating part and the second radiating part to be arranged at an angle. The radiator and the air conditioner provided by the embodiment of the application can effectively improve the contact area of the radiating air and the radiator, improve the radiating efficiency of the radiator and ensure the service life of a power device.

title_clean: Information configuration method and device of trackside equipment monitoring unit system and related equipment
abstract_clean: The invention provides an information configuration method and device of a track side equipment monitoring unit system and related equipment, wherein the method can be applied to a server and comprises the steps of obtaining equipment information of an information tuning matching unit of each track equipment monitoring acquisition extension on a target power carrier line in the track side equipment monitoring unit system; the method comprises the steps of determining a target configuration track equipment monitoring and collecting extension set from each track equipment monitoring and collecting extension set on a target power carrier line, and transmitting equipment information of an information tuning and matching unit of the target configuration track equipment monitoring and collecting extension set to the target configuration track equipment monitoring and collecting extension set through a preset interaction channel so as to realize information configuration of the target configuration track equipment monitoring and collecting extension set, namely, the method can remotely realize information configuration work of each track equipment monitoring and collecting extension set in a track side equipment monitoring and collecting unit system through a PC (personal computer), does not need to go on a track, and configuration writing efficiency is improved.

title_clean: Communication method and related device
abstract_clean: The application provides a communication method and a related device, which are applied to the technical field of communication. The method comprises receiving a first message, wherein the first message is used for indicating a first preamble sequence and/or a second preamble sequence, and transmitting the first preamble sequence or the second preamble sequence on a first random access resource, wherein the first random access resource is associated with a first preconfigured uplink resource PUR. The embodiment of the application can effectively ensure the probability of communication between the terminal and the network equipment.

title_clean: Methods and systems for reconstructing genomic reference sequences from compressed genomic sequence reads
abstract_clean: The methods and apparatus described in this disclosure include representing a reference genome in terms of syntax elements describing differences between the reference genome and genomic sequences previously aligned with the reference genome. Each aligned genomic sequence is described by means of a subset of the syntax elements. Syntax elements describing all genomic sequences are partitioned in blocks according to their statistical properties. Each syntax element block is entropy coded. The entropy encoded blocks are then concatenated to form a compressed bitstream. By virtue of the syntax element representing the difference between the reference genome and the aligned sequence, the syntax element is partitioned in blocks according to its statistical properties, each syntax element block being entropy coded. These entropy encoded syntax elements are embedded in the bitstream of the encoded blocks of syntax elements describing the aligned reads. The disclosed method enables reconstruction of a reference genome for alignment when decoding compressed genomic sequences while preserving different options of random access to compressed data and enabling efficient compression.

title_clean: Measurement model based on uplink signals with reciprocity to downlink beam
abstract_clean: In an aspect, a network component (e.g., BS, server, etc.) obtains measurement information associated with uplink signal(s) from UE(s), with the uplink signal(s) having reciprocity with one or more downlink beams of wireless node(s) (e.g., TRP, reference UE, etc.). The network component determines (e.g., generates or refines) a measurement (e.g., RFFP-P) model based on the measurement information. The network component provides the measurement (e.g., RFFP-P) model to a target UE. The target UE receives at least one signal (e.g., PRS) on the one or more downlink beams from the wireless node(s). The target UE processes the at least one signal (e.g., predicts target UE location) based at least in part on the measurement (e.g., RFFP-P) model.

title_clean: Broken siphon device of magnetic coagulation system sludge dewatering water inlet system
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to an environmental protection water treatment technical field especially relates to a broken siphon device of magnetism system sludge dewatering water intake system that congeals, including the muddy water elevator pump, the muddy water governing valve, the muddy water check valve, the sludge thickener, sludge dewaterer and air-breather, air-breather includes the framework, solenoid, the iron plate, first spring, move the iron core, connecting block and sliding block, framework and pipeline intercommunication, be provided with the recess in the framework, through-hole and spout, sliding block and spout sliding connection, through-hole and spout intercommunication, spout and recess intercommunication, solenoid sets up in the recess, solenoid's one end and framework fixed connection, solenoid's the other end and iron plate fixed connection, the one end and the framework fixed connection of first spring, the other end of first spring with move iron core fixed connection, in this way can become to shut down the back sewage still flow in sludge dewaterer through the pipeline.

title_clean: Waste water treatment device
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a wastewater treatment device, comprising: the separator comprises a waste water storage area, a distillate storage area and a concentrated solution area; the condenser is used for introducing steam subjected to heat exchange by the heater, condensing the steam and conveying the steam to the distillate storage area, and meanwhile, utilizing the steam to perform heat exchange preheating on the wastewater and conveying the wastewater to the wastewater storage area; the heater is used for introducing steam and wastewater, heating the wastewater by using the steam, discharging the wastewater to the wastewater storage area to form wastewater steam, and introducing the steam after heat exchange into the condenser; the demister is arranged in the separator and used for intercepting and demisting the waste water steam generated by the heater and conveying the intercepted substances to the concentrated solution area. The waste water treatment device of the invention not only has small floor area and low cost, but also is especially suitable for waste water which has small treatment capacity and needs concentration treatment. The pipeline is simple, the installation is convenient, only need put through a small amount of pipelines and install the completion, improves installation effectiveness and installation rate of accuracy.

title_clean: Microfluidic reactor for controlling chemical reaction and chemical reaction control method using the same
abstract_clean: The present invention relates to a microfluidic reactor for controlling chemical reactions and a chemical reaction control method using the same, and more specifically, provides a microfluidic reactor capable of controlling chemical reactions on an expanded scale and a microfluidic reaction device including the same. In addition, an ultra-fast synthesis method for controlling unstable intermediates using the microfluidic reactor and the microfluidic reaction device is provided. The microfluidic reactor of the present invention comprises a housing, a unit flow path module, a branch flow path module, and a collection flow path.

title_clean: Wet dust removal device for industrial waste gas treatment
abstract_clean: The invention relates to the technical field of industrial waste gas treatment, in particular to a wet dust removal device for industrial waste gas treatment. The invention provides a wet dust removal device for industrial waste gas treatment, which is used for removing an oil film on the inner wall. The wet dust collector for industrial waste gas treatment includes waste gas tower, high pressure nozzle, air inlet pipe, cylinder, annular scraper, collecting ring and guide rod. The annular scraping plate moves upwards to scrape the oil film on the inner wall of the waste gas tower, the scraped oil film falls into the collecting ring to be cleaned, when the annular scraping plate moves downwards and reaches the extension limit of the reset spring, the rubber clamping block is separated from the annular scraping plate, and the filter plate moves to reset under the action of the reset spring, so that vibration is formed to shake off the oil stains attached to the filter plate.

title_clean: Preparation method of patch integrating seepage management and pH monitoring
abstract_clean: The invention relates to the field of medical materials and discloses a preparation method of a patch integrating seepage management and pH monitoring, which comprises the steps of 1) forming a conical through hole array in a central area of a fabric, 2) activating oxygen plasma of the fabric, depositing 1, 3-dichloro tetramethyl disiloxane on the surface of the obtained activated fabric in a vapor phase mode, 3) constructing a hydrophilic area on the surface of the fabric and forming a hydrophilic channel to obtain a fabric A, 4) opening the central area of the fabric B, constructing the hydrophilic area and forming the hydrophilic channel, 5) sewing the fabric A and the fabric B by cotton threads, and 6) arranging a pH detection device. The invention firstly constructs a cascade liquid guide system combining the longitudinal conical through hole array and the plane hydrophilic channel, can realize continuous directional guiding-out and rapid transmission of wound exudates, then integrates the pH sensing device between the two liquid guide modules, can detect the one-way guided-out seepage pH value in situ and in real time, and can provide visual and convenient wound state monitoring means for patients and medical staff.

title_clean: Paper-plastic composite aqueous adhesive and preparation method thereof
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a paper-plastic composite water-based adhesive and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of adhesives, and comprising the following components in parts by weight: 65-70 parts of deionized water, 82-89 parts of monomer mixture, 3-4 parts of modified monomer, 3 parts of emulsifier, 0.6-0.8 part of initiator, 2-3 parts of tackifying resin, 0.8-1 part of ammonia water and 0.12-0.15 part of defoamer; the monomer mixture includes 60% -80% of one or more of the soft component monomers, 20% -40% of one or more of the hard component monomers, and 3% -6% of one or more of the functional monomers. The invention provides a paper-plastic composite water-based adhesive, which is prepared by adjusting the proportion of monomers and using modified monomers and tackifying resin.

title_clean: Tire for a civil-engineering vehicle
abstract_clean: A tire for a heavy vehicle of civil engineering type, intended to be fitted onto a rim, is provided. The nominal diameter of the tire is at least equal to 25 inches. The tire comprises a tread having a radial thickness HT at least equal to 30 mm. The tread has a composition based on at least one diene elastomer, a reinforcing filler predominantly comprising a filler at least partially covered with silica, an agent for coupling the filler to the at least one diene elastomer and a crosslinking system. The dispersion of the filler in the elastomeric matrix has a Z score of greater than or equal to 70.

title_clean: Conductive liquid-crystalline resin composition
abstract_clean: Provided is a conductive liquid-crystalline resin composition from which a molded article having excellent molding processability and having a low volume resistivity with less variation regardless of the thickness thereof is obtained. The conductive liquid-crystalline resin composition according to the present invention contains a liquid-crystalline resin (A), a fibrous conductive filler (B), a granular conductive filler (C), and a non-conductive filler (D). The total contained amount of the fibrous conductive filler (B) and the granular conductive filler (C) is 25-50 mass%. The mass ratio of the contained amount of the fibrous conductive filler (B) with respect to the contained amount of the granular conductive filler (C) is 0.50-3.00. The contained amount of the non-conductive filler (D) is 2-8 mass%.

title_clean: Novel derivative of beta-apopicropodophyllin and method of preparing thereof
abstract_clean: Provided are a novel derivative of β-apopicropodophyllin and a method of preparing the same, and more particularly, a compound represented by Formula 1 below, which is a novel derivative of β-apopicropodophyllin derived from podophyllotoxin, which is an anticancer agent, a method of preparing the same, and a composition for treating cancer, which includes the compound. In Formula 1, R is a C 2 to C 10 alkyl group, a C 2 to C 10 alkyl group containing an allyl- or alkyne, a —[CH 2 ] n —C 3 to C 8 cycloalkyl group, a substituted or unsubstituted —[CH 2 ] n -phenyl group, a substituted or unsubstituted —[CH 2 ] n —C 5 to C 6 heteroaromatic group, a —C(═O)—C 1 to C 8 alkyl group, a substituted or unsubstituted —C(═O)—[CH 2 ] n -phenyl group, or a substituted or unsubstituted —C(═O)—[CH 2 ] n —C 5 to C 6 heteroaromatic group, wherein n is an integer of 0 to 6.

title_clean: Molecules for use in the treatment and/or prevention of covid-19
abstract_clean: The present invention relates to a molecule for use in the treatment and/or prevention of viral infections caused by highly pathogenic coronaviruses, including Severe Acute Respiratory syndrome Coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), or variants thereof, Severe Acute Respiratory syndrome Coronavirus ((SARS)-CoV) and sarbecoviruses, said molecule being a mannose binding lectin (MBL) polypeptide, or a functional fragment, derivative, mutein or variant thereof, or an homologue having a percentage of identity with MBL polypeptide of at least 50, 60, 70, 80 or 90%, preferably for use in the treatment and/or prevention of 2019 Coronavirus disease (COVID-19).

title_clean: Synthesis and usage of 1,2-diaminodiamantane platinum(ii) complexes
abstract_clean: A new bulky lipophilic chiral ligand based on 1,2-diaminodiamantane is revealed in both of its enantiomeric forms for the preparation of novel platinum(II) complexes. The R,R-enantiomer shows increased efficacy as compared to cisplatin. The binding of diamondoid-based platinum complexes to nucleotides occurs at similar or faster rate for both isomers compared to cisplatin so that the herein revealed platinum(II) complexes are compounds with high anti-cancerogenic activity .

title_clean: CXCR2 inhibitors
abstract_clean: Compounds are provided that are CXCR2 inhibitors having the structure (I):

title_clean: High-quality laminating device
abstract_clean: The invention belongs to the technical field of printing equipment, and particularly relates to a high-quality laminating device which comprises a laminating platform, a printed matter unwinding mechanism arranged at the front end of the laminating platform, a protective film unwinding mechanism arranged above the laminating platform, a product winding mechanism arranged at the tail end of the laminating platform, a laminating mechanism arranged on the laminating platform and used for coating a protective film on a printed matter, a gluing mechanism arranged between the printed matter unwinding mechanism and the laminating mechanism and used for gluing the surface of the printed matter, and a static removing mechanism which is arranged corresponding to the protective film unwinding mechanism and used for removing static on the protective film. The invention provides a high-quality film coating device which can avoid the defects of film coating wrinkles, bubbles, unevenness, infirmity and the like and effectively improve the film coating quality of the device.

title_clean: Display device and electronic apparatus
abstract_clean: Provided are: a display device capable of suppressing moisture infiltration to a display area, and improving the applicability and adhesion of a functional layer when the functioning layer or a sealing substrate is provided on a protective layer; and an electronic apparatus. This display device has, on a substrate, in the following order a light-emitting element substrate having formed thereon an inorganic insulating layer and a light-emitting element, and a protective layer for covering the upper surface side of the light-emitting element substrate, and comprises, above the protective layer, a planarization layer and a functional layer different from the planarization layer. The inorganic insulating layer has at least one among a groove and a stepped portion, and the protective layer has a cover part which covers at least a portion of the groove or the stepped portion.

title_clean: Silicon-dirac semi-metal heterojunction avalanche photodetector integrated with metal nano-filter structure and preparation method thereof
abstract_clean: The invention belongs to the technical field of semiconductors and micro-nano photoelectrons, and particularly discloses a silicon-dirac semi-metal heterojunction avalanche photodetector integrated with a metal nano filter structure and a preparation method thereof. The photoelectric detector prepared by the invention realizes expansion of near infrared wave bands and enhancement of photoelectric response of visible light wave bands through the silicon-dirac semi-metal layer heterojunction. The metal nano structure realizes the response to the target narrow-band wave band of the incident light and has the advantages of selectable wavelength, miniaturization, easy integration and the like.

title_clean: Array substrate, manufacturing method thereof and display device
abstract_clean: The application provides an array substrate, a manufacturing method of the array substrate and a display device. Wherein, the array substrate includes first base plate and the first metal function layer that forms on first base plate, and first base plate is provided with open area and non-open area, and first metal function layer includes the grid of transistor, and the grid is located non-open area, and the array substrate still includes: the transparent conducting layer comprises a buffering conducting part and an alignment electrode part which are arranged on the same layer, the buffering conducting part is arranged between the grid and the first substrate and is in contact with the grid, the adhesion force between the buffering conducting part and the first substrate and the adhesion force between the buffering conducting part and the grid are both larger than the adhesion force between the grid and the first substrate in direct contact, the alignment electrode part is at least partially positioned in the opening area, and the alignment electrode part is used for providing an alignment electric field. The technical scheme of this application can improve the fastness of metal membranous layer to reduce droing of metal membranous layer.

title_clean: Electronic apparatus, control method thereof and server
abstract_clean: An electronic device is disclosed. The electronic device comprises: a memory storing a composite function in which two or more polynomials are combined; and a processor for reflecting and operating a plurality of homomorphic ciphertexts to the composite function and obtaining a comparison result of the plurality of homomorphic ciphertexts based on an operation result when a comparison operation command for the plurality of homomorphic ciphertexts is received. Each of the two or more polynomials outputs a value within a preset range for a value within a preset domain and a domain of one of the two or more polynomials may be determined based on a range of a previous polynomial.

title_clean: Power management chip and operating method thereof
abstract_clean: A power management chip includes a gate driver configured to output a first gate signal driving a first power switch and a second gate signal driving the second power switch, a multiplexer configured to receive an error detect signal from a first error amplifier and a first gate signal from the gate driver, and drive the first power switch with either of the error detect signal or the first gate signal in response to a mode select signal; an inductor detection logic configured to receive the inductor detect signal, output a comparison detect signal and a pulse signal for detecting an external inductor, and output the mode select signal corresponding to a result of the detecting, and a comparator comparing an internal output voltage of an output node and an output voltage of the feedback node in response to the comparison detect signal.

title_clean: System and uses for closed-loop control of e-beam and x-ray sterilization
abstract_clean: The disclosure relates to systems and methods for closed-loop control of electronbeam (EB)-based sterilization, and more particularly, to an improved solution for sterilizing a product using closed loop control of EB radiation, designed to monitor and adjust the irradiation process in real-time to ensure that the desired level of sterilization is achieved efficiently and consistently.

title_clean: Power switch arrangement
abstract_clean: A power device can be structured with a power switch having multiple arrangements such that the power switch can operate as a power switch with the capability to measure properties of the power switch. An example power device can comprise a main arrangement of transistor cells and a sensor arrangement of sensor transistor cells. The main arrangement can be structured to operate as a power switch, with the transistor cells of the main arrangement having control nodes connected in parallel to receive a common control signal. The sensor arrangement of sensor transistor cells can be structured to measure one or more parameters of the main arrangement, with the sensor transistor cells having sensor control nodes connected in parallel to receive a common sensor control signal. The sensor transistor cells can have a common transistor terminal shared with a common transistor terminal of the transistor cells of the main arrangement.

title_clean: Display device
abstract_clean: A display device (2) comprises: a first data signal line (DL1) connecting M-th-stage and N-th-stage pixel circuits (PCs); a second data signal line (DL2) connecting m-th-stage and n-th-stage pixel circuits (PCs); a switch circuit (SWC) connecting the first data signal line (DL1) and the second data signal line (DL2); a data signal source (DS) connected to the switch circuit (SWC); and a control unit (CC) that controls the switch circuit (SWC) such that a data signal is supplied from the data signal source (DS) to the pixel circuits (PCs) in the order of M-th stage, m-th stage, N-th stage, n-th stage in a first mode and in the order of M-th stage, N-th stage, m-th stage, n-th stage in a second mode where M, m, N, and n are natural numbers satisfying M<m<N<n.

title_clean: Image processing apparatus and method, image capturing apparatus, control method therefor, and storage medium
abstract_clean: The invention provides an image processing apparatus and method, an image capturing apparatus, a control method thereof, and a storage medium. The image processing apparatus includes an acquisition section configured to acquire a plurality of different viewpoint images obtained by capturing the same scene from different viewpoints, and configured to acquire at least one parallax image pair having parallax by pupil division, a first generation section configured to generate a first distance image from the parallax image pair, a second generation section configured to generate a second distance image from the plurality of different viewpoint images, and an integration section configured to integrate the first distance image and the second distance image and generate an integrated distance image.

title_clean: Reference of neural network model for adaptation of 2d video for streaming to heterogeneous client end-points
abstract_clean: A method, computer program, and computer system is provided for streaming immersive media. The method includes ingesting content in a two-dimensional format, the 2D format referencing at least one neural network; converting the ingested content to a three-dimensional format based on the referenced at least one neural network; and streaming the converted content to a client end-point.

title_clean: Pixel and display device including the same
abstract_clean: A display device that includes multiple pixels, each pixel includes a light emitting element, a multiple of transistors, multiple voltage sources and capacitors. The pixel circuit is designed and the pixels are driven so that a driving current going through the light emitting element is independent of a threshold voltage of a driving transistor of the multiple transistors. As a result, luminance variation due to threshold voltage can be minimized, and residual image can be reduced.

title_clean: Airport unpowered plate trailer detection positioning system and method
abstract_clean: The invention provides a detection and positioning system and method for an airport unpowered plate trailer, and belongs to the field of airport equipment. This airport does not have power trigger to detect positioning system includes: the trailer positioning terminal and the trailer detecting terminal are arranged on the trailer; a trigger positioning beacon mounted on the trigger; the trigger positioning beacon comprises a detection end and a transmitting end; on each plate trailer, a detection end is arranged at the rear end of the plate trailer, and a transmitting end is arranged at the front end of the plate trailer; or the detection end is arranged at the front end of the plate trailer, and the transmitting end is arranged at the rear end of the plate trailer; the detection end and the plate trailer detection terminal can detect signals sent by the transmitting end. The invention avoids the requirement of the existing Bluetooth positioning technology on the layout of base stations, also avoids the influence of signal shielding on the positioning precision, realizes continuous high-precision positioning in the whole apron range, and fully meets the performance requirement and the cost requirement of an airport on the positioning of the plate trailer.

title_clean: Leakage monitoring device
abstract_clean: The utility model provides a leakage monitoring device, belonging to the technical field of monitoring devices, comprising a monitoring box and a monitoring box, the side surface of the monitoring box is provided with a plurality of heat dissipation holes, the side surface of the monitoring box is fixedly connected with a first dust screen, the monitoring box is fixedly connected with the monitoring box through a connecting wire, a plurality of control buttons, a display screen and a broadcasting board are arranged on the monitoring box, signals are sent out through a gas concentration sensor, the monitoring box receives the signals, further, the monitoring box can carry out remote monitoring on the leaked gas, the monitoring safety is improved, the first air inlet pipe is convenient to be connected with other pipelines through the fixing mechanism, the gas leaked in the air is monitored through the second air inlet pipe, the gas concentration sensor in the monitoring box is blown by the heat dissipation fan, the heat dissipation hole is used for dissipating heat, make the monitoring box have good radiating effect and dustproof effect through first dust screen and second dust screen.

title_clean: Method for acquiring and testing threshold permeability coefficient and distribution coefficient of unfixed pollutant soil
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a test method for acquiring and calculating the permeability coefficient and distribution coefficient of an unsealed pollutant soil threshold, and belongs to the field of soil threshold calculation. The method comprises the steps of selecting sampling points on a site, excavating an annular groove fixed soil column to collect permeability coefficient measurement samples, and simultaneously collecting distribution coefficient samples at multiple points on the circumference of the sampling points. And when the permeability coefficient is measured, water is supplied by using a Marshall bottle and calculated by Darcy's law, and the distribution coefficient is obtained by measuring the fixed proportion of pollutant solutions with different concentrations in soil through a static adsorption test. The method solves the problems of structural damage and insufficient representativeness of distribution coefficient samples of the traditional soil column sampling, can accurately acquire the permeability coefficient and the distribution coefficient, provides a reliable basis for calculating the soil threshold value for protecting the underground water, and is suitable for risk assessment of unsealed new pollutants in chemical industry sites.

title_clean: Movement interval measurement apparatus for checking operating status of vehicle power transmission apparatus unaffected by temperature
abstract_clean: The present invention relates to a movement interval measurement apparatus for checking the operating status of a vehicle power transmission apparatus unaffected by temperature. The movement interval measurement apparatus for checking the operating status of a vehicle power transmission apparatus unaffected by temperature according to the present invention uses a resonance circuit including a sensing coil and uses changes in the resonance frequency of the resonance circuit and the output voltage of the resonance circuit, which change in response to changes in the distance between the detection target object and the sensing coil, so as to measure movement intervals of the detection target object, and is provided with a separate diode voltage detection unit for detecting diode voltage and removes the diode voltage included in the output value of the resonance circuit so as not to be affected by changes in temperature.

title_clean: Mannich type modified diethylenetriamine lignin calcium sulfonate-based filtrate reducer and preparation method thereof
abstract_clean: The invention provides a Mannich type modified diethylenetriamine lignin calcium sulfonate-based filtrate reducer which is characterized by being prepared by reacting calcium lignosulfonate, formaldehyde, diethylenetriamine and anhydrous sodium sulfite. The filtrate reducer has 180 ℃ temperature resistance, greatly improves the calcium resistance performance compared with the conventional filtrate reducer, reaches 10000mg/L, has good compatibility with various water-based drilling fluids, is convenient to use, and has important application value by boosting the technical progress of anti-pollution drilling fluids.

title_clean: End group functionalized polymer catalyst and synthesis method and application thereof
abstract_clean: The application relates to the technical field of high polymer synthesis, and provides a terminal group functionalized polymer catalyst and a synthesis method and application thereof, wherein 55mg (0.2 mmol) of cyclooctadiene nickel is weighed in a glove box, a Schlenk tube purged by high-purity argon is added, 1ml of newly-prepared anhydrous THF is slowly added under the argon flow, 0.2mmol of p-methoxy cinnamyl propionate is dropwise added at 0 ℃, the system gradually turns from yellow to dark red, the reaction is carried out for 30min at 0 ℃, 52.4mg (0.2mmol,solved in 1mlTHF) of triphenylphosphine is added, the reaction is carried out for 1h at 0 ℃ to obtain a Ni complex THF solution, and the reaction is continued for 1h at 0 ℃; 177mg (0.2 mmol) of sodium trifluoromethyl tetraphenyl borate was added, the reaction was continued for 1h, diethyl ether was removed by evaporation under reduced pressure, methanol was added to the system, yellow to orange crystallites were formed, and the product was filtered under argon atmosphere to give yellow crystallites. The method has the advantages of simple operation, high yield, easy industrial production and lower cost, and meets the requirements of more occasions.

title_clean: Cholesteric liquid crystal composition and liquid crystal display element having high dielectric anisotropy and refractive index anisotropy
abstract_clean: The present invention provides a cholesteric liquid crystal composition with positive dielectric anisotropy and a liquid crystal display element using the same. The cholesteric liquid crystal composition contains: a compound represented by the general formula (1-1), a compound represented by the general formula (1-2), a compound represented by the general formula (2-1) serving as a second component having a neutral dielectric property, and at least two optically active substances that are different in temperature dependence of the chiral pitch length from each other.

title_clean: Aromatic diamine compound and polyimide films
abstract_clean: The present invention relates to an aromatic diamine compound and polyimide films. The aromatic diamine compound has a structure as shown in the following formula (I): In the formula (I), two group of R 1 -R 4 and two group of R 1’ -R 4’ individually independently represent linear or branched aliphatic alkyl having 3-4 carbons, linear or branched aliphatic alkyl having 3-4 carbons and fluorine atoms, cyclic aliphatic alkyl having 5-6 carbons or aromatic ring, and the residual two group of R 1 -R 4 and the residual two group of R 1’ -R 4’ individually independently represent hydrogen atoms. A steric effect caused by the four substituted groups in the aromatic rings enlarges a distance between major chains of the polyimides and restricts rotation of ether bond in major chain to inhibit electrodes transition in the aromatic rings thereby reducing dielectric constant and dielectric loss of polyimide films made by the aromatic diamine compound.

title_clean: Sewing machine head shell with good heat dissipation effect
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a sewing machine head shell with a good heat dissipation effect, which comprises a machine head, wherein a protective shell is fixed on the outer wall of one side of the machine head, a protective plate is fixed on the outer wall of one side of the protective shell, a circular through hole is formed in the outer wall of one side of the protective plate, a connecting sleeve is fixed on the inner wall of the circular through hole, a rectangular through hole is formed in the outer wall of the bottom of the protective shell, a ventilation pipe is fixed on the inner wall of the rectangular through hole, a motor is fixed on the outer wall of one side of the machine head, an internal thread ring groove is formed in the outer wall of one side of the machine head, and an external thread lantern ring is connected to the inner wall of the internal thread ring groove through threads. According to the utility model, the filtering wire mesh sleeved on the outer wall of the connecting rod can shield and protect the motor inside, so that dust and cotton wool entering the protective shell through the ventilation pipe are prevented from being adhered to the motor, meanwhile, workers can conveniently clean the dust inside the protective shell, and the problem that a large amount of small impurities such as external dust and cotton wool are adhered to the motor to influence the normal work of the motor is avoided.

title_clean: Electrical equipment protection device convenient to heat dissipation
abstract_clean: The utility model provides an electrical equipment protection device convenient for heat dissipation, which comprises a box body and a second fan, wherein the upper end of the box body is fixedly connected with a rain shelter, the second fan is arranged at the upper end in the box body, window holes are arranged at the left and right ends of the box body, a first clamping groove is arranged at the upper end of the window hole, a second clamping groove is arranged at the lower end of the window hole, a spring is fixedly connected with the upper end of the second clamping groove, a ventilation mechanism is clamped in the first clamping groove and the second clamping groove, the spring is movably connected with the ventilation mechanism, a bottom plate is fixedly connected with the lower end of the box body, a first filter screen is fixedly connected with the lower end of the bottom plate, and a fan hole is; through setting up heat dissipation mechanism, can make outside air inhale inside the box when the inside temperature of box risees, through the rotation of first fan with the second fan, the inside high-temperature gas that produces by electrical equipment of box passes through heat dissipation mechanism, flows from the air outlet, reaches the radiating effect.

title_clean: Aluminum production powered by geothermal energy
abstract_clean: A geothermally powered aluminum production subsystem includes a geothermal system with a wellbore extending from a surface into an underground magma reservoir. A hopper receives a bauxite ore that is crushed and provided to a digestor. The digestor is heated by a heat transfer fluid heated by the geothermal system, and a product of the digestor is used to prepare aluminum.

title_clean: Automatic control equipment box with wire harness storage structure
abstract_clean: The utility model belongs to the technical field of automatic control equipment case, especially, be an automatic control equipment case with structure is accomodate to pencil, the intelligent cabinet temperature adjusting device comprises a cabinet body and a base, the inlet port has been seted up in the outside left side of the cabinet body, and the inside left side of the cabinet body is provided with the mounting panel to the inboard of mounting panel is provided with spacing spring, and the below of spacing spring is connected with the dust screen simultaneously, the spout has been seted up on the right side of mounting panel, and the right side of spout is connected with accepts the board to accept the outside of board and install fixation nut, fixation nut's right side is connected with adjusting bolt simultaneously, the internally mounted who accepts the board has the fixed block, the motor is installed to the inboard below of the cabinet body, the top of connecting rod is connected with the dwang. This automatic control equipment case with structure is accomodate to pencil can realize having the pencil and accomodate the structure in the use, convenient quick heat dissipation and convenient removal.

title_clean: Automatic defect detection equipment for noble metal electroplated layer
abstract_clean: The invention provides automatic detection equipment for defects of noble metal plating layers, which belongs to the technical field of plating layer detection and comprises a detection table, wherein a pair of supporting plates are fixedly connected to the detection table, a movement detection mechanism is arranged at the rear sides of the pair of supporting plates, a loading and unloading mechanism is arranged at the top of the pair of supporting plates, a surface dust removing mechanism is arranged below a clamping and rotating mechanism, the loading and unloading mechanism comprises a bracket fixedly connected to the supporting plates, an electric push rod II is arranged at one side of a sliding table, a connecting seat I is arranged at the output end of the electric push rod II, a material taking frame is arranged on the connecting seat I, a traction mechanism is arranged on the material taking frame, the material taking frame comprises a fastening area, and the fastening area comprises an initial fastening strip, a middle fastening strip and a tail fastening strip. The invention solves the problems that in the existing automatic detection equipment for the defects of the noble metal electroplated layer, the electroplated product needs to be manually taken to or moved from the clamping plates in the detection process of the electroplated product, the detection process is time-consuming and labor-consuming, is not beneficial to the durable detection, and reduces the detection efficiency.

title_clean: Electronic device
abstract_clean: An electronic device is provided. The electronic device includes a substrate, a semiconductor unit, a wall, and a light-transmitting member. The semiconductor unit is mounted on the substrate. The wall is disposed on the substrate and surrounds the semiconductor unit. The wall includes two exterior wall components and two interior wall components. The two exterior wall components are spaced apart from each other, so that two gaps are formed between the two exterior wall components. The two gaps are in spatial communication with an installation area that is surrounded by the two exterior wall components. The two interior wall components are arranged in the installation area and spaced apart from each other. The two interior wall components correspond in position to the two gaps and respectively shade parts of the two gaps. The light-transmitting member is disposed on the wall and covered on the semiconductor unit.

title_clean: Low-voltage etching back contact battery and preparation method thereof
abstract_clean: The application discloses a low-voltage etching back contact battery and a preparation method thereof, which are characterized in that through introducing a twice selective etching process under a low-voltage environment and combining accurate film deposition and doping sequence design, the formation of undercut defects is inhibited from the source, and meanwhile, the surface passivation quality and the carrier selective transmission performance are considered, so that the photoelectric conversion efficiency of a TBC battery is improved, and meanwhile, the production yield and the long-term operation reliability are remarkably improved.

title_clean: Semiconductor device with a plurality of semiconductor chips
abstract_clean: The present invention provides a semiconductor device, which is provided with a plurality of stacked semiconductor chips (11) and a control part (12), wherein each semiconductor chip (11) is provided with: a plurality of signal processing units (17, 18) that can be connected to each other; a plurality of on-chip signal lines (14, 15) that can be connected to each other; a connection state changing unit (13) that can change the connection state between the plurality of on-chip signal lines (14, 15) in accordance with an instruction from the control unit (12); and a plurality of non-contact communication units (16) connected to the plurality of on-chip signal lines (14, 15), respectively, wherein each non-contact communication unit (16) of each semiconductor chip (11) is capable of performing non-contact communication with the non-contact communication unit (16) of any one or more other semiconductor chips (11) in the stacking direction, and wherein the connection state changing unit (13) of each semiconductor chip (11) changes the connection state between the plurality of on-chip signal lines (14, 15) in accordance with an instruction from the control unit (12), thereby changing the connection state between the plurality of signal processing units (17, 18).

title_clean: Continuous transfer machine after pump shell spraying and drying
abstract_clean: The utility model belongs to the technical field of transfer equipment, and relates to a continuous transfer machine after pump shell spraying and drying. The utility model discloses a transfer machine, which comprises a transfer machine track, wherein a connecting frame is arranged on the transfer machine track, the lower end of the connecting frame is fixedly connected with a rotating piece, the lower end of the rotating piece is fixedly connected with a connecting plate, the side wall of the lower side of the connecting plate is fixedly connected with a U-shaped rod, a hook is hung on the U-shaped rod, the side wall of the lower side of the connecting plate is fixedly connected with a locking mechanism, the locking mechanism comprises a first vertical plate and a second vertical plate which are fixedly connected to the lower side of the connecting plate, jacks are formed in the first vertical plate and the second vertical plate, the same locking rod is movably inserted in the two jacks, and one end of the locking rod is fixedly connected with a baffle plate. The utility model can limit and lock the hook and prevent the hook from being separated from the U-shaped rod, thereby improving the stability of the hook and the safety of the pump shell in the transportation process.

title_clean: Air purification device for livestock breeding
abstract_clean: The utility model provides an air purification device for livestock breeding, which relates to the technical field of livestock breeding and comprises a purification box, wherein a dust removal mechanism is fixedly arranged on the inner wall of the purification box, electric shutters are fixedly arranged on the periphery of the purification box and correspond to the position of the dust removal mechanism, a disinfection box is fixedly arranged on the top surface of the dust removal mechanism, a group of ultraviolet sterilizing lamps is fixedly arranged on the inner top wall of the disinfection box, a liquid storage cavity is fixedly arranged between the opposite surfaces of the disinfection box and the purification box, ventilation holes communicated with the liquid storage cavity are fixedly arranged on the periphery of the disinfection box, a liquid spraying ring pipe is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the disinfection box and corresponds to the position of the liquid storage cavity, spraying holes are uniformly distributed on the bottom surface of the liquid spraying ring pipe, a liquid supplementing pipe, a circulating pump and a liquid level sensor are fixedly arranged on the side surface of the purification box respectively, one end of the liquid level sensor extends to the inside of the liquid storage cavity, be used for solving and lack one kind in the current livestock-raising field and carry out the problem that edulcoration purifies and sterilization and disinfection equipment to the air.

title_clean: Soxhlet-like fungus hzt-3', and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_clean: The invention relates to a panus pseudowire (Talaromyces pseudofuniculosus) hzt-3' and a preparation method and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of microbial application. The strain is preserved in China Center for Type Culture Collection (CCTCC) No. M20251797, and classified and named (Talaromyces pseudofuniculosus) hzt-3'. The method comprises the following steps of collecting moss and vegetation soil samples from basalt, diabase and dolomite, separating and purifying bacterial strains by using Czapek culture medium for bacterial colonies in diluted samples, screening bacterial strains by using anorthite and serpentine as inorganic salt sources to obtain bacterial strains which are stable in growth and have good leaching effects on anorthite minerals, and applying the bacterial strains to efficient leaching of anorthite, serpentine and wollastonite, wherein compared with a sterile control group, the leaching rate of calcium and magnesium ions is improved remarkably. The method solves the problem of slow reaction rate of mineral sequestration carbon dioxide caused by difficult ion leaching in natural silicate minerals, and has great significance.

title_clean: Device for improving stability and purity of propylene carbonate device rectification product
abstract_clean: The utility model provides equipment for improving stability and purity of propylene carbonate device rectification products, which relates to the technical field of propylene carbonate rectification and comprises a rear dehydrogenation tower, a front dehydrogenation tower, a heavy-duty removal tower and a synchronous processing device, wherein the synchronous processing device comprises silk screen structured packing fixedly connected inside the rear dehydrogenation tower and the front dehydrogenation tower, a water inlet pipe is fixedly connected to the top ends inside the rear dehydrogenation tower and the front dehydrogenation tower, a water distributing disc is fixedly connected to the output end of the water inlet pipe, and an air duct is fixedly connected inside the front dehydrogenation tower. And secondly, switching between series connection and parallel connection is realized through a switching valve, so that different production requirements are met. And the heat return pipe is used for recovering waste heat at the top of the tower, so that the steam consumption of the heavy-removal tower is reduced, and the filler of the heavy-removal tower is optimized and the pressure is controlled, thereby avoiding back mixing and polluting products.

title_clean: Cloud storage flow cost control method and device
abstract_clean: The application relates to a cloud storage flow cost control method and device, and relates to the technical field of cloud storage, wherein the method comprises the following steps: configuring a cloud storage server into a private read-private write mode; the user-defined server corresponding to the user is allocated, and the user-defined server and the cloud storage server are communicated based on an intranet; configuring a fixed bandwidth payment mode with preset duration to a custom server; and accessing the cloud storage server by using the custom server.
