According to the cloud storage method and the cloud storage system, the cloud storage server is configured, and the cloud storage server is accessed by using the custom server with the specific charging mode as an intermediate medium, so that the cost of cloud storage flow is effectively reduced.

title_clean: Communication method and apparatus
abstract_clean: Provided in the present application are a communication method and apparatus. The communication method comprises: acquiring first information, wherein the first information may be used for indicating an association relationship between a data identifier and a data processing mode, the data processing mode may comprise executing one or more first functions for data processing, and/or skipping one or more second functions for data processing, and the data identifier may comprise a first data identifier; and receiving first data carrying the first data identifier, and processing the first data on the basis of the first data identifier and the association relationship; or, sending the first data carrying the first data identifier. In the present application, different first data identifiers may have association relationships with different data processing modes. Thus, a corresponding functional entity processes first data on the basis of the data processing modes corresponding to the first data identifiers. In this way, appropriate functions are selected in a targeted manner for processing different data, thereby improving the service processing efficiency and the system performance.

title_clean: Bandwidth-adjustable on-chip second-order band-pass filter
abstract_clean: The invention discloses an on-chip second-order band-pass filter with adjustable bandwidth, relates to an on-chip integrated semiconductor technology, and provides a scheme for solving the problems that the bandwidth cannot be adjusted in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a second-order filter module of N channels after setting a first-order N-channel filter structure image, wherein each channel of the second-order filter module is controlled by a bias switch signal in one-to-one correspondence, and the bias switch signals are obtained by respectively superposing N-phase non-overlapping switch signals with adjustable bias voltages. The method has the advantages of realizing on-chip integration, bandwidth adjustment and out-of-band high suppression.

title_clean: Map generation device
abstract_clean: To provide a map generation device which efficiently generates a map of a traffic lane where a vehicle is not traveling.SOLUTION: A map generation device 50 includes: a camera 1a for detecting an external situation around an own vehicle; an outward map generation part 171 which generates an outward map based on the external situation detected by the camera 1a when the own vehicle is traveling on a first traffic lane; and a return map generation part 172 which generates a return map on a second traffic lane opposed to the first traffic lane, by inverting the outward map toward the second traffic lane side.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_clean: Gas concentration detection system of ultrapure zero gas generator
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to a gas concentration detection system of an ultrapure zero gas generator, which is used for detecting various gas concentrations in zero gas generated by the zero gas generator and comprises an electric control unit, a quantum cascade laser gas measurement unit, an oxygen measurement unit, a hydrocarbon measurement unit, a pressure control unit and a display unit. The system is divided into three paths, wherein the first path can realize the concentration of carbon monoxide (CO), carbon dioxide (CO 2 ), nitric Oxide (NO) and nitrogen dioxide (NO 2 ) in zero gas, and the gas can realize the detection of oxygen (O 2 ) after flowing through the oxygen measuring unit; the second path can measure the total concentration of Hydrocarbon (HC) in the zero gas; the third path is capable of exhausting gas other than the gas entering the first path and the second path. The system can realize detection of various gas concentrations, meets different detection requirements, and has simple detection method and low cost.

title_clean: Detection method, detection system and storage medium based on artificial intelligence early warning system
abstract_clean: The invention provides a detection method based on an artificial intelligence early warning system, which comprises the following steps: and classifying the monitored objects, and selecting corresponding artificial intelligence models according to the classified categories. And selecting a training sample, and training the selected artificial intelligence model by combining manual adjustment of the residual error overrun trigger threshold range of each measuring point. And applying the trained artificial intelligence model to the monitored object. The detection method based on the artificial intelligent early warning system can reduce the false alarm rate and the missing report rate of the early warning system, so that the early warning system can better play a role. The invention also provides a detection system and a storage medium for executing the detection method.

title_clean: Application of systemic inflammatory response index in prognosis evaluation of gastrointestinal diffuse large B cell lymphoma
abstract_clean: The invention provides application of a systemic inflammatory response index in prognosis evaluation of diffuse large B cell lymphoma of gastrointestinal tracts, and belongs to the technical field of disease prognosis evaluation. According to the invention, the SIRI level is found to be used as a prognosis marker of gastrointestinal diffuse large B cell lymphoma; furthermore, a new gastrointestinal diffuse large B cell lymphoma prognosis evaluation system is constructed based on SIRI and NCCN-IPI scores, can effectively predict clinical results, enriches current stratification, shows excellent distinguishing capability in the overall survival period and the progression-free survival period of patients, and has better risk distinguishing capability and layering capability than the existing NCCN-IPI scores, thereby having good value of practical application.

title_clean: Method and system for testing reliability of alarm system
abstract_clean: The application provides a method and a system for testing the reliability of an alarm system, wherein the testing method comprises the following steps: inputting initial data to be identified into an adapter, and obtaining target data to be identified, wherein the target data to be identified is obtained after the data type identifier is added to the initial data to be identified by the adapter; inputting target data to be identified into an alarm system to be tested, and acquiring alarm output information determined after the alarm system to be tested analyzes and processes the target data to be identified; inputting the alarm output information into an interpreter, and determining an alarm mode and a storage position corresponding to the alarm output information; determining the working state of the corresponding equipment according to the alarm mode, and storing alarm output information to the determined storage position; and testing and evaluating the alarm output information at the target position to determine the reliability of the alarm system to be tested. Therefore, by introducing the adapter and the interpreter, the system test is not dependent on the traditional manual operation, the operation difficulty of the system test is reduced, the resource investment and the manual operation error of the test are reduced, and the result accuracy can be effectively improved.

title_clean: Process for preparing isobutene by dehydrating tertiary butanol through gas-liquid phase mixing method
abstract_clean: The invention belongs to the technical field of preparation of isobutene, and particularly relates to a process for preparing isobutene by dehydrating tert-butyl alcohol by a gas-liquid phase mixing method. According to the process for preparing isobutene by dehydrating tert-butyl alcohol by a gas-liquid phase mixing method, tert-butyl alcohol is added into a fixed bed reactor, the temperature and the pressure are controlled under the action of a sulfonic acid type cation exchange resin catalyst, so that the tert-butyl alcohol is subjected to dehydration reaction to generate crude isobutene and water, and the crude isobutene is subjected to flash evaporation in a flash tank and rectification in a rectification tower to prepare isobutene. The process for preparing isobutene by dehydrating tert-butyl alcohol by a gas-liquid phase mixing method provided by the invention has the advantages of higher reaction conversion rate, high reaction selectivity and low energy consumption.

title_clean: Compound or pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof and crystal forms thereof
abstract_clean: The present disclosure provides (2 r,4ar,7 r) -3-propenoyl-12-chloro-10-fluoro-11- ((S) -2-fluoro-6-hydroxyphenyl) -2-methyl-7- ((S) -1-methylpyrrolidin-2-yl) -2,3, 4a,6, 7-hexahydro-8-oxa-3, 5a,9,13 c-tetralinimidazo [3,2,1-de ] anthracene-5 (1H) -one (hereinafter referred to as "compound I") or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof and crystalline forms thereof. The present disclosure also provides pharmaceutical compositions comprising at least one of compound I or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof and crystalline forms thereof, as well as methods for preparing the crystalline forms. The present disclosure further provides the use of compound I or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof and a crystalline form thereof or a pharmaceutical composition comprising at least one of compound I or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof and a crystalline form thereof in the prevention and/or treatment of a disease, in particular a disease mediated by a KRAS G12C mutation. The crystal form of the compound I or the pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof has excellent hygroscopicity, solubility and stability.

title_clean: Synthesis and usage of 1,2-diaminodiamantane platinum(ii) complexes
abstract_clean: A new bulky lipophilic chiral ligand based on 1,2-diaminodiamantane is revealed in both of its enantiomeric forms for the preparation of novel platinum(II) complexes. The R,R-enantiomer shows increased efficacy as compared to cisplatin. The binding of diamondoid-based platinum complexes to nucleotides occurs at similar or faster rate for both isomers compared to cisplatin so that the herein revealed platinum(II) complexes are compounds with high anti-cancerogenic activity .

title_clean: Isolated polynucleotides and polypeptides, and methods of using same for increasing plant yield and/or agricultural characteristics.
abstract_clean: Provided are isolated polypeptides which are at least 80% homologous to SEQ ID NOs: 182-184, 186-202, 204-216, 219-223, 225, 227-232, 235-236, 238, 240-260, 262-268, 270-275, 277-287, 289-297, 3651-3671, 3686, 3720-3721, 3724, 3727, 3735, 3754, 3774, 3795-4304, 4316, 4374, 4425, 4464, 4481-4813, 4824, 4833, 4843-4844, 4867-4869, 4888, 4890-4891, 5005-5050, 5053-5070, 5093, 5217, 5231, 5233, 5239, 246, 5255, 5257-5296, 5412, 5415-5429, 5447-5456, 5465-5673, 5675-5686, 5688- 695, 5697-5698, 5700, 5702-5707, 5709-5715, 5717-5785, 5831, 5869, 5980, 6010- 6043, 6045-6053, 6055-6093, 6132, 6383, 6405, 6493, 6523, 6533-6537, and 6563- 6589, isolated polynucleotides encoding same, nucleic acid constructs comprising same, transgenic cells expressing same, transgenic plants expressing same and method of using same for increasing yield, abiotic stress tolerance, growth rate, biomass, vigor, oil content, photosynthetic capacity, seed yield, fiber yield, fiber quality, fiber length, and/or nitrogen use efficiency of a plant.

title_clean: Quaternary nanostructure based on bright silver
abstract_clean: The present invention discloses nanostructures comprising Ag, in, ga, and S, and a shell comprising Ag, ga, and S, wherein the nanostructures have a peak wavelength emission of 480-545nm and wherein at least about 80% of the emission is band-edge emission. Methods of making the nanostructures are also disclosed.

title_clean: Light or heat curing method and curable resin composition
abstract_clean: The objectives of the present invention are to provide a light or heat curing method capable of easily obtaining a cured product (crosslinking product/resin) even if it contains a large amount of filler; and a curable resin composition or the like which uses the curing method. The present invention relates to a light or heat curing method comprising: step 1 and step 2; wherein, step 1: obtaining (E) a condensate having constituent units of Si-O-Al or/and Si-O-Si, which is obtained from aluminum derived from aluminum alkoxide and silane derived from a silane coupling agent having a mercapto group from (A) a compound composed of a salt of a carboxylic acid and an amine and having a carboxylate group capable of generating a radical by decomposing the carbonyl group generating radicals by light irradiation or heating, (B) an aluminum alkoxide, (C) a silane coupling agent having a mercapto group, and (D) water; and step 2: in the presence of the compound (A), reacting the condensate (E), a compound having two or more polymerizable unsaturated groups (H), and a filler (I) under light irradiation or heating conditions; in addition, the present invention also relates to a curable resin composition or the like which uses the curing method.

title_clean: 2-dimensional polymer nanosheets and method for morphologically tunable preparing the same
abstract_clean: The present disclosure relates to a 2-dimensional polymer nanosheet, a device including the nanosheet and a method of morphologically tunable preparing the nanosheet. Two-dimensional (2D) polymer nanosheets have been attracting immense attention owing to their potential applications in optical devices, membranes, and catalysis. A new crystalline polyacetylene is described that contains fluorenes and triisopropylsilyl side chains, which could self-assemble into sharp-edged 5-nm-thick square nanosheets with a narrow length dispersity of 1.01, by simple heating and aging in dichloromethane (DCM). The addition of tetrahydrofuran (THF) or chloroform to the heated polymer solution in DCM changed the morphology from square to rectangle. The aspect ratios increased linearly, from 1.0 to 10.6, according to the amount of THF or chloroform added, while maintaining narrow length dispersities less than 1.06. These unique fluorescent semiconducting nanosheets with tunable shapes exhibit high potential for optoelectronic applications.

title_clean: Method for producing thiourethane resin raw material and use thereof, method for producing polythiol composition and use thereof, and polythiol composition
abstract_clean: A process for producing a thiourethane resin raw material, which comprises a step of reacting a thiourethane resin with an active hydrogen compound to produce a thiourethane resin raw material, and an application thereof.

title_clean: Actuator for a valve and device having such an actuator
abstract_clean: The invention relates to a control drive (10) for a valve (11), having an actuating device (17), a control member (16) and a manually actuable switching device, wherein the control member (16) moves the actuating device (17) between two end positions as a function of a control or control variable, and wherein the actuating device (17) can be moved into at least one of the two end positions independently of the control or control variable using the manually actuable switching device. In order to be able to switch the adjustment drive (10) into one of its end positions in a simple and convenient manner, the adjustment drive (10) according to the invention is characterized in that the switching means is an eccentric (29), which eccentric (29) can be actuated by means of a manual actuating element (23). The invention also relates to a device having such an adjusting drive (10).

title_clean: Driving assembly and positioning device
abstract_clean: Aiming at the problem that in the prior art, machining scraps easily enter a cylinder to cause easy blocking of a piston and a guide rod of the machining scraps, the utility model provides a driving assembly and a positioning device. The cover body is a drawer cover body structure and is arranged on the bottom plate. A cavity is formed between the cover body and the bottom plate, and the cylinder is fixed in the cavity. The starting end of the sliding block is connected with the guide rod of the air cylinder, and the tail end of the sliding block extends along the extending direction of the guide rod of the air cylinder and penetrates out of the cover body; the tail end of the sliding block is used for connecting the leaning angle. The sliding block is in sliding fit with the cover body and is sealed. Therefore, the problem that machining scraps enter the cylinder to cause clamping can be solved.

title_clean: Pile-supported embankment multi-layer reinforcement body reinforcing technology based on numerical simulation
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a pile-supported embankment multi-layer reinforcement body reinforcing technology based on numerical simulation, which specifically comprises the following steps: establishing a numerical model of the pile-supported embankment with the multilayer reinforced ribs by using finite element software, and calculating and analyzing the working mechanism of the multilayer reinforced rib body; based on the stress-strain analysis result of each layer of reinforcement body in the reinforcement cushion layer, the strength grade of each layer of reinforcement body in the reinforcement cushion layer is optimized, and the fine design of the pile-supported reinforced embankment is guided. The invention deeply researches the cooperative bearing mechanism of the reinforcement bodies of each layer in the reinforcement cushion layer, can ensure that the strength of the reinforcement bodies of each layer is fully exerted, and effectively controls the vertical and horizontal displacement of the embankment, on one hand, the long-term stability of the pile-supported reinforced embankment can be maintained, and on the other hand, the material waste caused by the unreasonable design of the reinforcement bodies of multiple layers can be avoided.

title_clean: Big bag wrapping bag mouth guiding device
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a big bag wrapping bag mouth guiding device relates to packing technical field, including roof and guiding mechanism, guiding mechanism sets up the bottom at the roof, guiding mechanism includes four belt mount pads, two belt mount pad symmetric distribution of every group and with being equipped with the conveying clearance that is used for conveying the wrapping bag sack between two belt mount pads of group, the upper end symmetry of every belt mount pad is fixed and is equipped with two hoisting support, and hoisting support rotates with the bottom face of roof to be connected, wherein articulated seat top of two belt mount pads of a set of all articulates there is the cylinder, and the cylinder is articulated with roof bottom face, be connected with the regulating part between articulated seat of two belt mount pads of another group and the roof. title_clean: Synthesis and usage of 1,2-diaminodiamantane platinum(ii) complexes
abstract_clean: A new bulky lipophilic chiral ligand based on 1,2-diaminodiamantane is revealed in both of its enantiomeric forms for the preparation of novel platinum(II) complexes. The R,R-enantiomer shows increased efficacy as compared to cisplatin. The binding of diamondoid-based platinum complexes to nucleotides occurs at similar or faster rate for both isomers compared to cisplatin so that the herein revealed platinum(II) complexes are compounds with high anti-cancerogenic activity .

title_clean: Liquid protein formulations containing viscosity-lowering agents.
abstract_clean: Concentrated, low-viscosity, low-volume liquid pharmaceutical formulations of proteins have been developed. Such formulations can be rapidly and conveniently administered by subcutaneous or intramuscular injection, rather than by lengthy intravenous infusion. These formulations include low-molecular-weight and/or high-molecular-weight proteins, such as mAbs, and viscosity-lowering agents that are typically bulky polar organic compounds, such as many of the GRAS (US Food and Drug Administration List of compounds generally regarded as safe) and inactive injectable ingredients and FDA approved therapeutics.

title_clean: Anti-solidification quick cleaning discharge valve of asphalt tank truck
abstract_clean: The utility model belongs to the technical field of valves, and relates to an anti-solidification rapid cleaning and discharging valve of an asphalt tank truck, which comprises a valve main body, wherein a hollow groove is formed in the middle of the valve main body, the hollow groove is connected with a heating assembly through a steam conveying pipeline, and a plurality of groups of air dispersing holes matched with the heating assembly are formed in the top of the valve main body; the heating component is a miniature electric heating steam generator. The utility model can heat the asphalt discharging valve main body, thereby relieving the cooling speed of asphalt when the asphalt discharging valve main body discharges asphalt, further preventing the asphalt from being solidified easily due to temperature reduction, thereby causing the valve main body to generate blocking phenomenon and affecting the discharging efficiency, and simultaneously, the utility model can drive the hollow disc and the rubber ring to move by the servo motor, so that distilled water attached to the inner wall of the asphalt discharging valve main body is separated, thereby reducing the phenomenon that distilled water is attached to the inner wall of the asphalt discharging valve main body for a long time and scale is easy to generate.

title_clean: Electrical equipment protection device convenient to heat dissipation
abstract_clean: The utility model provides an electrical equipment protection device convenient for heat dissipation, which comprises a box body and a second fan, wherein the upper end of the box body is fixedly connected with a rain shelter, the second fan is arranged at the upper end in the box body, window holes are arranged at the left and right ends of the box body, a first clamping groove is arranged at the upper end of the window hole, a second clamping groove is arranged at the lower end of the window hole, a spring is fixedly connected with the upper end of the second clamping groove, a ventilation mechanism is clamped in the first clamping groove and the second clamping groove, the spring is movably connected with the ventilation mechanism, a bottom plate is fixedly connected with the lower end of the box body, a first filter screen is fixedly connected with the lower end of the bottom plate, and a fan hole is; through setting up heat dissipation mechanism, can make outside air inhale inside the box when the inside temperature of box risees, through the rotation of first fan with the second fan, the inside high-temperature gas that produces by electrical equipment of box passes through heat dissipation mechanism, flows from the air outlet, reaches the radiating effect.

title_clean: Liquid tank displacement finite element calculation method for ultra-large liquefied gas carrier
abstract_clean: The invention relates to a calculation method of liquid tank displacement finite element of an oversized liquefied gas carrier, which comprises the steps of conducting grid division on a liquid tank three-dimensional model, setting material properties of unit grids, adjusting material density, conducting model diagnosis on the adjusted finite element three-dimensional model, placing a rotary pier at a strong structure at the bottom of the liquid tank, conducting modeling on the rotary pier through a Gap unit, conducting node coupling on the liquid tank and a module group through Rigid rigid units respectively, conducting overturning analysis on the arrangement position of the module group, judging whether the liquid tank has overturning risk or not, adjusting the module group arrangement if the liquid tank has overturning risk, conducting stress analysis on the rotary pier, and adjusting the pier if the rotary pier is overlarge in bearing capacity and breaks or the liquid tank is overlarge in stress strain. According to the invention, displacement overturning analysis and pier placing stress analysis are carried out by means of finite element calculation, so that overturning in the actual displacement process is avoided, damage to the liquid tank and the module group is avoided, and the safety of the whole displacement of the liquid tank is improved.

title_clean: Gas field wellhead pressure energy utilization device
abstract_clean: The utility model provides a gas field wellhead pressure energy utilization device which comprises a cylinder body and a control system, wherein a movable separation mechanism is arranged in the cylinder body and is in sealing connection with the cylinder body, the movable separation mechanism separates the cylinder body into A, B chambers, a distance sensor and an exhaust valve are arranged in each chamber, a first high-pressure suction valve and a first low-pressure suction valve are arranged in the chamber A, a second high-pressure suction valve and a second low-pressure suction valve are arranged in the chamber B, and the distance sensor, the exhaust valve, the high-pressure suction valve and the low-pressure suction valve are all in electric signal connection with the control system. According to the utility model, the high pressure of the new wellhead is utilized to push the movable separation mechanism to move, so that the low pressure energy of the wellhead of the old well is pressurized, the depressurization and the outward transportation of the natural gas of the new wellhead and the pressurization and the outward transportation of the natural gas of the wellhead of the old well are realized, the waste of the pressure energy of the wellhead of the new well is effectively avoided, the investment on the pressurization cost of the wellhead of the old well is reduced, the production efficiency is improved, and the aims of energy conservation and emission reduction are realized.

title_clean: Electrical stimulation cell culture system comprising yarn containing conductive polymer and cell culture method using the same
abstract_clean: The present invention discloses an electrical stimulation cell culture system comprising a yarn containing a conductive polymer and a cell culture method using the same. The cell culture system of the present invention comprises: an electrical stimulation unit (100) comprising a working electrode (110) comprising a yarn and a first conductive polymer and a counter electrode (120) electrically connected to the working electrode; a cell culture unit (200) comprising a conductive scaffold (210) electrically connected to the working electrode (110) and the counter electrode (120), respectively, between the working electrode (110) and the counter electrode (120); an electrolyte (300) comprising a cell culture medium (310); and a packaging part (400) capable of mechanical deformation, which fixes one end and the other end of the above-mentioned working electrode (110) respectively. By using cell culture medium as an electrolyte, the possibility of integrating the electrolyte used for driving the energy harvester and cell culture is improved, and the protruding external wire used for electrical stimulation transmission when using a conventional mechanical energy harvester is unnecessary, thereby reducing the complexity of the system and enabling miniaturization, and has the effect of being usable in the medical industry and the biopharmaceutical industry.

title_clean: Na 2 Fe(SO 4 ) 2 Preparation method of/C as composite positive electrode material of sodium-ion battery
abstract_clean: The invention belongs to the technical field of sodium ion battery preparation, and particularly relates to Na 2 Fe(SO 4 ) 2 A preparation method of the composite positive electrode material of the sodium-ion battery; dispersing nano graphite in deionized water to obtain a mixed suspension; mixing sodium sulfate pentahydrate, ferrous sulfate heptahydrate and ascorbic acid according to a certain proportion, and spray-drying the nano graphite and Na 2 Fe(SO 4 ) 2 ·2H 2 O is tightly combined, the electrochemical performance of the material is greatly improved, the composite material is well coated by using a spray drying method, the conductivity of the material is improved, a precursor is synthesized by using a one-step method, the nano graphite and the precursor are mixed and spray dried, a three-dimensional spherical structure with uniform size is formed after spray drying, and the used medicine has the advantages of rich raw materials, low price and simple synthesis method.

title_clean: Carbon concentration distribution analysis method
abstract_clean: Provided is a method for more easily ensuring the accuracy when analyzing the carbon concentration distribution in accordance with the position in a steel material to be subjected to a carburization treatment. Specifically, this method is for analyzing the carbon concentration distribution in accordance with the position in a steel material to be subjected to a carburization treatment. When analyzing the carbon concentration distribution using a diffusion equation, at least one of the diffusion coefficient, the mobility, and the diffusion flux, of carbon, included in the diffusion equation is multiplied by a correction coefficient. The correction coefficient is set so as to satisfy a condition in which an error between the carbon concentration distribution analyzed from the diffusion equation and a previously measured carbon concentration distribution becomes equal to or less than a threshold value.

title_clean: Carbon nanodot delaying fluorescence and room-temperature phosphorescence emission and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a carbon nanodot with delayed fluorescence and room temperature phosphorescence emission, a preparation method and an application thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step 1, dissolving boric acid, citric acid and diethanol amine in deionized water according to the proportion of (1-3 g) - (0.05-0.5 g) - (0.1-0.3 ml), heating and stirring to fully dissolve the boric acid, citric acid and diethanol amine to obtain a mixed solution A; step 2, placing the mixed solution A in a reaction kettle to carry out hydrothermal reaction at 180-200 ℃ to obtain a product B; and 3, cooling the product B, and fully grinding to obtain the carbon nanodots emitting delayed fluorescence and room-temperature phosphorescence. The carbon nano-dots prepared by the method are non-toxic and harmless, can be stored for a long time, have long afterglow life and high phosphorescence quantum yield, and can be used in the technical field of anti-counterfeiting.

title_clean: Hot melt adhesive applying device
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a hot melt adhesive device, which comprises a main frame assembly, and comprises a workbench, wherein a bracket is arranged on the upper side of the workbench, a top plate is arranged on the upper side of the bracket, after the hot melt adhesive device is used for coating materials, mounting blocks are arranged on two sides of two ends of the upper side of a supporting plate, a movable plate on the front side of the mounting blocks is pushed forwards by a telescopic rod on the front side of the mounting blocks, and the scraper on the front side of the movable plate starts to scrape and clean hot melt adhesive remained on the surface of a glue spreader along with the continuous forward movement of the scraper to the position of the glue spreader, so that the hot melt adhesive which is not cleaned in time on the glue spreader is prevented from being solidified on the surface to influence the next glue spreading work.

title_clean: Chemically cured water-based 2-component compositions
abstract_clean: The present invention relates to a two-component composition comprising: A) a first component a comprising: -an aqueous dispersion of at least one polymer P1; B) a second component B comprising: -at least one hydraulic binder H, -at least one functional compound P2; wherein both components a and B are liquid or pasty and both are prepared and stored separately and mixed directly before application; and with the proviso that the functional compound P2 comprises a functional group which chemically reacts with said aqueous dispersion of said first polymer P1 to form a crosslinked and/or chain-extended polymer. The compositions of the present invention are highly suitable cementitious adhesives, joint sealants, casting compositions or coatings and exhibit improved mechanical properties, adhesive properties and resistance and minimized plasticizer migration problems.

title_clean: Combination of aluminum silicate powder for immediate insulation and fire extinguishing with cooling capabilities and anti-caking
abstract_clean: The current fire extinguishing powders are ineffective due to their low weight, which prevents them from properly covering the fire and makes them easily spread by the wind. To solve this, we have developed a new mineral composition by mixing sodium chloride, calcium carbonate, and barium sulfate in specific ratios. These ingredients have unique properties that help in cooling the fire, create a covering layer, and preventing the powder from being displaced. Additionally, we use stearic acid to prevent moisture absorption and aluminum silicate to enhance physical properties and prevent clumping during storage.

title_clean: TAC composite film and preparation method thereof
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a TAC composite film and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of optical films. The TAC composite film comprises a modified TAC base film and a functional protective coating, wherein the modified TAC base film is prepared by casting a triacetate cellulose solution into a film, the triacetate cellulose solution comprises, by mass, 20 parts of triacetate cellulose, 1-2 parts of sulfhydryl esterified cellulose, 0.1-0.3 part of plasticizer, 0.1-0.4 part of ultraviolet absorber and 80-100 parts of mixed solvent, the functional protective coating is prepared by coating slurry and then photo-curing, and the coating slurry comprises, by mass, 30 parts of photo-curing acrylate prepolymer, 4-8 parts of alkenyl quaternized cellulose, 0.5-1.5 parts of photoinitiator and 40-50 parts of solvent. In the invention, sulfhydryl esterified cellulose is added into a base film, alkenyl quaternized cellulose is added into a coating, and the interfacial binding force is enhanced through chemical action.

title_clean: Protection cover device and arrangement structure for wiring/piping materials
abstract_clean: To make it possible, in a structure in which a protection cover is arranged in a state of causing an irregular gap with respect to an external surface of an apparatus or a structure body, to cover and hide wiring/piping materials exposed from the gap regardless of the size of the gap.SOLUTION: A protection cover device comprises: a communication path formation cover C11 comprising a parallel plate part 42 arranged along a side plate part 81a of a piping cover 81 and a communication path formation part 41 that is extended in a direction away from the side plate part 81a and includes a pair of side plate parts 41a arranged so as to face each other and a top plate part 41b connecting the pair of side plate parts 41a; and a protection cover C1 arranged beside the side plate part 81a with a predetermined gap G1 between the side plate part 81a and the protection cover. title_clean: A valve assembly for an analytical system
abstract_clean: A valve assembly for use with an analytical system comprises first (102) and second (104) members, with each member having a through-bore (106, 108) from a first face to a second face. The members are stacked together with their respective first faces in contact to form a seal between them, and one of the members is slidably movable, relative to the other, between at least two configurations: a first configuration in which the through-bores are fluidically connected, and a second configuration in which the through-bores are sealed from each other.

title_clean: Superconducting Joints
abstract_clean: A superconducting joint arrangement for superconducting magnets, having an elongate joint arranged between superconducting filaments of superconducting wires of one or more superconducting coils, and excess wire provided between the elongate joint and the one or more superconducting coils.

title_clean: Process for preparing 2-exo-(2-methylbenzyloxy)-1-methyl-4-isopropyl-7-oxabicyclo[2.2.1]heptane
abstract_clean: This invention relates to a process for preparing (±)-2-exo-(2-Methylbenzyloxy)-1-methyl-4-isopropyl-7-oxabicyclo[2.2.1]heptane of the formula (I) any one of its individual enantiomers or any non-racemic mixture thereof comprising the steps of (a) deprotonating (t)-2-exo-hydroxy-1-methyl-4-isopropyl-7-oxabicyclo[2.2.1]heptane of the formula (II) any one of its individual enantiomers or any non-racemic mixture thereof in the presence of at least one base of the formula [M m+ ] n [A n- ] m (III) wherein M m+ represents a m-valent metal cation wherein m is an integer of 1 or 2, and A n- represents a n-valent anion wherein n is an integer of 1 or 2, said base being capable of forming a solvent S1 selected from a C 1 -C 4 -alkyl alcohol or a combination of water and a C 1 -C 4 -alkyl alcohol under the reaction conditions, to form a metal alkoxide or metal alkoxide solvate of the formula (IV) any one of its individual enantiomers or any non-racemic mixture thereof wherein M m+ , m and the solvent S1 have the same meaning as defined for the base of formula (III), and x denotes a number from 0 to 10, and (b) reacting the metal alkoxide or metal alkoxide solvate of the formula (IV), any of its individual enantiomers or any non-racemic mixture thereof with a 2-Methylbenzyl compound of the formula (V) wherein X is a leaving group, wherein the steps (a) and (b) are conducted in the presence of at least one inert organic solvent S2 and comprise a further step of (c) simultaneously removing the solvent S1 from the reaction mixture.

title_clean: High-safety cab tipping system circuit
abstract_clean: The invention relates to a high-safety cab tipping system circuit, which solves the problems that the existing tipping function circuit and the prompting function circuit are weak in relevance and have potential safety hazards. The intelligent control system comprises a storage battery pack (1), a power supply main switch (2), a cab rollover switch (3), a rollover detection switch (4), a diode (5), a rollover oil pump relay (6), a rollover oil pump switch (7), a rollover oil pump (8), an instrument (9) and a related wire harness, wherein one end of the diode (5) is connected to the rear of the cab rollover switch (3) of a rollover oil pump relay control circuit, and the other end of the diode is connected to the rear of the rollover detection switch (4) of a cab position detection circuit. The invention integrates the tipping function circuit and the prompt function circuit, thereby enhancing the relevance between the tipping function circuit and the prompt function circuit; the detection range of the rollover indicator lamp on the instrument is enlarged, so that whether the cab falls in place or not can be detected, and whether the rollover function circuit is closed or not can be detected.

title_clean: High-side switch circuit
abstract_clean: A high-side switching circuit, comprising: a target current generation unit adapted to generate and output a target current; the first comparison unit outputs a first comparison result of the output voltage of the high-side switch circuit and the first voltage; a control unit outputting a first control signal based on a first comparison result; when the temperature protection trigger signal is received, the power tube is controlled to be disconnected, and when the temperature protection trigger signal is not received, the power tube is controlled to be connected; controlling the current of the power tube when being conducted to be equal to the target current; the protection threshold generating unit is suitable for outputting a first temperature protection threshold or a second temperature protection threshold as a target temperature protection threshold based on the first control signal; and the temperature protection unit is suitable for responding to the fact that the real-time temperature of the power tube is larger than the target temperature protection threshold value and outputting a temperature protection trigger signal. By the scheme, the reliability of the high-side switch circuit in a capacitor charging scene can be improved, and meanwhile the steady-state load capacity of the high-side switch circuit is not affected.

title_clean: Ultra-wideband low-noise amplifier based on gate-source low-coupling structure
abstract_clean: The invention discloses an ultra-wideband low-noise amplifier based on a gate-source low-coupling structure, which is applied to the field of low-noise amplifier chips and aims to solve the problems that the conventional cascode amplifier is narrow in bandwidth and high in noise caused by high gate-source coupling of a second-stage cascode transistor. The cascode amplifier is improved, and on one hand, a grid-source low-coupling connection structure is adopted, so that parasitic capacitance is reduced, noise coefficient is reduced, and bandwidth is increased; on the other hand, the bandwidth is further expanded by combining a negative feedback structure.

title_clean: Pulse generating circuit for Serdes transmitter
abstract_clean: The application relates to the technical field of integrated circuits and discloses a pulse generating circuit for a Serdes transmitter, which comprises a single pulse generating module, a current mode driving module and a pseudo-static selector, wherein the single pulse generating module comprises a first transistor, a second transistor, a third transistor, a fourth transistor, a fifth transistor, a seventh transistor, a sixth transistor, a seventh transistor, a third transistor, a fourth transistor, a fifth transistor, a seventh transistor, a grid electrode, a bias voltage, a source electrode and a full-swing single pulse signal, the grid electrode of the fifth transistor is connected with a lifting voltage, the grid electrode of the seventh transistor is connected with an output end of the single pulse generating module, the drain electrode of the fifth transistor is connected with the drain electrode of the seventh transistor and the full-swing single pulse signal is output, the current mode driving module comprises an eighth transistor, the grid electrodes of the eighth transistor and the ninth transistor are respectively connected with an output end of the pseudo-static selector, and the grid electrode of the eighth transistor is connected with a bias voltage, and the source electrode of the driving current is output. The application can improve the pulse establishment speed and reduce the complexity and cost of the driving module circuit.

title_clean: Stereo garage new energy automobile electric quantity induction detection technology device
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a stereo garage new energy automobile electric quantity induction detection technical device, which belongs to the technical field of electric automobile charging and comprises a support frame, wherein a charging table is arranged on the support frame according to the number of garages, the charging table comprises an outer protective cover, a supporting table is arranged in the outer protective cover, the supporting table is connected with an inner cover body through a displacement assembly, the inner side wall of the inner cover body is connected with a data display screen and a detection assembly through a rotating connecting piece, the output end of an electric push rod is connected with a positioning butt joint plate, a protection disc is arranged at the end part of the positioning butt joint plate, and an electric connector is connected onto the protection disc through a telescopic protection piece. According to the invention, the charging platform is arranged on the stereo garage, and the existing positioning parking function of the stereo garage is utilized, so that the charging platform automatically extends out after a vehicle in the garage is stably placed, the effect of charging the electric vehicle is fully automatically realized, the effect of parking and automatically charging in the stereo garage is achieved, and the electric quantity condition of the vehicle can be known in time through the data display screen.

title_clean: Intelligent monitoring devices of soil remediation
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses an intelligent monitoring devices of soil remediation, a serial communication port, include: the base comprises a lower fixed plate, the upper end of the lower fixed plate is fixedly connected with an upper fixed plate through a lifting mechanism, and at least two telescopic guide rods are arranged between the upper fixed plate and the lower fixed plate; the upper fixing plate and the lower fixing plate are provided with adjusting grooves which are matched with each other, and the upper end of the upper fixing plate is provided with a control unit; monitoring devices, monitoring devices are two at least, and monitoring devices detachably fixes in the adjustment tank, and monitoring devices includes the upper junction plate, and connecting plate lower extreme fixedly connected with connecting rod, the side of connecting rod are seted up flutedly, install the soil inductor in the recess, soil inductor and the control unit electric connection, connecting rod lower extreme fixedly connected with drill bit. Through being provided with the adjustment tank on the upper fixed plate, monitoring mechanism can slide in the adjustment tank, and the workman selects suitable position to fix according to actual conditions, makes things convenient for the workman to use.

title_clean: System and method for measuring lunar soil particle interaction force in simulated lunar environment
abstract_clean: The invention relates to a system and a method for measuring lunar soil particle interaction force under a simulated lunar environment, which simulate the high vacuum and high temperature difference environment of the moon by designing a lunar environment simulation system. The method is beneficial to analyzing the contact property among the lunar soil particles in a simulated lunar environment, establishes a refined digital lunar soil model, and can provide theoretical support for research and exploration of lunar soil macroscopic properties and engineering properties in a complex lunar environment.

title_clean: Integral type groundwater monitoring facilities
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses an integral type groundwater monitoring facilities, including solar panel, install on power supply unit through the support frame solar panel below, power supply unit includes the shell body, the shell body internal fixation is equipped with the baffle, install the battery on the baffle, the battery pass through cable one with solar panel connects, be located in the shell body the inner wall both sides of the below of baffle are equipped with the bearing, install the dwang between the inner circle of bearing, be equipped with the cable coil on the dwang, the one end of cable coil pass through connecting wire with the battery bottom is connected, the other end of cable coil is connected with underwater detection device, beneficial effect through cable two: the device is simple in structure and convenient to use, can be charged and powered by solar energy, does not need an external power supply, can adjust the position of the underwater detection device according to the water depth, has the waterproof protection function on the circuit board, and prolongs the service life of the circuit board.

title_clean: Device for producing n-propyl acetate by thermal coupling and production method thereof
abstract_clean: The invention relates to the field of chemical industry and discloses a device for producing n-propyl acetate by thermal coupling and a production method thereof. The rare earth modified solid super acidic catalyst is utilized for catalytic reaction, so that the requirements on the catalytic efficiency and the service life of the catalyst in the production process are met. The heat of the product discharged in the reaction process is fully utilized by utilizing the plurality of heat exchange units, the heat balance of the device is reasonably optimized, the safety of the device is improved, the operation efficiency of the device is improved, and the energy-saving effect is achieved.

title_clean: Method and plant for processing biological substrate
abstract_clean: The invention relates to a method for processing biological substrate, comprising the steps of: a) introducing the biological substrate into an apparatus for dry fermentation, b) carrying out dry fermentation to recover methane, forming fermentation residue, c) transferring the fermentation residue obtained in step b) to an apparatus for solid-liquid separation, d) carrying out solid-liquid separation of the fermentation residue, forming a fermentation residue solid phase and a fermentation residue raw liquid phase, e) transferring the fermentation residue raw liquid phase obtained in step d) to an apparatus for separating solids, f) carrying out separation of solids from the fermentation residue raw liquid phase, recovering a fermentation residue liquid phase, g) introducing the fermentation residue liquid phase obtained in step f) into an apparatus for wet fermentation, h) carrying out wet fermentation to recover methane, forming liquid fermentation residue, i) returning at least some of the liquid fermentation residue formed in step h) as inoculum to the apparatus for dry fermentation.

title_clean: 2709 alkali protease mutant modified based on molecular dynamics calculation and use thereof
abstract_clean: The present disclosure belongs relates to a 2709 alkali protease mutant modified based on molecular dynamics calculation and use thereof in liquid detergents. The dynamic structure feature of a 2709 alkali protease derived from Bacillus licheniformis are studied by using a molecular dynamics method through computer simulation, which is a unique effective method capable of studying a relationship between the structure of the 2709 alkali protease and molecular dynamics as well as an enzyme function in an atomic level. After molecular dynamics calculation, appropriate sites are selected for protein engineering to obtain the 2709 alkali protease mutant suitable for industrial application of detergents. The protease mutant has significantly improved enzyme activity under the alkaline condition, is better in stability, not only has good decontamination effect but also has good component compatibility with components in the detergent, and can be widely applied to the field of washing industry.

title_clean: Antibacterial cotton product and preparation method thereof
abstract_clean: The application relates to the field of textiles, and particularly discloses an antibacterial cotton product and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method of the antibacterial cotton product comprises the following steps: step 1: firstly, winding the thread into a cloth cover, then placing the cloth cover into the antibacterial slurry for soaking and sizing, and drying; then, slitting and serging the product obtained in the step 1 to finish the preparation of the cotton product; wherein, the antibacterial slurry comprises 95-105 parts of basic slurry and 4-5 parts of copper ion antibacterial agent by weight. The cotton product of the present application can be used for dishwashing, which has the advantage of being able to be antibacterial.

title_clean: Roving flock recovery device for spinning roving process and use method
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a roving linter recovery device for a spinning roving process and a use method thereof, comprising an installation bottom plate, wherein the top of the installation bottom plate is fixedly connected with a shell, the top of the shell is provided with a sealing cover plate, the left side and the right side of an inner cavity of the shell are respectively provided with an auxiliary frame, the front sides of the opposite sides of the two auxiliary frames are fixedly provided with a screw rod, the surface of the screw rod is sleeved with a filter assembly, and the center of the left side of the shell is fixedly provided with a driving motor. The utility model can be widely applied to recovery devices with different front and back lengths through the matched use of the support plate, the double-head screw rods and the buckling frame; the auxiliary frame, the filter screen plate, the threaded sleeve, the screw rod and the auxiliary frame are matched for use, so that the utilization rate of a filtering space can be improved, and the cleaning frequency of staff is reduced; through movable rod, driving pulley, connecting belt, driven pulley and helical blade cooperation use, can reduce the short velvet plug rate greatly, guarantee that the device carries out normal recovery process.

title_clean: Service creeper for automobile maintenance
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses an automobile maintenance lying plate, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein two rectangular grooves are formed in the lower end of the bottom plate, two bidirectional threaded rods are connected to the inner walls of the left side and the right side of the two rectangular grooves in a rotating mode, two sliding blocks are connected to the two bidirectional threaded rods in a threaded mode, connecting rods are connected to the lower ends of the sliding blocks in a rotating mode, abutting blocks are connected to the lower ends of the connecting rods in a rotating mode, rotating shafts are connected to the adjacent surfaces of the two connecting rods in a matching mode in a rotating mode, and a motor is installed on the right side of the bottom plate. Through setting up to the piece, under the operation of motor for support piece and ground contact, thereby can play limiting displacement, avoid the staff to carry out spacingly with the foot, thereby can improve maintenance efficiency, simultaneously through setting up diaphragm box rectangle box, when making certain instrument and part of needs, can be faster find instrument and part, thereby improve maintenance efficiency.

title_clean: Metal rubber three-way impact-resistant composite shock absorber based on active control
abstract_clean: The application discloses an active control-based metal rubber three-way impact-resistant composite damper which comprises a damping support framework, a top pressure plate, a top sealing plate, a top torsion spring shape memory alloy, a first vertical damping high-density metal rubber, a first lateral damping low-density metal rubber, a bottom sealing plate, a bottom pressure plate, a bottom torsion spring shape memory alloy, a second vertical damping high-density metal rubber, a second lateral damping low-density metal rubber and a power supply. The application adopts high-low density combined structural metal rubber with high damping performance and a torsion spring high-elasticity shape memory alloy as vibration damping elements, can control the rigidity characteristic of the shape memory alloy by changing the temperature through actively controlling the electrifying mode when bearing external high load so as to indirectly improve the rigidity of the metal rubber, thereby achieving overload protection, and adopts a high-low density composite metal rubber component to realize three-way vibration damping, thereby solving the phenomenon of poor horizontal vibration damping effect in the traditional high-speed centrifugal state.

title_clean: High-speed wire harness connector for electronic rearview mirror
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to the technical field of automobile wire harnesses, in particular to a high-speed wire harness connector for an electronic rearview mirror, wherein an inner hole is formed in a plug-in end of a connector body, a terminal assembly is arranged in the middle of the inner hole, one side surface of the connector body is an arc-shaped side surface, the other three side surfaces are planes, one side edge of the plug-in end of the connector body is provided with a protrusion extending outwards, the protrusion faces the arc-shaped side surface, a notch is formed in the side edge of the plug-in end of the connector body, the inner hole is communicated with the protrusion through the notch, three side edges of the notch extend outwards to form an outer protruding part, the outer protruding part positioned on the protruding part is in contact with the inner wall of the protrusion, a fan-shaped through hole is formed by surrounding the protrusion, the outer protruding part and the connector body, a cover is arranged on the side surface of the connector body, the cover is arranged on the same side surface of the connector body, the cover is arranged on the notch, and a gap is formed between the cover and the protrusion. Realize that asymmetric structure prevents slow-witted, accurate butt joint of direction inserted bar, occupation space is less, light in weight.

title_clean: Multi-angle optical scanning platform and optical scanning system based on rope group driving
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to the technical field of optical scanning equipment, in particular to a multi-angle optical scanning platform based on rope group driving and an optical scanning system. The multi-angle optical scanning platform based on rope group driving comprises an optical scanning piece, a bearing assembly, a base and a support, wherein a track is arranged on the base, the bearing assembly comprises a bottom platform, a suspension platform and at least three groups of rope groups, the support is fixedly arranged on the bottom platform, the suspension platform is rotatably arranged on the support, the bottom platform is in sliding connection with the track, the rope groups comprise telescopic driving pieces and connecting ropes, the telescopic driving pieces are fixedly arranged on the bottom platform, the suspension platform is connected with the telescopic driving pieces through the connecting ropes, and the telescopic driving pieces are used for adjusting the extending amount of the connecting ropes. The angle of the workpiece to be scanned is adjusted by the rope group based on the extending amount of the connecting ropes of the rope group, so that the multi-angle optical scanning platform driven by the rope group has higher flexibility, accuracy and applicability.

title_clean: Lens system and projection device
abstract_clean: The application protects a lens system, has an optical axis, includes: the optical lens comprises a modulation device, a first lens group, a second lens group, a diaphragm and a third lens group which are sequentially arranged between an object side and an image side along an optical axis, wherein the focal power of the first lens group is positive and is used for converging light rays, the first lens group at least comprises a first lens, and the effective clear diameter of the first lens is smaller than the size of an image circle; the focal power of the second lens group is positive and is used for further converging the light rays; the number of lens pieces of the third lens group is less than the sum of the lenses of the first lens group and the second lens group, and the third lens group is used for adapting the dilution of the etendue of the illumination light; the modulation device is used for emitting projection light rays, and the projection light rays are projected to a screen to form a projection image after passing through the first lens group, the second lens group and the diaphragm. Due to the arrangement of the third lens group, the optical expansion of the illuminating light can be effectively adapted to be diluted, and the problem of poor efficiency and uniformity caused by asymmetric arrangement is solved.

title_clean: PXIe-based one-to-many optical fiber communication board card
abstract_clean: The invention relates to a PXIe-based pair of multi-fiber communication board cards, and belongs to the field of testing. The board card comprises a connector interface (1), an RS422 communication part (2), a switching value part (3), an optical module part (4), a multi-channel conversion module part (5), a core controller (6) and a PXIe interface (7). The PXIe-based one-to-many optical fiber communication (SRIO) board card designed by the invention realizes the test of one-to-many optical fiber communication functions, reduces the cost of testing equipment in the batch production stage, shortens the time of debugging and testing stages, and improves the utilization rate of testers.

title_clean: Optical system, lens module and terminal equipment
abstract_clean: The embodiment of the application discloses an optical system, a lens module and terminal equipment. The optical system comprises a first lens element with positive refractive power, a third lens element with negative refractive power, a second lens element with refractive power, a fourth lens element with refractive power, a fifth lens element with refractive power, a sixth lens element with refractive power, a seventh lens element with refractive power and an eighth lens element with refractive power, wherein an object-side surface of the first lens element is convex at an optical axis, an image-side surface of the third lens element is concave at the optical axis, and an image-side surface of the fourth lens element is convex at the optical axis; the optical system satisfies the following conditional expression: TTL/f is less than 1.1, TTL is the distance between the object side surface of the first lens element and the imaging surface of the optical system on the optical axis, and f is the focal length of the optical system. The optical system has the characteristics of long focal length and good imaging quality while meeting the requirement of micro design by reasonably configuring the refractive power and the surface type of the first lens to the eighth lens in the optical system and limiting the TTL/f to be less than 1.1.

title_clean: Full life cycle-based carbon emission evaluation system for construction of traffic infrastructure
abstract_clean: The invention provides a full life cycle-based carbon emission evaluation system for construction of a traffic infrastructure, which comprises an exhaust pipe, wherein the exhaust pipe comprises an exhaust pipe of an infrastructure material production factory and an automobile tail gas pipe, a carbon emission monitor is attached to the outer wall of the exhaust pipe, clamping frames are rotatably arranged at the upper end and the lower end of the carbon emission monitor through hinges, the carbon emission monitor is arranged on the exhaust pipe through the clamping frames, the exhaust pipe can be the exhaust pipe of the infrastructure material production factory or the automobile tail gas pipe, the exhaust gas is monitored and counted to obtain carbon emission, and when a vehicle for transporting materials cannot continue to run, a front ring, a cleaning layer and a rear ring of a protection assembly wrap a detection end, and the cleaning layer is driven to rotate by the driving of the rear ring to clean dust on the surface of the detection end, meanwhile, the relatively sealed detection end can not be influenced by external carbon emission, the carbon emission value is recorded in an accumulated mode, and the error of carbon emission statistics is reduced.

title_clean: Intelligent fire fighting system and automatic inspection method thereof
abstract_clean: The invention provides an intelligent fire fighting system and an automatic inspection method thereof, wherein the intelligent fire fighting system comprises: the system comprises a collecting end, a multi-end inspection device and a real-time warning information acquiring and processing end, wherein the collecting end is used for collecting inspection information in an inspection range based on the multi-end inspection device, receiving warning information in the inspection range and acquiring real-time warning information based on the inspection information and the warning information; the prediction end is used for carrying out multi-dimensional analysis prediction on the routing inspection information to obtain a corresponding prediction result; the generating end is used for generating a corresponding latest disaster memory spool based on the real-time alarm information and generating a corresponding latest inspection plan based on the latest disaster memory spool and the prediction result; the inspection end is used for controlling the corresponding inspection device to perform inspection based on the latest inspection plan; the multi-dimensional analysis based on the inspection information and the historical inspection information can generate an efficient inspection plan, and the automatic inspection mode of fixing the crash of the traditional intelligent fire-fighting system is improved.

title_clean: Method for relieving characteristic value oscillation in small-interference stable constraint optimal power flow model
abstract_clean: The invention provides a method for relieving characteristic value oscillation in a small-interference stable constraint optimal power flow model, which comprises the steps of firstly, solving power flow calculation of an initial operating point and carrying out small-interference stable analysis; secondly, constructing a small interference stability constraint which fully considers the influence of steady-state operating point change on the characteristic value; on the basis, a small-interference stable constraint optimal power flow model is established; then, the Lagrangian multiplier method is utilized to process the equality constraint, the external point penalty function method is utilized to process the inequality constraint, and an augmented Lagrangian function is constructed; and finally, realizing simultaneous solving by using a quasi-Newton method. Characteristic value oscillation in the small-interference stable constraint optimal power flow simultaneous solution can be effectively relieved, and the convergence of an algorithm is improved; has the advantages of strong practicability and good effect.

title_clean: Community fire control toughness optimization promotion strategy method and system based on complex network and ISM-MICMAC model
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a method and a system for optimizing and improving the fire-fighting toughness of a community based on a complex network and an ISM-MICMAC model, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a community fire-fighting toughness evaluation index system and defining an index association relation; based on the community fire-fighting toughness evaluation index system and the association relation, a community fire-fighting toughness complex network is established, key influence factors of the community fire-fighting toughness are defined, based on the factors and the association relation, the emergency degree and the importance degree of the factors are defined by using an ISM-MICMAC model, a community fire-fighting toughness grade matrix is established based on the emergency degree and the importance degree, the key influence factor optimization priority of the community fire-fighting toughness is defined, and a community fire-fighting toughness optimization promotion strategy is formulated. The method can realize grading of key factors of the fire control toughness of the community, construct a fire control toughness promotion strategy of the community, and provide powerful support for realizing omnibearing fire control toughness promotion of the community.

title_clean: Tracking monitoring device, tracking monitoring system, tracking monitoring method, and tracking monitoring program
abstract_clean: To provide a tracking monitoring technique capable of monitoring an object to be tracked for a longer time.SOLUTION: A tracking monitoring device includes: a video receiving unit configured to receive video data captured by a first camera; a target detecting unit configured to detect a target from received video data and measure a moving speed of a detected target; a subsequent-stage camera comparing unit configured to calculate a predicted arrival time at which the target reaches an imaging range of a second camera based on the measured moving speed; and a control unit configured to transmit a calculated predicted arrival time to a second camera.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_clean: Image forming device, information processing device, and program
abstract_clean: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an image forming device which, upon receipt of an instruction from a user to collectively execute two or more adjustment items that can be arbitrary selected and executed for adjustment related to image formation of the image forming device, makes adjustments corresponding to the adjustment items in a predetermined order regardless of the order in which the two or more adjustment items were selected by the user. SOLUTION: An image forming device is provided, comprising: image forming means for forming an image on a recording material; a control unit configured to provide control to make a display unit display a screen showing multiple adjustment items related to quality of an image formed by the image forming means; and an adjustment unit configured to respond to a situation where two or more arbitrary selectable adjustment items are selected through manipulation on the screen and an instruction is issued to collectively execute the two or more adjustment items by making adjustments corresponding to the two or more adjustment items in a predetermined order regardless of an order in which the two or more adjustment items were selected.
