title_clean: Generating a Unique Code from Orientation Information
abstract_clean: In a general aspect, orientation information is used to generate a unique code. In some aspects, orientation information is extracted from an object. The object includes multiple elements, and the orientation information indicates the relative spatial orientations of the respective elements. The orientation information can be extracted, for instance, by a scanner system that detects the elements. A unique code is generated for the object based on the orientation information. In some examples, the elements are diamond particles that each have one or more color centers, and the orientation information is extracted by detecting the color centers.

title_clean: Pixel circuit, driving method thereof, display panel and display device
abstract_clean: A pixel circuit (100) and a driving method thereof, a display panel (1000) and a display device, wherein the pixel circuit (100) comprises a data writing sub-circuit (110), a driving sub-circuit (120) and at least one potential maintaining sub-circuit (130). The Data writing sub-circuit (110) is coupled with at least a first voltage signal terminal (VDD), a Data signal terminal (Data), a first scan signal terminal (Pgate) and a first node (N1), and writes the Data signal provided by the Data signal terminal (Data) into the first node (N1) under the control of the first scan signal provided by at least the first scan signal terminal (Pgate); the driving sub-circuit (120) is coupled with the first node (N1), the second node (N2) and the third node (N3), and forms a path between the second node (N2) and the third node (N3) under the control of the potential of the first node (N1); a potential maintaining sub-circuit (130) is coupled to a circuit node and a reference signal terminal (Vref) for maintaining the potential of the corresponding circuit node via the reference signal provided by the reference signal terminal (Vref).

title_clean: Molecular metal-based single crystalline thin film, component having same, and method for manufacturing single crystalline thin film
abstract_clean: Provided is a molecular metal-based single crystalline thin film having high electrical conductivity and high light transmittance. The molecular metal-based single crystalline thin film has a light transmittance of 80% or more at a wavelength of 360-830 nm, wherein the molecular metal is a compound represented by Formula (I). In Formula (I), X represents at least one atom selected from the group consisting of S, O, and Se, the plurality of X's may be the same or different, R represents a hydrogen atom or a monovalent substituent, the plurality of R's may be the same or different, provided that at least one among the R's is at least one group selected from the group consisting of groups represented by Formula (II), and the R's on adjacent atoms may be linked to each other to form a ring. In Formula (II), * represents a bonding position, and R 11 represents a hydrogen atom or a C1-4 alkyl group.

title_clean: Semiconductor device and manufacturing method of semiconductor device
abstract_clean: To solve a problem in which bonded semiconductor chips vary in height from one another when a plurality of semiconductor chips is bonded to a wafer, and the electronic components may not be able to exhibit the desired performance when used as electronic components.SOLUTION: A manufacturing method for a semiconductor device includes the steps of preparing a first semiconductor substrate, a second semiconductor substrate having a first semiconductor layer and a second semiconductor layer, and a third semiconductor substrate, a bonding step of bonding the second semiconductor substrate and the third semiconductor substrate to one main surface of the first semiconductor substrate, and a thinning step of removing, after the bonding step, at least the second semiconductor layer of the second semiconductor substrate by wet etching, and an etching rate of an etchant used in the thinning step for the second semiconductor layer is greater than an etching rate for the first semiconductor layer.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_clean: Methods and devices for adapting a solar module support
abstract_clean: Included are methods and devices of adapting a solar module support with pre-formed features that position and/or secure solar module clips. The adaptation may include forming new positioning and/securing features at new locations on the solar module support, or otherwise positioning the solar module clips on the solar module support at locations different from these pre-formed features. These methods and devices allow a solar module support with pre-formed features to accommodate solar modules of different dimensions than originally envisioned.

title_clean: High electron mobility transistor and method for forming the same
abstract_clean: A high electron mobility transistor includes an epitaxial stack on a substrate, a gate structure on the epitaxial stack, a passivation layer on the epitaxial stack and covering the gate structure, and an air gap between the passivation layer and the gate structure.

title_clean: Automatic driving voice broadcasting method and system
abstract_clean: The invention relates to an automatic driving voice broadcasting method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of initializing a system, loading a voice synthesis engine and an expert knowledge base, starting a tcp port, waiting for a tcp client to establish connection, receiving intelligent driving system information after establishing connection, carrying out reasoning analysis on the received intelligent driving system information by combining the expert knowledge base, judging whether voice broadcasting is needed, synthesizing the voice information through the voice synthesis engine if the voice broadcasting is needed, adjusting voice volume, voice speed and switching voice packets through a voice broadcasting device knob, and playing sound through in-car sound equipment and an out-car loudspeaker. According to the invention, through real-time in-car and out-car voice prompts, drivers and external traffic participants can better understand and adapt to the driving intention of the automatic driving vehicle, the trouble caused by unsmooth communication or misunderstanding is reduced, and the user experience is optimized.

title_clean: Communication method and apparatus
abstract_clean: Provided in the present application are a communication method and apparatus. The communication method comprises: acquiring first information, wherein the first information may be used for indicating an association relationship between a data identifier and a data processing mode, the data processing mode may comprise executing one or more first functions for data processing, and/or skipping one or more second functions for data processing, and the data identifier may comprise a first data identifier; and receiving first data carrying the first data identifier, and processing the first data on the basis of the first data identifier and the association relationship; or, sending the first data carrying the first data identifier. In the present application, different first data identifiers may have association relationships with different data processing modes. Thus, a corresponding functional entity processes first data on the basis of the data processing modes corresponding to the first data identifiers. In this way, appropriate functions are selected in a targeted manner for processing different data, thereby improving the service processing efficiency and the system performance.

title_clean: OTFS multi-satellite channel estimation-oriented PCRB analysis and power optimization method and system
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a PCRB analysis and power optimization method and system for OTFS multi-satellite channel estimation, which comprises the steps of constructing an OTFS signal-based pilot frequency and data superposition transmission model, constructing a pilot frequency observation covariance matrix based on multi-satellite LoS path correlation and data interference, constructing an observation Fisher information matrix based on PCRB, utilizing a spread spectrum pilot frequency derivative subspace to label an inverse matrix of the pilot frequency observation covariance matrix in the PCRB-based observation Fisher information matrix, constructing an equivalent observation Fisher information matrix for PCRB calculation and power optimization based on a standard quantification processing result, calculating PCRB according to the equivalent observation Fisher information matrix, constructing a throughput maximization-oriented power optimization problem based on the PCRB, and solving the throughput maximization-oriented power optimization problem to obtain an optimal power optimization scheme. The invention can obtain better balance between the channel estimation precision and the data transmission rate, and avoid the problems of channel estimation error increase and actual throughput reduction caused by simply increasing the data power.

title_clean: Method for transmitting channel state information report, communication device, and storage medium
abstract_clean: The disclosure provides a transmission method, a communication device and a storage medium for a channel state information report, which relate to the technical field of wireless communication and can improve the compression performance of channel information. The method comprises the following steps: determining a first state parameter according to a contracted mode; or determining a first state parameter according to the mode of signaling transmission; determining second channel state information and second state parameters according to the first state parameters and the first channel state information; generating a channel state information report according to the second channel state information; and sending a channel state information report.

title_clean: Method for removing hydrogen sulfide in formation produced water based on synergistic effect of ferrous sulfate and ferrous gluconate
abstract_clean: Disclosed is a method for removing hydrogen sulﬁde in formation produced water based on the synergistic effect of ferrous sulfate and ferrous gluconate, including the steps of: Sl, extracting a formation produced water sample; S2, adding caustic soda into the formation produced water and adjusting a pH value to weak alkalinity; S3, weighing appropriate amounts of ferrous sulfate and ferrous gluconate to prepare a treatment liquid,; S4, adding an appropriate amount of treatment liquid into the water sample, and controlling a reaction temperature at 25-40°C and a reaction time to be 3-5 min; and SS, standing for a precipitation, separating a supernatant, and completing a removal of hydrogen sulfide after the reaction. By adopting technical solutions of the present invention, the problems of high cost and non—environmental protection existing in the existing desulfurization technology are overcame, and the treatment effect of water samples is improved at a lower cost. title_clean: But chemical waste gas treatment device of automatically cleaning
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to a chemical waste gas treatment technical field specifically is a but chemical waste gas treatment device of automatically cleaning, including exhaust treatment device body, servo motor, first driving motor and second driving motor, the air inlet has been installed to the side of exhaust treatment device body, the motor case has been installed on the top of exhaust treatment device body, servo motor has been installed to the inside of motor case, and servo motor's output shaft fixed mounting has a common gear. The utility model discloses a be provided with second driving motor and suction pump, can spray water suction outlet pipe in the middle of through the suction pump, the rethread goes out the water shower nozzle, can carry out neutralization treatment with this internal chemical waste gas of exhaust treatment device through this mode, can make the carriage carry out the oscilaltion through servo motor's rotation, through carrying out the oscilaltion with the laminating of clearance scraper blade on the inner wall of exhaust treatment device body, can clear up the inner wall of exhaust treatment device body.

title_clean: Comprehensive garbage and biogas treatment method for urban densely populated areas
abstract_clean: A comprehensive treatment method for garbage and methane in urban dense population areas can collect methane from a large number of anaerobic tanks in cities, and intensively convey the methane to a garbage incinerator to be used as a garbage combustion improver; the method can solve the problem that the anaerobic pond biogas pollutes the urban environment, and can save combustion improver such as coal, oil, natural gas and the like used for garbage incineration. The environmental problems of urban solid waste and urban waste gas are fundamentally improved.

title_clean: Purging method, control module, purging device and storage medium
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a purging method, a control module, purging equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining purging instructions comprising preset purging paths and purging modes, wherein the preset purging paths comprise a plurality of paths which are sequentially arranged, and each purging mode is associated with a preset purging direction; the method includes the steps of controlling a purge device to travel along a first path from a start point of a first path in a preset purge path and to perform a purge operation in a preset purge direction, controlling the purge device to perform a transfer operation corresponding to a purge mode to transfer the purge device to a start point of a next path in the preset purge path when an end point of the first path is reached, and controlling the purge device to travel along the preset purge path from the start point of the next path and to perform the purge operation in the preset purge direction. The invention improves the blowing effect and the intelligence of blowing operation.

title_clean: A dispersion section device for paint produce
abstract_clean: The utility model provides a dispersion section device for paint produce, the on-line screen storage device comprises a base, dispersion slicer main part, the support subassembly, agitator and screening part, dispersion slicer main part sets up on the base, the agitator is through being connected with the support subassembly, have screening part in the agitator, form first stirring region and second stirring region in the messenger's agitator, dispersion slicer main part has rabbling mechanism, rabbling mechanism includes the axostylus axostyle, dispersion dish part and branch material subassembly, when the part of axostylus axostyle is located the agitator, the dispersion dish part is located first stirring region, the branch material subassembly is located the second stirring region, the coating raw materials of pouring in the agitator is blocked by the screening part, make it be located first stirring region, and stir the operation by the dispersion dish part, later get into the second stirring region through the screening part, again by the branch material subassembly carries out secondary stirring operation, avoid the coating raw materials to exist great granule and impurity unable the condition of getting rid of after the stirring is accomplished.

title_clean: Cutting fixing device for packaging box
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to the technical field of life, in particular to a cutting and fixing device of a packing box, which comprises a fixing device main body, a power assembly and a pressing device; the fixing device main body is composed of a movable rod, a positioning block, a groove body, a chassis and a fixing block; one end of the fixed block is integrally connected with the chassis; the other end of the fixed block is movably connected with the trough body, and the fixed block is arranged in the trough body; one end of the movable rod is integrally connected with the groove body, and the other end of the movable rod penetrates through the positioning block; the movable rod, the groove body and the fixed block are arranged in the fixing device main body, so that the chassis can perform circular motion, the packaging box fixed on the chassis can perform circular motion, and the periphery of the packaging box can be conveniently cut and fixed; through set up the spring in closing device, can adjust the size, be convenient for fix the packing carton of equidimension not, can make the packing carton be in the middle part all the time simultaneously, application range is wider, and the practicality is stronger.

title_clean: Corrosion-resistant wear-resistant slag welding wire and preparation method thereof
abstract_clean: The application relates to the technical field of welding materials, in particular to a corrosion-resistant wear-resistant slag welding wire and a preparation method thereof. The raw materials used for the corrosion-resistant and wear-resistant slag-based welding wire comprise a flux core and a steel belt, wherein the raw materials used for the flux core comprise micro-carbon ferrochrome nickel powder, ferroboron, high-carbon ferromanganese, ferrosilicon, aluminum powder, rutile powder, quartz powder, fluorite powder, ferrovanadium, ferroniobium, cobalt powder, tungsten powder, potassium carbonate powder, fused magnesia, marble powder, ferrotitanium, fluxing agent and iron. The product of the application can realize semi-automatic or full-automatic welding of spiral welding and swing welding, and the welding wire has strong air hole resistance, high wear resistance and good corrosion resistance, and can obviously improve the hardness of the welding part and the air hole resistance of the welding seam.

title_clean: Tea rolling device with elastic cloth guiding structure
abstract_clean: The utility model is suitable for the technical field of tea processing devices, and provides a tea rolling device with an elastic cloth guiding structure, which comprises: the rolling machine comprises a frame, wherein a rolling box is fixedly connected to the top of the frame, and a connecting frame is arranged at the top of the rolling box. According to the tea rolling device with the elastic cloth guiding-out structure, provided by the utility model, the rotation of the rolling blocks while the rolling blocks turn round is controlled by arranging the hollow pipe, the power shaft, the first bevel gear, the second bevel gear, the motor case, the third bevel gear, the motor, the rotating mechanism and the linkage mechanism, so that the loss of electric energy is reduced, the problem that the existing rolling device is used for rolling tea by arranging a plurality of motors to control the rolling bottom plate to rotate while the rolling bottom plate turns round is solved, but the power consumption is overlarge due to the arrangement of the motors, and the processing cost of the tea is increased is solved.

title_clean: Tracking monitoring device, tracking monitoring system, tracking monitoring method, and tracking monitoring program
abstract_clean: To provide a tracking monitoring technique capable of monitoring an object to be tracked for a longer time.SOLUTION: A tracking monitoring device includes: a video receiving unit configured to receive video data captured by a first camera; a target detecting unit configured to detect a target from received video data and measure a moving speed of a detected target; a subsequent-stage camera comparing unit configured to calculate a predicted arrival time at which the target reaches an imaging range of a second camera based on the measured moving speed; and a control unit configured to transmit a calculated predicted arrival time to a second camera.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_clean: Intelligent maintenance prediction and health management system for high-altitude equipment
abstract_clean: The invention discloses an intelligent maintenance prediction and health management system for high-altitude equipment, which relates to the technical field of high-altitude equipment management and has the technical scheme that the intelligent maintenance prediction and health management system comprises the following main points of collecting operation parameter values of the high-altitude equipment and dividing the condition area of the high-altitude equipment into area division groups according to the operation parameter values of the high-altitude equipment; the regional division set comprises a target fault region, a first region to be divided and a second region to be divided, an initial steering state of the detection device is set according to the position relation of the regional division set, the initial steering state of the detection device and condition data in the target fault region are processed, analyzed and set to be the initial working state of the detection device, the regional coverage range of the target fault region towards the direction of the detection device is collected, and the parameter fluctuation trend of high-altitude equipment is obtained in real time.

title_clean: Methods and systems for annuloplasty alignment
abstract_clean: The present disclosure relates to methods, systems, subsystems, and kits for aligning an annuloplasty ring or a toroidal portion thereof with a natural fiducial in an annular target.

title_clean: Data compression system and method based on multistage series decimation filter
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a data compression system and a method based on a multistage series extraction filter, wherein the data compression system comprises a channel selector switch, a multistage extraction filter, a multistage storage switch, an extraction filter coefficient memory or a filter coefficient generator and a data memory; wherein the channel switch is connected with the first stage of the multistage series decimation filter; all stages in the multi-stage decimation filter are connected in series in sequence. When the data compression system and the data compression method based on the multistage series decimation filter are applied to online analysis of data, the system can compress prepared data according to analysis requirements, so that the efficiency of online data processing can be greatly improved when long data with high and low frequency analysis requirements are considered simultaneously is processed; on the other hand, when the application data is collected in real time, the extraction filter can output compressed data at different stages, namely the system can realize the function of classifying data at different extraction rates of channels, and the actual data storage amount can be greatly reduced through reasonable configuration selection.

title_clean: Device and method for storing, applying, outputting and/or mixing at least one ink
abstract_clean: Device for storing and/or applying and/or outputting and/or mixing at least one ink, comprising at least one storage device (02), at least one handling device and/or at least one transport device (03) and at least one output device (04), wherein the at least one output device comprises at least one receiving device (59) and at least one pouring device (61), wherein the at least one pouring device has at least one holding device (62), wherein the at least one holding device is arranged in a movable and/or pivotable manner about a horizontal pivot axis (64) by means of a drive.

title_clean: Connector contact core installation quality inspection device
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a connector contact core installation quality inspection device, including a supporting bench and bearing structure, the front end outer wall mid-mounting of a supporting bench has the level gauge, and a supporting bench's top outer wall is fixed with the main part, the pivot is worn to be equipped with on the top of main part, and the bottom outer wall of pivot has linked up the door leaf. This connector contact core installation quality inspection device places the top of connector between two push pedals through handheld, then provide the energy through the motor and make hydraulic cylinder can carry out the activity of rising to contract, utilize the setting of fixed long slab, can play the effect of a butt to hydraulic cylinder, and then make the push pedal can be more stable when promoting the centre gripping connector, this installation quality detection device's security and fastness have been guaranteed, after quality inspection finishes, can rotate the door leaf about the outer wall of pivot, thereby accomplish closing to the door leaf, and then can effectively prevent that the dust from falling into inside the device, it is more difficult to lead to cleaning work.

title_clean: Article of footwear with first and second outsole components and method of manufacturing an article of footwear
abstract_clean: A sole structure for an article of footwear comprises a midsole including a polymeric bladder element enclosing a fluid-filled interior cavity, a first outsole component secured to a bottom surface and to a side surface of the polymeric bladder element, and a second outsole component. The first outsole component includes a first base, and a wall integral with the first base. The second outsole component includes a second base secured to the first base, and a wall integral with the second base and secured to the outer surface of the wall of the first outsole component. A method of manufacturing the article of footwear includes thermoforming the bladder element and the first outsole component, and securing the second outsole component to the first outsole component.

title_clean: Multifunctional meter box mounting bracket
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a multifunctional meter box mounting bracket, which relates to the technical field of meter box brackets and comprises two cross beams, wherein two positioning sleeves are sleeved outside the two cross beams in a sliding way, a connecting plate is arranged between the positioning sleeves on the two cross beams, a second mounting groove is formed in the front side of the cross beam, a first fixing bolt penetrates through the second mounting groove and is used for fixing the connecting plate, bottom plates are arranged at the lower ends of the two connecting plates, a third mounting groove is formed in the upper parts of the two bottom plates, and a rain shielding piece is sleeved between the upper parts of the two connecting plates in a sliding way. This multi-functional table case installing support, with the support mounting to the wall after, if need install the not equidimension table case, need not to dismantle the support for the installation that punches alone again, can the direct adjustment support the installation dimension to the convenience is installed different table cases, convenient and fast, and stability is high after the installation, and the table case is difficult for droing.

title_clean: Nozzle head and apparatus
abstract_clean: A nozzle head and apparatus for subjecting a surface of a substrate to alternate surface reactions of at least two precursors (A, B) includes an output face, at least one gas supply nozzle, and at least one discharge nozzle. The nozzle head includes on the output face in the following order: a first zone end nozzle, a gas supply nozzle and a second zone end nozzle, repeated one or more times. The first zone end nozzle is arranged at a first distance (L Y ) from the gas supply nozzle and the second zone end nozzle is arranged at a second distance (L X ) from the gas supply nozzle. The second distance (L X ) is greater than the first distance (L Y ).

title_clean: Anti-aging wire and cable and preparation method thereof
abstract_clean: The application relates to the technical field of wires and cables, and discloses an anti-aging wire and cable and a preparation method thereof; cobalt (Co) is selected as a metal blank, and bipyridine-imidazole connecting agent is introduced to prepare a two-dimensional MOF material with high heat dissipation performance and oxidation resistance; the preparation method comprises the steps of immersing carbon nano tubes in a MOF preparation process to prepare the composite MOF crosslinked carbon nano tubes with the three-dimensional structure, preparing two materials into a coating to be coated on the surface of a conductor, extruding a coating insulating layer through an extruder, cooling, rolling and packaging to obtain the anti-aging wire and cable. The material has wide application prospect in the field of wires and cables, and provides an effective way for solving the problem of cable aging.

title_clean: Production method of low-yield-ratio 780 MPa-grade bridge steel
abstract_clean: The production method of the low yield ratio 780MPa grade bridge steel comprises the following chemical components in percentage by weight: c=0.07 to 0.10%, si less than or equal to 0.14%, mn=1.40 to 2.00%, P less than or equal to 0.010%, S less than or equal to 0.0060%, cu=0.20 to 0.40%, ni=0.6 to 1.20%, cr=0.50 to 0.90%, mo=0.30 to 0.60%, al=0.030 to 0.050%, ti=0.010 to 0.015%, and the balance Fe and unavoidable impurities. The method for realizing recrystallization refinement and multiple heat preservation quenching refinement homogenization of austenite grains by utilizing the limit deformation of the austenite grains in the hot rolling process of the Nb-free steel realizes refinement homogenization of the transformation martensite structure and the lath bainite structure, and ensures that the bridge steel plate with the thickness of 50mm and 780MPa has the characteristics of high strength, excellent low-temperature toughness and low yield ratio under the combined action of fine precipitation.

title_clean: Method for producing ceramic nanoparticle dispersion and method for producing oxide superconducting thin film
abstract_clean: In the present invention, a starting material solution that contains a first metal-organic compound, barium hydroxide, and water molecules is prepared. The first metal-organic compound contains a transition metal atom. In the starting material solution, the molar fraction of the water molecules relative to the barium atoms included in the barium hydroxide is not more than 10.0. A suspension that contains ceramic nanoparticles is prepared by heat-treating the starting material solution at not less than 200°C using a solvothermal method.

title_clean: Application of lycium barbarum glycopeptide in preparing medicament for preventing and/or treating amyotrophic lateral sclerosis
abstract_clean: The invention relates to the field of biological medicine, in particular to application of lycium barbarum glycopeptides in preparation of a medicament for preventing and/or treating amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Experimental results show that the medlar glycopeptide is applied to the preparation of the medicament for preventing and/or treating amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Specifically, the medlar glycopeptide slows down the weight reduction of the SOD1G93A transgenic mouse, prolongs the life cycle of the SOD1G93A transgenic mouse, prolongs the disease course of the SOD1G93A transgenic mouse, and down regulates the relative expression quantity of the lumbar spinal cord inflammatory factor of the SOD1G93A transgenic mouse.

title_clean: Method and measurement reagent for measuring adrenomedullins
abstract_clean: To provide a test method and a test reagent for equivalently quantifying AMs secreted from a patient and an externally administered AM analog, covering only active AMs, to administer an optimal dose of the AM analog so as to keep the dose optimal during treatment with the AM analog.SOLUTION: A method and a test reagent are provided for equivalently quantifying endogenous AMs and an administered AM analog in a human specimen, covering only active AMs, to administer an optimal dose of the AM analog.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_clean: Devices, systems, and methods for treating vessel wall openings
abstract_clean: Devices, systems, and methods for treating vessel openings are disclosed herein. According to some embodiments, a device for treating a vessel opening comprises a housing configured to be positioned within an opening in subcutaneous tissue proximate the vessel opening. The housing can comprise an inner wall and an outer wall. The inner wall can define a first lumen configured to receive an elongate member therein and the inner and outer walls can define a second lumen configured to receive an adhesive. The outer wall of the housing can define one or more apertures extending radially from the second lumen to an environment external of the housing. The device can comprise an actuator configured to be received within the second lumen. Movement of the actuator can force the adhesive to move through the aperture to the external environment and into an extravascular space within the subcutaneous tissue proximate the vessel opening.

title_clean: Compositions, devices and methods for treating immune-mediated inflammatory diseases
abstract_clean: Described herein are implantable devices comprising cells genetically modified to express and secrete one or more immunomodulatory proteins. The devices and compositions thereof may be useful for treating immune-mediated inflammatory diseases.

title_clean: Automatic production line spoofing attack detection method and system based on random control
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a method and a system for detecting cheating attacks on an automatic production line based on random control. In the training stage, randomly generating control instructions of different equipment of the production line, enabling the equipment to execute according to the control instructions, and generating the real running/waiting time of the equipment; identifying the relationship between the respective real running/waiting time of all equipment of the production line and the received control instruction by a linear regression method; in the attack detection stage, control instructions and expected operation/waiting time of different devices are randomly generated, the expected operation period of the production line is kept unchanged, and finally, the accumulated deviation between the real operation/waiting time and the expected operation/waiting time of the devices is calculated according to the operation data of the different devices uploaded by the production line, so that the attack detection is realized. By means of the technical scheme provided by the invention, detection aiming at the deception attack can be realized on the premise of keeping the operation efficiency of the production line, the detection process is not easily interfered by the outside, and the detection accuracy rate is higher.

title_clean: Artificial intelligence model training method and communication apparatus
abstract_clean: The present application relates to the technical field of communications, and provides an artificial intelligence model training method and a communication apparatus. In the artificial intelligence model training method, a parameter, which needs to be updated, of a first model can be determined on the basis of acquired identification information of a first scenario, and the parameter, which needs to be updated, of the first model is updated, but not all parameters are updated, thereby effectively reducing the overall overhead of model updating.

title_clean: System and method for transferring funds
abstract_clean: A computer-implemented method including receiving a request to facilitate a transfer of funds from a sender account of a sender at a sender financial institution to a recipient account of a recipient at a recipient financial institution. The request can include a public identifier for the recipient but not include an account number of the recipient account at the recipient financial institution. The method also can include determining, using an information directory, a private token for the recipient account based on the public identifier. The method additionally can include transmitting the private token of the recipient account to enable the transfer of the funds from the sender account to the recipient account. Other embodiments are disclosed.

title_clean: AI-based system and method for establishing channelized communications
abstract_clean: AI-based system for establishing channelized communications and resource management for an organization. The system includes: a processor of a channel server node connected to an organization network; a memory on which are stored machine-readable instructions that when executed by the processor, cause the processor to: monitor the at least one organization network to collect analytics data comprising workflow data, generate a plurality of classifiers based on the analytics data, the plurality of classifiers comprising data reflecting nodes and associated pivot objects of the at least one organization network, feed the plurality of classifiers to an AI/ML module configured to output configuration parameters for at least one communication channel; and generate the at least one communication channel for the at least one organization network based on the configuration parameters.

title_clean: Antibacterial coating structure of return air filter
abstract_clean: The utility model provides an antibacterial coating structure of a return air filter, which comprises a return air filter frame, wherein a base layer is arranged in the return air filter frame, a transition layer is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the base layer, an antibacterial layer is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the transition layer, an adhesive layer is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the antibacterial layer, and an inner protective layer is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the adhesive layer. This antibiotic coating structure of return air filter through basic unit, the setting of transition layer, antibiotic layer and tie coat, can effectively restrain the growth and the propagation of multiple bacterium at the filter surface, greatly reduced the possibility that the bacterium breeds and spreads in return air system, ensured the sanitary quality of air, when playing antibiotic effect, ensured that the return air filter can last steadily to filter the processing to the air, possess good stability, can last to keep antibiotic ability in long-term use, prolonged the life of return air filter, improved whole ventilation system's operating efficiency.

title_clean: Reduced iron shaft furnace cooling circulating water treatment device
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a reduced iron shaft furnace refrigeration cycle water treatment facilities, which comprises a tank body, the upper end fixed mounting of the jar body has the go-between, the upper end fixed mounting of go-between has the top cap, the upper end fixed mounting of top cap has the input mouth, the lower extreme fixed mounting of the jar body has the support column, the lower extreme swing joint of support column has the bottom plate, one side fixed mounting of the jar body has the oral siphon, the one end fixed mounting of oral siphon has the connector, the vent has been seted up to the opposite side of the jar body, the inside fixed mounting of the jar body has the filter layer, the inside below fixed mounting of the jar body has the immersible pump, one side fixedly connected with water pipe of immersible pump, the opposite side below fixed mounting of the jar body has the outlet pipe. The utility model provides a water treatment device with a filtering effect, avoids influencing the service life because of too much rust, and provides a radiating function, thereby having practicability.

title_clean: Internal combustion engine
abstract_clean: A valve seat 30 has a port connection surface 32 which connects between a downstream intake port surface 24 and a valve resting surface 31 and intersects with the downstream intake port surface 24. The valve seat 30 has an edge 33 which is defined by a line-shaped sharp corner lying on an intersection between the downstream intake port surface 24 and the port connection surface 32. Recesses 25A, 25B, and 25C are formed to extend in a direction in which the intake port 23 extends. The recesses 25A, 25B, and 25C are hollowed in the downstream intake port surface 24 and the port connection surface 32 to increase a transverse sectional area thereof. The recesses 25A, 25B, and 25C are arranged adjacent each other in a circumferential direction of the intake port 23. These arrangements ensure the stability in creating a tumble flow 40 of intake air in a combustion chamber 5 and enhances the efficiency in supplying the intake air into the combustion chamber 5.

title_clean: Water-saving counter-flow cooling tower
abstract_clean: The application relates to a water-saving counter-flow cooling tower which comprises a tower body, a fan and a filler, wherein a spraying assembly is arranged above the filler, the spraying assembly comprises a water main arranged in the tower body, a plurality of water diversion pipes are arranged on the water main, a rain collecting box is arranged on the outer side wall of the tower body, a filter screen is arranged in the rain collecting box, a water supply pipe communicated with the water main is arranged on the outer side wall of the rain collecting box, a water pump is arranged on the water supply pipe, rainwater flows into the rain collecting box through the filter screen during raining, when the cooling tower needs to be supplemented with water, an operator turns on the water pump, the rainwater in the rain collecting box flows out from a water outlet of the water diversion pipes through the water main, the whole water supplementing process does not depend on tap water resources completely, and the utilization rate of natural water is improved. The application has the effect of saving tap water resources.

title_clean: Recovery ink box and chip mounting method thereof
abstract_clean: The invention provides a recycling ink box and a chip mounting method thereof, comprising the following steps: through fixing the recovery ink horn and cutting, remove a part of ink horn, the breach after the excision forms the chip installation position, rethread equipment of polishing is with near the burr overlap of cutting opening excision, form smooth complete chip installation position, it is down with the chip mount pad alignment fixed slot installation again, then place the chip on the chip mount pad, accomplish the installation, in this whole installation, process the ink horn makes its structure hold the chip of different models, make under the condition of installing the area battery chip, the electrical interface of chip still can contact with the contact of printer, make the recovery ink horn can normal use.

title_clean: Reflection board
abstract_clean: To provide a reflection board which can reduce a manufacturing cost.SOLUTION: A reflection board 1 that reflects an electromagnetic wave of a specified frequency band to a direction different from a specular direction, includes an uneven structure in which a plurality of unit structures 10 including a thickness distribution where a thickness is increased to a predetermined direction is arranged. The unit structure 10 includes a plurality of cell regions 11a to 11f each having a different thickness, at least includes a first unit structure having two or more cell regions each having a different thickness as a unit structure, and includes a conductive layer 3 on a surface on each uneven structure side. Both of the adjacent cell regions are conducted.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_clean: Amplified spontaneous emission light source
abstract_clean: The embodiment of the utility model discloses an amplified spontaneous emission light source. The amplified spontaneous emission light source comprises a seed source and a power amplifier, wherein the seed source is used for outputting wide-spectrum signal light with the wave band of 900-930 nm, the power amplifier comprises a first neodymium-doped optical fiber, a first pump source and a beam combiner, the first pump source is used for outputting first pump light, the input end of the beam combiner is respectively connected with the output end of the seed source and the output end of the first pump source, the output end of the beam combiner is connected with the input end of the first neodymium-doped optical fiber, and the first pump light is used for pumping neodymium ions in the first neodymium-doped optical fiber so as to enable the neodymium ions to be stimulated to radiate and amplify the seed signal light. The utility model solves the problems that the output power of the existing 900 nm-930 nm wave band broad spectrum spontaneous emission light source is lower, and the application requirements such as high-power nonlinear frequency multiplication and the like are difficult to be completely met, and realizes the stable output of the high-power amplified spontaneous emission light with the center wavelength of 910-930 nm.

title_clean: Film package
abstract_clean: According to an embodiment of the present invention, provided is a film package comprising: a film substrate; a semiconductor chip; a wiring pattern; a protective layer; a thermal conductive resin; and a thermal conductive film. The film substrate includes: a first side and a second side opposite to each other. The semiconductor chip is arranged on the film substrate; and includes: first sides which extend to a first direction to face the first side and the second side, and second sides which extend in a second direction crossing the first direction. The wiring pattern is electrically connected to the semiconductor chip; and includes: an inputting pattern extending in the first side on the film substrate, and an outputting pattern extending in the second side on the film substrate. The protective layer is arranged on the film substrate to cover at least a part of the wiring pattern; and includes: a first opening unit on which the semiconductor chip is arranged, and a second opening unit which is separated from the first opening unit. The thermal conductive resin includes: a first resin which is arranged on the first opening unit; and a second resin which is arranged on the second opening unit to cover the semiconductor chip. The thermal conductive film is arranged on the protective layer; and includes a first penetrating hole for exposing at least a part of the first resin, and a second penetrating hole for exposing at least a part of the second resin. The present invention can improve a heat dissipation feature.

title_clean: Bismuth oxide/manganese oxide composite nanospheres, preparation method thereof and application thereof in psoriasis treatment
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a bismuth oxide/manganese oxide composite nanosphere, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in psoriasis treatment 2 S 3 Hollow nano-microsphere as precursor, and KMnO 4 Obtained by reaction in water. The bismuth oxide/manganese oxide composite nanospheres are synthesized in a mild aqueous solution for the first time, the synthesis method is simple, the reaction conditions are mild, the obtained product is uniform in appearance, the production cost is low, and the method is suitable for industrial large-scale production; the nanospheres obtained by the invention can interrupt the inflammatory loop of psoriasis, effectively prevent inflammatory recurrence and realize accurate, effective and long-term treatment of psoriasis.

title_clean: Phellinus linteus YX2, extract and application thereof
abstract_clean: The application belongs to the technical field of microorganisms, and particularly discloses a Phellinus linteus YX2, an extract and application thereof, wherein Phellinus linteus YX2 has been preserved in China general microbiological culture collection center (CGMCC) for China general microbiological culture Collection center (CGMCC) for 12 months and 1 day in 2020, and the preservation address is: the collection number of the strain is CGMCC No.21078 at the institute of microbiological study of the national academy of sciences of China, north Chen Xiu Lu No. 1, no. 3 of the Chaoyang area of Beijing city; the Phellinus linteus YX2 or the extract thereof can obviously enhance drought stress resistance of plants and promote seed germination and plant growth and development only by using nanogram-level dosage; the Phellinus linteus YX2 and the extract thereof can be compounded with fertilizer for use, and after compounding, the synergistic effect is achieved, the stress resistance of plants is further improved, and the compound fertilizer can be used in crop production to realize industrial production.

title_clean: Method for preparing nicotinamide mononucleotide
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a method for preparing nicotinamide mononucleotide, which takes nicotinamide, pyrophosphoric acid or salt thereof and inosinic acid or salt thereof as raw materials, and takes reaction under the catalytic action of nicotinamide phosphoribosyl transferase, hypoxanthine phosphoribosyl transferase and xanthine oxidase to prepare the nicotinamide mononucleotide.

title_clean: Sugar-modified polyorganosiloxane emulsifier, and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_clean: The invention relates to a preparation method of organosilicon modified glycoside, and a sugar modified polyorganosiloxane emulsifier prepared by using the product and application thereof. The preparation method of the organosilicon modified glycoside comprises the steps of firstly, reacting a ketone compound with a saccharide compound under an acid catalyst to prepare a reaction system containing a saccharide intermediate, then adding a glycidyl ether compound containing a carbon-carbon double bond into the reaction system containing the saccharide intermediate to prepare an alkyl glycoside, and then, reacting the alkyl glycoside with hydrogen-containing siloxane to prepare the organosilicon modified glycoside. The organosilicon modified glycoside is dispersed in cyclomethicone, dimethicone or isododecane to obtain the sugar modified polyorganosiloxane emulsifier. According to the preparation method, hydroxyl on sugar is protected, self-polycondensation of the sugar in the preparation process of alkyl glycoside is reduced, meanwhile, glycidyl ether compound containing epoxy groups and sugar intermediate are adopted to prepare the alkyl glycoside, water generated in the preparation of the alkyl glycoside is consumed, normal operation of reaction is promoted, and the sugar modified polyorganosiloxane emulsifier prepared by the preparation method has good emulsion stability.

title_clean: BHET hydrolase designed based on reverse folding algorithm and preparation method thereof
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a BHET hydrolase designed based on an inverse folding algorithm and a preparation method thereof, which relate to the technical field of biology, wherein an amino acid sequence is shown as SEQ ID NO. 1, the preparation method comprises the steps of selecting a polyester hydrolase PHL7, learning a protein crystal structure by a deep learning algorithm ProteinMPNN, carrying out three-dimensional structure modeling by utilizing Esmfold, carrying out molecular docking on candidate proteins and BHET, carrying out molecular dynamics simulation, screening out proteins with better binding with a substrate, carrying out expression and purification, and applying the BHET hydrolase in hydrolyzing the BHET. The invention can screen the BHET hydrolase from the candidate sequences generated in large quantities simply, rapidly and efficiently through the screening flow, and expands the source of the BHET hydrolase.

title_clean: Phellinus linteus YX2, extract and application thereof
abstract_clean: The application belongs to the technical field of microorganisms, and particularly discloses a Phellinus linteus YX2, an extract and application thereof, wherein Phellinus linteus YX2 has been preserved in China general microbiological culture collection center (CGMCC) for China general microbiological culture Collection center (CGMCC) for 12 months and 1 day in 2020, and the preservation address is: the collection number of the strain is CGMCC No.21078 at the institute of microbiological study of the national academy of sciences of China, north Chen Xiu Lu No. 1, no. 3 of the Chaoyang area of Beijing city; the Phellinus linteus YX2 or the extract thereof can obviously enhance drought stress resistance of plants and promote seed germination and plant growth and development only by using nanogram-level dosage; the Phellinus linteus YX2 and the extract thereof can be compounded with fertilizer for use, and after compounding, the synergistic effect is achieved, the stress resistance of plants is further improved, and the compound fertilizer can be used in crop production to realize industrial production.

title_clean: Method for preparing nicotinamide mononucleotide
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a method for preparing nicotinamide mononucleotide, which takes nicotinamide, pyrophosphoric acid or salt thereof and inosinic acid or salt thereof as raw materials, and takes reaction under the catalytic action of nicotinamide phosphoribosyl transferase, hypoxanthine phosphoribosyl transferase and xanthine oxidase to prepare the nicotinamide mononucleotide.

title_clean: Microbial agent for improving glycogen content of oyster
abstract_clean: The application belongs to the technical field of microbial agents, and particularly relates to a microbial agent for improving the glycogen content of oyster. The microbial agent for improving the glycogen content of the oyster is prepared by the method that the functions of the several microorganisms are complementary, the synthesis of glycogen is increased through the synergy of immunity and metabolism, the consumption of the glycogen is reduced, the glycogen synthesis efficiency in the oyster is enhanced, the glycogen content of the oyster is improved, and an innovative solution is provided for the quality improvement and the synergy of oyster cultivation.

title_clean: Decontamination solution and device and method for decontamination using same
abstract_clean: The present invention provides a decontamination solution capable of preventing charging of a mist for decontamination and preventing excessive wetting and liquid dripping on a wall surface inside a working chamber to be decontaminated when the inside of a working chamber such as an isolator is decontaminated using a mist for decontamination composed of hydrogen peroxide, and a device and a method for decontamination using the same. The decontamination solution is composed of a hydrogen peroxide solution where a substance increasing the electric conductivity of an aqueous solution is dissolved. The substance is preferably an electrolyte and more preferably an inorganic salt or an organic acid. The decontamination solution preferably has an electric conductivity of 14 µS/cm or more. The decontamination solution preferably has a residue on evaporation of 30 ppm or less. The device and the method for decontamination discharge the decontamination solution toward the inside of a room to be decontaminated as a mist for decontamination, thereby decontaminating the inside of the room to be decontaminated.

title_clean: Tobacco discharged high-temperature high-humidity waste gas treatment device and comprehensive treatment method
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a tobacco discharged high-temperature high-humidity waste gas treatment device and a comprehensive treatment method, comprising a water tank, a washing tower, a gas transmission pipe and a tank body, wherein the water tank is arranged at the bottom of the outer wall of the washing tower, the top of the outer wall of the washing tower is provided with a gas pipe in a penetrating mode, the other end of the gas pipe is provided with a box body, and the top of the water tank is provided with a water pump. According to the invention, the water flow in the water tank can be cooled through the arrangement of the refrigerating sheet assembly, the water flow is conveyed into the spray pipe through the water suction pipe and the water delivery pipe through the water pump, and is sprayed out through the atomization spray nozzle, so that the high-temperature and high-humidity waste gas entering the washing tower from the air inlet pipe can be cooled, meanwhile, atomized water drops can remove particles in the waste gas and fall into the sewage pipe at the bottom of the washing tower, and the sprayed water flow can flow into the water tank again through the arrangement of the circulating water inlet pipe and the filter screen, so that the cyclic utilization of the sprayed water flow can be ensured.

title_clean: Method for selection of improved hydrocarbon recovery agents for hydrocarbon revervoirs
abstract_clean: A physical modeling method that includes providing a reservoir core plug, the reservoir core plug having a wellbore interface end, an outlet interface end, and a cylindrical face and saturating the reservoir core plug with hydrocarbon and brine to fonn a saturated core plug. The method also includes positioning the saturated core plug within a flooding apparatus and pumping the fracturing fluid through saturated core plug to displace a portion of the hydrocarbon to fonn a displaced hydrocarbon plug. In addition the method includes positioning the displaced hydrocarbon plug in an imbibition cell and conducting an imbibition test to fonn an imbibed core plug having brine and hydrocarbon. Further the method includes positioning the imbibed core plug in core-flooding apparatus and displacing a portion of the brine and hydrocarbon from the imbibed core plug.

title_clean: Flue gas waste heat utilization device
abstract_clean: A flue gas waste heat utilization device mainly comprises: the flue gas distillation reaction kettle, the salinization kettle, the first pipeline, the second pipeline, the third pipeline, the boiler, the cyclone dust collector, the bag dust collector, the first pipeline fan, the wet desulfurization tower, the SCR denitration device, the flue gas cooler, the flue gas pipeline and the second pipeline fan; the flue gas distillation reaction kettle comprises a flue gas inlet, a first electromagnetic valve, a liquid channel, a discharge hole, an inner container, an outer wall, a thermometer, an air outlet, a feed inlet, a flue gas outlet, a second electromagnetic valve, a sandwich body and a third electromagnetic valve; according to the utility model, the waste heat of the boiler flue gas is recycled, and the acetophenone is distilled and dried by utilizing the waste heat of the high-temperature boiler flue gas, so that the production cost can be effectively reduced, and the green production can be realized.

title_clean: Parameter detection test method, vehicle body structural adhesive selection method and system
abstract_clean: The disclosure relates to a parameter detection test method, a vehicle body structural adhesive selection method and a system. The parameter detection test method is used for detecting physical parameters of the structural adhesive and comprises the following steps: and manufacturing a test sample, and performing a structural adhesive physical parameter detection test by using the test sample to obtain data of the structural adhesive physical parameter corresponding to the characteristic information and the test condition of the test sample. The test sample was prepared by: coating structural adhesive doped with glass beads between a first substrate and a second substrate to bond the first substrate and the second substrate to form an initial sample; fixing the initial sample; baking the initial sample; cooling the initial sample after baking; and cutting the cooled initial sample to obtain the test sample. Thus, the parameters of the structural adhesive can be detected more accurately.

title_clean: Pattern manufacturing apparatus and pattern manufacturing method using the same
abstract_clean: According to one embodiment of the present invention, an apparatus for processing a pattern on a substrate may be provided. The apparatus for processing a pattern includes: a mold fixing part that fixes a mold at a position where the mold is in contact with the substrate to provide a pressing force to the substrate; a substrate transfer module that includes a linear actuator that moves the substrate in a straight line in one direction; and a rotation stage that rotates any one of the mold fixing part and the linear actuator to form the one direction and the mold at a predetermined rotation angle. Therefore, asymmetrically shaped patterns can be easily processed at high speed and low cost.

title_clean: Lens system and projection device
abstract_clean: The application protects a lens system, has an optical axis, includes: the optical lens comprises a modulation device, a first lens group, a second lens group, a diaphragm and a third lens group which are sequentially arranged between an object side and an image side along an optical axis, wherein the focal power of the first lens group is positive and is used for converging light rays, the first lens group at least comprises a first lens, and the effective clear diameter of the first lens is smaller than the size of an image circle; the focal power of the second lens group is positive and is used for further converging the light rays; the number of lens pieces of the third lens group is less than the sum of the lenses of the first lens group and the second lens group, and the third lens group is used for adapting the dilution of the etendue of the illumination light; the modulation device is used for emitting projection light rays, and the projection light rays are projected to a screen to form a projection image after passing through the first lens group, the second lens group and the diaphragm. Due to the arrangement of the third lens group, the optical expansion of the illuminating light can be effectively adapted to be diluted, and the problem of poor efficiency and uniformity caused by asymmetric arrangement is solved.

title_clean: Display device and method of fabricating the same
abstract_clean: A display device includes a substrate including a display area having first color subpixels and a transparent area inside the display area, an array layer in the display area on the substrate, a first electrode in the first color subpixels on the array layer, a first emission assisting layer on the first electrode, an emitting material layer in the first color subpixels on the first emission assisting layer, a second emission assisting layer on the emitting material layer, a deposition preventing layer in the transparent area on the second emission assisting layer, a second electrode on the second emission assisting layer, the second electrode selectively disposed in a region where the deposition preventing layer is not disposed, an encapsulating layer on the deposition preventing layer and the second electrode, a polarizing layer in the display area on the encapsulating layer, an auxiliary equipment in the transparent area under the substrate.

title_clean: Fluorescent probe for detecting ochratoxin A and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_clean: The invention relates to the technical field of harmful substance detection, in particular to a fluorescent probe for detecting ochratoxin A, and a preparation method and application thereof. The fluorescent probe for detecting ochratoxin A is a compound of fluorescent dye DOCE and serum albumin through hydrogen bond, wherein the chemical structural formula of the fluorescent dye DOCE is shown as the specification As shown. The fluorescence probe prepared by the invention is used for rapidly and quantitatively detecting ochratoxin A (OTA), and the detection method has the advantages of ultra-fast response speed (5 seconds), high sensitivity (the detection limit is 0.39 ppb) and high selectivity, and has been successfully applied to on-site rapid detection of real food samples such as flour, white wine, red wine and the like.

title_clean: Aryl-substituted nitrogen-containing heterocyclic compounds
abstract_clean: The invention discloses an aryl substituted nitrogen-containing heterocyclic compound which can be used as a SMARCA2 target inhibitor or a degradation agent. Specifically disclosed is a compound represented by the structure of formula (I) or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt, solvate, hydrate, isotopic substituent or isomer thereof. The structural compound of the formula (I) has an affinity or degradation effect on a SMARCA2 mutant target, particularly has a strong proliferation inhibition effect on SMARCA mutant cancer cells, and can be used for preparing medicaments or molecular probes for preventing or treating diseases (such as cancers, immune diseases and the like) related to SMARCA mutation (particularly SAMRCA4 mutation) signal paths.

title_clean: Pesticidal mixtures containing spiroheterocyclic pyrrolidine diones
abstract_clean: A pesticidal mixture comprising as active ingredient a mixture of component A and component B, wherein component A is a compound of formula (I) Wherein Q is i or ii Wherein X, Y and Z, m and n, A, G and R are as defined in claim 1, and component B is a compound selected from the following insecticides: a) pyrazinone; b) one kind of compound selected from the group consisting of triclopyrPyrethroids of the group consisting of esters, lambda-cyhalothrin, gamma-cyhalothrin; c) a macrolide selected from the group consisting of abamectin, emamectin, and spinetoram; d) a diamide selected from the group consisting of chlorantraniliprole and cyantraniliprole; e) thiamethoxam; f) sulfoxaflor; g) fenpyrad. The invention also relates to a method for controlling plant pests using said mixture.

title_clean: Srebp inhibitor comprising a thiophene central ring
abstract_clean: Provided herein is the compound (3-chloro-4-(4-(2-(2-hydroxypropan-2-yl)pyridin-4-yl)thiophen-2-yl)phenyl)(4-hydroxypiperidin-1-yl)methanone (Compound 1), and pharmaceutically acceptable salts, solvates, tautomers, isotopes, or isomers thereof. Also provided herein are methods of inhibiting a component of the sterol regulatory element binding protein (SREBP) pathway, such as an SREBP or SREBP cleavage activating protein (SCAP), using Compound 1, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt, solvate, tautomer, isotope, or isomer thereof. Further provided are methods of treating a disorder in a subject in need thereof, such as liver disease, non-alcoholic steatohepatitis, insulin resistance, or cancer.

title_clean: Utensil is examined to seat backplate
abstract_clean: This application belongs to the automotive checking fixture field, and especially an utensil is examined to seat protection plate is to current utensil of examining generally fixed installation, can not detect the seat protection plate of different specifications, examines the utensil and does not accomodate the function temporarily, and article pile up the problem in the workstation surface easily in a jumble, now proposes following scheme, and it includes the support body, fixedly connected with receiver between the both sides inner wall of support body, the last fixed surface of support body is connected with the workstation, and the last fixed surface of workstation is connected with drawing board and mounting panel, and a plurality of screw holes have been seted up to the upper surface of mounting panel, the upper surface of mounting panel is equipped with a plurality of locating component that are used for advancing line location to the seat protection plate, in this application, can detect the seat protection plate of different specifications, has improved the application scope of examining the utensil, can accomodate article, avoids the workstation too in a jumble, can also let the pattern of drawing clear and definite, facilitates for detection work.

title_clean: Vertical machining center with stable feeding
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to the technical field of machining centers, in particular to a vertical machining center with stable feeding. The utility model provides a vertical machining center with stable feeding, which comprises: the mobile platform can slide back and forth; the supporting components are arranged on two sides of the top end surface of the moving platform and are suitable for supporting the substrate; a stamping mechanism adapted to stamp the substrate; the shifting rod is hinged to the movable end of the stamping mechanism, and a torsion spring is arranged between the shifting rod and the stamping mechanism; and the supporting component is positioned below the movable end of the shifting rod and is provided with a slope. The utility model provides a vertical machining center with stable feeding, wherein the horizontal displacement of the end of a deflector rod drives a base material to slide when the deflector rod slides along a slope, the blanking of excess materials with different intervals can be adjusted only by adjusting the width of the slope, the structure is simple, the operation is convenient, and the overload of a power source is not needed to be worried about.

title_clean: Discretization parameter drawing method based on four elliptical arc lines of clothes
abstract_clean: The invention relates to the technical field of garment customization, and particularly discloses a discretization parameter drawing method based on four elliptical arc lines of a garment, wherein the discretization parameter drawing method comprises the following steps: acquiring basic parameters of a target four-ellipse arc line; obtaining the radius of a base circle and the quantity of discretized line segments of the elliptic arc line; deformation and displacement processing are carried out on the quarter circular arc determined by the radius of the base circle according to basic parameters of a target quarter elliptical arc line, and a deformed and displaced quarter elliptical arc is obtained; discretizing the four-quarter elliptic arc according to the discretization line segment number of the elliptic arc to obtain a plurality of discretization line segments; drawing according to the multiple discrete line segments to obtain a target four-quadrant elliptical arc line; and outputting the target four-quarter elliptic arc line and the coordinate data corresponding to each discretization line segment to the numerical control cutting equipment. The discretization parameter drawing method based on the four elliptical arc lines of the clothes improves the universality of the drawn clothes plate core diagram.

title_clean: Ultrasonic phased array welding seam detection scanning frame
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses an ultrasonic phased array welding seam detection scanning frame, which comprises a bracket, a scanner is arranged at the upper end of the bracket, a base is fixed on the upper surface of the bracket, grooves are arranged on the left side surface and the right side surface of the base, a driving component is arranged in the base, the driving component comprises a motor, the back side surface of the motor is fixed with the front side surface of the inner wall of the base, a slider moves towards the inside of a shell, a spring is in a compression state at the moment, the slider moves towards the inside of the shell and drives the lower end of a cross rod to move towards the center of the shell, the cross rod rotates through a round rod, so that one end of a top plate moves downwards through the rotation of the cross rod, the cross rod at the other end still supports the top plate, the top plate is in an inclined state, the detected workpiece drops through the trapezoid of the groove, and the detected workpiece drops by itself through the mode, compared with the traditional manual taking mode, the device can drop by itself when in use, more editing is used.

title_clean: Ad hoc synchronization of data from multiple link coordinated sensing systems
abstract_clean: Examples herein may include a computer-implemented method for synchronizing data from multiple link coordinated sensing systems. The method may include receiving a measurement at a first time. The measurement may be associated with a sensing system. The measurement may be associated with a communications interface. The method may include obtaining a latency value. The latency value may be associated with the surgical sensing system. The latency value may be associated with the communications interface. The method may include applying a time code to the received measurement. The time code may be applied based on the first time and the obtained latency value. The method may include ordering an output based on the received measurement and time code.

title_clean: Apparatus and method for communication
abstract_clean: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a solution for communication. In one solution, a terminal device sends first information to a network device, the first information indicating at least one of an antenna switching capability of the terminal device, or a first maximum duration for which the terminal device is capable of maintaining power consistency and phase continuity in a first state of a non-terrestrial network (NTN) device, wherein the first state of the NTN device includes two or more of a first elevation of the NTN device, or a payload type of the NTN device, and determines a TDW for demodulation reference signal (DMRS) bonding based on at least one of the first information, or second information from the network device indicating one or more TDWs.

title_clean: Encoding method, decoding method, and electronic device
abstract_clean: This application relates to an encoding method, a decoding method, and an electronic device. An example method includes: performing inter prediction on a current frame, to obtain prediction information of the current frame; determining residual information of the current frame based on the prediction information of the current frame and an original picture of the current frame; determining first residual hyperprior information of the current frame based on the residual information of the current frame and prior information of the residual information of the current frame; encoding the first residual hyperprior information of the current frame, to obtain a first bitstream; and performing probability estimation based on second residual hyperprior information of the current frame and prior information of the residual information of the current frame, to obtain a residual probability distribution of the current frame.

title_clean: Method and apparatus for utilizing radio access network guidance to select operating parameters
abstract_clean: Aspects of the subject disclosure may include, for example, receiving a first plurality of operating parameters associated with a first plurality of communication devices, obtaining a first prediction of a performance of a first communication device included in the first plurality of communication devices that is based on an application of the first plurality of operating parameters to a model, and responsive to a determination that the first prediction of the performance is inadequate in accordance with a first threshold, transmitting a first command to at least one communication device included in the first plurality of communication devices to modify at least one operating parameter of the at least one communication device. Other embodiments are disclosed.

title_clean: Flow control device formed of thermally adaptive material and a thermoelectric junction
abstract_clean: A flow control device, having: a flow tube extending between upstream and downstream, and a neck region between the first and second ends, wherein the flow tube includes: a wall defining an outer boundary and extending longitudinally from a first end to a second end and transversely from a first side to a second side, wherein: the wall is nonmetal; the wall defines: a first segment extending longitudinally between the first and second ends and transversely from the first side to a segment junction; and a second segment extending longitudinally between the first and second ends and transversely from the second side to the segment junction; and the first segment has a first coefficient of thermal expansion (CTE) and the second segment has a second CTE that differs from the first CTE, to define a transverse CTE gradient.

title_clean: Plasma processing apparatus
abstract_clean: A plasma processing apparatus includes a placing table configured to place a substrate thereon; a chamber accommodating the placing table therein; a gas supply unit configured to supply a processing gas into the chamber; a plasma forming device configured to form plasma within the chamber; a consumption member which is disposed in a space in which the plasma is formed, and which is consumed by the plasma; and a controller. The consumption member includes a base member made of a material including an oxygen element; and a cover member made of a material which does not include the oxygen element. At least a part of a surface of the base member exposed to the space in which the plasma is formed is covered with the cover member.

title_clean: Handgun cartridge with shear groove bullet
abstract_clean: A rimless cartridge comprising a case and a bullet mounted therein. In embodiments, the bullet comprises a jacket having a cylindrical body portion, an ogive portion, and a plurality of longitudinally extending paths of weakness formed in the ogive portion and defining petals there between and extending rearward from the mouth. The bullet includes a malleable core mounted within the jacket. The bullet further comprises a circumferential groove between forward and rearward circumferential indentations imparted in the body portion of the jacket.

title_clean: Nozzle head and apparatus
abstract_clean: A nozzle head and apparatus for subjecting a surface of a substrate to alternate surface reactions of at least two precursors (A, B) includes an output face, at least one gas supply nozzle, and at least one discharge nozzle. The nozzle head includes on the output face in the following order: a first zone end nozzle, a gas supply nozzle and a second zone end nozzle, repeated one or more times. The first zone end nozzle is arranged at a first distance (L Y ) from the gas supply nozzle and the second zone end nozzle is arranged at a second distance (L X ) from the gas supply nozzle. The second distance (L X ) is greater than the first distance (L Y ).

title_clean: Fan check valve structure and exhaust system
