abstract_clean: The utility model relates to a fan check valve structure and an exhaust system, comprising an exhaust mechanism, wherein the exhaust mechanism comprises a first shell and a fan, a first channel is formed in the first shell in a surrounding manner, the fan is arranged in the first channel, the check mechanism comprises a second shell, a rotating shaft and a valve blade, the second shell is connected with the first shell, the second channel is formed in the surrounding manner, an input port of the fan is communicated with the second channel, the rotating shaft is arranged on the second shell, the valve blade is provided with a hinge position, the valve blade is rotatably connected in the second shell through the rotating shaft at the hinge position, and the distance from the hinge position to one end of the valve blade is larger than the distance from the hinge position to the other end of the valve blade. Through the arrangement, the partition sealing is realized through continuous lap joint, so that unnecessary air supply and air leakage are avoided, and the valve blades can deflect along the air flow direction to reduce resistance, thereby ensuring ventilation efficiency.

title_clean: Damping rotating shaft with self-locking function
abstract_clean: The invention relates to the technical field of damping rotating shafts with a self-locking function, and discloses a damping rotating shaft with a self-locking function, which comprises a threaded ring, wherein the inner wall of the threaded ring is in threaded connection with a movable ring, a ring-shaped groove is formed in the movable ring, a slip ring is connected in the ring-shaped groove in a sliding manner, the surface of the threaded ring is fixedly connected with a limiting expansion plate, and the surface of the slip ring is fixedly connected with a driven expansion block. According to the invention, the self-locking mechanism is arranged, so that the friction plate is in contact with the surface of the damping rotating shaft more tightly when the stressed telescopic pipe is contracted, the whole self-locking of the rotating frame is more stable when the rotating frame rotates in place, and the larger the rotating angle of the rotating frame is, the larger the friction force generated by the friction plate and the damping rotating shaft is, so that the whole stability of the rotating frame is improved, the durability of the self-locking function is improved, and the phenomenon that the self-locking function is poor due to the fact that the gasket or the friction plate is used for a long time is solved.

title_clean: Article of footwear with first and second outsole components and method of manufacturing an article of footwear
abstract_clean: A sole structure for an article of footwear comprises a midsole including a polymeric bladder element enclosing a fluid-filled interior cavity, a first outsole component secured to a bottom surface and to a side surface of the polymeric bladder element, and a second outsole component. The first outsole component includes a first base, and a wall integral with the first base. The second outsole component includes a second base secured to the first base, and a wall integral with the second base and secured to the outer surface of the wall of the first outsole component. A method of manufacturing the article of footwear includes thermoforming the bladder element and the first outsole component, and securing the second outsole component to the first outsole component.

title_clean: Rotating shaft mechanism and electronic equipment
abstract_clean: The application provides a rotating shaft mechanism and electronic equipment. The gear comprises a middle beam, a synchronous gear, a first swing arm and a second swing arm, wherein the synchronous gear comprises a first gear and a second gear which are meshed and mounted on the middle beam and are respectively connected with the first swing arm and the second swing arm, the first gear comprises a first tooth, the first tooth comprises a first end and a second end which are oppositely arranged in the tooth width direction of the first tooth, the second gear comprises a second tooth, the second tooth comprises a third end and a fourth end which are oppositely arranged in the tooth width direction of the second tooth, the third end and the first end are positioned on one side of the synchronous gear, the fourth end and the second end are positioned on the other side of the synchronous gear, the tooth top thickness of the first tooth gradually changes from the first end to the second end, the tooth top thickness of the second tooth gradually changes from the third end to the fourth end, and the change trend of the tooth top thickness of the second tooth is opposite to that of the first tooth. The synchronous structure of the technical scheme of the application has good synchronous effect and is easy to realize synchronous rotation of the structures at the two sides of the rotating shaft.

title_clean: Multifunctional auxiliary equipment
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses multifunctional auxiliary equipment, which comprises a power supply module, a charging module, a wireless transmitting module and a charging interface, wherein the power supply module is connected with the charging module; the charging module is respectively connected with the wireless transmitting module and the charging interface; the system also comprises a communication module, a SIM card control module and a control and display module, wherein the communication module is used for wireless communication, is connected with the power supply module and is powered by the power supply module; the SIM control module is connected with the communication module and is used for identifying, converting and transmitting SIM card information and transmitting signals with the communication module; the control and display module is connected with the power supply module and the communication module, is powered by the power supply module, is interconnected with the communication module and is used for displaying and controlling the working state. The utility model integrates the portable power supply function, wireless charging, WIFI network hot spot providing and real-time display control, so that the functions of the equipment are diversified, and the utility model can adapt to more application scenes.

title_clean: Signal output circuit and safety laser radar
abstract_clean: The utility model provides a signal output circuit and a safe laser radar, wherein the signal output circuit comprises a level switching circuit, a first transistor detection circuit, a second transistor detection circuit and a controller, the level switching circuit comprises a first switch circuit and a second switch circuit, when the first switch circuit is conducted, a high-level control signal is output, when the second switch circuit is conducted, a low-level control signal is output, the first transistor detection circuit and the second transistor detection circuit respectively detect output currents when the first switch circuit and the second switch circuit are conducted, when the first level signal is output to the controller, the controller correspondingly switches the switch states of the first switch circuit or the second switch circuit, overcurrent detection and protection are realized, the working state of an external system is changed, meanwhile, the two transistor detection circuits are adopted, the structure is simple, the cost is low, the response time is short, and the overcurrent protection efficiency is improved.

title_clean: Memory system
abstract_clean: A memory system includes a nonvolatile memory and a memory controller. The nonvolatile memory stores a multidimensional error correction code in which each of a plurality of symbol groups is encoded by both a first component code and a second component code. The memory controller reads the error correction code from the nonvolatile memory, executes a first decoding process using the first component code and the second component code, and when the first decoding process fails, executes a second decoding process on an error symbol group. The second decoding process includes a process of selecting the positions of a plurality of symbols whose values included in the error symbol group are to be inverted according to a decision rule. The decision rule includes a rule for cyclically shifting a position selected for the second decoding process at to decide the position for the second decoding process at the next time.

title_clean: Reference signal switching circuit, test circuit and test instrument
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a reference signal switching circuit, a test circuit and a test instrument, wherein the switching circuit comprises an input end, a channel for receiving an input signal, and a control circuit, wherein the input signal comprises an internal reference signal and an external reference signal, and the internal reference signal or the external reference signal is input into the channel in a selective mode each time; the phase-locked loop is arranged at the output port of the channel and comprises a loop filter; the output end outputs an internal reference signal from the output end after the internal reference signal or the external reference signal passes through the phase-locked loop; the output end of the loop filter is provided with a first constant-temperature crystal oscillator; when the channel is input with an internal reference signal or an external reference signal, the first constant temperature crystal oscillator generates an internal reference signal after passing through the loop filter. The invention not only ensures the synchronization problem of using the variable external reference signal, but also solves the problem of phase noise deterioration of using the external reference signal.

title_clean: Ontology-based knowledge provision system and method
abstract_clean: The present invention relates to an ontology-based knowledge provision system and a method thereof. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the system comprises: an ontology knowledge model including knowledge information on a social and environmental context of context; a storage unit storing personal characteristic information and general knowledge information of a patient to be cared for; a reasoning machine configured to infer a response to a query input from a user on the basis of the ontology knowledge model and the information stored in the storage unit; and a user interface configured to receive the query from the user or output the response inferred by the reasoning machine. Accordingly, a reasoning machine and knowledge model in a unified form are provided to simultaneously infer a response related to a patient to be cared for on the basis of the personal characteristic information of the patient to be cared for and a general task response on the basis of the general knowledge information and the ontology knowledge model is structured to express knowledge information required for a caregiver who cares for to the patient to be cared for, thereby enabling anyone to take care of the patient to be cared for.

title_clean: Network service access control method and system
abstract_clean: The present application discloses a network service access control method and system. The method is applied to a network service provider; a secondary server, a target server, and a firewall are deployed on the network service provider; and a target service runs on the target server. The method comprises: the secondary server receives a request of a user, wherein the request is adapted to a predetermined packet format of the secondary server, the content comprises combined information and a check code, and the combined information comprises an access identifier and a firewall setting command; the secondary server searches for an associated target server on the basis of the access identifier, and forwards the combined information and the check code to the target server; the target server verifies the combined information and the check code; and if the verification is successful, on the basis of the setting command, the target server notifies the firewall to adjust firewall settings regarding access of the user to the target service.

title_clean: Efficient sub-picture extraction
abstract_clean: Sub-picture extraction is rendered less complex by providing each slice with start position information which indicates a starting position from which onwards the picture is, along a coding path, encoded into the respective slice, relative to an onset position at which the coding path starts traversing a segment the starting position is located in. Alternatively or additionally, sub-picture extraction processes are treated like choosing one layer out of a multi-layer datastream.

title_clean: Intelligent decision support system for bidding complete process
abstract_clean: The invention relates to the technical field of bidding decision making, and discloses an intelligent decision support system for bidding complete flows, wherein a model construction module analyzes the bidding complete flows to obtain bidding complete flow nodes, constructs a bidding complete flow node model and outputs corresponding node evaluation values; the method comprises the steps of determining a node evaluation value set according to all node evaluation values by a first calculation module, calculating corresponding node evaluation fluctuation metric values, analyzing all node evaluation fluctuation metric values by a second calculation module, calculating bidding difference coefficients, intelligently deciding the whole bidding process by a process decision-making module according to the bidding difference coefficients and preset bidding difference coefficients, calculating quantization indexes capable of representing the whole health of the whole process by deep mining and analysis of all node evaluation values, providing clear and reliable decision support for management staff, realizing the intellectualization and the precision of bidding management, and effectively improving the project success rate and the resource utilization efficiency.

title_clean: Antibacterial peptide and application thereof as medicine and feed additive
abstract_clean: The invention discloses an antibacterial peptide and application thereof as a medicine and a feed additive. The antibacterial peptide is obtained by modifying an amino acid sequence shown as SEQ ID No. 1. The invention excavates potential antibacterial peptide sequences from channel catfish proteome, and obtains a novel antibacterial peptide with broad-spectrum antibacterial activity, especially with obvious inhibition effect on APEC through structural transformation and optimization. The antibacterial peptide can effectively inhibit the growth of various drug-resistant APEC strains in vitro, has good safety in cytotoxicity and erythrocyte hemolysis experiments, and can be used as a powerful supplement for the prevention and control of traditional antibiotics and vaccines.

title_clean: Compositions and methods for capture of cellular targets of bioactive agents
abstract_clean: The present invention provides compositions and methods for capture and identification of the cellular targets of a bioactive agent. In particular, provided herein are bioactive agents tethered to capture ligand, cellular targets (optionally tagged with a reporter), capture proteins (optionally present as capture fusions), surfaces (e.g., displaying, capture ligands, capture proteins, or capture fusions), and methods of capturing and identifying the cellular targets of a bioactive agent therewith.

title_clean: Mycoplasma pneumoniae immunoassay method and immunoassay instrument
abstract_clean: An immunoassay utilizing a monoclonal antibody which specifically reacts with both of P1 protein and P30 protein of Mycoplasma pneumoniae, which monoclonal antibody has a higher affinity with P1 protein and P30 protein of Mycoplasma pneumoniae than the known monoclonal antibodies, is disclosed. The immunoassay utilizes an antigen-antibody reaction between a monoclonal antibody which specifically reacts with P1 protein and P30 protein of Mycoplasma pneumoniae and which specifically reacts with a peptide containing an amino acid sequence composed of PPQPG or antigen-binding fragment thereof, and P1 protein and P30 protein derived from Mycoplasma pneumoniae.

title_clean: anti-EGFRv III safe chimeric antigen receptor, preparation method thereof, NK cell modified by same and application
abstract_clean: The invention belongs to an anti-EGFRvIII safe chimeric antigen receptor, a preparation method thereof, an NK cell modified by the anti-EGFRvIII safe chimeric antigen receptor and an application, wherein the anti-EGFRvIII safe chimeric antigen receptor comprises a CD8leader nucleic acid sequence, an EGFRvIII scFv nucleic acid sequence, a CD8 alpha nucleic acid sequence, an NKG2D nucleic acid sequence, a 2B4 nucleic acid sequence, a CD3 zeta nucleic acid sequence, a self-cleavage polypeptide T2A nucleic acid sequence and an RQR8 nucleic acid sequence. The anti-EGFRv III safe chimeric antigen receptor provided by the invention can reduce serious toxic and side effects caused by excessive activity or uncontrolled activity after the chimeric antigen receptor is infused into a body.

title_clean: Arrival reminding method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_clean: The embodiment of the application discloses a method and a device for reminding of arriving at a station, a storage medium and electronic equipment, wherein a processor is used for receiving a request for reminding of arriving at the station, determining a target public transport station needing to be reminded of arriving at the station according to the request for reminding of arriving at the station, then sleeping the processor, obtaining the number of the target stations of the public transport stations which the electronic equipment needs to pass through when the electronic equipment arrives at the target public transport station through a low-power chip, then controlling a microphone through the low-power chip to collect external audio signals, identifying the collected audio signals through the low-power chip to obtain the number of the stations of the electronic equipment which have passed through the public transport station, and finally awakening the processor through the low-power chip when the number of the passed stations is consistent with the number of the target stations, and executing preset operation for reminding of arriving at the station through the. Compared with the related technology, the method does not need continuous operation of a processor, and even does not need satellite positioning, so that the power consumption of the electronic equipment for realizing arrival reminding can be effectively reduced.

title_clean: Intelligent maintenance prediction and health management system for high-altitude equipment
abstract_clean: The invention discloses an intelligent maintenance prediction and health management system for high-altitude equipment, which relates to the technical field of high-altitude equipment management and has the technical scheme that the intelligent maintenance prediction and health management system comprises the following main points of collecting operation parameter values of the high-altitude equipment and dividing the condition area of the high-altitude equipment into area division groups according to the operation parameter values of the high-altitude equipment; the regional division set comprises a target fault region, a first region to be divided and a second region to be divided, an initial steering state of the detection device is set according to the position relation of the regional division set, the initial steering state of the detection device and condition data in the target fault region are processed, analyzed and set to be the initial working state of the detection device, the regional coverage range of the target fault region towards the direction of the detection device is collected, and the parameter fluctuation trend of high-altitude equipment is obtained in real time.

title_clean: Video encoding method and video decoding method
abstract_clean: Provided is a video encoding/decoding technique for improving the compression efficiency by reducing the motion vector code amount. In a video decoding process, the prediction vector calculation method is switched from one to another in accordance with a difference between predetermined motion vectors among a plurality of motion vectors of a peripheral block of a block to be decoded and already decoded. The calculated prediction vector is added to a difference vector decoded from an encoded stream so as to calculate a motion vector. By using the calculated motion vector, the inter-image prediction process is executed.

title_clean: Machine vision-based damage detection method for lining plate of vertical lifting skip
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a machine vision-based vertical lifting skip lining plate damage detection method, which relates to the technical field of machine vision and comprises the steps of collecting multi-mode data streams, preprocessing, carrying out space-time alignment on the multi-mode data streams by utilizing time stamps synchronously, outputting a multi-mode data set, constructing a multi-scale feature pyramid, extracting local detail features and capturing global deformation features, dynamically distributing weights of different scale features by utilizing reinforcement learning, generating a dynamic multi-scale damage detection model through pre-training, transmitting an abnormal sample to a cloud when unrecorded damage types are detected according to a three-dimensional deformation report, and updating the dynamic multi-scale damage detection model through a federal learning frame. According to the invention, through a multi-mode space-time alignment and cross-mode attention fusion mechanism, the robustness and accuracy of damage detection in a complex mine environment are improved.

title_clean: Element analyzer convenient to it is clean

title_clean: Excrement collector suitable for being installed under a wheelchair and a hospital bed, and easy to operate

title_clean: Preparation method and application of Pd-Cu alloy nano sea urchin
abstract_clean: The invention relates to a preparation method and application of Pd-Cu alloy nanometer sea urchin, which comprises the steps of weighing a certain mass of ionic liquid, adding the ionic liquid into water to prepare an ionic liquid aqueous solution, taking a certain volume from the ionic liquid aqueous solution, adding a metal Pd precursor into a round-bottom flask, adding a metal Cu precursor, and fully and uniformly mixing to obtain a homogeneous reaction solution; adding the prepared reducing agent into the homogeneous reaction solution, slightly shaking the round-bottom flask to uniformly mix reactants, and standing at room temperature for reacting for a certain time to prepare a reaction mixture; and centrifugally separating the reaction mixture, discarding supernatant to obtain a lower-layer precipitate, centrifugally washing the precipitate with water, and finally, carrying out heat preservation and drying on the precipitate to obtain a black solid product, namely the Pd-Cu alloy nano sea urchin. The green aqueous phase method is simple and low in energy consumption, and the prepared Pd-Cu alloy nano sea urchin has a hierarchical structure and has excellent catalytic activity and selectivity in p-nitrobenzaldehyde hydrogenation reaction.

title_clean: Aei-type zeolitic material obtained from high temperature calcination and use as a catalyst

title_clean: Inorganic hollow nanocoils and method of manufacturing the same
abstract_clean: The present invention relates to hollow nanocoils having a three-dimensional helical structure in the form of a hollow tube and a method of manufacturing the same. title_clean: Production process of silver mirror
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a production process of a silver mirror, relates to the field of production and manufacturing of mirrors, and aims to solve the problems of short service life and low reflectivity of the silver mirror, and the key points of the technical scheme are as follows: a production process of a silver mirror comprises the following steps: cleaning and polishing glass; sensitizing; performing hypersensitization; silver plating; passivating; preheating; spraying a primer; baking the primer; spraying epoxy resin masking liquid; spraying finish paint; air cooling; pickling the surface; cleaning the surface; and (5) drying. The production process of the silver mirror can ensure the effects of long durability, high reflectivity and long service life of the silver layer.

title_clean: Anti-hygroscopic environment-friendly precoated sand and preparation method thereof
abstract_clean: The invention discloses an environment-friendly precoated sand with moisture absorption resistance and a preparation method thereof. The invention prepares an organosilicon hydrophobing agent with epoxy reaction activity by carrying out cohydrolytic polycondensation on long-chain alkyl trialkoxysilane and an epoxy silane coupling agent under an acidic condition, then in a film coating process, firstly coats the hydrophobing agent on the surface of hot sand, then sequentially adds thermosetting phenolic resin and a curing agent, and finally obtains a final product after mixing grinding, cooling and crushing. According to the method, a hydrophobic interface layer anchored by chemical bonds is constructed between sand grains and resin, a stable physical water-blocking barrier is formed by long-chain alkyl, and firm combination of the interface is realized by reactive group reaction, so that the moisture absorption resistance of precoated sand is fundamentally improved. Meanwhile, the environment-friendly resin with low free formaldehyde and low free phenol is combined, so that the gas generation amount of the product is obviously reduced.

title_clean: Floor Mat with Hidden Base Component
abstract_clean: This invention relates to a washable multi-component magnetic floor mat with a hidden base component. The floor mat contains a textile component and a base component. The textile component and the base component are attached to one another by magnetic attraction. The magnetic attraction is provided by incorporation of magnetic particles in both the textile and base components. The textile component is designed to be soiled, washed, and re-used, thereby providing ideal end-use applications in areas such as building entryways. The present invention eliminates the need to wash the base component of the floor mat which results in environmental, cost and labor conservation. Alignment and deployment of the textile component with the base component in an efficient manner is also described herein.

title_clean: High-permeability double-component primer and preparation method thereof

The high-permeability double-component primer paint prepared by the invention solves the problems of poor wetting, round eyes, no third dimension and the like of a base material with smaller surface tension, meets the requirements of environmental protection standards, and can permeate open pores on various different base materials to reflect the third dimension.

title_clean: Selecting antenna patterns on unmanned aerial vehicles
abstract_clean: Described herein are unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and systems and methods for dynamically selecting directional antennas onboard the UAV for wireless transmissions. For example, an embodiment pertains to a UAV that comprises a flight control system in remote communication with a remote receiver via directional antennas onboard the UAV. The flight control system is operatively coupled with a propulsion system to control the flight of the UAV. While in-flight, the flight control system is configured to determine an orientation and position of the UAV. It is further configured to select a subset of directional antennas to transmit from based on the determined orientation and position, among other factors. The flight control system then directs a transmitter to send wireless communications using the selected directional antennas.

title_clean: Preparation method of columnar electrode structure of perovskite solar cell
abstract_clean: The invention provides a preparation method of a columnar electrode structure of a perovskite solar cell, which comprises the following steps: firstly, etching off a metal material outside a reserved position on the surface of a plane metal to obtain an initial columnar electrode structure; depositing a first carrier transmission layer on the surface of the initial columnar electrode structure to obtain a columnar electrode structure; the method comprises the steps of preparing an initial columnar electrode structure by using a laser etching method, and depositing a first carrier transmission layer by using a surface deposition method to obtain a columnar electrode structure; the method can process the position beneficial to depositing the carrier transmission layer on the surface of the fine electrode core layer, and finally prepare the columnar electrode structure, so that the prepared perovskite battery has higher photoelectric conversion efficiency.

title_clean: Preparation method and application of core-shell Ni-HITP@PDA film based on three-dimensional conductive network
abstract_clean: A preparation method and application of a core-shell Ni-HITP@PDA film based on a three-dimensional conductive network belong to the technical field of conductive MOF composite film preparation. The invention aims to solve the problems of poor water phase stability and easy blockage of pore channels of the traditional Ni-HITP material. The method comprises the steps of firstly preparing an SP-PDA@PVDF activated film, secondly preparing a PANI@PVDF conductive substrate, thirdly preparing a PPy/PANI@PVDF conductive film, fourthly preparing Ni-HITP@PDA core-shell particles, and fifthly assembling the Ni-HITP@PDA film. The core-shell Ni-HITP@PDA membrane based on the three-dimensional conductive network is used for selectively extracting lithium in salt lake brine with high magnesium-lithium ratio. The stable core-shell structure of the invention ensures the structural integrity of crystals and pore channels in the cyclic process, maintains the exposure of high-selectivity recognition sites, and realizes high adsorption capacity and cyclic stability under high magnesium-lithium ratio.

title_clean: Crucible cover for physical vapor transport method and preparation method thereof

title_clean: Method for deconvolving image data

title_clean: Vitamin K3Chrome tanning liquid using waste liquid as raw material and preparation method thereof
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a vitamin K 3 Chrome tanning liquid with waste liquid as raw material, the raw material includes vitamin K 3 Waste liquid, chromate, and reducing agent. Comprises the following steps: dissolving at normal temperature: firstly, vitamin K is added 3 Adding the waste liquid into a normal-temperature dissolver, then sequentially adding chromate and a reducing agent into the normal-temperature dissolver, stirring to completely dissolve the chromate and the reducing agent to obtain a mixed solution, wherein the addition amount of the chromate is vitamin K 3 2-10% of the mass of the waste liquid, wherein the addition amount of the reducing agent is vitamin K 3 1-3% of the mass of the waste liquid; high-pressure reaction: and (3) placing the mixed solution prepared in the step one in a high-pressure reaction kettle, and reacting for 4-10 hours at the temperature of 140-180 ℃ and under the pressure of 1.4-2.0 MPa to prepare the chrome tanning liquid. The invention effectively treats vitamin K 3 The waste liquid in the production process can not cause waste and secondary pollution, the preparation process is simple, the cost is lower, the organic content of the prepared chrome tanning liquid is less, the performance of the product is stable, and the large-scale popularization is easy.

title_clean: Resin composition, sheet-like laminate material, printed wiring board, and semiconductor device
abstract_clean: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a resin composition providing a cured article having low dielectric loss tangent, high mechanical strength, and high adhesiveness. SOLUTION: There is provided a resin composition containing (A) a resin having a thermosetting functional group FA, (B) a resin having a radical polymerizable functional group FB, and (C) a resin having a functional group FA' reactive with the thermosetting functional group FA and a functional group FB' reactive with the radical polymerizable functional group FB, and the number n a of the functional group FA' of the (C) component when the number of the thermosetting functional group FA of the (A) component is 1, and the number n b of the functional group FB' of the (C) component when the number of the radical polymerizable functional group FB of the (B) component is 1, satisfy 0.01≤n a ≤200 and 0.01≤n b ≤400. title_clean: Retortable gluten-free pasta
abstract_clean: A gluten-free pasta product that survives retort may be formed by preparing a dough mixture with gluten-free flour and water. The dough can be extruded at a temperature and with an amount of mechanical energy effective to form an extruded pasta product having a bi-continuous matrix of protein and starch. The extruded pasta product can be incorporated into a closed retort container and subsequently retorted. The resulting retorted food product may contain gluten-free pasta that has the structural integrity and textual firmness consistent with that exhibited by traditional wheat pasta after having undergone retort despite the absence of binding gluten molecules.

title_clean: Preparation process of graphene modified polyester resin for track anticorrosive paint
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a preparation process of graphene modified polyester resin for track anticorrosive paint, which comprises the following steps: s1, mixing the graphene and the polyester resin, and then putting the mixture into a crushing device for crushing; and S2, putting the crushed graphene and polyester resin into a stirring device, and mixing and stirring to obtain a blend. According to the invention, the driving cylindrical gear is driven to rotate forwards or backwards through the first driving motor, the driven cylindrical gear is driven to drive the transmission screw to rotate, the sliding blocks at two ends are driven to move away from or close to each other in the horizontal direction, the connecting plate is driven to reciprocate in the vertical direction under the action of the connecting rod, and then the rack is driven to move in the vertical direction through the sliding rod to drive the crushing roller to rotate, so that a graphene and polyester resin mixture at the meshing position of the crushing roller and the rack is crushed, the condition that materials fly out is improved, and the crushing quality is improved.

title_clean: Overturning adsorption mechanism
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a upset adsorption apparatus constructs, including support body and returning face plate, rotatable being connected with the pivot on the support body, the one end and the pivot of returning face plate are connected, be fixed with in the pivot from the driving wheel, still be connected with the motor on the support body, the output shaft of motor is connected with the pivot through taking drive mechanism, take drive mechanism to include the action wheel and follow the driving wheel, the action wheel with from being connected with the belt between the driving wheel, be connected with the pivot from the driving wheel, the output shaft of action wheel and motor is connected, be connected with vacuum suction nozzle on the returning face plate, be provided with the vacuum hole. The utility model is simple in operation convenient, and can effectively prevent the panel damage, the control of being convenient for has improved machining efficiency greatly.

title_clean: Reduced iron shaft furnace cooling circulating water treatment device
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a reduced iron shaft furnace refrigeration cycle water treatment facilities, which comprises a tank body, the upper end fixed mounting of the jar body has the go-between, the upper end fixed mounting of go-between has the top cap, the upper end fixed mounting of top cap has the input mouth, the lower extreme fixed mounting of the jar body has the support column, the lower extreme swing joint of support column has the bottom plate, one side fixed mounting of the jar body has the oral siphon, the one end fixed mounting of oral siphon has the connector, the vent has been seted up to the opposite side of the jar body, the inside fixed mounting of the jar body has the filter layer, the inside below fixed mounting of the jar body has the immersible pump, one side fixedly connected with water pipe of immersible pump, the opposite side below fixed mounting of the jar body has the outlet pipe. The utility model provides a water treatment device with a filtering effect, avoids influencing the service life because of too much rust, and provides a radiating function, thereby having practicability.

title_clean: Method for calculating flow coefficient of regulating valve of refrigeration compressor performance testing device
abstract_clean: A method for calculating flow coefficient of regulating valve of a refrigeration compressor performance test device comprises the following steps: aiming at performance design parameters of the refrigeration compressor, a working condition operation diagram of the compressor is built in a two-dimensional coordinate system taking evaporation pressure as an abscissa and condensing pressure as an ordinate, and working condition inflection points on the working condition operation diagram are obtained; variable parameters and fixed parameters corresponding to the inflection points of all working conditions are obtained; and obtaining the maximum value of the flow coefficient primary upper limit values of the regulating valve to be calculated under different working condition inflection points as the flow coefficient upper limit value of the regulating valve to be calculated, and obtaining the minimum value of the flow coefficient primary lower limit values of the regulating valve to be calculated under different working condition inflection points as the flow coefficient lower limit value of the regulating valve to be calculated. According to the invention, the finally obtained flow coefficient adjusting range of the adjusting valve to be calculated can meet the requirement of any working condition inflection point, and support is provided for parameter selection of the adjusting valve of the refrigerating compressor performance testing device.

title_clean: Copper strip annealing equipment and process thereof
abstract_clean: The invention discloses copper strip annealing equipment, which comprises an equipment main body, a copper strip feeding device, a heating device, an air extracting device and a cooling device, the upper end of the equipment main body is provided with a heating device, two sides of the heating device are provided with copper strip feeding devices, the invention is provided with a vacuum tank, an air pump and an air exhaust pipe, after annealing is finished, air in the vacuum tank can be pumped out through the air pump, the annealed copper strip is sent into the fixed sleeve in the vacuum tank for cooling, the annealed copper strip is prevented from generating oxidation reaction with the air under a high temperature state, so that the quality of the surface of the copper strip is prevented from being deteriorated, the production quality of the product is greatly improved, and meanwhile, the production efficiency of the copper strip is improved due to the fact that the copper strip is cooled.

title_clean: CDKL 3-targeted small molecule inhibitor HZ1 and derivative HZ1-X thereof
abstract_clean: A small molecule inhibitor HZ1 of a targeted CDKL3 and a derivative HZ1-X thereof, belonging to the field of biomedicine. The invention provides a specific small molecule inhibitor capable of effectively inhibiting the activity of CDKL3 kinase, and comprehensively characterizes a key cell signal path and tumor growth which are mediated by HZ1 and a derivative HZ1-X thereof and inhibit protein kinase CDKL3 and promote the occurrence and development of various tumors at a cellular level. The invention provides a new method for the targeted treatment of tumors and a new way for the clinical treatment of malignant tumors.

title_clean: Chimeric antigen receptor cells for treating solid tumor
abstract_clean: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide antibodies that bind UPK2 or antigen-binding fragments thereof. SOLUTION: Provided is an antibody that binds UPK2, or an antigen-binding fragment thereof, comprising a heavy chain variable region (HVR) and a light chain variable region (LVR), the heavy chain variable region comprising any of 7 amino acid sequences, each of which is different from each other, the light chain variable region comprising any of 8 amino acid sequences, each of which is different from each other and different from any of the 7 amino acid sequences. The HVR may be linked to a human IgG chain constant region. An antigen-binding domain comprising the antibody or antigen-binding fragment thereof may be comprised in a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR). SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1 COPYRIGHT: (C)2023,JPO&INPIT

title_clean: Methods and compositions for noninvasive prenatal diagnosis through targeted covalent labeling of genomic sites
abstract_clean: This invention relates to a method that covalently modifies unmodified and hydroxymethylated genomic sites in fetal specific genetic material present in maternal blood DNA samples and produce the adjacent genomic regions for detecting fetal aneuploidies and fetal gender using quantitative real time PCR or sequencing. A large panel of differently labeled sites and regions between maternal and fetal genetic material has been identified and they validity for diagnostic purposes of fetal trisomy of chromosome 21 has been demonstrated.

title_clean: Methods for treating muscular dystrophy using inhibitory oligonucleotides to cd49d
abstract_clean: A method of modifying muscle or limb performance in a subject with or at risk of a condition associated with muscle atrophy, muscle fatty tissue, or pseudohypertrophy or a muscular dystrophy, by administering a pharmaceutical composition an inhibitory oligonucleotide to CD49d sufficient to modify one or more markers, signs or parameters of muscle fat, muscle performance or function, or limb performance or function. A method comprising the following steps: (i) determining the level of CD4+CD49d+ T cells in a blood sample from the subject; (ii) administering a course of antisense oligonucleotide and repeating step (i) at least once towards the end of the dosing period; (iii) within one week of dose completion repeat step (i); (iv) processing the results to determine whether the subject has or has not displayed a post-dose completion rebound, stability or loss in the level of CD4+CD49d+ T cells.

title_clean: Longan ultrasonic disinfection equipment
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses longan ultrasonic disinfection equipment, belonging to the field of longan disinfection; an ultrasonic longan disinfection device comprises a bottom plate, a water tank, a mounting rack, a storage box and universal wheels; the water tank is arranged at the upper end of the bottom plate, the energy converter is arranged on the water tank, the sound energy of the power ultrasonic frequency source can be converted into mechanical vibration, ultrasonic waves are radiated into water through the wall of the water tank, the liftable storage box is arranged on the mounting frame, and the storage box can be overturned, so that the positions of the longan can be conveniently adjusted by driving the longan to be more fully disinfected and cleaned; the mounting frame is connected with the bottom plate in a sliding mode, and the longan storage box is turned over, so that taking and unloading of longan in the storage box are facilitated; four universal wheels are arranged at the lower end of the bottom plate, so that the transplanting and the transportation of the disinfection equipment are facilitated.

title_clean: Iron handicraft processing spraying equipment
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to the technical field of iron artware processing and discloses iron artware processing spraying equipment which comprises a base, wherein side plates are fixedly assembled at the tops of the two sides of the base, a circular plate is rotatably connected to the inner wall of the side plate, an adjusting wheel is rotatably connected to the inner wall of the circular plate, and a clamping threaded rod is fixedly assembled on the side face of the adjusting wheel. Through the cooperation use of regulating wheel and centre gripping threaded rod, rotate the regulating wheel to utilize the regulating wheel to drive the centre gripping threaded rod and rotate, and then utilize the centre gripping threaded rod to drive urceolus and grip block removal, and then utilize the side of grip block to carry out the centre gripping to the side of iron article handicraft body, afterwards utilize driving motor to drive the plectane and rotate, thereby utilize the plectane to drive iron article handicraft body and rotate, rotate after the required spraying angle, close driving motor, and utilize the air pump to promote the round bar in the inner wall of fixed frame, thereby utilize the side of round bar and the inner wall of round groove group to dock spacing.

title_clean: Pouch-type liquid color makeup container
abstract_clean: A cosmetic container is manufactured as a pouch type to accommodate a small amount of liquid cosmetics. The pouch-type liquid color makeup container facilitates confirmation of whether the container is initially opened and exhibition and selling of the container in a vending machine and the like while enabling cosmetic materials to be conveniently carried and used indoors/outdoors through the attachment/detachment of a cap and the entrance/exit of cosmetic tools. A cap attachment/detachment and cosmetic tool entrance/exit and rail movement guide are provided in a discharge member of a pouch manufactured so as to receive and portably carry a small amount of liquid cosmetics, such as lip gloss, mascara, and eyeliner; enabling detailed application by being stably held, thereby enabling various demands of young people sensitive to color to be satisfied.

title_clean: Integrated pet food particle processing, screening and drying equipment
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to the technical field of pet food screening processing equipment, and discloses integrated pet food particle processing, screening and drying equipment, which comprises a drying and sieving box, wherein a vibrating screen is arranged on the right side of the drying and sieving box, an air heater is arranged on the right side of the drying and sieving box, a supporting leg is fixedly connected to the bottom of the drying and sieving box, a feeding box is fixedly connected to the top of the drying and sieving box, a discharging frame is fixedly connected to the left side of the drying and sieving box, a movable feeding and discharging mechanism is arranged outside the discharging frame, an auxiliary dust removing mechanism is arranged at the top of the drying and sieving box, and in the use process, the position of a feeding hopper is conveniently adjusted through a hydraulic rod, so that dust scattering in the subsequent drying process is avoided when feeding pet food particles in the feeding hopper is met, the baffle angle is conveniently adjusted through motor operation, the discharging angle of the discharging frame is adjusted, and the front and back reciprocating movement of a guide plate is conveniently realized through electric telescopic rod operation.

title_clean: Intelligent decision support system for bidding complete process
abstract_clean: The invention relates to the technical field of bidding decision making, and discloses an intelligent decision support system for bidding complete flows, wherein a model construction module analyzes the bidding complete flows to obtain bidding complete flow nodes, constructs a bidding complete flow node model and outputs corresponding node evaluation values; the method comprises the steps of determining a node evaluation value set according to all node evaluation values by a first calculation module, calculating corresponding node evaluation fluctuation metric values, analyzing all node evaluation fluctuation metric values by a second calculation module, calculating bidding difference coefficients, intelligently deciding the whole bidding process by a process decision-making module according to the bidding difference coefficients and preset bidding difference coefficients, calculating quantization indexes capable of representing the whole health of the whole process by deep mining and analysis of all node evaluation values, providing clear and reliable decision support for management staff, realizing the intellectualization and the precision of bidding management, and effectively improving the project success rate and the resource utilization efficiency.

title_clean: Communication method and apparatus
abstract_clean: Provided in the present application are a communication method and apparatus. The communication method comprises: acquiring first information, wherein the first information may be used for indicating an association relationship between a data identifier and a data processing mode, the data processing mode may comprise executing one or more first functions for data processing, and/or skipping one or more second functions for data processing, and the data identifier may comprise a first data identifier; and receiving first data carrying the first data identifier, and processing the first data on the basis of the first data identifier and the association relationship; or, sending the first data carrying the first data identifier. In the present application, different first data identifiers may have association relationships with different data processing modes. Thus, a corresponding functional entity processes first data on the basis of the data processing modes corresponding to the first data identifiers. In this way, appropriate functions are selected in a targeted manner for processing different data, thereby improving the service processing efficiency and the system performance.

title_clean: System, method, and apparatus for selective participant interaction in an online multi-participant gathering space
abstract_clean: A video communication system that allows users to focus on one another to create focused groups. The effect of these focused groups is the virtual equivalent of being in the same physical room as all users while having separate conversations in different areas of the room. Users are able to adjust the volume of other users independently and thus create this effect of being in different areas of the room, while still being in the same room.

title_clean: Intelligent tourism comprehensive service system and method
abstract_clean: The invention provides an intelligent tourism comprehensive service system and a method thereof. The client sends data to the server and transmits real-time positioning information of the client; the server analyzes and processes the received data and transmits the analyzed and processed data to the platform service center and the client; the platform service center displays the data and position information of the tourists and other information of the scenic spot on a monitoring screen, and matches or pushes the requirements of the tourists to corresponding server customer service personnel according to the text data, the voice data and the real-time facial image data of the tourists; and the platform service center pushes the information to the client. The invention can improve the comprehensive service efficiency and quality of the intelligent tourist attraction.

title_clean: Pipeline irrigation pipe diameter optimization method based on small-sized electromechanical canal irrigation area system layout
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a pipe diameter optimization method for pipe irrigation based on a small-sized electromechanical canal irrigation area system layout, which takes total head of open canal irrigation as a reference, determines total pipe network pressure according to the requirement that the total head of the pipe irrigation system is not more than a certain multiple of the total head of the open canal irrigation system, distributes the total pipe network pressure in each level of pipe network by adopting an orthogonal design method, and deduces pipe network diameter and pipe network engineering investment in each row of an orthogonal table according to the pressure distributed by each level of pipe network, and determines the minimum pipe network investment and corresponding pipe diameter of each level of pipe through orthogonal analysis. The invention improves the rationality and practicability of the design of the pipeline irrigation system.

title_clean: Flue gas pretreatment denitrification facility
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a flue gas pretreatment denitration device, which comprises a tripod, wherein a cooling mechanism is arranged on the upper side of the tripod, a fixing mechanism is arranged on the front side of the cooling mechanism, the cooling mechanism comprises a water collecting tank fixedly arranged at the upper side of the tripod, a cooling cylinder is fixedly connected to the upper side of the water collecting tank, a flue inlet is fixedly arranged on the rear side of the cooling cylinder, a flue outlet is fixedly connected to the front side of the cooling cylinder, an air inlet is fixedly arranged on one side of the cooling cylinder, and an air outlet is fixedly connected to the other side of the cooling cylinder. According to the flue gas pretreatment denitration device, heat exchange is carried out between high-temperature flue gas and low-temperature air entering the inner side of the cooling cylinder, meanwhile, water flows are sprayed out through the spray head to cool the circular pipe in a double-layer mode, the flue gas temperature is stably controlled within a proper range, sintering caused by flue gas catalyst particles is avoided, and therefore the service life and activity of a flue gas catalyst are prolonged.

title_clean: Device and method for injecting a hydrogen-air mixture for a turbine engine burner
abstract_clean: The invention relates to a device for injecting a combustible mixture, for a combustion chamber (100) of an aircraft turbine engine turbine, which comprises, about a longitudinal axis (X), a tubular central channel (1), a first annular channel (2) about the central channel and a second annular channel (3) about the first annular channel (2), the channels (1, 2, 3) opening into the combustion chamber at a first lip (9) of the central channel (10), of a second lip (10) of the first annular channel and of an end (11) of the second annular channel, the first annular channel comprising, upstream of the second lip (10), a device (5, 6, 7) for injecting dihydrogen into the first annular channel (2) in an air flow (8) passing along the longitudinal axis of the first annular channel so as to create a dihydrogen-air mixture flowing towards the combustion chamber.

title_clean: Non-rotating particle separator and aeroengine
abstract_clean: The application discloses a non-rotating particle separator, wherein the inner wall of the non-rotating particle separator is arranged in a rotating surface, and the position with the largest distance between the inner wall and a rotating center line forms a vertex; the outer wall is arranged outside the inner wall in a surrounding manner, a separation channel is formed by surrounding the outer wall and the inner wall, one end of the separation channel is an inlet, the other end of the separation channel is an outlet, and the sectional area of the separation channel is gradually increased from the vertex position to the inlet and the outlet; the flow dividing piece is arranged at the outlet end of the separation channel and divides the outlet of the flow dividing channel into a cleaning channel close to the outer wall and a gas channel close to the inner wall; the inner wall forms a windward surface from the top position of the inlet of the separation channel, an exhaust port is arranged on the windward surface, a leeward surface is formed at the top position of the outlet of the separation channel, an air suction port is arranged on the leeward surface, an air guide channel is arranged between the air suction port and the exhaust port, the air guide channel is positioned outside the separation channel, and a pumping device for conveying air of the air suction port to the exhaust port is arranged in the air guide channel. The application solves the technical problem of contradiction between air inlet loss and fine sand separation efficiency, and has less influence on the air inlet loss while improving the fine sand separation efficiency.

title_clean: Effectual band-aid of laminating
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to the technical field of wound dressings and discloses a wound dressing with a good fitting effect, which comprises a base layer, wherein the top of the base layer is provided with a through groove, a transparent film is bonded inside the through groove, the bottom of the transparent film is bonded with a water absorption pad, and a first extending part and a second extending part are integrally formed at two ends of the base layer; according to the utility model, the base layer is firstly adhered to the skin, then the two first extending parts are adhered to the skin above the joint, and the two second extending parts are adhered to the skin below the joint, so that the laminating effect is good, the influence on the wound plaster when the joint is bent is ensured, the flexibility is good, meanwhile, a user can see whether the water absorption pad accurately covers the wound site through the transparent film during adhering, and can know whether the wound site is deteriorated through the transparent film during use, so that the wound site can be conveniently observed, and the practicability is high.
