title_clean: Anastomat and repairing sheet for strengthening anastomotic stoma
abstract_clean: The invention provides an anastomotic stoma reinforcement repair sheet and an anastomat, wherein the anastomotic stoma reinforcement repair sheet comprises a back lining, a repair sheet and a suture, the back lining is provided with a first end and a second end which are opposite in the length direction, the back lining is provided with a first surface and a second surface which are opposite to each other in the thickness direction, the repair sheet is arranged on the first surface and is detachably connected with the back lining, at least one part of the suture is sewed on the repair sheet and the back lining, so that the repair sheet is detachably connected with the back lining, the back lining is made of an elastic material, the elastic material enables the back lining to have different constant force elongation rates in the width direction and the length direction of the back lining, and the constant force elongation rate of the back lining in the width direction is more than or equal to 110%, less than or equal to 145%, preferably 120%, 130% or 140%. The backing of the anastomat reinforcing repair sheet provided by the disclosure has elasticity in the width direction, and can be used for adapting to anastomat assemblies with different perimeter sizes.

title_clean: Composition for chromium-free surface treating containing, coated steel sheet using thereof, and method for manufacturing therefor
abstract_clean: A chrome-free surface treatment composition is provided, comprising, at 100% by weight: i) 25% to 60% of a biomass-based water-soluble polyurethane resin, ii) 25% to 60% of a petroleum-based water-soluble polyurethane resin, iii) 0.1% to 5.0% of a silane-based crosslinking agent, iv) 3% to 15% of a co-modifier, v) 1% to 10% of an inorganic metal rust inhibitor; vi) 0.1% to 5.0% of a lubricant; and the remainder being a solvent. According to the present invention, in providing a surface treatment composition for surface treating a plated steel sheet, an environmentally friendly composition can be provided, and such a composition has corrosion resistance, chemical resistance, weather resistance, processability, etc., equivalent to or greater than that of a conventional surface treatment agent using materials derived from fossil fuels.

title_clean: Full life cycle-based carbon emission evaluation system for construction of traffic infrastructure
abstract_clean: The invention provides a full life cycle-based carbon emission evaluation system for construction of a traffic infrastructure, which comprises an exhaust pipe, wherein the exhaust pipe comprises an exhaust pipe of an infrastructure material production factory and an automobile tail gas pipe, a carbon emission monitor is attached to the outer wall of the exhaust pipe, clamping frames are rotatably arranged at the upper end and the lower end of the carbon emission monitor through hinges, the carbon emission monitor is arranged on the exhaust pipe through the clamping frames, the exhaust pipe can be the exhaust pipe of the infrastructure material production factory or the automobile tail gas pipe, the exhaust gas is monitored and counted to obtain carbon emission, and when a vehicle for transporting materials cannot continue to run, a front ring, a cleaning layer and a rear ring of a protection assembly wrap a detection end, and the cleaning layer is driven to rotate by the driving of the rear ring to clean dust on the surface of the detection end, meanwhile, the relatively sealed detection end can not be influenced by external carbon emission, the carbon emission value is recorded in an accumulated mode, and the error of carbon emission statistics is reduced.

title_clean: Intelligent maintenance prediction and health management system for high-altitude equipment
abstract_clean: The invention discloses an intelligent maintenance prediction and health management system for high-altitude equipment, which relates to the technical field of high-altitude equipment management and has the technical scheme that the intelligent maintenance prediction and health management system comprises the following main points of collecting operation parameter values of the high-altitude equipment and dividing the condition area of the high-altitude equipment into area division groups according to the operation parameter values of the high-altitude equipment; the regional division set comprises a target fault region, a first region to be divided and a second region to be divided, an initial steering state of the detection device is set according to the position relation of the regional division set, the initial steering state of the detection device and condition data in the target fault region are processed, analyzed and set to be the initial working state of the detection device, the regional coverage range of the target fault region towards the direction of the detection device is collected, and the parameter fluctuation trend of high-altitude equipment is obtained in real time.

title_clean: Precise determination of the injection quantity of a fuel injector
abstract_clean: A method for determining an injection quantity of a fuel injector with an electromagnetic drive of an internal combustion engine of a motor vehicle is described. The method comprises the following steps: (a) determining (510) a first time at which an injection event of the fuel injector starts, (b) determining (520) a second time at which the injection event of the fuel injector ends, (c) calculating (530) a model based on the first time and the second time, the model representing a position of a nozzle needle of the fuel injector as a function of time, and (d) calculating (540) an injection quantity based on the model and a relation between the position of the nozzle needle and a through-flow rate through the fuel injector.

title_clean: Intelligent card-swiping starting type safe smokeless moxibustion instrument
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses an intelligent card-swiping starting type safe smokeless moxibustion instrument, which comprises a moxibustion instrument main body and a supporting seat, wherein the supporting seat is rotationally connected with the moxibustion instrument main body through a supporting rod, the center of the supporting rod is also provided with an air exhaust channel and a fan arranged at the air exhaust channel, a purifying chamber is also arranged in the supporting seat, a smokeless filter bag is also arranged in the purifying chamber, the supporting seat is also provided with a controller and an LED display panel, the LED display panel is also electrically connected with an NFC induction integrated chip, the controller is connected with an NFC induction radio frequency card, and the controller is also internally provided with an identity detection module, a starting module, a sympathetic data detection module, a frequency detection module, a temperature control detection module and a time detection module, and the sympathetic data detection module is also connected with a background cloud terminal, the utility model greatly improves the operation convenience of users, and can carry out physiotherapy according to different crowds according to the customized moxibustion treatment scheme of professional doctors, the practicability and the efficiency of the product are greatly improved.

title_clean: Tail gas detection device for diesel vehicle in autumn and winter
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a diesel vehicle tail gas detection device in autumn and winter relates to automobile exhaust and detects technical field. Including vertical support and horizontal strut, horizontal strut is located vertical support's upside, the incision has been seted up on the left outer wall of horizontal strut, incision department rotationally is provided with the winding roller, fixedly connected with curb plate on horizontal strut's the outer wall, fixed mounting has the first motor that provides winding roller rotary power on the curb plate, the winding has the rope on the winding roller, horizontal strut and fixedly connected with tail gas detection body are worn to establish to the one end that the winding roller was kept away from to the rope, be provided with the direction subassembly of avoiding rope and horizontal strut direct contact on the horizontal strut. Compared with the prior art, the tail gas detection body is not required to be held by a worker in the detection process, the tail gas of the diesel vehicle is detected, the problem that the worker inhales a large amount of tail gas in the process of detecting the tail gas of the diesel vehicle and the body of the worker is damaged is avoided.

title_clean: Vertical dredge pump with prevent blockking up function
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a vertical sewage pump with an anti-blocking function, which comprises a buffer seat, fixing plates and a sewage pump body, wherein the lower end of the sewage pump body comprises a water inlet pipe, a rotating shaft is rotatably installed in the water inlet pipe, blades are installed on the rotating shaft, the two fixing plates are symmetrically installed at the side end of the sewage pump body, a supporting seat is welded at the lower end of each fixing plate, the buffer seat is installed at the lower end of the supporting seat, a buffer cavity is arranged in the buffer seat, a second buffer spring is installed on the inner wall of the side end in the buffer cavity, first buffer springs which are symmetrically distributed are installed on the inner wall of the bottom end of the buffer cavity, a supporting plate is installed at the upper end of each first buffer spring, a buffer groove is formed in the upper end of the buffer seat, the supporting seat extends into the buffer cavity from the buffer groove, and the lower end of the supporting seat is in contact with the upper end face of the supporting plate. The utility model has the advantages of anti-blocking function, buffering and vibration damping function and capability of effectively prolonging the service life of equipment.

title_clean: Methods and systems for annuloplasty alignment
abstract_clean: The present disclosure relates to methods, systems, subsystems, and kits for aligning an annuloplasty ring or a toroidal portion thereof with a natural fiducial in an annular target.

title_clean: Combined type water pump device of ultra-wide water jet loom
abstract_clean: The utility model provides a composite water pump device of an ultra-wide water jet loom. Super broad width hydraulic loom combined type water pump unit includes the bar shaped plate, the top fixedly connected with brace table of bar shaped plate, the top fixedly connected with shock attenuation box of brace table, sliding connection buffer board between the top of shock attenuation box inner wall both sides, the both sides of buffer board bottom front side all rotate and are connected with the connecting plate, fixedly connected with slide bar between the front side of shock attenuation box inner wall both sides. The ultra-wide water jet loom combined type water pump device provided by the utility model adopts a mode that two water pumps are connected in parallel, and a high-pressure waterline required by weft insertion is simultaneously provided for a nozzle through a one-way valve, so that the weft insertion effect is better, in addition, the abrasion of vibration to the inside of the water pump is effectively reduced through the shock absorption treatment of the water pumps, the service life is prolonged, in addition, the stability of water supply can be ensured through reducing the vibration, and the generation of noise is reduced.

title_clean: Two-dimensional material memristor based on intrinsic sub-nano pore channel confinement and preparation method thereof
abstract_clean: The invention relates to a two-dimensional material memristor based on intrinsic sub-nano pore canal confinement and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of semiconductor devices. The active metal layer is arranged on the surface of the bottom electrode layer, and the active metal layer is arranged on the surface of the bottom electrode layer. The innovation core of the invention is that the resistive layer is composed of a two-dimensional material with sub-nanometer pore canals, the porous two-dimensional material layer not only provides a limited rapid channel for migration of metal cations, but also can effectively guide and restrict the forming paths of the conductive filaments. Compared with the traditional memristor, the random path is replaced by the definite ion migration channel, so that the memristor has the advantages of low set voltage, low energy consumption and the like. The memristor prepared by the invention has wide application prospect in a high-density nonvolatile memory and a brain-like nerve morphology computing system.

title_clean: Array substrate, manufacturing method thereof and display device
abstract_clean: The application provides an array substrate, a manufacturing method of the array substrate and a display device. Wherein, the array substrate includes first base plate and the first metal function layer that forms on first base plate, and first base plate is provided with open area and non-open area, and first metal function layer includes the grid of transistor, and the grid is located non-open area, and the array substrate still includes: the transparent conducting layer comprises a buffering conducting part and an alignment electrode part which are arranged on the same layer, the buffering conducting part is arranged between the grid and the first substrate and is in contact with the grid, the adhesion force between the buffering conducting part and the first substrate and the adhesion force between the buffering conducting part and the grid are both larger than the adhesion force between the grid and the first substrate in direct contact, the alignment electrode part is at least partially positioned in the opening area, and the alignment electrode part is used for providing an alignment electric field. The technical scheme of this application can improve the fastness of metal membranous layer to reduce droing of metal membranous layer.

title_clean: Linear polarization Sagnac total reflection mirror based on double-core optical fiber, method and optical system
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a linear polarization Sagnac total reflection mirror based on a double-core optical fiber, a method and an optical system, wherein the Sagnac total reflection mirror comprises the double-core optical fiber with a tapered coupler, and the double-core optical fiber comprises a first fiber core and a second fiber core which are symmetrically distributed on two sides of a neutral axis of the optical fiber; the first 45-degree inclined fiber grating forming an included angle of 135 degrees with the first fiber core is engraved on the first fiber core, the second 45-degree inclined fiber grating forming an included angle of 45 degrees with the second fiber core is engraved on the second fiber core, and the first 45-degree inclined fiber grating and the second 45-degree inclined fiber grating are arranged at the same position along the length direction of the optical fiber. The invention has the characteristic that the Sagnac total reflection mirror is formed by the single mode fiber (namely, the total reflection function is realized), other discrete devices are not needed, and the double-core fiber has the characteristics of fiber integration, small volume, convenience for integration with other functional devices and high stability because the double-core fiber is compared with the single mode fiber.

title_clean: Display panel, manufacturing method thereof, and display apparatus
abstract_clean: The present disclosure provides a display panel, a manufacturing method thereof, and a display apparatus. The display panel has a display region comprising a first display region and a second display region. A distribution density of pixel circuits in the first display region is smaller than that in the second display region. The display panel includes: a base substrate; a plurality of first pixel circuits disposed on a side of the base substrate and located in the second display region; traces disposed on a side of the first pixel circuits away from the base substrate; first light emitting devices disposed on a side of the traces away from the base substrate and located in the first display region, where first anodes in the first light emitting devices each include at least two conductive layers, and the at least two conductive layers include at least a first transparent electrode; connecting lines each disposed on a same layer as first transparent electrodes and electrically connected with a respective one of the first transparent electrodes, where the traces are used to electrically connect the respective first pixel circuits and the respective connecting lines, so that the first pixel circuits drive the first light emitting devices to emit light.

title_clean: Multifunctional grinding tool quality detection equipment for grinding tool production
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a multifunctional grinding tool quality detection device for grinding tool production, which comprises a base, wherein a centering clamping mechanism is arranged on the base; the centering and clamping structure comprises: the device comprises a plurality of bearing seats, a screw rod, a small-sized rotating motor, two guide rods, a clamping structure and an expansion structure; the small-sized rotating motor is embedded in the inner cavity of the base, and the driving end is connected to one end of the screw rod.

title_clean: Bracket capable of being adjusted rapidly
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to the technical field of brackets and discloses a bracket capable of being quickly adjusted, which comprises a movable shell, wherein the inner side of the movable shell is movably connected with a bracket body, the bracket also comprises a cover plate and a supporting block, connecting rods are vertically and fixedly arranged on two sides of the lower surface of the cover plate, and the bottom ends of the two groups of connecting rods are fixedly connected with two sides of the upper surface of the bracket body respectively. According to the utility model, through the combination of the cover plate, the handle, the connecting rod and the connecting groove, the bracket body can be pulled to move upwards in the movable shell, the use height of the bracket body is adjusted, the screw rod is reversely rotated, the supporting block can be driven to be retracted into the sliding groove, the bracket body and the insulation resistance tester can be further retracted into the movable shell under the action of gravity, the through groove is blocked by the cover plate, and the problems of inconvenience in accommodating the insulation resistance tester and adjustment of the use position of the existing bracket can be solved.

title_clean: Apparatus for drum brake assembly
abstract_clean: An apparatus for a drum brake assembly having a brake drum and an actuator includes a shoe spreader web with a first side for connecting to a first piston of the actuator and a second side for connecting to a second piston of the actuator. A first brake shoe is secured to the first side of the web. A second brake shoe is secured to the second side of the web. The brake shoes have a first condition in which the respective first and second sides of the web move the brake shoes to apply braking force to the brake drum in response to actuation of the actuator. The first brake shoe has a second condition moving relative to the web for absorbing brake drum contraction forces and prevent the full magnitude of these forces from reaching the actuator clevises.

title_clean: Testing device for high-sensitivity brush holder
abstract_clean: The utility model provides a testing device for a high-sensitivity brush holder, which comprises a fixing assembly, wherein the fixing assembly comprises a detection platform, a cavity, a groove, a connecting plate, a spring, a first flexible steel rope, a pull block, a second flexible steel rope, a rectangular hole and a positioning rod. Draw the piece to drive the connecting plate through first flexible steel cable and remove, the connecting plate drives the movable plate through the flexible steel cable of second and removes, the movable plate drives the arc through the connecting rod and removes, place the brush yoke between two arcs, relax the pulling force to drawing the piece gradually, the extension spring under the compression state resets, the extension spring drives the connecting rod through the movable plate and removes, the connecting rod drives the arc that corresponds and removes and fix with the brush yoke, be convenient for fix the brush yoke of different specifications this moment, the knob rotates, the knob passes through the screw rod and drives the carriage release lever and remove, the carriage release lever drives L shape pole and slides on the square bar that corresponds, the carriage release lever drives the probe and removes, be convenient for adjust the position of probe as required and test.

title_clean: Molecular-grade production process and device of inulin
abstract_clean: The invention relates to a molecular-grade production process and a molecular-grade production device for inulin, and belongs to the technical field of natural plant extraction. The invention provides a molecular-grade inulin production technology, which utilizes a molecular weight grading and separating device, namely products with more than four different grades, namely a molecular weight of more than 2500, a molecular weight of more than 1000, a molecular weight of more than 500 and a molecular weight of less than 500 and a molecular weight of more than 200, according to the molecular weight.

title_clean: Method for producing four-season meju with lactic acid bacteria and beneficial bacteria that reduces the harmful factors of traditional soybean paste
abstract_clean: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing lactic acid bacteria (beneficial bacteria) four-season fermented soybean lump reducing risk factors in traditional fermented sauces realized with: a raw material and auxiliary raw material bringing-in step; a selection and washing step; an immersion step; a steaming step; a starter inoculation step; a grinding step; a compression and molding step; a fermentation step; and a drying step, wherein the manufactured four-season fermented soybean lump have a remarkable effect of developing the traditional fermented soybean lumps industry into a competitive industry by making the allowable range of apratoxin and biogenic amine, which are risk factors, meet domestic and international standards.

title_clean: Surfactant assisted oil recovery using alcohol ether sulfonates and cationic surfactants
abstract_clean: A composition comprising an alcohol ether sulfonate and a quaternary ammonium salt is provided for use in methods of increasing recovery of crude oil from a subterranean hydrocarbon-containing formation.

title_clean: Functional food for preventing and improving female menopausal symptoms using horse placenta
abstract_clean: The present invention relates to a functional food for preventing and improving female menopausal symptoms using horse placenta. A functional food for preventing and improving female menopausal symptoms using horse placenta according to an embodiment of the technical idea of the present invention contains hydrolyzed and fermented horse placenta as an active ingredient, wherein 1-10 wt% of the hydrolyzed and fermented horse placenta is contained based on the total content of the function food. By such configuration, a functional food for preventing and improving female menopausal symptoms using horse placenta according to various embodiments of the technical idea of the present invention causes no side effect and is effective in preventing and improving female menopausal symptoms by hydrolyzing the horse placenta to produce a hydrolyzed and fermented product and using the same in a food.

title_clean: Actuator for optical image stabilization and camera module including the same
abstract_clean: According to an embodiment of the present invention, an actuator for shake correction comprises: a sensor substrate on which an image sensor having an imaging surface is disposed; a fixed frame accommodating the sensor substrate; a moving frame accommodated in the fixed frame and movable in a direction parallel to the imaging surface; a first ball member disposed between the fixed frame and the moving frame and supporting the movement of the moving frame; and a first driving unit disposed on the moving frame and the fixed frame and providing a driving force to the moving frame. The sensor substrate includes a moving unit coupled to the moving frame, a fixing unit coupled to the fixed frame, and a plurality of bridges movably supporting the moving unit. the plurality of bridges extend along the circumference of the moving unit. The sensor substrate can include a first support unit connecting the plurality of bridges and the fixing unit, and a second support unit connecting the plurality of bridges and the moving unit.

title_clean: Image formation apparatus
abstract_clean: To provide an image formation apparatus which can suppress unauthorized use.SOLUTION: An image formation apparatus 1 comprises: an imaging unit 21; a storage unit 22; a collation unit 23; a determination unit 24; and a control unit 25. The imaging unit 21 acquires image data by imaging the peripheral scenery of the image formation apparatus 1. The storage unit 22 stores first registered image data registered by imaging the peripheral scenery of an installation schedule place of the image formation apparatus 1. The collation unit 23 collates the image data with the first registered image data to output first collation data. The determination unit 24 determines whether or not the image formation apparatus 1 is installed at the installation schedule place on the basis of the first collation data to output determination information. The control unit 25 drives a drive system of the image formation apparatus 1 on the basis of the determination information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_clean: Intraocular lens delivery devices and methods of use
abstract_clean: Intraocular lens delivery devices and methods of use.

title_clean: Tracking monitoring device, tracking monitoring system, tracking monitoring method, and tracking monitoring program
abstract_clean: To provide a tracking monitoring technique capable of monitoring an object to be tracked for a longer time.SOLUTION: A tracking monitoring device includes: a video receiving unit configured to receive video data captured by a first camera; a target detecting unit configured to detect a target from received video data and measure a moving speed of a detected target; a subsequent-stage camera comparing unit configured to calculate a predicted arrival time at which the target reaches an imaging range of a second camera based on the measured moving speed; and a control unit configured to transmit a calculated predicted arrival time to a second camera.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_clean: Anti-aging wire and cable and preparation method thereof
abstract_clean: The application relates to the technical field of wires and cables, and discloses an anti-aging wire and cable and a preparation method thereof; cobalt (Co) is selected as a metal blank, and bipyridine-imidazole connecting agent is introduced to prepare a two-dimensional MOF material with high heat dissipation performance and oxidation resistance; the preparation method comprises the steps of immersing carbon nano tubes in a MOF preparation process to prepare the composite MOF crosslinked carbon nano tubes with the three-dimensional structure, preparing two materials into a coating to be coated on the surface of a conductor, extruding a coating insulating layer through an extruder, cooling, rolling and packaging to obtain the anti-aging wire and cable. The material has wide application prospect in the field of wires and cables, and provides an effective way for solving the problem of cable aging.

title_clean: MOFs derivative PBA @ Co-Ni-S composite material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a MOFs derivative PBA @ Co-Ni-S composite material, which is characterized in that a nanocube with uniform size is formed by adopting a room temperature precipitation method, then a static adsorption method is carried out to load MOF nanosheets on the surfaces of the nanocube, and finally the MOF nanosheets are activated by solvothermal vulcanization to realize rapid and reversible Faraday reaction, so that the electrochemical performance of EC is improved. The Fe-Co-PBA provides a main appearance and has a stable structure; the MOF is coated on the surface of the Fe-Co-PBA subsequently, and the specific surface area of the whole material is improved due to the morphology of the nanosheets; and then, vulcanization treatment is carried out, so that the electronic structure of the outer MOF is further regulated and controlled, and the performance is improved. The preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing 1 Fe-Co-PBA; MOF nanosheets are loaded on the outer layer of the 2 Fe-Co-PBA; 3, carrying out vulcanization treatment by adopting a solvothermal method. The electrode material is applied to the super capacitor, the electrode material is charged and discharged in a range of-0.1-0.45V, and the specific capacitance is 1200-1300F/g when the discharge current density is 1A/g. Has excellent material stability and excellent ion transmission capacity.

title_clean: Electrochemical device and electronic device
abstract_clean: An electrochemical device and an electronic device. The electrochemical device comprises a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and an electrolyte. The electrolyte comprises an organic solvent, a lithium salt, and an additive. The organic solvent comprises an acetate compound and a carbonate compound. The carbonate compound comprises ethylene carbonate and propylene carbonate. Based on the total mass of the electrolyte, the mass percentage content of the acetate compound ranges from 4% to 50%, and the mass percentage content of ethylene carbonate ranges from 5% to 20%. By optimizing the content and the type of the solvent in the electrolyte, the charging capability of the electrochemical device is improved by utilizing the interface modification effect of the additive, and temperature rise during charging is reduced.

title_clean: Inclusion control method for reducing sand hole defect
abstract_clean: The invention discloses an inclusion control method for reducing sand hole defects, and belongs to the technical field of ferrous metallurgy. Firstly, converter smelting bottom argon blowing promotes carbon-oxygen reaction balance, and after converter tapping, ladle top slag modification is not needed to directly enter an RH process; step two, RH vacuum treatment, namely controlling the dissolved oxygen to be 380-420 ppm, and adding aluminum particles; after decarburization is finished, setting a circulation time according to the addition amount of aluminum particles; after all the alloy is added, controlling the depth of a molten pool of the RH vacuum chamber within the range of 100-250 mm; the net circulation time from the completion of the addition of all the alloys to the breaking of the alloy is 4 to 8 minutes; and step three, continuous casting. According to the invention, the quantity of inclusions and the refinement size are reduced by controlling the addition amount of RH aluminum particles and optimizing the RH inclusion removal dynamics condition, and the risk casting blank is screened out by identifying abnormal conditions in the continuous casting process, so that the occurrence rate of sand hole defects of the finished product is reduced.

title_clean: Signal processing apparatus, optical transmitting apparatus, optical receiving apparatus, optical transmission system, and signal processing method
abstract_clean: A signal processing apparatus ( 10 ) according to the present disclosure includes: an overlap-type FFT processing unit ( 11 ) that performs FFT processing overlapping input subcarrier signals each other for each of FFT blocks, and a generation unit ( 12 ) that generates a signal which is obtained by frequency shifting the subcarrier signals that have been subjected to the FFT processing by the overlap-type FFT processing unit ( 11 ) by a frequency shift amount of a subcarrier, a phase offset that occurs between the FFT blocks overlapping each other being compensated in the signal.

title_clean: Charge pump circuit and high voltage generation method with improved psrr
abstract_clean: To improve power supply rejection ratio in an on-chip high voltage generation circuit using a charge pump.SOLUTION: A high voltage generation circuit includes a charge pump and a control loop, the control loop further includes a feed-forward path including a second circuit element configured to combine a second reference voltage and a second voltage generated by inverting a supply voltage to obtain a second voltage difference signal, a third circuit element configured to generate a feed-forward compensation signal inversely proportional to a voltage difference between the supply voltage and the second reference voltage based on the second voltage difference signal, and a fourth circuit element configured to generate a control signal by summing a feedback signal and the feed-forward compensation signal.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_clean: Patch antenna and array antenna comprising same
abstract_clean: A patch antenna includes: a substrate; a first radiator disposed on the substrate and having a first shape; a second radiator disposed on the substrate while being spaced a predetermined distance apart from the first radiator, and having a second shape; and a power feeder which supplies a power feed signal to the first radiator, wherein the first radiator includes a first outer edge portion straightly formed in the horizontal direction and second outer edge portions vertically formed from both ends of the first outer edge portion.

title_clean: Embedded high-power microwave functional module
abstract_clean: The invention discloses an embedded high-power microwave functional module which comprises an output matching circuit, an input matching circuit, a functional circuit interface, a microwave interface, a test interface, a direct current power supply interface, a mechanical installation interface, a heat sink, a microwave power tube, a locating pin, a liquid cooling input port and a liquid cooling output port. The microwave power tube, the matching and functional circuit and the bottom heat sink are independent from the power amplifier and are provided with interfaces for supporting conduction heat dissipation and liquid cooling heat dissipation. The plug-and-play high-power component is an independent and replaceable high-power component with complete functions of temperature compensation, temperature compensation protection, time sequence control and the like and a flexible heat dissipation mode, can be conveniently produced and debugged while maintaining good high-power performance, and can be replaced in time in an external use environment.

title_clean: Application of pectin ECG composition in inhibiting formation of pyridine derivatives in gastrointestinal tract
abstract_clean: The application discloses an application of a pectin ECG composition in inhibiting the formation of pyridine derivatives in the gastrointestinal tract, belonging to the field of health-care food or medicines. The application discovers that the pectin and the ECG can obviously improve the effect of inhibiting the formation of pyridine derivatives in the gastrointestinal tract after being combined with each other, and the antioxidant capacity of the combination of the pectin and the ECG is obviously stronger than that of the pectin or the ECG alone. The pectin and the ECG or the composition containing the pectin and the ECG can be used for preparing health-care food or medicine for inhibiting the formation of pyridine derivatives or resisting oxidation or treating and delaying or improving diseases related to the pyridine derivatives, and has wide application prospect in the fields of resisting oxidation, aging, diabetes and the like.

title_clean: Diphenylalkane compound and preparation method, pharmaceutical composition and application thereof
abstract_clean: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicines, relates to a diphenylalkane compound, a preparation method thereof, a pharmaceutical composition and application thereof, and particularly discloses a diphenylalkane compound shown as a formula (I) and 1-fluoro-3-methoxy-5-phenethyl benzene (II), a preparation method thereof and application thereof in preparing medicines for preventing or treating metabolic syndrome. The compound has obvious antimetabolite syndrome effect, and can be applied to the clinical treatment of antimetabolite syndrome in the form of monomer or medicinal composition.

title_clean: FORMULATION INCLUDING A COMBINATION OF β-ENDORPHIN AND ADRENOCORTICOTROPIC HORMONE
abstract_clean: The present specification provides compositions of β-endorphin and adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH). These compositions are useful in methods of treating disease.

title_clean: Fused ring aryl imide derivative with alternately fused naphthalimide and pyrene and preparation method thereof
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a condensed ring aromatic imide derivative with alternately condensed naphthalimide and pyrene, a preparation method and application thereof, which takes tetrabromonaphthalimide and hetero atom condensed ring aromatic imide derivative as raw materials, under the protection of inert gas, palladium catalysis is adopted to perform aromatization reaction, and the fused ring aromatic imide derivative formed by alternately fusing naphthalimide and pyrene is prepared by a one-step method. The naphthalimide and pyrene alternate fused condensed ring aromatic imide derivative has stronger absorption to visible light with the wavelength of 400-700nm and higher fluorescence quantum yield, and is shown by TGA test to have thermal decomposition temperatures of more than 340 ℃ and good chemical stability, and can be used as an organic semiconductor n-type electron transport material applied to organic field effect transistors, solar cell materials, liquid crystal materials, organic luminescent materials, industrial dyes and the like .

title_clean: Risk model-based network communication risk prediction method and device
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a network communication risk prediction method and device based on a risk model, comprising the following steps: determining a source communication end and a target communication end corresponding to a target communication task in all communication tasks to be executed in a current communication network; determining a first risk prediction model corresponding to the source communication end and a second risk prediction model corresponding to the target communication end according to the corresponding equipment type and the corresponding equipment information; based on the corresponding risk prediction model and the corresponding equipment information prediction source communication terminal, the first communication risk information corresponding to the target communication information and the second communication risk information corresponding to the target communication information are sent by the target communication terminal; and determining comprehensive risk information according to the two communication risk information. Therefore, the invention can improve the prediction accuracy and the prediction efficiency of the network communication risk, and improve the reliability when the network communication safety is improved based on the communication risk prediction mode, thereby being beneficial to ensuring the normal operation of the communication network.

title_clean: Psfch resource determination method, arrangement method, and communication apparatus
abstract_clean: To provide a physical side-link feedback channel (PSFCH) resource determination method, an arrangement method, and a communication apparatus that match the understanding of a target object PSFCH resource between a first communication apparatus and a second communication apparatus and improve communication reliability, by determining a target object PSFCH resource.SOLUTION: A physical side-link feedback channel (PSFCH) resource determination method includes the step of determining a target object PSFCH resource based on acquired PSFCH resource arrangement information. The target object includes at least one of a carrier, a bandwidth part BWP, and a resource pool, and the PSFCH resource includes at least one of a PSFCH transmission resource and a PSFCH reception resource. The method also includes the step of performing a target operation on feedback information on the PSFCH resource. The target operation includes at least one of a reception operation and a transmission operation.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_clean: Apparatus and method of processing quantum state tomography in quantum information integrated processing system
abstract_clean: The present invention relates to a technology for reducing resources required for estimating a qubit and multi-qubit system based on particle filter-based quantum state tomography, which reduces resources required for estimating a quantum state by introducing efficient adaptive learning of a measurement basis. A quantum state tomography processing device according to an embodiment of the present invention may include: a first layer processing unit that optimizes the measurement settings of the next iteration by using particle distribution in each iteration for the basis tomography of a qubit to apply the particle distribution as a single item in the measurement settings of the next iteration; and a second layer processing unit that reduces the number of the measurement setting sets by using measurement results of the measurement setting sets according to the optimized measurement settings of the next iteration.

title_clean: Simultaneous transmission in multiple frequency segments
abstract_clean: A communication device determines whether simultaneous transmissions in a first frequency segment and a second frequency segment are to be synchronized in time. In response determining that simultaneous transmissions in the first frequency segment and the second frequency segment are to be synchronized in time, the communication device transmits a first packet in the first frequency segment beginning at a first time, and transmits a second packet in the second frequency segment beginning at the first time. In response to determining that simultaneous transmissions in the first frequency segment and the second frequency segment are to be unsynchronized in time, the communication device transmits a third packet in the first frequency segment beginning at a second time, and transmits a fourth packet in the second frequency segment beginning at a third time that is different than the second time.

title_clean: Pig house air filtration epidemic prevention device
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a pig house air filtration epidemic prevention device, which comprises a main body, wherein one end of the main body is fixedly connected with a ventilation pipe, the outer side surface of the ventilation pipe is fixedly connected with a metal net, one end of the ventilation pipe is fixedly connected with a fan, the other end of the main body is provided with an air outlet, an air deflector is arranged in the air outlet, an efficient filter plate core is arranged in the main body, the upper end of the main body is fixedly connected with a sterilizing liquid tank, one end of the sterilizing liquid tank is fixedly connected with a high-pressure water pump, the high-pressure water pump is connected with a water outlet pipe, an atomization spray nozzle is fixedly connected onto the water outlet pipe, a sewage collecting box is arranged in the main body, a plurality of U-shaped limiting plates are fixedly connected onto the upper end and the lower end of the main body, and a dustproof net and primary filter cotton are arranged in the ventilation pipe. The filter core is fixed through setting up U type limiting plate, threaded rod and grip block to can dismantle the convenient filter core of changing.

title_clean: Heat radiation structure that relay protection supervisor used
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a heat radiation structure for a relay protection management machine, which relates to the technical field of the relay protection management machine, and comprises a protection box body, wherein a supporting screen plate for supporting the relay protection management machine is arranged in a net basket, a water-cooling heat absorption mechanism is arranged between the supporting screen plate and the net basket, a supporting frame is arranged on the side wall of the protection box body, a motor I is arranged on the supporting frame, an axial fan for blowing air inside the protection box body is connected on the motor I in a driving way, a heat radiation strip hole is arranged on the side wall of the protection box body, and an adjusting mechanism for driving the net basket to lift is arranged on the protection box body; the utility model discloses a motor I drive axial fan who sets up is rotatory, realizes blowing air to protection box inside, promotes the heat dissipation of relay protection supervisor in the net basket, and the inside circulation flow of snakelike pipe that sets up has cold water, realizes the inside fine heat absorption effect of net basket, and the heat dissipation of relay protection supervisor is abundant high-efficient.

title_clean: Healthcare thermal mat with sleeping biorhythm monitoring function through smart device linkage control
abstract_clean: The present invention relates to a healthcare heating mat equipped with a biorhythm monitoring function of a sleep state through smart device linkage control, wherein a biometric monitoring device is detachably equipped on a heating mat to monitor monitoring data generated during sleep of a user, and the smart equipment analyzes thereof to generate biorhythm information, provides to the user, and controls the temperature of the heating mat with the smart equipment when transmitted to a smart equipment mounted with a biorhythm monitoring application. According to the present invention, the present invention enables the user to monitor the biorhythm and adjust the temperature of the heating mat when sleeping by using the heating mat by using the smart equipment and thus being effective in creating an environment in which the user can sleep soundly, monitors various biorhythms generated during sleep by monitoring changes and the like of various biorhythms with the smart equipment, enables expansion functions through linkage with various equipment, and comprehensively monitors and manages the biorhythms of a plurality of users.

title_clean: Multifunctional indoor unit
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to the technical field of machine room air conditioners, in particular to a multifunctional indoor unit which comprises a machine body and a cleaning device, wherein a base is fixedly connected to the lower surface of the machine body, an air inlet pipe is arranged on the side surface of the machine body, an air outlet frame is arranged on the surface of the machine body, a heat dissipation hole is formed in the side surface of the machine body, the cleaning device is arranged on the surface of the machine body and comprises a connecting block, a sliding rod and a threaded rod, the connecting block is fixedly connected with the surface of the machine body, the sliding rod is fixedly connected with the inner wall of the connecting block, and the threaded rod is rotatably connected with the inner wall of the connecting block. According to the utility model, the cleaning device is arranged to effectively clean the surface of the air outlet frame, so that the effect of cleaning the surface of the air outlet frame is achieved, dust is easily adsorbed on the surface of the air outlet frame when the equipment is used, the equipment is blocked and cannot be used, and the practicability of the equipment is improved.

title_clean: Movement interval measurement apparatus for checking operating status of vehicle power transmission apparatus unaffected by temperature
abstract_clean: The present invention relates to a movement interval measurement apparatus for checking the operating status of a vehicle power transmission apparatus unaffected by temperature. The movement interval measurement apparatus for checking the operating status of a vehicle power transmission apparatus unaffected by temperature according to the present invention uses a resonance circuit including a sensing coil and uses changes in the resonance frequency of the resonance circuit and the output voltage of the resonance circuit, which change in response to changes in the distance between the detection target object and the sensing coil, so as to measure movement intervals of the detection target object, and is provided with a separate diode voltage detection unit for detecting diode voltage and removes the diode voltage included in the output value of the resonance circuit so as not to be affected by changes in temperature.

title_clean: Screw feeder blade forming device
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses an auger blade forming device, which comprises a mounting plate, wherein the upper end surface of the mounting plate is fixedly provided with two supporting plates which are symmetrically arranged, the upper ends of the supporting plates are respectively and fixedly provided with a fixed block, the inside of the fixed block is provided with a limit component, one side of the limit components which are close to each other is provided with a connecting component, a limit slider is arranged between the limit component and the connecting component, the upper end of the mounting plate is fixedly provided with a driving component, and the power output end of the driving component is respectively and fixedly connected with the connecting component, simultaneously still improved the stability of screw feeder blade shaping body.

title_clean: Novel hernia band
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to the technical field of medical care auxiliary supplies, in particular to a novel hernia band, which has more stable fixing effect, is not easy to deviate, is not easy to protrude and comprises a waist band and leg bands, wherein the two leg bands are arranged, the rear part of the waist band is provided with two binding bands, one end of each binding band is provided with a hook surface of a magic tape, the side wall of each leg band is provided with a connecting band, the top of each connecting band is provided with a hernia bag, the bottom of each connecting band is provided with a connecting ring, the front part of the waist band is provided with two magic tape surfaces, the two ends of each waist band are provided with magic tapes, the two ends of each leg band are provided with magic tapes, the binding bands penetrate through the inside of the connecting rings, one end of each connecting band is sewn on the leg band, one end of each binding band is sewn on the waist band, and the connecting band and the hernia bag are made of skin-friendly materials.

title_clean: Anti-blocking spiral pulp extruder for producing viscose filament cotton pulp
abstract_clean: The utility model provides a production of viscose filament yarn cotton pulp is with preventing stifled type spiral press master. The production of viscose filament yarn cotton pulp is with preventing stifled type spiral press master includes: workstation, circular case, rectangle baffle, auger, first circular opening, extrusion case, inlet pipe, prevent stifled mechanism, crowded thick liquid mechanism, filtering mechanism and fixed establishment, circular case fixed mounting is at the top of workstation, rectangle baffle fixed mounting is in circular incasement, the auger rotates and installs on the rectangle baffle, the auger is kept away from the one end of rectangle baffle and is extended to outside the circular case, first circular opening is seted up on one side outer wall of circular case. title_clean: Method for electrostatic discharge protection, electrostatic discharge circuit and integrated circuit
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a method for electrostatic discharge protection, an electrostatic discharge circuit and an integrated circuit. According to an embodiment, a method for electrostatic discharge protection includes dividing a voltage between a plurality of circuit nodes using a voltage divider circuit to form a divided voltage, compensating for a temperature dependence of the divided voltage to form a temperature compensated divided voltage, monitoring the voltage between the plurality of circuit nodes using a transient detection circuit to form a transient detection signal, and activating a clamp circuit coupled between the plurality of circuit nodes based on the temperature compensated divided voltage and based on the transient detection signal.

title_clean: Radio frequency switch circuit, radio frequency switch chip and wireless communication equipment
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a radio frequency switch circuit, a radio frequency switch chip and wireless communication equipment, wherein the radio frequency switch circuit comprises N switch sub-circuits, and each switch sub-circuit comprises a series switch unit and a parallel switch unit; the switch sub-circuit further comprises a first feedback unit and/or a second feedback unit. According to the invention, the series switch unit outputs the radio frequency signal, and the parallel switch unit blocks the inactive radio frequency signal to the ground, so that the isolation degree of the switch is increased; the harmonic part in the signal is filtered by the feedback unit, so that the second harmonic and the third harmonic generated by the switch are reduced, the linearity of the switch is effectively increased, and the aim of increasing the maximum output power of the switch is fulfilled. In addition, the sizes of the series switch unit and the parallel switch unit are greatly reduced, so that the production cost is reduced, and the method has wide practical application prospect.

title_clean: Soft decoding in memory systems
abstract_clean: The present disclosure involves methods, apparatuses, and systems for performing soft decoding in a memory system. In one example, a method for a memory system includes sending, by a memory controller, a read command to a memory device. The method further includes storing, by the memory device based on the read command, first soft data in a first latch, second soft data in a second latch, and hard data in a third latch. The method further includes sending, by the memory controller, a first page transfer command to the memory device, wherein the first page transfer command indicates a selected latch from the first latch, the second latch, or the third latch to transfer data in the selected latch to a cache latch.

title_clean: Circuit microwave signal stable gain device
abstract_clean: The invention relates to the technical field of signal processing, in particular to a circuit microwave signal stable gain device, which comprises an upstream device and a downstream device for signal processing, wherein the upstream device and the downstream device are connected in series; the microwave signal guiding device is characterized in that a signal input module used for receiving an external signal is arranged in the upstream device, a power adjusting module used for adjusting signal power is embedded in the input module, a double-path conduction module used for signal shunting is arranged in the downstream device, high-power paths and low-power paths which are arranged at intervals are arranged in the double-path conduction module, the high-power paths and the low-power paths jointly act on microwave signal guiding, and the double-path conduction module is arranged, so that the classification guiding processing of the signals can be efficiently guaranteed.

title_clean: Positioning assistance system for materials handling vehicle
abstract_clean: A materials handling vehicle is disclosed that includes a power unit, a load handling assembly, and a positioning assistance system that provides assistance to an operator driving the vehicle. The assistance provided by the positioning assistance system comprises at least one of an audible, tactile or visual cue to indicate at least one of: a distance from the vehicle to the boundary object; or the heading of the vehicle relative to the boundary object.

title_clean: Electronic device and method for transmitting data to cluster traveling vehicles
abstract_clean: The invention discloses an electronic device and a method for transmitting data to a cluster traveling vehicle. The electronic device comprises a camera, a communication circuit, a memory for storing a neural network model and instructions, and a processor operatively connected to the camera, the communication circuit and the memory. The instructions, when executed by the processor, enable the electronic device to obtain an image via the camera, identify a first classification result of an object contained in the image using the image and the neural network model, transmit, via the communication circuit, a feature map of the image-based neural network model to an external electronic device contained in a subsequent vehicle on which the electronic device is mounted, obtain, via the communication circuit, a second classification result of the object calculated in the external electronic device based on the feature map from the external electronic device, and determine whether the vehicle is traveling as a preceding vehicle based on the first classification result and the second classification result.

title_clean: Latent feature activity constraints for ensuring explainability in interpretable neural network models
abstract_clean: A method for generating a classifier, comprising: initializing a neural network with a fully connected architecture; applying a regularization constraint to the set of weights between neurons in the input layer and the plurality of latent features in the hidden layer; iteratively reducing a number of incoming connections to each latent feature in the hidden layer to a predetermined number based on the regularized first set of weights; weighting loss function's value based on categories of activation tuples, wherein contributions of data entries with activation tuples of size greater than a predetermined threshold to the loss function's value are limited and wherein contributions of data entries with activation tuples of size "0" to the loss function's value are minimized, to a predefined percentage; and selectively updating sets of weights associated with top-ranked latent features as evaluated by the magnitude of their contributions at the output layer in a training process.

title_clean: Information providing device

title_clean: Polysaccharide modified phospholipid complex and preparation method thereof
abstract_clean: The invention relates to a polysaccharide-modified medicinal phospholipid compound, wherein the medicinal phospholipid compound is prepared from a medicament and phospholipid, the medicament comprises oxymatrine and glycyrrhizin, and the polysaccharide modification is to modify the medicinal phospholipid compound by chitosan and then modify the medicinal phospholipid compound coated with chitosan by hyaluronic acid. The polysaccharide modified medicinal phospholipid complex can enhance medicinal aggregation in tumor cells through synergistic effect and active targeting effect, and remarkably improves the antitumor effect of the medicaments.

title_clean: Method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium for calibrating concentration of anesthetic gas
abstract_clean: A method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium for calibrating concentration of anesthetic gas relate to the field of concentration calibration. In the method, a reference gas set is determined, a first curve model of a first standard gas is constructed according to the relation between the absorbance and the concentration of the first standard gas, and the first standard gas is one gas in the reference gas set; obtaining a first concentration value and a first absorbance value of a second standard gas, calculating a second concentration value of the second standard gas according to the first absorbance value and a first curve model, calculating a first deviation coefficient of the second standard gas according to the first concentration value and the second concentration value, and calibrating the first curve model according to the first deviation coefficient to obtain a second curve model corresponding to the second standard gas, wherein the second standard gas is any gas except the first standard gas in a reference gas set; and acquiring a second absorbance value of the gas to be detected, acquiring the type data of the gas to be detected input by a user, matching a target curve model according to the type data, and determining the concentration value of the gas to be detected according to the second absorbance value and the target curve model. By implementing the technical scheme provided by the application, the effect that other gases and instruments can be calibrated through the first curve model of one gas is achieved.

title_clean: Polypeptide for inhibiting hog cholera virus infection activity and application thereof
abstract_clean: The invention relates to a polypeptide for inhibiting the infection activity of classical swine fever virus and application thereof, wherein the polypeptide sequence is KRWWSHK (P) 8 ). The invention takes the crystal structure of bovine viral diarrhea virus E2 protein as a template, obtains the three-dimensional structure of classical swine fever virus E2 protein by homologous modeling, and finally obtains a polypeptide sequence with high scoring value, namely P, by virtue of a virtual molecule docking technology 8 (ii) a Artificially synthesized P 8 The sequence is identified by ELISA and SPR tests to have affinity and specificity with the interaction of E2 protein, and the result shows that P 8 Has higher affinity and specific combination with E2; then the activity of inhibiting virus infection is verified by qRT-PCR and IPMA test, and the result shows that P 8 The sequence has the activity of better inhibiting the hog cholera virus from infecting PK-15 cells. The invention can provide reliable theoretical basis and new thought for further research on virus receptors and antiviral drug design.

title_clean: Cleaning machine for food processing
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a cleaning machine for food processing, which relates to the technical field of food processing and comprises a main body unit, a containing unit and a cleaning unit which are arranged in the main body unit, a clamping unit which is arranged between the containing unit and the main body unit, and a pollution discharge unit which is arranged on the side part of the main body unit, wherein the containing unit comprises a supporting seat which is arranged on the inner wall of the main body unit, a filter bucket which is arranged in the supporting seat, and a connecting enclosure seat which is arranged on the side wall of the filter bucket, and the cleaning unit comprises a telescopic piece which is arranged in the main body unit, a cleaning rod which is arranged at the top of the telescopic piece, a transmission piece which is arranged in the main body unit and is positioned below the telescopic piece, and a driving motor which is arranged at the input end of the transmission piece. The utility model relates to a cleaning machine for food processing, which prevents sludge from adhering to a filter hole through a containing unit and a cleaning unit, and ensures the cleaning effect.

title_clean: Fertile for production fermenting installation of liquid of adaptation various environment

title_clean: Denitrification deep bed filter capable of uniformly adding medicines
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to a denitrification deep bed filter capable of uniformly adding medicines, which comprises a medicine mixing tank and a filter which are sequentially connected, wherein the medicine mixing tank is provided with a medicine adding box, the top of the medicine adding box is provided with a plurality of medicine conveying pipes, the top ends of the medicine conveying pipes are provided with medicine storage boxes, a pair of stirring rods are arranged in the medicine adding box, the stirring rods are arranged in the horizontal direction and are parallel to each other, the stirring rods are connected with spiral blades, the rotation directions of the spiral blades of different stirring rods are opposite, one side of the medicine adding box is also provided with a motor cavity, the bottom of the medicine adding box is provided with a medicine outlet which can be opened and closed, the cavity opening of the motor cavity is provided with a baffle plate, a pair of driving motors are arranged in the motor cavity, and the stirring rods penetrate through the baffle plate and are correspondingly connected with the driving motors to carry out matched linkage; the spiral blade with opposite rotation directions is rotated, the medicament is pushed to circularly move in the medicament adding box, the medicament is fully mixed and then is put in from the medicament outlet, and the reduction of the primary treatment effect caused by uneven distribution of different medicaments in sewage is avoided.

title_clean: Device for simultaneously drawing multiple crystals
abstract_clean: The utility model provides a device for drawing many crystals simultaneously, the utility model discloses a set up the heated board below crystal cooling body, keep warm to crystal cooling body's surface through the heated board, effectually avoided the volatile substance because of condensation phenomenon adheres to below and on the lateral wall of crystal cooling body, the utility model discloses when realizing avoiding the volatile substance adhesion on crystal cooling body, because the heat preservation effect of heated board, avoided because of the cooling that low temperature below the crystal cooling body is regional to its corresponding crucible, prevent that crystal cooling body from taking away too much temperature, played the effect that reduces the heating energy consumption etc, simultaneously, because the heat preservation effect of heated board, make the cooling effect complete action of cooling medium in crystal cooling body on the pulling hole is lifted on the crystal, and then improve the cooling effect to the drawing crystal, realize the quick crystallization of crystal, played the purpose that improves crystal drawing speed etc.

title_clean: Long carbon chain polyamide resin composition and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_clean: The invention provides a long carbon chain polyamide resin composition, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the long carbon chain polyamide resin composition comprises, by weight, 35-70 parts of long carbon chain polyamide resin, 4-22 parts of reinforcing filler, 10-40 parts of porcelain forming filler and 2.5-22 parts of ablative filler, and the porcelain forming filler comprises boron nitride and/or aluminum nitride. In the invention, the long carbon chain polyamide resin composition has good ablation resistance, flame retardance and mechanical property, and is easy to extrude and process.

title_clean: Synergistic sulfide scavenging additives for use in oilfield operations
abstract_clean: Systems, compositions, and methods for synergistic additives for use in the scavenging of sulfur-containing compounds encountered in oilfield operations are provided. In one embodiment, the methods comprise injecting a sulfide scavenging additive that does not comprise a significant amount of an aldehyde into at least a portion of a subterranean formation where one or more sulfur-containing species are present; and injecting a synergistic additive comprising at least one base into at least the portion of the subterranean formation.

title_clean: Heat resistant aromatic polycarbonate - polyester composition
abstract_clean: The present invention relates to a composition comprising from 25-75 wt. % of aromatic polycarbonate comprising melt polycarbonate and from 75-25 wt. % of polyester based on the combined weight of the aromatic polycarbonate and the polyester, wherein said aromatic polycarbonate has an endcap level of at most 75 mol % and said polyester comprises polybutylene terephthalate, and wherein i) said polyester comprises a polymer miscible with poly(butylene terephthalate), said polymer having a glass transition temperature higher than the glass transition temperature of said poly(butylene terephthalate) and/or, ii) said aromatic polycarbonate comprises a polymer miscible with said melt polycarbonate, said polymer having a glass transition temperature higher than the glass transition temperature of said melt polycarbonate.

title_clean: TO-46 packaging automatic bonding fixing clamp and application method thereof

According TO the invention, by pushing the push rod, the baffle plate on the main body moves back and forth, so that the TO-46 packaged product TO be bonded is fixed.

title_clean: Display panel and method of manufacturing display panel
abstract_clean: The present invention relates to a display panel. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a display panel comprises: a base layer divided into a first area including a display area and a transmissive area and a second area surrounding at least a portion of the first area and having a light transmittance lower than that of the first area; first pixels disposed in the display area and each including sub-pixels and a dummy electrode, wherein the sub-pixels include a pixel circuit including first transistors and a light emitting device connected to the first transistors, respectively, the transistors include a semiconductor pattern unit and a gate electrode overlapping the semiconductor pattern unit, respectively, and the dummy electrode is spaced apart from the semiconductor pattern unit on a plane.

title_clean: Surface Modification and Application of Silicone Hydrogel Contact Lens
abstract_clean: The present invention relates to preparation of aminated hyaluronic acid and a method for surface treatment of a contact lenses with the aminated hyaluronic acid. The present invention chemically bonds hyaluronic acid to the surface of the contact lens having a low expansion rate due to moisture, thereby providing the contact lens with high oxygen permeability, surface wettability, and remarkably improved wearing comfort.

title_clean: Image exposure compensation method and device and computer readable storage medium
abstract_clean: The invention discloses an image exposure compensation method, an image exposure compensation device and a computer-readable storage medium, which can divide a shooting preview image into a plurality of exposure compensation sub-areas according to the pixel distribution characteristics of the shooting preview image in the image shooting process; acquiring exposure compensation parameters corresponding to each exposure compensation sub-area according to the pixel distribution characteristics of each exposure compensation sub-area; and respectively carrying out exposure compensation on the exposure compensation parameters according to the exposure compensation parameters corresponding to the exposure compensation sub-regions. Compared with the image global exposure compensation in the prior art, the image global exposure compensation method has the advantages that the exposure compensation subareas are divided according to the pixel distribution characteristics of the image, and the corresponding exposure compensation parameters are respectively arranged in each subarea, so that each exposure compensation subarea can obtain appropriate exposure compensation with different degrees, the possibility of occurrence of overexposure and underexposure is effectively reduced, the outline and the stereoscopic impression of the image are enhanced, the imaging quality of the image is improved, and the shooting experience of a user is improved.

title_clean: Refractory brick for kiln tail smoke chamber
abstract_clean: The utility model provides a refractory brick for a kiln tail smoke chamber, which comprises a refractory brick I and a refractory brick II, wherein the refractory brick II is positioned at the top of the refractory brick I; the ventilation assembly is arranged between the first refractory brick and the second refractory brick and comprises a cavity, and a first airflow channel is formed in the first refractory brick so as to discharge hot air in the cavity through the first airflow channel; the positioning assembly is arranged between the first refractory brick and the second refractory brick so as to perform auxiliary connection between the first refractory brick and the second refractory brick through the positioning assembly. title_clean: Method for selection of improved hydrocarbon recovery agents for hydrocarbon revervoirs
abstract_clean: A physical modeling method that includes providing a reservoir core plug, the reservoir core plug having a wellbore interface end, an outlet interface end, and a cylindrical face and saturating the reservoir core plug with hydrocarbon and brine to fonn a saturated core plug. The method also includes positioning the saturated core plug within a flooding apparatus and pumping the fracturing fluid through saturated core plug to displace a portion of the hydrocarbon to fonn a displaced hydrocarbon plug. In addition the method includes positioning the displaced hydrocarbon plug in an imbibition cell and conducting an imbibition test to fonn an imbibed core plug having brine and hydrocarbon. Further the method includes positioning the imbibed core plug in core-flooding apparatus and displacing a portion of the brine and hydrocarbon from the imbibed core plug.

title_clean: Rotor pump rotor with corrosion-resistant rubber lining
abstract_clean: The utility model provides a rotor pump rotor with corrosion resistant lining is glued, belongs to rotor pump technical field, installs in the rotor pump shell, includes: the cooling oil in the oil storage cavity flows back to the oil storage cavity through an oil pipe arranged in the rotor body so as to cool the rotor body; the circulating assembly is arranged between the rotor pump shell and the rotor body and is used for driving cooling oil in a closed space formed by the oil pipe and the oil storage cavity to circularly flow; the bottom plate is fixedly connected with the rotor pump shell; the cooling mechanism is arranged on the bottom plate and is rotationally connected with the rotor body, and cools the cooling oil in the oil storage cavity in the process that the cooling oil circularly flows to cool the rotor body in the working state, so that the rotor of the rotor pump is cooled in the working process of the rotor pump.

title_clean: Method for sealing liquid composite spring
abstract_clean: A method for sealing a liquid composite spring, includes the steps of: placing a sleeve-shaped outer wall around an upper portion of a core shaft, and forming an upper liquid chamber and a lower liquid chamber inside the outer wall; and arranging a sealing member at a bottom of the outer wall to seal the lower liquid chamber, wherein the sealing member is made of flexible material. The liquid composite spring is provided with the rigid outer wall and the flexible sealing member. The volume and shape of the lower liquid chamber can be changed through the flexible sealing member, so that the chamber is formed as a flexible chamber.

title_clean: Straw fiber talcum powder modified polyethylene film blowing grade composite material and preparation method thereof
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a straw fiber talcum powder modified polyethylene film blowing grade composite material, which relates to the technical field of polymer modified materials, and comprises a polyethylene main material, polyolefin auxiliary materials, talcum powder, straw fibers, a coupling agent, a surface modifier and an auxiliary agent; the auxiliary agent at least comprises a compatilizer; the straw fiber is fiber with submicron to nanometer scale after the straw is subjected to high-temperature pyrolysis treatment. The straw fiber talcum powder modified polyethylene film blowing grade composite material provided by the invention utilizes the characteristics of the organic compatibility of straw fibers, the coexisting organic conjugated molecules in talcum powder and the surfactant composition, reduces the surface polarity of talcum powder, improves the compatibility between straw fibers and talcum powder and organic high polymer materials, and simultaneously has the characteristics of low cost and high strength.

title_clean: Dry construction repair mix
