title_clean: Preparation method of ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene fiber
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a preparation method of ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene fibers, which comprises the following steps of dispersing ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene powder and a processing aid in a solvent to obtain a mixed raw material, preheating the mixed raw material, feeding the mixed raw material into a double-screw extruder for spinning to obtain polyethylene sol colloidal filament bundles, cooling the polyethylene sol colloidal filament bundles in cold water, squeezing water to obtain gel filaments, pre-drawing the gel filaments, extracting the gel filaments in an extracting agent at normal temperature, sequentially washing, evaporating and drying after extraction is finished to obtain ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene fiber precursor, and drawing the ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene fiber precursor to obtain the ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene fibers. The invention can solve the problem of poor fluidity in the current ultra-high molecular polyethylene processing, and the polyethylene fiber with excellent creep resistance and ideal mechanical property is prepared.

title_clean: Fuel cell low-temperature starting system based on phase-change heat storage and control method thereof
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a fuel cell low-temperature starting system based on phase change heat storage and a control method thereof, wherein the system comprises a fuel cell electric pile, a thermal management controller, an air system, a cooling liquid circulating system and a hydrogen system, wherein the thermal management controller is respectively in communication connection with the air system, the cooling liquid circulating system and the hydrogen system; the coolant circulation system includes: the device comprises a water pump, a three-way electromagnetic valve, a phase change heat reservoir, a thermostat, a radiator and a temperature sensor. The system has the advantages of high utilization rate of vehicle-mounted energy, quick low-temperature starting and the like, and prolongs the service life of the membrane electrode of the fuel cell to a certain extent.

title_clean: Positive electrode material, preparation method, pole piece and battery
abstract_clean: The invention relates to a positive electrode material, a preparation method, a pole piece and a battery. The positive electrode material comprises a covered wire structure, wherein the covered wire structure comprises a core material and a shell layer which axially covers the core material, the core material comprises a sodium vanadium phosphate material, and the shell layer comprises a sodium ferric pyrophosphate phosphate material. The preparation method of the positive electrode material comprises the following steps of S1, carrying out coaxial electrostatic spinning on a sodium vanadium phosphate spinning solution and a sodium ferric phosphate spinning solution, wherein the sodium vanadium phosphate spinning solution is positioned at an inner layer, the sodium ferric phosphate spinning solution is positioned at an outer layer, and a precursor film is obtained, and S2, carrying out heat treatment on the precursor film under a protective atmosphere. According to the invention, the sodium ferric phosphate material is coated with the sodium vanadium phosphate material to prepare the one-dimensional nano-covered wire structure, and the one-dimensional nano-covered wire structure is used as a positive electrode material in a battery, so that the rate capability and the cycle performance of the battery are improved.

title_clean: Fuel cell system and aircraft
abstract_clean: The invention provides a fuel cell system and an aircraft capable of charging a battery while ensuring independence and redundancy of the fuel cell and the battery as power sources. The fuel cell system is a fuel cell system for an aircraft, and is characterized in that the fuel cell system includes a fuel cell, a battery, a motor, and a control unit, the motor is electrically connected to the fuel cell and the battery as independent power sources and has a dual 3-phase winding using a dual inverter, and the control unit drives the motor at a predetermined 1 st output from the fuel cell and charges the battery with a torque generated by the motor when receiving a normal output request from the motor.

title_clean: Automatic pressure-relief explosion-proof lead-acid storage battery protection mechanism and fixing device
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a lead-acid storage battery protection mechanism capable of automatically relieving pressure and preventing explosion and a fixing device, comprising a box body, a fixing frame arranged on the inner wall of the box body, a fixing plate arranged on the inner wall of the fixing frame, a splayed ring arranged on the inner wall of the fixing plate, an explosion-proof frame arranged on the outer side of the splayed ring, an explosion-proof valve arranged on one side of the explosion-proof frame, and a plurality of anti-explosion valves arranged on the outer side of the explosion-proof frame; the pressure relief assembly comprises a fixed seat arranged at the top of the box body, a pressure relief pipe arranged in the fixed seat, and a fireproof net arranged on the inner wall of the pressure relief pipe. The device solves the problem that the storage battery is easy to explode and burn in the current charge and discharge operation process of the storage battery.

title_clean: Vehicle control method, apparatus, vehicle, and computer-readable storage medium
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a vehicle control method, a device, a vehicle and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when a vehicle detects a ramp identifier, determining whether the vehicle starts a navigation system; if the vehicle does not start a navigation system, acquiring lane line information corresponding to the vehicle; determining whether the vehicle is traveling in a ramp direction based on the lane line information; if it is determined that the vehicle is traveling in the ramp direction, and acquiring ramp speed limit information corresponding to the ramp identification, and outputting the ramp speed limit information. According to the method and the device, whether the vehicle runs towards the ramp direction or not is accurately determined through the lane line information, and the ramp speed limit information is output when the vehicle runs towards the ramp direction, so that the situations of error display and display omission of the ramp speed limit information when the vehicle without starting a navigation system enters the ramp are greatly reduced, and the safety of the vehicle running into the ramp is improved through accurately outputting the ramp speed limit information.

title_clean: Electronic device and method for transmitting data to cluster traveling vehicles
abstract_clean: The invention discloses an electronic device and a method for transmitting data to a cluster traveling vehicle. The electronic device comprises a camera, a communication circuit, a memory for storing a neural network model and instructions, and a processor operatively connected to the camera, the communication circuit and the memory. The instructions, when executed by the processor, enable the electronic device to obtain an image via the camera, identify a first classification result of an object contained in the image using the image and the neural network model, transmit, via the communication circuit, a feature map of the image-based neural network model to an external electronic device contained in a subsequent vehicle on which the electronic device is mounted, obtain, via the communication circuit, a second classification result of the object calculated in the external electronic device based on the feature map from the external electronic device, and determine whether the vehicle is traveling as a preceding vehicle based on the first classification result and the second classification result.

title_clean: Apparatus and method of processing quantum state tomography in quantum information integrated processing system
abstract_clean: The present invention relates to a technology for reducing resources required for estimating a qubit and multi-qubit system based on particle filter-based quantum state tomography, which reduces resources required for estimating a quantum state by introducing efficient adaptive learning of a measurement basis. A quantum state tomography processing device according to an embodiment of the present invention may include: a first layer processing unit that optimizes the measurement settings of the next iteration by using particle distribution in each iteration for the basis tomography of a qubit to apply the particle distribution as a single item in the measurement settings of the next iteration; and a second layer processing unit that reduces the number of the measurement setting sets by using measurement results of the measurement setting sets according to the optimized measurement settings of the next iteration.

title_clean: Method for operating an automated vehicle, and automated vehicle
abstract_clean: The present invention relates to a method for operating an automatically driving vehicle (1), comprising: - determining predefined vehicle parameters of the automatically driving vehicle (1) by a determination device (2) of the automatically driving vehicle (1), - determining a first vehicle parameter of the automatically driving vehicle (1) by a control device (3) of the automatically driving vehicle (1), - determining a first surroundings parameter of surroundings (U) of the automatically driving vehicle (1) by the control device (3), - determining, by the control device (3), whether a predefined trigger criterion is met by the combination of the first vehicle parameter and the first surroundings parameter, and - further processing the determined predefined vehicle parameters by the control device (3) if the trigger criterion is met. The invention further relates to an automatically driving vehicle (1).

title_clean: Portable WIFI signal detection device
abstract_clean: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic components, in particular to a portable WIFI signal detection device, which comprises a box body, wherein the box body is provided with: the box body base is arranged at the bottom of the box body; the bearing base disc is arranged in an inner cavity of the box body and loaded on the box body base, a loading frame is arranged on the box body base, an adjusting assembly is arranged between an installation surface of the bearing base disc and the loading frame, and the adjusting assembly is used for adjusting an adjusting inclination angle of the bearing base disc; the turnover frame is arranged on the side edge of the box body base and can be rotatably installed; the box covering frame is designed to be of a four-side frame type structure; the cover box closing frame, the box body base and the turnover frame are combined in an interference fit mode and can be installed on the top of the turnover frame in a turnover mode. The invention is convenient for operators to carry and transfer, and has comprehensive detection function so as to be convenient for matching with a production line production system.

title_clean: Signal transmission method and communication apparatus
abstract_clean: This application provides a signal transmission method and a communication apparatus, so that SSBs with different periodicities can be flexibly sent based on an actual network parameter. This helps improve an access success rate, a handover success rate, and service stability of a terminal device, and reduce a proportion of time domain resources occupied by the SSB. The method includes: A first network device determines, based on a current network parameter, a sending quantity or sending duration of a synchronization signal and physical broadcast channel block SSB with a first periodicity; and the first network device sends, on a basis of sending an SSB with a second periodicity, the SSB with the first periodicity based on the sending quantity or the sending duration, where the first periodicity is less than or equal to 20 ms, and the second periodicity is greater than or equal to 40 ms.

title_clean: Method for eliminating direct current offset between electrodes of electroencephalogram acquisition equipment by digital-analog mixed DSL technology
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a method for eliminating direct current offset between electrodes of an electroencephalogram acquisition device by using a digital-analog mixed DSL technology, which relates to electroencephalogram signal processing and comprises the steps of transmitting an electroencephalogram acquisition input signal to a signal amplification module for amplification processing to obtain a first amplified electroencephalogram signal, processing the first amplified electroencephalogram signal through an analog direct current servo loop module to obtain a second analog direct current component, transmitting the electroencephalogram acquisition input signal to a digital direct current servo loop module to obtain a first digital direct current component, converting the first digital direct current component and the second analog direct current component into alternating current through a capacitor and a chopper modulation module to be offset with alternating current at an input end, transmitting the first amplified electroencephalogram signal to a programmable gain amplification module for secondary amplification processing to obtain a second amplified electroencephalogram signal, inputting the second amplified electroencephalogram signal to an anti-aliasing filter, converting the analog signal to a digital processing module for processing. The invention shortens the time for counteracting EDO at the input end, and the sampling rate of the analog-to-digital converter in the digital servo loop is very low, so that the power consumption of the digital servo loop is very small, and the problems that the high EDO inhibition range and the low input reference noise are difficult to realize, and the time constant of an integrator in the traditional analog direct current servo loop is too large and the EDO counteracting time is too long are effectively solved.

title_clean: Ultra-wideband phase-shifting circuit
abstract_clean: The invention discloses an ultra-wideband phase-shifting circuit which comprises a first single-pole double-throw switch circuit, a second single-pole double-throw switch circuit, a full-pass filter circuit and a band-pass filter circuit. According to the invention, broadband phase shifting is realized by switching the single-pole double-throw switch between the all-pass filter circuit and the band-pass filter circuit, a phase shifting path realizes a required broadband lagging phase based on a magnetic coupling all-pass network structure, the order of a reference state high-pass element is reasonably selected by utilizing the phase advance characteristic of the high-pass element according to the phase shifting amount to be realized, and a wider phase-frequency characteristic bandwidth can be realized; series resonance and parallel resonance in the band-pass network improve the inherent phase nonlinear characteristics of the high-pass element at a low frequency end and a high frequency end, and further widen the phase bandwidth; the single-pole double-throw switch circuit and the phase-shifting network are designed in a matching mode, so that smaller insertion loss and area can be realized. The phase-shifting circuit has the characteristics of wide working bandwidth, small insertion loss, compact circuit structure and stable performance.

title_clean: Nanopore sensing device, components and method of operation
abstract_clean: Devices for improved nanopore sensing are described. An example device has a structure arranged to separate an analyte reservoir and an outlet chamber. An example device has a structure arranged to separate an analyte reservoir and an outlet chamber. The structure can include an array of nanopore structures, each nanopore structure comprising a passage for fluid connection through the structure between the analyte reservoir and outlet chamber. Control terminals can be arranged for applying a control signal to alter the electrical potential difference across that nanopore structure. Some embodiments include an electronic circuit configured to detect a signal from an electrical transduction element at each nanopore structure. Additional structural features and methods of operating and making the devices are described.

title_clean: Polysaccharide modified phospholipid complex and preparation method thereof
abstract_clean: The invention relates to a polysaccharide-modified medicinal phospholipid compound, wherein the medicinal phospholipid compound is prepared from a medicament and phospholipid, the medicament comprises oxymatrine and glycyrrhizin, and the polysaccharide modification is to modify the medicinal phospholipid compound by chitosan and then modify the medicinal phospholipid compound coated with chitosan by hyaluronic acid. The polysaccharide modified medicinal phospholipid complex can enhance medicinal aggregation in tumor cells through synergistic effect and active targeting effect, and remarkably improves the antitumor effect of the medicaments.

title_clean: Method for anticoagulant therapy and prevention of thrombotic complications in patients with severe brain damage in a chronic critical condition
abstract_clean: FIELD: medicine. SUBSTANCE: invention relates to medicine, namely neurology, and can be used in the treatment and prevention of thrombotic complications in patients with severe brain damage in a chronic critical condition. The method includes the administration of oral anticoagulants rivaroxaban or dabigatran in the absence of contraindications in the form of gastrointestinal dysfunction, severe hepatic or renal insufficiency, severe thrombocytopenia less than 100x10 9 /l: Rivaroxaban orally at a therapeutic dose of 15 mg 2 t/day for 21 days, followed by a dose reduction to prophylactic 20 mg/day or Dabigatran etexilate orally at a therapeutic dose of 110-150 mg 2 t/day up to 6 months, followed by a reduction in the dose to the preventive 110-150 mg/day. With thrombocytopenia 100-200×10 9 /l, a prophylactic dose of drugs is prescribed: Rivaroxaban 10-20 mg/day or Dabigatran etexilate 110-150 mg/day until thrombocytopenia is eliminated. The introduction of anticoagulants is canceled 48 hours before the planned surgical intervention and no later than 12 hours before the start of an urgent operation and is prescribed again 12 hours after the completion of surgical treatment. EFFECT: use of the invention makes it possible to reduce the risk of complications, reduce the side effects of anticoagulant therapy, and shorten the duration of treatment. 1 cl, 6 ex

title_clean: Molecular metal-based single crystalline thin film, component having same, and method for manufacturing single crystalline thin film
abstract_clean: Provided is a molecular metal-based single crystalline thin film having high electrical conductivity and high light transmittance. The molecular metal-based single crystalline thin film has a light transmittance of 80% or more at a wavelength of 360-830 nm, wherein the molecular metal is a compound represented by Formula (I). In Formula (II), * represents a bonding position, and R 11 represents a hydrogen atom or a C1-4 alkyl group.

title_clean: Liquid crystal display device having a plurality of pixel electrodes
abstract_clean: The embodiment of the utility model discloses liquid crystal display device, through optimizing the center structure, first supporting part and the sub-supporting part of second form first stair structure promptly to and the setting is used for dodging the light that the backlight sent so that the light that the backlight sent incides the portion of dodging to the marginal area of diffuser plate, can make the light that the light source sent effectively reach the module edge, avoid the problem that light was sheltered from.

title_clean: Indoor cultivation pool fish yield increasing cultivation lamp
abstract_clean: The invention discloses an indoor cultivation pool fish yield increasing cultivation lamp, and relates to the technical field of cultivation lamps. This indoor pond fish yield increase breed lamp, including breeding lamp body and fixed roof, the fixed orifices that corresponds the setting about both sides all have been seted up around the fixed roof upper surface, four fixed orifices all run through the lower surface of fixed roof, the transmission shaft drives two first gears and rotates, two first gears drive the connecting axle through the second gear and rotate left, the connecting axle drives two fixed sleeves and the first spliced pole that is connected with it and rotates left, two fixed sleeves and the first spliced pole that is connected with it drive the protective housing whole and move left, thereby change the irradiation direction of breeding the lamp body, through the rotation direction of control first motor, realize the regulation to breed lamp body illumination angle, avoid the appearance of illumination blind area, improve the practicality of this breed lamp, thereby make things convenient for the night to the observation and the throwing feed of shoal of fish, it is more convenient to make the shoal of fish.

title_clean: Photodetection device, method for manufacturing photodetection device, and electronic apparatus
abstract_clean: The present disclosure relates to a photodetection device, a method of manufacturing the photodetection device, and an electronic device, which are capable of improving a light condensing effect of a microlens in units of pixels and improving optical characteristics. The photodetection device includes pixels each including a photoelectric conversion section that photoelectrically converts incident light, a microlens that condenses the incident light on the photoelectric conversion section, and a plurality of protrusions formed on the microlens. The pixels each include two or more of the protrusions in which at least one of a width, a height, or a density is different. The present disclosure can be applied to, for example, a solid-state imaging device or the like.

title_clean: Safe charging method, system and power supply
abstract_clean: The application relates to a safe charging method, a safe charging system and a safe charging power supply, which belong to the technical field of charging power supplies, and the safe charging method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first voltage value of an output end of a charging circuit, wherein the output end of the charging circuit is connected with one end of a switching circuit, and the other end of the switching circuit is used for being connected with a battery to be charged; acquiring a second voltage value at the other end of the switching circuit; and switching on the switching circuit in response to the first voltage value being within a first preset interval and the second voltage value being within a second preset interval. According to the charging method and device, in the charging process, electric shock accidents caused by the fact that a user contacts with a charging port can be effectively prevented, the battery is effectively prevented from being damaged due to overvoltage or undervoltage faults of a charging circuit or mismatching between a battery to be charged and a charging power supply, the battery is protected when the user is protected, the charging safety of the battery is improved, and potential safety hazards of the user when the user uses the charging power supply are reduced.

title_clean: Air conditioner, control method and device thereof and readable storage medium
abstract_clean: The invention discloses an air conditioner control method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring the current total current of the electricity environment where the air conditioner is located and acquiring the target frequency of the last frequency reduction operation of the air conditioner; when the total current is in a preset interval, determining the current target frequency of the air conditioner according to the total current and the target frequency of the last frequency reduction operation; and reducing the operating frequency of the air conditioner according to the determined target frequency. The invention also discloses an air conditioner control device, an air conditioner and a readable storage medium. The invention is closer to the operating characteristic of the circuit on-off device, improves the effective utilization degree of the electric quantity in the power utilization environment, and more reliably prevents the circuit on-off device from tripping.

title_clean: Comprehensive optimization method for train speed curve and timetable under reversible traction power supply system
abstract_clean: The invention provides a comprehensive optimization method of a train speed curve and a timetable under a reversible traction power supply system, which belongs to the technical field of urban rail train energy-saving operation.

title_clean: Switching frequency controller, voltage converter, and method for controlling switching frequency
abstract_clean: A switching frequency controller, a voltage converter, and a method are used for controlling switching frequency. The switching frequency controller includes a frequency divider, a frequency detector, an accumulation counter, and an on-time controller. The frequency divider generates a divisional signal having a divisional frequency according to an input signal having a target frequency. The target frequency is 2 N times of the divisional frequency. The frequency detector receives the divisional frequency and a switching control signal, and calculate a number of periods that pass by during each cycle of the divisional signal. The number of periods is represented by (N+1) bits. The accumulation counter increases or decreases a control indication value by a predetermined value according to a most significant bit of the number of periods. The on-time controller adjusts an on-time length of the switching control signal according to the control indication value.

title_clean: Preparation method of filamentous fungus-derived PDRN product, product and application thereof
abstract_clean: The invention relates to a preparation method of a filamentous fungus-derived PDRN product, and a product and application thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the steps of suspending a filamentous fungus mycelium in a buffer solution for homogenization treatment, and then mixing and incubating the mycelium with glycoside hydrolase, protease and ribonuclease to obtain an enzymolysis mixed solution; centrifuging the enzymolysis mixed solution after high-temperature and high-pressure treatment, collecting supernatant, passing the supernatant through an ultrafiltration membrane, removing sediment from filtrate by adopting a sodium acetate ethanol precipitation method, collecting supernatant, carrying out ethanol precipitation treatment on the supernatant, and collecting sediment to obtain the filamentous fungus-derived PDRN product. The preparation process realizes the large-scale preparation of the high-yield high-purity small-molecular-weight PDRN with narrow molecular weight distribution range from the filamentous fungi for the first time, and the filamentous fungi-derived PDRN product has extremely high skin permeability and bioavailability, can more effectively penetrate through the skin stratum corneum, and plays a plurality of biological effects.

title_clean: Method for extracting atractylodes macrocephala polysaccharide by using microbial fermentation method
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a method for extracting atractylodes macrocephala polysaccharide by using a microbial fermentation method, which comprises the following steps: inoculating Rhizopus oryzae (Rhizopus oryzae) GDMCC No:60990 spore in Atractylodis rhizoma powder containing sterile water, fermenting at 28-30 deg.C for 2-3d, ultrasonic extracting the fermented product with water, and concentrating to obtain concentrate; precipitating the concentrate with ethanol and vacuum drying to obtain crude polysaccharide of Atractylodis rhizoma. The fermentation pretreatment of rhizopus oryzae CH5 is added in advance of the ultrasonic treatment of the atractylodes macrocephala polysaccharide. Rhizopus oryzae CH5 grows moderately in Atractylodis rhizoma powder to produce polysaccharide hydrolase, which can hydrolyze insoluble polysaccharide structure tissue of Atractylodes macrocephala, promote dissociation of soluble polysaccharide in binding state, and is more easily dissolved out during hot water ultrasonic extraction. Compared with the conventional method without fermentation pretreatment, the extraction yield of the atractylodes macrocephala polysaccharide can be improved by more than 50%.

title_clean: Green algal bestrophin bicarbonate transporters

title_clean: Histidine decarboxylase expression plasmid and application thereof
abstract_clean: The invention discloses an expression plasmid of histidine decarboxylase and application thereof, wherein the expression plasmid is constructed by selecting proper expression vectors pET-28a plasmid, pACYCDuet-sfp plasmid or pTrc-p99A plasmid, so as to obtain corresponding recombinant genetically engineered bacteria, and the histamine is synthesized by using a biological enzyme method to catalyze, so that the recombinant genetically engineered bacteria are more environment-friendly than the existing chemical synthesis method.

title_clean: XPS heated board extrusion equipment and extrusion line
abstract_clean: The invention discloses XPS insulation board extrusion equipment and an extrusion production line, which comprise a primary feeding belt, a secondary feeding belt, a cooling assembly and a supporting assembly, wherein the supporting assembly comprises a movable roller which is rotatably arranged, a pointed part is arranged on the circumference of the movable roller to form a supporting groove, the movable roller is driven to rotate so that the pointed part sequentially supports against the lower part of a material, and a cutting knife which keeps driven to keep vertical reciprocating movement. According to the XPS insulation board extrusion equipment and the extrusion production line, the material is cooled by the cooling component to reduce the elasticity of the material, and the pointed parts of the movable rollers are propped against the two sides of the cutting point of the material by the cutting knife, so that the traditional cutting mode of mutually approaching the cutting knife and the surface is changed into a mode that the cutting knife is vertically cut downwards, the two sides of the cutting position of the cutting knife are material supporting points, and the problem that the cutting surface is uneven due to deformation caused by extrusion of the upper side and the lower side of the cutting point of the material during cutting is avoided.

title_clean: Steel pipe flange welding positioning machine

title_clean: Aluminum alloys for fluxless brazing applications, methods of making the same, and uses thereof

title_clean: Multi-station rotary disc type full-automatic screw machine
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a multi-station rotating disc type full-automatic screw machine, which belongs to the field of screw machines, wherein a regulating valve and a product clamp are matched with each other, negative pressure is generated in the regulating valve in the actual use process, one part of the negative pressure enters an inner ring chamber and an adsorption bin and adsorbs a workpiece, the other part of the negative pressure enters an outer ring chamber and a detection bin and is sucked in an air way through an unlocked screw hole, when a screw fed by a locking mechanism moves downwards, the screw hole can be aligned by utilizing the air suction operation, the locking precision of the screw hole is improved, after the screw hole on the workpiece is sequentially locked, the screw hole is closed due to the locking of the screw, the air suction action disappears, the adsorption force transmitted to a valve core is increased at the moment, the valve core is driven to overcome the elastic force of a tensioning spring to move downwards, the adsorption force disappears, and the unloading is convenient.

title_clean: Respiratory pressure device
abstract_clean: The present invention relates to a respiratory pressure device (4000) comprising a pressure generator (4140) for supplying a flow of air at positive pressure and an apparatus (5000) for humidifying the flow of air integrated in the respiratory pressure device. title_clean: Medical multifunctional treatment cabin
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a medical multifunctional treatment cabin, which comprises a treatment cabin body, wherein the treatment cabin body comprises a cabin body and a cabin door which is matched with the cabin body to form a closed cavity; the cabin parameter detection device is arranged on the treatment cabin body and is used for detecting parameters in the cabin; the digital display and parameter control device is arranged on the treatment cabin body and is used for displaying and controlling parameters in the cabin; and the main control device is respectively connected with the parameter detection device in the cabin and the digital display and parameter control device, controls the digital display and parameter control device to display the parameters in the cabin, and triggers the alarm device to alarm when the parameters in the cabin of the parameter detection device in the cabin exceed the preset parameter range in the cabin. title_clean: Oxygen concentration control method and device of breathing machine and breathing machine
abstract_clean: The invention relates to an oxygen concentration control method and device of a breathing machine and the breathing machine, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first corresponding relation between the sampling voltage and the oxygen concentration under a first airway pressure and a second corresponding relation between the sampling voltage and the oxygen concentration under a second airway pressure; acquiring a corresponding relation between the airway pressure and a deviation value of the sampling voltage according to the first corresponding relation and the second corresponding relation; obtaining a deviation value corresponding to the current sampling voltage according to the current airway pressure and the corresponding relation between the airway pressure and the deviation value of the sampling voltage; obtaining the current oxygen concentration of the breathing machine according to the current sampling voltage, the deviation value corresponding to the current sampling voltage and the first corresponding relation; and controlling the breathing machine to adjust the ratio of the oxygen flow and the air flow in the total gas flow according to the current oxygen concentration and a preset target oxygen concentration. title_clean: Sheet processing equipment and sheet production line
abstract_clean: The disclosure relates to the technical field of semiconductors and photovoltaics, in particular to sheet processing equipment and a sheet production line, and solves the problems of low process efficiency and poor process effect in the process of processing sheets on carriers in a reaction cavity in the related art. The sheet material processing equipment is provided with at least one processing position and comprises a carrier and processing components, wherein the carrier is provided with a containing cavity, the carrier is provided with a concave which is concave towards the containing cavity at a position between every two adjacent sheet materials, each processing component is provided with at least one processing part, at least part of the processing part can extend into the corresponding concave, so that the processing part passes through the carrier surrounding the concave part to act on the adjacent sheet materials. The sheet material process equipment and the sheet material production line can improve the process efficiency and the process effect on the sheet material.

title_clean: Memory device and method of manufacturing the same
abstract_clean: A memory device and a manufacturing method thereof are provided, wherein the memory device comprises a first electrode, a resistance transformation layer, a cover layer, a protection layer and a second electrode. The resistance transition layer is arranged above the first electrode. The cover layer is arranged above the resistance transition layer, wherein the bottom surface of the cover layer is smaller than the top surface of the resistance transition layer. The protection layer is disposed above the resistance transformation layer and surrounds the cap layer. At least a portion of the second electrode is disposed over the cap layer and covers the protective layer. The invention can prevent the cover layer from being damaged by the subsequent manufacturing process by arranging the protective layer surrounding the cover layer on the memory device, thereby improving the reliability of the memory device and increasing the manufacturing process allowance.

title_clean: Method for improving field nondestructive current carrying capacity of REBCO high-temperature superconducting material and treated REBCO high-temperature superconducting material
abstract_clean: The invention provides a method for improving the field nondestructive current carrying capacity of REBCO high-temperature superconducting materials and the treated REBCO high-temperature superconducting materials, and belongs to the field of high-temperature superconducting materials. The method comprises the steps of carrying out twice irradiation on REBCO high-temperature superconducting materials by utilizing a fast heavy ion beam, and changing the incidence angle of the fast heavy ions in the twice irradiation, so that columnar defects which are distributed in a crossing way are introduced into REBCO, the movement of vortex kinks is restrained, and the field lossless current carrying capacity of the REBCO high-temperature superconducting materials is improved.

title_clean: Manufacturing method of sensing die encapsulated by encapsulant with roughness surface having hollow region

title_clean: Multistage drying device is used in agricultural product production

title_clean: Paper machine dryer scraper equipment for pillow-pack base paper processing

title_clean: Packaging box
abstract_clean: The invention relates to the technical field of packaging, and particularly discloses a packaging box. Wherein, the packing carton is formed by paper material is folding to be used for packing lamp decoration and lamp decoration's accessory, the packing carton includes box and interior card subassembly.
