First buffer layer, inner wall buffer layer and second buffer layer cladding lamp decoration to fixed and buffering lamp decoration, and then avoid the direct contact of lamp decoration and box, further guarantee the buffering effect of lamp decoration, avoid increasing other buffer material and lead to packing carton manufacturing cost to increase.

title_clean: Spiral tensioning device support frame for reversible belt conveyor
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a spiral tensioning device support frame for a reversible belt conveyor, which comprises a channel steel track, wherein the outer sides of two end parts of the channel steel track are respectively and fixedly provided with a baffle and a screw mounting plate, and the screw mounting plate is matched with a screw in a spiral tensioning device for use; two connecting seats are fixedly arranged on two side surfaces of the channel steel track, are arranged in pairs and are respectively close to the baffle and the screw mounting plate; the length of the channel steel track is larger than the working length of the screw. The utility model has simple structure and convenient use, and can meet the spiral tensioning requirement and the conveying requirement of the reversible belt conveyor; meanwhile, the tensioning capacity and tensioning effect of the spiral tensioning device can be ensured.

title_clean: Pretreatment system and method for directly reducing raw material gas by coke oven gas
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a pretreatment system and a pretreatment method for directly reducing raw material gas by coke oven gas, wherein the pretreatment system comprises a primary compression unit, a deep purification unit and a secondary compression unit; the first-stage compression unit comprises a first-stage compressor, a filter, a heat exchanger and a No. 1 gas-liquid separation tank; the coke oven gas pipeline is communicated with the inlet of the first-stage compressor through the filter, the outlet of the first-stage compressor is communicated with the inlet of the heat exchanger, and the outlet of the heat exchanger is communicated with the No. 1 gas-liquid separation tank; the deep purification comprises a deep purification adsorption tower and a filter; the outlet of the No. 1 gas-liquid separation tank is communicated with the inlet of the deep purification adsorption tower, the outlet of the deep purification adsorption tower is communicated with the inlet of the filter, and the outlet of the filter is communicated with the direct reduction heating furnace; the secondary compression unit comprises a secondary compressor, a cooling tower and a No. 2 gas-liquid separation tank. The system fully considers the requirements of the direct reduction process, adopts the coupling of graded compression and deep purification, and can effectively improve the purification effect.

title_clean: Preparation method of high-hydrophobicity ozonolysis catalyst
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a preparation method of a high-hydrophobicity ozonolysis catalyst, which comprises the following steps: A. mixing materials; a1, firstly, selecting manganese sulfate, ferric nitrate, copper nitrate and silver nitrate, then mixing the materials with ionized water, and then drying the mixture; a2, drying the mixed material by a dryer to obtain a solid material, then roasting, and finally grinding by a grinder to obtain the supported molecular sieve powder. According to the invention, the activity of the catalyst is improved through manganese sulfate, ferric nitrate, copper nitrate and silver nitrate, the hydrophobicity of aerogel is further improved by treating the powder loaded with the molecular sieve and the surface of gel with trimethylchlorosilane, so that the condition that water vapor is condensed on the surface of the catalyst is avoided, and the problem that the catalyst used in a catalytic decomposition method is easy to adsorb moisture in high-humidity tail gas, so that the performance of the catalyst is reduced and even loses efficacy is solved.

title_clean: Silica in rock samples
abstract_clean: A method comprises determining an amount of excess silica and/or an amount of terrigenous silica in a rock sample taking into account a measurement indicative of an amount of silica in the rock sample and a measurement indicative of an amount of zirconium in the rock sample.

title_clean: Vanadium-phosphorus-loaded catalyst and preparation method thereof
abstract_clean: The invention relates to a supported vanadium-phosphorus catalyst and a preparation method thereof, and solves the problems that the strength of the catalyst is low in specific surface area and the performance of the supported catalyst is seriously reduced in the prior art. The method comprises the following steps: 1) treating the composite carrier with inorganic acid; 2) adding a certain amount of vanadium solution into the carrier prepared in the step 1, and soaking to obtain a precursor A; 3) mixing the precursor A, an organic solvent, phosphoric acid and an optional element compound, heating to reflux, keeping for 3-24h, filtering, washing, drying, and roasting at the temperature of not more than 300 ℃ for 1-20h to obtain a catalyst precursor B; 4) and roasting the precursor B in the atmosphere with special composition at the temperature of 350-500 ℃ to obtain the final catalyst. The load catalyst prepared by the invention has better catalytic performance and can be used for the selective oxidation reaction of low-carbon alkane.

title_clean: Fluorine-reducing tea rubbing machine based on tea leaf manufacturing
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to a rub tea machine technical field, specifically be for fall fluorine and rub tea machine based on tealeaves preparation, including workstation, machine of twisting, be provided with the cooperation on the workstation and rub the take-up (stock) pan that the machine was kneaded to tealeaves, be provided with the drive on the workstation and rub the actuating mechanism that the machine was kneaded, be provided with the automatic mechanism of adding water and fall fluorine on the workstation, the mechanism of adding water includes the water tank, the inside of water tank is provided with the closing plate, the inside of water tank is provided with the water pump, the drain pipe is installed to the water outlet end of water pump, drain pipe and closing plate through connection, drain pipe and take-up (stock) pan through connection, the mechanism of adding water still includes the wash port of seting up on the take-up (stock) pan, rotate on the water tank and install the switch shaft, the utility model aims to provide fall fluorine based on tealeaves preparation and rub tea machine, through the application of water treatment and hydrologic cycle in falling fluorine work, saved a large amount of water resources, reduced the cost that tealeaves falls fluorine processing.

title_clean: Vertical dredge pump with prevent blockking up function
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a vertical sewage pump with an anti-blocking function, which comprises a buffer seat, fixing plates and a sewage pump body, wherein the lower end of the sewage pump body comprises a water inlet pipe, a rotating shaft is rotatably installed in the water inlet pipe, blades are installed on the rotating shaft, the two fixing plates are symmetrically installed at the side end of the sewage pump body, a supporting seat is welded at the lower end of each fixing plate, the buffer seat is installed at the lower end of the supporting seat, a buffer cavity is arranged in the buffer seat, a second buffer spring is installed on the inner wall of the side end in the buffer cavity, first buffer springs which are symmetrically distributed are installed on the inner wall of the bottom end of the buffer cavity, a supporting plate is installed at the upper end of each first buffer spring, a buffer groove is formed in the upper end of the buffer seat, the supporting seat extends into the buffer cavity from the buffer groove, and the lower end of the supporting seat is in contact with the upper end face of the supporting plate. The utility model has the advantages of anti-blocking function, buffering and vibration damping function and capability of effectively prolonging the service life of equipment.

title_clean: Geochemical analysis of drainage basins
abstract_clean: Techniques for determining a mineralogy of a portion of a drainage basin include identifying topography data associated with a drainage basin comprising at least one body of water; identifying weather data associated with the drainage basin; identifying first sensor data associated with a first water sensor installed in the drainage basin; identifying second sensor data associated with a second water sensor that is located downstream of the first water sensor in the drainage basin; providing the first sensor data, second sensor data, topography data, and weather data as input to a machine learning algorithm; and determining, by the machine learning algorithm, a mineralogy of a portion of the drainage basin.

title_clean: Roots vacuum pump sealing water treatment system
abstract_clean: The embodiment of the utility model provides a Roots vacuum pump sealing water treatment system, and belongs to the technical field of energy supply equipment for production of neutral borosilicate glass. The Roots vacuum pump sealing water treatment system comprises: the water tank, the working shaft, the vacuum pump, and first water storage bucket, wherein, this working shaft is used for pumping the sealed water in the water tank for this sealed water flows into the vacuum pump appearance intracavity of this vacuum pump through the sealed water entry of vacuum pump, and this sealed water flows in the first water storage bucket and discharges through the drain valve after the sealed rotor of vacuum pump, and this system still includes: a sealing water recycling unit for realizing recycling of sealing water, the unit comprising: a return pipe connected to the water tank from the front end of the drain valve; and a water return pump in the water return pipe for pumping back the sealing water from the first water storage tank to the water tank. The utility model has the advantages of saving water resources, timely and automatically supplementing sealing water, reducing manpower, controlling water return quantity, saving electric energy and the like.

title_clean: Shape correction die for yaw brake pad
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a correction die for a yaw brake pad, and relates to the technical field of manufacturing dies. The sizing die comprises an upper pressure head, a finishing middle die and a top head. The finishing middle die is a shaping die with the function of changing the shape of the support back plate, the finishing middle die can enable the support back plate to be plastically deformed in the finishing middle die, and the outline shape is changed. The finishing middle die is provided with a through hole, the upper pressure head can be pressed into the through hole from the upper part, and the top head can be pressed into the through hole from the lower part. The lower surface of the upper pressure head is perpendicular to the axis of the through hole. Grooves are formed in two sides of the through hole of the finishing middle die, and the width of the grooves is larger than that of the protruding structure of the supporting backboard. A balance plate is arranged in the groove. The stand column is arranged at the middle lower part of the balance plate, and the balance plate can be pressed down by the convex structure to move. The shape correction die can correct the shape of the support backboard under the condition of not contacting the friction material, optimize the roundness of the support backboard and ensure the shape correction accuracy.

title_clean: Control arm device and shaft sleeve assembly of double-A control arm suspension system
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to a control arm device and a shaft sleeve component of a double A control arm suspension system, wherein the shaft sleeve component comprises a bushing provided with a first perforation and an adjusting shaft which can be rotationally clamped in the first perforation by external force and is provided with a second perforation, the central axis of the second perforation deviates from the central axis of the first perforation in parallel, the control arm device comprises a control arm and two shaft sleeve components, the control arm comprises a front end part for installing a joint and two rear end parts, the rear end parts are respectively provided with a mounting hole, the mounting holes are coaxially corresponding, and the bushings of the shaft sleeve component are respectively arranged in the mounting holes of the control arm in a tight fit manner. The shaft sleeve assembly and the control arm device can be applied to an upper control arm of a double A control arm suspension system, can adjust the camber angle of a wheel, and have good structural strength.

title_clean: Handgun safe dismantling mechanism
abstract_clean: A handgun, including a safety lever for disengaging a sear, the safety lever located under a slide of the handgun and extending along a longitudinal axis within a body of the handgun, wherein the safety lever includes a) a sear switch located external to the body of the handgun, and is configured to be positioned by a user in one of at least two positions along the longitudinal axis of the handgun and configured to move the safety lever with the sear switch to an elected position; (b) a sear tab at a rear end of the safety lever near a sear of the handgun, wherein when the sear switch is in a first position the sear tab does not interfere with the action of the sear and when in a second position the sear tab causes the sear to tilt so that the sear is disengaged and cannot come in contact with a striker of the handgun to fire a bullet.

title_clean: Rotating shaft mechanism and electronic equipment
abstract_clean: The application provides a rotating shaft mechanism and electronic equipment. The gear comprises a middle beam, a synchronous gear, a first swing arm and a second swing arm, wherein the synchronous gear comprises a first gear and a second gear which are meshed and mounted on the middle beam and are respectively connected with the first swing arm and the second swing arm, the first gear comprises a first tooth, the first tooth comprises a first end and a second end which are oppositely arranged in the tooth width direction of the first tooth, the second gear comprises a second tooth, the second tooth comprises a third end and a fourth end which are oppositely arranged in the tooth width direction of the second tooth, the third end and the first end are positioned on one side of the synchronous gear, the fourth end and the second end are positioned on the other side of the synchronous gear, the tooth top thickness of the first tooth gradually changes from the first end to the second end, the tooth top thickness of the second tooth gradually changes from the third end to the fourth end, and the change trend of the tooth top thickness of the second tooth is opposite to that of the first tooth. The synchronous structure of the technical scheme of the application has good synchronous effect and is easy to realize synchronous rotation of the structures at the two sides of the rotating shaft.

title_clean: Automatic energy-saving control system of electrical engineering suitable for thermal power plant
abstract_clean: The invention provides an automatic energy-saving control system for electrical engineering of a thermal power plant, and relates to the technical field of automation. An electrical engineering automation energy-saving control system suitable for a thermal power plant comprises: the prediction module is used for respectively determining the output predicted value of the thermal power generating unit, the output predicted value of the thermal power station and the power load predicted value at each prediction moment, and determining the plant-level AGC instruction predicted value of the thermal power plant at each prediction moment; the emission detection module is used for detecting sulfur dioxide, carbon monoxide, nitrogen dioxide, O2, dust, hydride, fluoride and mercuride, as well as temperature, flue gas flow, pressure, flue gas oxygen content and flue gas moisture content; the monitoring module is used for monitoring combustion state data in the boiler; and the full-power automatic energy-saving control module is used for calculating the calculated value of the active power of each thermal power plant generator set when the total standard coal consumption of the whole thermal power plant is minimum. The coal powder feeding control system can automatically control coal powder feeding amount and other control parameters.

title_clean: Nitrogen cooling structure of furnace temperature-equalizing fan
abstract_clean: The invention provides a nitrogen cooling structure of a temperature equalizing fan for a furnace, which comprises a heating furnace, the temperature equalizing fan, a nitrogen inlet main pipeline and a nitrogen outlet main pipeline, wherein the temperature equalizing fan is connected to the top of the heating furnace and is connected with the nitrogen inlet main pipeline, and the temperature equalizing fan is connected with the nitrogen outlet main pipeline.

title_clean: Apparatus for decommissioning pressure heavy water reactor facilities
abstract_clean: The present invention relates to an apparatus for dismantling a heavy water reactor facility, which comprises: a withdrawal unit for withdrawing a double tube including a calandria tube extending in a horizontal direction inside a calandria supported by a calandria vault and a pressure tube positioned inside the calandria tube, in the horizontal direction from the calandria; a heating unit disposed adjacent to the calandria in the horizontal direction, and heating the double tube withdrawn from the calandria by the withdrawal unit; a compression cutting unit disposed adjacent to the heating unit in the horizontal direction, compressing the heated double tube and cutting the same into a chip-shaped cut object; and a packaging unit positioned at a lower side of the compression cutting unit, and packaging the cut object dropped from the compression cutting unit. Therefore, the calandria tube and the pressure tube positioned inside the calandria are withdrawn to the outside to be dismantled.

title_clean: Air guide structure of wall-mounted air conditioner indoor unit and wall-mounted air conditioner indoor unit
abstract_clean: The utility model provides an air guide structure of an indoor unit of a wall-mounted air conditioner and the indoor unit of the wall-mounted air conditioner, and relates to the technical field of air conditioners. The air deflector is rotatably arranged at the air outlet of the indoor unit of the wall-mounted air conditioner, the air deflector is provided with a first position for guiding air flow at the air outlet and a second position below the shell of the indoor unit of the wall-mounted air conditioner, and a drainage channel is defined with the bottom of the shell when the air deflector is positioned at the second position, so that the ambient air flowing through the drainage channel is converged with the air flow at the air outlet, the function of the air deflector can be increased, the air deflector can guide air and the practicability of the air deflector is improved.

title_clean: Waste liquid container and fitting
abstract_clean: The invention provides a waste liquid container and a fitting capable of preventing waste liquid leaked from a waste liquid introducing part from adhering to a contact part of a limited part. A waste liquid container (50) is provided with: a waste liquid introduction section (56) connected to the discharge section when the waste liquid container (50) is mounted in the mounting section; a storage section that stores the waste liquid discharged from the discharge section; and a restricted portion (53) having a contact portion capable of contacting the restricting portion, wherein the restricted portion restricts movement of the waste liquid container (50) in a removal direction opposite to the mounting direction by the contact portion contacting the restricting portion in a state where the waste liquid container (50) is mounted in the mounting portion, and the contact portion is disposed at a position not overlapping with an opening center of the waste liquid introducing portion (56) in a vertical direction when viewed from a side where the waste liquid introducing portion (56) is opened.

title_clean: Control device for vehicle
abstract_clean: The present invention relates to a control device for a vehicle, which is capable of reducing the size of an electric oil pump device while supporting the starting of an engine using a starter motor. In the case where the output voltage of the power supply device is reduced in association with cranking, the electric oil pump device can be operated normally without using a high-function device that can be operated even when the voltage is reduced in the electric oil pump device. This makes it possible to reduce the size of the electric oil pump device while supporting the starting of the engine using the starter motor.

title_clean: Accessory Support for An Archery Bow and Related Apparatuses
abstract_clean: A support for retaining an archery bow on a support surface includes a mounting block affixable to the archery bow and a member adjustably coupled to the mounting block. The member can be repositionable between two or more configurations relative to the mounting block. For example, the member can be rotatable between two or more orientations relative to the mounting block. In some examples, the member can be linearly repositionable relative to the mounting block. In some examples, the member can be a first member and the support can further include a second member adjustably coupled to the mounting block.

title_clean: Energy recovery braking system and method for hydraulic braking electric automobile
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a hydraulic braking electric automobile energy recovery braking system and method, comprising a brake pedal arm, wherein the middle part of the front section of the brake pedal arm is rotationally connected with a pedal support body through a pedal shaft, the front end of the brake pedal arm is hinged with a brake master cylinder, and the rear end of the brake pedal arm is provided with a brake pedal; the brake master cylinder is connected with the service brake and the wheel assembly; a stroke sensor is arranged in the middle of the rear section of the brake pedal arm and is sequentially connected with a whole vehicle motor controller, an energy recovery motor and a wheel assembly; the electric automobile energy recovery braking is divided into an initial state section, a pressure building state section and a braking state section, so that the energy recovery braking system and the hydraulic braking system exert maximum energy recovery performance and braking performance in different braking stages, the energy recovery efficiency is high, the service frequency of a service brake is reduced, the service life of the braking system is prolonged, and the reliability, the safety and the comfort are high.

title_clean: Copper-containing catalyst and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_clean: The application discloses a copper-containing catalyst which is selected from any one of substances with a structure shown as a formula I. According to the method, the copper-containing catalyst is introduced into the natural raw lacquer, the synergistic effect of the cellulose Schiff base copper and laccase is utilized, the urushiol monomer is promoted to be rapidly oxidized to generate urushiol quinone free radical, and the urushiol monomer is further polymerized to form a high-molecular polymer, so that the purpose of rapid drying of the raw lacquer is realized, and the curing speed of the natural raw lacquer is greatly accelerated.

title_clean: Conveying and packaging integrated device for water heating casting external member
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses an integrative device of conveying encapsulation of hot-water heating casting external member, including first transport mechanism and second transport mechanism, still include packagine machine and construct, first transport mechanism with be provided with between the second transport mechanism packagine machine constructs, first transport mechanism sets up second transport mechanism is the top to one side, packagine machine constructs including supporting mechanism, bag sealing mechanism, pushing mechanism, the supporting mechanism below is provided with bag sealing mechanism, bag sealing mechanism below is provided with pushing mechanism. The utility model discloses packagine machine constructs's setting has realized the function to the continuous automatic encapsulation of material with the effect of conveying next process automatically, improved production efficiency and reduced intensity of labour.

title_clean: Distributed replacement flow shop scheduling optimization method with preventive maintenance
abstract_clean: The invention belongs to the technical field of distributed replacement flow shop scheduling in intelligent manufacturing, and particularly relates to a distributed replacement flow shop scheduling optimization method with preventive maintenance. The method comprises the steps of dividing a population into two populations of an explorer and a developer, performing state evaluation and search action decision based on population improvement rate and diversity through Q learning, combining a multi-arm slot machine model to adaptively select eight types of neighborhood disturbance operators including a factory layer, a workpiece layer and a local layer for an individual, constructing an elite library to finish deep search after propagation diffusion, local search, competitive exclusion and population immigration iterative optimization, and finally using a heuristic algorithm global optimal solution as a heat starting point to finish final optimization through constraint planning CP model. The invention obviously improves the solving precision and efficiency of the scheduling problem and effectively balances the global exploration and local development capacity of the algorithm.

title_clean: Ball valve core polishing equipment
abstract_clean: The application discloses ball valve core polishing equipment which comprises a supporting frame, a driving device, a first telescopic device, a first polishing device, a second telescopic device and a second polishing device, wherein the supporting frame comprises a supporting frame, a supporting table, a sleeve and a supporting disc, and the supporting table is arranged on the supporting frame; the sleeve is vertically and fixedly arranged on the supporting table, and the bottom end of the sleeve penetrates through the supporting table; the supporting disc is sleeved on the sleeve and fixedly connected with the supporting table; the driving device is arranged in the sleeve in a lifting and moving manner; the first telescopic device is arranged on the supporting frame. From this, can carry out polishing to the inside and outside surface of ball valve case simultaneously, not only shortened polishing time, promoted production efficiency, alleviateed the manual work burden moreover, reduced use cost, ensured the smoothness and the uniformity on case surface simultaneously, in addition, this equipment can also be applicable to multiple not unidimensional case, has the advantage that accommodation is wide.

title_clean: Coil device
abstract_clean: To provide a coil device compatible with high voltage and surface mount.SOLUTION: A coil device comprises: a first wire 20 that is connected to first terminals 41a, 41b; a second wire 30 that is connected to second terminals 42a, 42b; terminal blocks 50a, 50b that fix the first terminals 41a, 41b and the second terminals 42a, 42b, respectively; a bobbin 60 that comprises a first drum 61 on which the first wire 20 is wound and which extends along a first axis, a second drum 62 on which the second wire 30 is wound and which extends along the first axis, and flange parts 63a, 63b that connect the first drum 61 and the second drum 62; and a core 10 that is stored in the bobbin 60. The terminal blocks 50a, 50b at least partially cover the flange parts 63a, 63b of the bobbin 60, respectively.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_clean: Electronic device
abstract_clean: An electronic device is provided. The electronic device includes a substrate, a semiconductor unit, a wall, and a light-transmitting member. The semiconductor unit is mounted on the substrate. The wall is disposed on the substrate and surrounds the semiconductor unit. The wall includes two exterior wall components and two interior wall components. The two exterior wall components are spaced apart from each other, so that two gaps are formed between the two exterior wall components. The two gaps are in spatial communication with an installation area that is surrounded by the two exterior wall components. The two interior wall components are arranged in the installation area and spaced apart from each other. The two interior wall components correspond in position to the two gaps and respectively shade parts of the two gaps. The light-transmitting member is disposed on the wall and covered on the semiconductor unit.

title_clean: Superconducting current control system
abstract_clean: One example includes a superconducting current control system. The system includes an inductive coupler comprising a load inductor and a control inductor. The inductive coupler can be configured to inductively provide a control current from the control inductor to a superconducting circuit device based on a load current being provided through the load inductor. The system also includes a current control element comprising a superconducting quantum interference device (SQUID) array comprising a plurality of SQUIDs. The current control element can be coupled to the inductive coupler to control an amplitude of the load current through the load inductor, and thus to control an amplitude of the control current to the superconducting circuit device.

title_clean: Signal processing circuit and solid state imaging device
abstract_clean: To provide a signal processing circuit capable of expanding an output bit and a dynamic range in response to a detection signal amount by using a limited number of counters, and provide a solid state imaging device.SOLUTION: In a signal processing circuit, which is a signal reading circuit of a solid state imaging device comprising a photoelectric conversion unit in which a light reception sensitivity is changed by an application voltage, and comprises: a pulse generation circuit generating a pulse in accordance with a charge amount to be photoelectric-converted; and a counter circuit counting the pulse, the application voltage of the photoelectric conversion unit is controlled in each detection period of the charge amount, and an output bit signal of the counter circuit of each detection period having a different application voltage to obtain an output in which the bit number is expanded more than the bit number of the counter circuit. The application voltage of a first detection period and a second detection period is set so that the charge amount to be photoelectric-converted in response to the same light amount becomes a ratio of a power of two.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_clean: Quorum sensing quenching strain Dan Quanhai source strain from hydrothermal solution and application thereof
abstract_clean: The invention provides a quorum sensing quenching strain Dan Quanhai source bacterium from a hydrothermal source and application thereof, wherein the screened strain can inhibit pathogenic bacteria and is used for preparing antibacterial medicines, and the preservation number of the screened Dan Quanhai source bacterium is CCTCC NO: M20251224. The invention also provides an AHL degrading enzyme Aii937 protein separated from YESM strain, which is characterized in that the amino acid sequence of the protein is SEQ ID NO. 2. The YESM strain can block the QS channel of pathogenic bacteria through AHL lactonase Aii937, reduce the secretion of virulence factors of the pathogenic bacteria, and the strain YESM is free from pathogenicity. AHL lactonase has no broad spectrum and strong substrate specificity, and only degrades C 6 -HSL and 3OC-C 14 -HSL.

title_clean: Method for measuring pulmonary surfactant protein d, measurement kit, monoclonal antibody, and cell
abstract_clean: This method for measuring pulmonary surfactant protein D includes a step of bringing a sample containing pulmonary surfactant protein D into contact with an insoluble carrier on which an anti-pulmonary surfactant protein D monoclonal antibody has been immobilized, and a step of detecting a complex of the pulmonary surfactant protein D and at least two of the anti-pulmonary surfactant protein D monoclonal antibodies, wherein the insoluble carrier supports only one type of antibody as the anti-pulmonary surfactant protein D monoclonal antibody.

title_clean: Pesticidally active pyridazinone compounds
abstract_clean: Compounds of formula (I) (I) where Q is or ; and R 4 is or , and wherein the substituents are as defined in claim 1, and the agrochemically acceptable salts, stereoisomers, enantiomers, tautomers and N-oxides of those compounds, can be used as insecticides.

title_clean: Anti-csp antibodies
abstract_clean: The present disclosure provides anti-circumsporozoite (CSP) antibodies, compositions comprising such antibodies. Also disclosed are methods of producing the disclosed antibodies and methods of treating or preventing malaria using the same.

title_clean: Data center test equipment, control method thereof and data center test system
abstract_clean: The application discloses data center test equipment, a control method thereof and a data center test system. The data center test equipment comprises a liquid cooling module and a heating module. The liquid cooling module comprises a heat exchanger, a liquid inlet pipeline and a liquid outlet pipeline, wherein a liquid cooling channel and a waterway channel are arranged on the heat exchanger, a liquid inlet port of the liquid cooling channel is communicated with the liquid inlet pipeline, and a liquid outlet port of the liquid cooling channel is communicated with the liquid outlet pipeline; the heating module comprises a thermal resistance box, a circulating water pipe is arranged in the thermal resistance box, and the circulating water pipe is communicated with the waterway channel to convey water to the heat exchanger so as to exchange heat with cooling liquid in the liquid cooling channel. The data center test equipment and the control method thereof and the data center test system at least solve the problem that the dummy load in the prior art can not meet the liquid cooling test requirement only by means of air cooling heat dissipation.

title_clean: Communication method and apparatus
abstract_clean: Provided in the present application are a communication method and apparatus. The communication method comprises: acquiring first information, wherein the first information may be used for indicating an association relationship between a data identifier and a data processing mode, the data processing mode may comprise executing one or more first functions for data processing, and/or skipping one or more second functions for data processing, and the data identifier may comprise a first data identifier; and receiving first data carrying the first data identifier, and processing the first data on the basis of the first data identifier and the association relationship; or, sending the first data carrying the first data identifier. In the present application, different first data identifiers may have association relationships with different data processing modes. Thus, a corresponding functional entity processes first data on the basis of the data processing modes corresponding to the first data identifiers. In this way, appropriate functions are selected in a targeted manner for processing different data, thereby improving the service processing efficiency and the system performance.

title_clean: Financial data analysis and statistical model construction method
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a financial data analysis and statistical model construction method, which relates to the technical field of financial big data analysis and comprises the steps of collecting client transaction running water, public opinion text and industrial chain data from a transaction system, a social media platform and an industrial chain database of a financial institution, cleaning the collected data, removing noise data, carrying out standardized processing, extracting key features, constructing an initial knowledge graph according to the extracted information, continuously monitoring time sequence changes of the data, and continuously updating the knowledge graph. According to the invention, through comprehensively fusing multi-source data, potential information can be more accurately evaluated and potential association and risk can be found in time, risk misjudgment caused by a single data source is reduced, event-driven self-adaptive updating is realized, and timeliness of a map can be kept to follow market change, so that decision accuracy and timeliness are improved, a three-dimensional attribution analysis system is constructed, decision transparency can be improved, and reliability and fairness of financial data analysis are enhanced.

title_clean: Personnel abnormal behavior early warning method and system for accommodation service places
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a personnel abnormal behavior early warning method and system for accommodation service places, wherein the method comprises the steps of S1, obtaining multi-source comprehensive data of a plurality of accommodation service places, S2, digging potential features based on a TF-IDF technology, S3, taking basic features and the potential features of each accommodation service place as input, outputting abnormal behavior assessment results of each accommodation service place, S4, marking areas according to the abnormal behavior assessment results, and determining target risk places and target risk personnel according to the marking results, and early warning. According to the technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention, the possible abnormal behavior is mined from multiple dimensions, the supervision system of the accommodation service place is perfected, and the abnormal situation is early warned in advance.

title_clean: Vegetables dehydration reducing mechanism
abstract_clean: This specification provides a vegetables dehydration reducing mechanism, includes: the microwave oven comprises a main body, wherein microwave generators are embedded at four corners of the inner wall of the main body; the humidity sensor comprises a main body, a central column, an inner groove, a humidity sensor and a vacuum pump, wherein the central column is installed at the center of the bottom end inside the main body in a threaded mode, an inner groove is formed in the center of the top end of the central column, four air holes are uniformly formed in the central column on the periphery of the inner groove, a communication hole is formed in the inner groove on the periphery of the humidity sensor, and the vacuum pump is embedded in the central column in the middle of the communication hole; when using, the central column, the top cover and the corresponding cover body strengthen the combinability, the use is more flexible, the drying is carried out by vacuum and heating when using, and simultaneously the crushing blade is matched to crush vegetables, so that the crushing and dehydration of the whole vegetable are synchronously carried out when using, and the dehydration effect is also strengthened, thereby realizing the acceleration of the working efficiency.

title_clean: Acquisition circuit with selectable switching value judgment threshold
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses an acquisition circuit with an optional switching value judgment threshold, which comprises: the circuit comprises a first interface, a second interface, a first resistor, a second interface, a second resistor, a third resistor, a fourth resistor, an operational amplifier, a voltage dividing circuit and an optocoupler; the first interface is used for accessing an external sensor; the non-inverting input end of the operational amplifier is connected with the first interface, and the inverting input end of the operational amplifier is connected with an external switching value input interface; one end of the first resistor is connected between the non-inverting input end of the operational amplifier and the first interface, and the other end of the second resistor is connected with the second interface and then grounded; the second interface is connected with external 24V voltage through a second resistor, a third resistor and a fourth resistor respectively; the voltage dividing circuit is connected with the output end of the operational amplifier and the optical coupler; the optocoupler is connected to an external central chip. The utility model can easily adjust and adapt to the threshold value of switch detection, thereby better meeting different functional and performance requirements.

title_clean: Be used for colleges and universities law education with teaching device
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a teaching device for law education in colleges and universities, which comprises a base, wherein a bedplate is connected to the base through a supporting plate, a rotating shaft is rotatably arranged on the base and penetrates through the bedplate, a supporting plate is annularly connected to the rotating shaft and is connected with a placing frame, a tablet computer is arranged in the placing frame, a bolt is screwed on the placing frame and tightly presses the tablet computer through the bolt, a placing groove is annularly arranged on the bedplate and is internally provided with a wireless keyboard. Students can stand at the positions beside the wireless keyboards respectively, when answering, the students can input answering characters to the tablet personal computer through the wireless keyboards, the rotating shaft rotates through the rotating rotary disc, the position of the tablet personal computer is changed, the students can conveniently conduct collaborative analysis on the answering conditions of the group members, after the analysis is correct, the group members press the answering buttons respectively, and the answering is finished, so that the effect of the students on collaborative analysis of the answering conditions of the group members is better.

title_clean: Display control console structure
abstract_clean: The invention belongs to the technical field of display consoles, and particularly relates to a display console structure. The invention provides a display control console structure which comprises a shell and a shock absorber component arranged below the shell, wherein a display control module, a control module, an expansion interface module and an article placement module are arranged on the upper surface of the shell, the shell is in a flat shape, the display control module is located in the middle of the upper surface, the control module is arranged on two sides of the display control module, the expansion interface module and the article placement module are respectively arranged on the upper side of the control module, the control module is used for sending an operation instruction according to the content of the display control module, and the expansion interface module is used for connecting external equipment.

title_clean: Sealed effectual chemical reagent auxiliary agent filter equipment
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to the technical field of filtering devices, in particular to a chemical reagent auxiliary filtering device with good sealing effect, which comprises a base, the left end and the right end of the base are respectively provided with a lifting device, a beam is arranged between the top ends of the lifting devices, a shell is rotatably arranged in the middle of the top end of the base, a working cavity is arranged in the shell, a driving motor is arranged at the position of the base corresponding to the shell, the output end of the driving motor is connected with the shell, the shell comprises a shell body and a shell cover, the top end of the working cavity is provided with a feeding hole, the shell body is provided with a shell cover at the top end of the feed inlet, the side wall of the feed inlet is provided with an annular sealing groove, through the setting of elevating gear, crossbeam, cap and sealed piece, be convenient for through the height of elevating gear control cap to through the sealing performance of sealed piece with the cooperation promotion work cavity of seal groove.

title_clean: Silane unloading system
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a silane unloading system, which comprises a silane pressurizing device, a silane storage tank, a condenser and an evaporator, wherein the condenser and the evaporator are matched with the silane storage tank; the outsourcing silane tank truck conveys silane gas to a silane pressurizing device through a pipeline for treatment, and the treated silane gas is conveyed to a silane storage tank for storage; when downstream debugging or generation is carried out, silane gas is respectively condensed and boosted through a condenser and an evaporator matched with the silane storage tank until the air pressure in the outsourcing silane tank car is consistent with the air pressure in the silane storage tank or the liquid level of the silane storage tank is kept unchanged, and silane unloading is finished. This embodiment can solve the problem that the prior art is not specifically applied to the silane unloading treatment.

title_clean: ZLD (zero liquid discharge) wastewater treatment
abstract_clean: Methods and systems are provided for wastewater treatment that yields zero liquid discharge (ZLD). These include pre-treating provided wastewater from any contaminated water source to remove heavy metals, ultra-filtering the pre-treated wastewater to remove suspended and colloidal solids, nano-filtering the ultra-filtered wastewater to yield treated water (with monovalent ions) and a concentrate, treating the concentrate to remove di- and tri-valent elements and other compounds from the concentrate, and to reduce a level of sulfates to a specified level which is above a solubility level of sulfates—to yield returned water, and sludge, mixing the returned water with the provided wastewater before or at the first treatment stage and/or with the pre-treated wastewater before the ultrafiltration, and removing residual water from the sludge to yield removed solids with ZLD. Advantageously, disclosed processes and systems are efficient, cheaper and more sustainable than prior art systems.

title_clean: Preparation method of pore-diameter-controllable self-activated lignin-based micro-nano activated carbon fiber
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a preparation method of a pore diameter-controllable self-activated lignin-based micro-nano activated carbon fiber. Acid-method lignin is extracted from a biomass raw material by adopting an acid extraction method, the acid-method lignin is spun into precursor fibers by an electrostatic spinning technology, then the precursor fibers are pre-oxidized and carbonized, and the lignin-based micro-nano activated carbon fibers with controllable apertures are obtained by adjusting the pre-oxidation and carbonization process parameters. The carbon fiber prepared by the invention does not need subsequent activation steps, can be self-activated in the pre-oxidation and carbonization processes, and has higher specific surface area and better electrochemical performance. The active carbon fiber prepared by the invention has the advantages of simple production process, low price, controllable aperture and wider application prospect in the field of super capacitors.

title_clean: Preparation method of soybean oil microemulsion capable of being infinitely diluted
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a preparation method of soybean oil microemulsion capable of infinitely diluting. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, fully mixing soybean oil and a solubilizer, and then putting the mixture on a constant-temperature oscillator for shaking to obtain a mixed oil phase A; then, fully mixing the surfactant with the mixed oil phase A, and then putting the mixture on a constant temperature oscillator for shaking to obtain a mixed oil phase B; finally, mixing the mixed oil phase B with a cosurfactant, and placing the mixture on a constant-temperature oscillator for shaking to obtain a mixed phase C; and adding distilled water into the phase C until the system is clear and transparent, thus obtaining the soybean oil microemulsion which can be infinitely diluted. The soybean oil microemulsion which can be infinitely diluted and is prepared by the invention not only can still keep a clear and transparent state under the extreme conditions of centrifugation and high salinity, but also has the characteristics of infinite dilution by water and no demulsification, and the particle size test shows that the particle size is less than 30nm and the particle size distribution is more uniform; therefore, the utility model has higher practical value.

title_clean: Multifunctional cell washing preparation tube
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a multifunctional cell washing preparation tube which comprises a tube main body, wherein a liquid injection port is formed in the circumferential outer wall of the tube main body, a first sealing plug is fixedly arranged in the liquid injection port, a first connecting tube and a second connecting tube are respectively and fixedly connected to the two ends of the tube main body, and a first filter membrane and a second filter membrane are both arranged in the tube main body. The cell washing preparation provided by the utility model has dual purposes, remarkably simplifies the processes of cell washing and cell suspension preparation, is less influenced by environmental cleanliness, and reduces the risk of cell pollution to a certain extent.

title_clean: Mandevilla plant named ‘TVMD938’
abstract_clean: A new and distinct cultivar of Mandevilla plant named ‘TVMD938’, characterized by its upright to somewhat outwardly spreading plant habit; moderately vigorous to vigorous growth habit; early and freely flowering habit; deep purplish pink-colored flowers; and good container and garden performance.

title_clean: Manufacturing equipment of biological type expanding agent
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to the technical field of swelling agent production and processing auxiliary devices, in particular to a biological swelling agent manufacturing device, which can enable staff to quickly take out a mixed and stirred agent, thereby improving the working efficiency and effect of the production and processing swelling agent and enhancing the practicability; including the device main part, still include two sets of installation pieces, two sets of first sliders, the fixed plate, the clamp plate, the second slider, the agitator, the mounting panel, the mounting bracket, the backup pad, first screw rod, first motor, two sets of third sliders, the apron, stirring subassembly, the agitator motor, fixed subassembly, spacing subassembly and resilience subassembly, device main part top left end and right-hand member are connected with a set of installation piece bottom respectively, two sets of installation piece one end are provided with a set of spout respectively, two sets of first slider one end respectively with installation piece spout sliding connection, and two sets of first slider other ends are connected with fixed plate one end respectively, the agitator bottom is hugged closely with fixed plate recess bottom.

title_clean: Photoelectric conversion element
abstract_clean: The present invention improves heat resistance. A photoelectric conversion element 10 which includes a positive electrode 12, a negative electrode and an active layer 14 provided between said positive and negative electrodes, wherein the active layer contains an n-type semiconductor material and a p-type semiconductor material, the n-type semiconductor material is a compound represented by formula (I), and the p-type semiconductor material is a polymer compound containing a structural unit represented by formula (II). (In formula (I), R 1 and R 2 are as defined in the description.) (In formula (II), Ar 1 , Ar 2 and Z are as defined in the description.)

title_clean: Display device and manufacturing method therefor
abstract_clean: The present invention relates to a display device and a manufacturing method therefor, the display device comprising: a lower substrate including a transistor and a light source; and an upper substrate including a cover substrate, a black matrix layer, a reflective layer, a light conversion layer, and a planarization layer, wherein the reflective layer comprises a particular component such as a titanium oxide, and the cross-section of the reflective layer cut in the direction perpendicular to the longitudinal direction has a reverse taper shape, and thus the light efficiency of quantum dots that omnidirectionally emit light can be improved and the overflow of ink, occurring in the discharge step of an inkjet process, can be prevented.

title_clean: Spoof detection based on specular and diffuse reflections
abstract_clean: The present invention relates biometric authentication using an optical biometric arrangement comprising an image sensor comprising a photodetector pixel array configured to capture an image of an object, the image sensor being arranged under a controllable light source comprising light source units, the method comprising: providing a light pattern comprising portions of different light intensity for illuminating the object; acquiring an image of the object, the image comprising image portions corresponding to the portions of different light intensity of the light pattern illuminating the object, at least one image portion being captured by pixels in the photodetector pixel array arranged directly under a light source unit being active during image acquisition, and at least one image portion being captured by pixels in the photodetector pixel array arranged under an at least partly in-active illumination area of the controllable light source during image acquisition, performing biometric authentication at least partly based on metrics extracted from the image portions.

title_clean: Display apparatus
abstract_clean: There is provided a display device including: a substrate having a curved region between a first region and a second region; an inorganic insulating layer disposed on the substrate, the inorganic insulating layer having an opening or a trench corresponding to the bending region; a wiring unit extending to the second region through the bending region, the wiring unit being disposed on the inorganic insulating layer and having at least a portion thereof overlapped with the opening or the trench; and an organic material layer between the inorganic insulating layer and the wiring unit, the organic material layer being configured to fill the opening or the trench, wherein the wiring unit includes a first wiring and a second wiring adjacent to each other, and a width of the opening or the trench overlapping the first wiring is different from a width of the opening or the trench overlapping the second wiring.

title_clean: Power plant boiler combustion protection belt
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to a power boiler technical field, in particular to power boiler defends fires area. The coating comprises an anti-corrosion coating made of graphene materials, an anti-oxidation layer made of boron carbide materials, a high-temperature wear-resistant layer made of silicon carbide materials and an outer coating made of fly ash materials, wherein the anti-corrosion coating, the anti-oxidation layer, the high-temperature wear-resistant layer and the outer coating are arranged from inside to outside, and bonding layers are arranged among the anti-corrosion coating, the anti-oxidation layer, the high-temperature wear-resistant layer and the outer coating. The utility model avoids the phenomenon of erosion melting loss burning protection belt caused by the liquid phase of the coating at high temperature and wetting and permeating with the fused coal ash through the anti-corrosion coating made of graphene material; the anti-oxidation layer made of the boron carbide material can reduce the risk that the refractory belt of the power plant boiler is damaged due to oxidation of internal materials when the power plant boiler works in a high-temperature environment.

title_clean: Mixed solution, preparation method thereof and application thereof in absorbing hydrogen sulfide
abstract_clean: The application discloses a mixed solution, a preparation method thereof and application of the mixed solution in absorbing hydrogen sulfide. Containing Fe 3+ Ions, fe 2+ Ion, VO 2+ Ions, acid ions and water; said Fe 3+ The concentration is 0.1-2 mol/L, fe 2+ The concentration is 0.1-0.5 mol/L; VO (vacuum vapor volume) 2+ VO with the concentration of 0.01-2 mol/L + The concentration is 0.01-0.5 mol/L. title_clean: Method for selection of improved hydrocarbon recovery agents for hydrocarbon revervoirs
abstract_clean: A physical modeling method that includes providing a reservoir core plug, the reservoir core plug having a wellbore interface end, an outlet interface end, and a cylindrical face and saturating the reservoir core plug with hydrocarbon and brine to fonn a saturated core plug. The method also includes positioning the saturated core plug within a flooding apparatus and pumping the fracturing fluid through saturated core plug to displace a portion of the hydrocarbon to fonn a displaced hydrocarbon plug. In addition the method includes positioning the displaced hydrocarbon plug in an imbibition cell and conducting an imbibition test to fonn an imbibed core plug having brine and hydrocarbon. Further the method includes positioning the imbibed core plug in core-flooding apparatus and displacing a portion of the brine and hydrocarbon from the imbibed core plug.

title_clean: Chemical storage tank waste gas RTO administers device
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a chemical storage tank waste gas RTO treatment device, which relates to the field of comprehensive waste gas treatment and comprises a sewage station dangerous waste storage tank, other waste gas storage tanks and a benzene waste gas storage tank, wherein the sewage station dangerous waste storage tank is connected with a first washing tower, the other waste gas storage tanks are connected to a first air mixing box through a gas-liquid separator, the benzene waste gas storage tank is connected to the first air mixing box through a condensing device, the first air mixing box is connected to a concentration buffer through a second washing tower, the first washing tower and the concentration buffer are respectively connected to a second air mixing box through pipelines, the second air mixing box is sequentially connected with a flame arrester, an RTO burner and a chimney along a waste gas treatment sequence, and the second washing tower is further connected to the chimney through an emergency adsorption tank. The utility model can carry out centralized treatment on the waste gas generated in the chemical production, has high treatment efficiency and good treatment effect, and ensures that the waste gas emission reaches the standard.

title_clean: Ceiling type fresh air purification all-in-one machine
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a ceiling type fresh air purification integrated machine which comprises a host with a shell, wherein two centrifugal fans, a front filter assembly and a rear filter assembly are arranged in the host, and the host comprises an upper part of a main body and a lower part of the host; one side of the upper part of the main machine is provided with a fresh air inlet used for being communicated with the outside, the lower part of the main machine is provided with an indoor air inlet, and the lower panel of the lower part of the main machine is provided with an air outlet; the upper part of the main machine is provided with a first chamber and a second chamber which are arranged side by side from left to right, the two centrifugal fans are arranged above the first chamber side by side, the front-mounted filter assembly is arranged below the first chamber, and the air inlet of each centrifugal fan faces the front-mounted filter assembly; an air outlet of the centrifugal fan transversely faces the upper part of the second chamber, an air flow transition area is formed above the second chamber, and the rear filter assembly is arranged below the air flow transition area; the air current blows out from the air outlet after passing through the front filter assembly, the centrifugal fan and the rear filter assembly.

title_clean: Pipe die efficient milling device with recovery structure
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a pipe die efficient milling device with a recovery structure, which comprises a machine body, a base and a filter plate, wherein a water pipe is arranged in the machine body, one end of the water pipe is connected with a spray head, the base is arranged at the bottom of the machine body, the base is internally divided into a filtering bin and a water bin by the filter plate, an electric push rod is arranged at one side of the filtering bin, a push plate is arranged at one end of the electric push rod, a transmission port is arranged at one side of the filtering bin, the transmission port is communicated with a sorting bin, and a hydraulic cylinder is arranged at the top side of the inside of the sorting bin.

title_clean: Underwater explosion cutting system assisted by underwater vehicle
abstract_clean: The invention discloses an underwater explosion cutting system assisted by an underwater vehicle, which relates to the technical field of ocean engineering and underwater equipment, and comprises an AUV carrying platform, an annular cutter module, an intelligent control system and a pipeline; the AUV carrying platform is used for carrying an intelligent control system and installing the annular cutter module on the pipeline, the annular cutter module is connected with the intelligent control system through signals, and the intelligent control system is used for controlling the annular cutter module to detonate. The invention solves the problems of efficiency, precision and environmental adaptability of the traditional underwater cutting technology by combining a heavy AUV carrying platform with modularized design, high-precision navigation, multi-mode detection and intelligent control technology and an innovative adjustable diameter annular cutter. The self-adaptive locking mechanism is used for realizing rapid and accurate adjustment, the V-shaped unit body charging structure is used for improving the energy collecting effect and reducing the charging quantity, and the triple safety interlocking mechanism and the shock wave buffer design are used for ensuring the operation safety.

title_clean: Novel sickle elbow part pre-control method
abstract_clean: The invention provides a novel sickle elbow part pre-control method, which comprises the following steps: s1, calculating the rigidity K of the two sides of the zero adjustment of each rack according to the data of the zero adjustment process of each rolling mill ios0 、K ids0 (ii) a S2 reading the tested rigidity K of two sides of each stand from the control system of the rolling mill iosT 、K idsT (ii) a S3, calculating rigidity K of two sides of each rack according to the zero adjustment rigidity and the test rigidity ios 、K ids (ii) a S4 calculating the roll gap S of the base of each stand according to the rigidity of the two sides of each stand i0 (ii) a S5, performing curve processing on the center line of the rough rolling outlet, and calculating the camber bending L of the camber of the current intermediate billet c (ii) a S6 calculating the roll gap regulating quantity delta S for eliminating the camber bending quantity according to a formula i : s7 calculating roll gap pre-swing value S of each frame i ：S i ＝S i0 +ΔS i And transmitting to a pressing system for execution. According to the method, the influence of the camber part of the intermediate billet on the deviation of finish rolling can be eliminated. Can solve the problem that the stability of finish rolling is influenced by the camber defect of a rough rolling intermediate billet, and reduce the deviation of the strip steel between framesSteel piling accidents are avoided, and the stability of hot rolling production is improved.

title_clean: Heterotandem bicyclic peptide complex
abstract_clean: The present invention relates to a heterotandem bicyclic peptide complex which comprises a first peptide ligand, which binds to EphA2, conjugated via a linker to two second peptide ligands, which bind to CD137. The invention also relates to the use of said heterotandem bicyclic peptide complex in preventing, suppressing or treating cancer.

title_clean: Novel amino aryl derivatives and their use as inhibitors against diacylglycerol acyltransferase 2
abstract_clean: The present invention relates to an amino aryl derivative compound represented by the following Formula (1) showing inhibitory activity against diacylglycerol acyltransferase 2 (DGAT2), a pharmaceutical composition comprising the same as an active ingredient, and use thereof: wherein A, B, D, E, R 1 , R 2 and R 3 are the same as defined herein.

title_clean: Soluble coffee powder
abstract_clean: A soluble beverage powder includes dried coffee extract particles having two essentially flat surfaces and a uniform thickness. A further aspect is a process for making a freeze-dried soluble beverage powder.

title_clean: Bicyclic derivatives and use thereof
abstract_clean: A compound of Formula (I), (II) or (III), stereoisomer thereof, pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, pharmaceutically acceptable salt of the stereoisomer are disclosed.

title_clean: Image processing method, device and equipment
abstract_clean: The embodiment of the application provides an image processing method, an image processing device and image processing equipment, wherein the method is applied to electronic equipment, an image pickup device is arranged in the electronic equipment, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring feedback information of a first image, wherein the first image is obtained by shooting the electronic equipment through the camera device, and the feedback information comprises voice evaluation information and/or image editing information; according to the feedback information, determining a first shooting parameter of the first image and a target image processing algorithm corresponding to the first shooting parameter; and updating the image processing algorithm corresponding to the first shooting parameter into the target image processing algorithm. The method can adjust the image processing algorithm according to the feedback information, so that the image processing flexibility is better.

title_clean: Information processing method and device and computing equipment
abstract_clean: The embodiment of the application provides an information processing method, an information processing device and computing equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: detecting a system access request initiated by a target user aiming at a target processing system; determining decision results respectively generated by a plurality of online decision models at the target processing system in response to the system access request; determining target recommendation information based on decision results respectively corresponding to the plurality of online decision models; and outputting the target recommendation information for the target user. The embodiment of the application improves the recommendation accuracy and effectiveness.

title_clean: Regional science popularization capability evaluation method based on VIKOR method
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a regional science popularization capability evaluation method based on a VI KOR method, which relates to the technical field of science popularization capability evaluation, and comprises the steps of S1 normalizing original data by using a very poor method, S2 carrying out correlation analysis on each index by using a Spearman method, S3 utilizing a conditional generalized variance minimum selection index among indexes and S4 comprehensive evaluation analysis, constructing a science popularization capability index system by using the Spearman method and the generalized variance minimum method, integrating subjective and objective weights of each index by using a game theory combined weighting method, and determining the weights of each index. Finally, the obtained weight is used for analyzing and evaluating the science popularization capability by using a Vikor method, so that the result obtained by the Vikor method is more objective. The method is carried out step by step from index screening, weight determination and method evaluation, and a process reference is provided for the evaluation and research of science popularization capability. The method is beneficial to scientifically making scientific popularization work planning according to the actual conditions of the area in each area.

title_clean: Quality inspection method and device for offline network customer service, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_clean: The application provides a quality inspection method and device for off-line network customer service, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of computers. The method comprises the steps of obtaining offline customer service data, identifying and extracting facial expressions from each image data, carrying out emotion analysis and keyword extraction on each voice dialogue data to obtain service items and voice emotion analysis, carrying out emotion analysis based on the facial expressions and the voice emotion analysis to obtain fusion emotion analysis, carrying out evaluation on the fusion emotion analysis to obtain a first evaluation score, carrying out evaluation on the service items by using preset evaluation standards to obtain a second evaluation score, carrying out fusion on the first evaluation score and the second evaluation score to obtain a machine quality inspection result, carrying out manual sampling inspection on each voice dialogue data and the image data to obtain a manual quality inspection result, carrying out fusion on the machine quality inspection result and the manual quality inspection result, obtaining a service quality inspection result based on the fusion result, and realizing accurate online network customer service quality inspection.

title_clean: Production process of degradable cotton soft sanitary towel
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a production process of a degradable cotton soft sanitary towel, which belongs to the technical field of sanitary towels and comprises the following steps of S1 preparing a degradation promoting solution containing bacillus subtilis spores, atomizing the degradation promoting solution, spraying the degradation promoting solution into a crosslinking solution, filtering to obtain degradation promoting particles, S2 preparing a degradation promoting adhesive containing the degradation promoting particles and sodium bicarbonate powder, S3 sequentially bonding a leak-proof bottom film, a cotton soft core body and a cotton soft surface layer through the degradation promoting adhesive to form a sanitary towel semi-finished product, S4 heating the sanitary towel semi-finished product to dry, and decomposing the sodium bicarbonate after heating to enable the surface of the degradation promoting adhesive to form a plurality of air holes, S5 thermally pressing and bonding the edges of the sanitary towel semi-finished product, and then cutting to obtain the cotton soft sanitary towel.

title_clean: Ladle-shaped hollow conductive foam automatic wrapping jig convenient for adjusting coverage area of pressing plate
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a ladle-shaped hollow conductive foam automatic wrapping jig convenient for adjusting the coverage area of a pressing plate, which is arranged on a production line of a circular cutter die-cutting machine and is applied to conductive cloth with two flanging edges inside. The entrance of the shaping groove is provided with a turnover guide opening with the section width gradually reduced along the advancing direction of the conductive cloth at two sides of the shaping groove. The utility model can automatically wrap the original material strip-shaped conductive cloth to form a wrapped state with a cylindrical surface, and has high production efficiency and high yield.

title_clean: Pouch-type liquid color makeup container
abstract_clean: A cosmetic container is manufactured as a pouch type to accommodate a small amount of liquid cosmetics. The pouch-type liquid color makeup container facilitates confirmation of whether the container is initially opened and exhibition and selling of the container in a vending machine and the like while enabling cosmetic materials to be conveniently carried and used indoors/outdoors through the attachment/detachment of a cap and the entrance/exit of cosmetic tools. A cap attachment/detachment and cosmetic tool entrance/exit and rail movement guide are provided in a discharge member of a pouch manufactured so as to receive and portably carry a small amount of liquid cosmetics, such as lip gloss, mascara, and eyeliner; enabling detailed application by being stably held, thereby enabling various demands of young people sensitive to color to be satisfied.

title_clean: Water feeder capable of realizing alternate water feeding
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a water feeder for realizing alternate water feeding, which comprises a water pump with a water inlet end and a water outlet end, a switching valve with a water inlet end and at least two water outlet ends, a first water feeding seat and a second water feeding seat, wherein the first water feeding seat and the second water feeding seat are provided with water feeding pipes and lower couplers which are electrically connected with a heating container; the utility model discloses convenient to use, overall arrangement are simple, manufacturing cost is lower.

title_clean: Explosion-proof heating tube
abstract_clean: The application relates to the technical field of heating equipment, and particularly discloses an explosion-proof heating tube which comprises a heating component and a wiring component, wherein the heating component comprises a hollow sealing metal column and a heating wire, the heating wire is fixedly arranged in the hollow sealing metal column, the heating wire is in a spiral shape, a spiral channel is formed in the hollow sealing metal column, the heating wire is used for converting electric energy into heat energy, a wiring terminal is detachably arranged on the outer wall of one end of the hollow sealing metal column, the wiring terminal is electrically connected with the heating wire, the wiring terminal is electrically connected with an electric wire so as to convey current to the heating wire, the wiring component comprises a metal tube, one end of the metal tube is detachably connected with one end of the hollow sealing metal column, which is provided with the wiring terminal, and the metal tube is used for shielding the wiring terminal. The application has the effect of improving the problem that the wiring position of the existing explosion-proof heat pipe is inconvenient to check and maintain.

title_clean: Acquisition circuit with selectable switching value judgment threshold
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses an acquisition circuit with an optional switching value judgment threshold, which comprises: the circuit comprises a first interface, a second interface, a first resistor, a second interface, a second resistor, a third resistor, a fourth resistor, an operational amplifier, a voltage dividing circuit and an optocoupler; the first interface is used for accessing an external sensor; the non-inverting input end of the operational amplifier is connected with the first interface, and the inverting input end of the operational amplifier is connected with an external switching value input interface; one end of the first resistor is connected between the non-inverting input end of the operational amplifier and the first interface, and the other end of the second resistor is connected with the second interface and then grounded; the second interface is connected with external 24V voltage through a second resistor, a third resistor and a fourth resistor respectively; the voltage dividing circuit is connected with the output end of the operational amplifier and the optical coupler; the optocoupler is connected to an external central chip. The utility model can easily adjust and adapt to the threshold value of switch detection, thereby better meeting different functional and performance requirements.

title_clean: Urban infrastructure event chain analysis method based on large model and logic atlas
abstract_clean: The invention discloses an urban infrastructure event chain analysis method based on a large model and logic atlases, belonging to the technical field of public safety. The method comprises the following steps: carrying out multi-dimensional identification and extraction of emergency accident carriers based on a large model; constructing an accident entity attribute library through accident carrier abstract entity aggregation and ontology feature deconstructment; excavating accident non-space-time disaster transfer paths based on logic patterns, and supervising large model training to obtain disaster transfer coping schemes; extracting accident multidimensional disaster transfer characteristics, and carrying out disaster transfer characteristic analysis and entity space-time association rule construction; optimizing logic the map based on the entity space-time correlation analysis; carrying out event chain sequencing through risk analysis; carrying out dynamic update of the event chain according to the feedback information; and outputting and visually displaying results.
