The invention can realize the automatic association, dynamic prediction, rapid deduction and scientific prevention and control of single/cross-system and single/multi-disaster accident evolution scenes of urban infrastructure through comprehensive consideration of accident carriers and disaster transfer.

title_clean: Monitoring communication method and system
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a monitoring communication method based on a monitoring communication system, which comprises a background control terminal, a field monitoring terminal, a static communication terminal and a dynamic communication terminal; the monitoring communication method comprises the following steps: the background control terminal is communicated with the field monitoring terminal through optical cable connection, and the background control terminal judges the field state according to the field monitoring data sent by the field monitoring terminal; when the background control terminal judges an abnormal state, the background control terminal performs primary communication to the site through a static communication terminal; when primary communication is carried out, the background control terminal judges a communication receiving state through a field monitoring terminal; when the background control terminal judges that the state is not received, the background control terminal performs secondary communication to the site through the dynamic communication terminal. The invention adopts a dynamic communication mode to notify the content to be communicated, and solves the problem of poor long-distance communication in the prior art.

title_clean: Hot air heating method and system of pre-oxidation furnace with coupled heat recovery
abstract_clean: The invention belongs to the technical field of heating of a carbon fiber pre-oxidation furnace, in particular to the technical field of a waste or low-grade fuel combustion method, and particularly relates to a hot air heating method and a hot air heating system of a pre-oxidation furnace for coupling heat recovery. The method comprises the steps of dividing fresh air to be fed into a pre-oxidation furnace into two parts, mixing one part of fresh air with circulating air of the last process flow of the pre-oxidation furnace after multiple times of gradient heating, carrying out third gradient heating, then carrying out fourth gradient heating through a heat conducting oil heater, introducing the other part of fresh air which is heated once and is not mixed, mixing the fresh air with mixed air heated to be higher than the process temperature again, and feeding the fresh air into the pre-oxidation furnace after the process temperature is reached. By controlling the flow of fresh air newly introduced, the effect of precisely controlling the temperature of the mixed air at the process temperature is achieved.

title_clean: Resin composition molded body
abstract_clean: This resin composition molded body contains 50% by mass or more of an olefin-based polymer A, and satisfies the following requirements (i) and (ii). (i) The amount of oxygen atoms on the surface of the resin composition molded body as determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 0.01 atom% to 8.5 atom% inclusive. (ii) The surface wetting tension of the resin composition molded body is 25 mN/m to 45 mN/m inclusive.

title_clean: Silica in rock samples
abstract_clean: A method comprises determining an amount of excess silica and/or an amount of terrigenous silica in a rock sample taking into account a measurement indicative of an amount of silica in the rock sample and a measurement indicative of an amount of zirconium in the rock sample.

title_clean: Super-hydrophobic temperature-resistant polyurea-based composite plugging sealing material and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_clean: The invention belongs to the technical field of plugging sealing materials, and relates to a super-hydrophobic temperature-resistant polyurea-based composite plugging sealing material, a preparation method and application thereof, wherein the super-hydrophobic temperature-resistant polyurea-based composite plugging sealing material comprises a base material system, a modified functional filler system and a composite auxiliary agent system, wherein the base material system comprises 65.8-98.3 parts of amino-terminated polyether modified polyurea prepolymer, 8.2-15.7 parts of active diluent, the modified functional filler system comprises 12.5-26.9 parts of silicon carbide micro powder subjected to composite modification by nano silicon dioxide and montmorillonite, and the composite auxiliary agent system comprises 1.2-3.8 parts of super-hydrophobic modifier, 0.9-2.7 parts of high Wen Oulian parts of foam inhibitor compatibilizer, 0.5-1.9 parts of foam inhibitor and 0.3-1.1 part of gel inhibitor. The invention effectively solves the technical problems of poor temperature resistance, insufficient adhesion in complex environment, easy foaming in underwater construction and the like of the traditional polyurea material, and has wide engineering application value.

title_clean: Application of SHP099 and derivatives thereof in preparation of medicines for treating or relieving postherpetic neuralgia
abstract_clean: The invention belongs to the field of biological medicine, and particularly provides application of SHP099 and a derivative thereof in preparing a medicament for treating or relieving postherpetic neuralgia (Postherpetic Neuralgia, PHN). The invention provides the use of SHP099 or a pharmaceutically acceptable derivative thereof as an active ingredient for reducing HSV-1 viral load and pro-inflammatory factor expression in the dorsal horn of the spinal cord while up-regulating the level of neurotrophic factors. The invention discovers that SHP099 or pharmaceutically acceptable derivatives thereof can significantly relieve mechanical hyperalgesia of PHN model animals, and intrathecal local administration can enhance curative effect and reduce systemic side effects. The invention expands the clinical application of SHP099 and provides a new strategy for PHN treatment.

title_clean: Heating injector
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a heating injector, including the syringe body, the inside of syringe body is provided with the boosting pole, the upper end surface of boosting pole is provided with the push pedal. A heating syringe, hasp through heating mechanism, fix the heating jacket on syringe body outer wall through the hasp, start miniature power drive silica gel zone of heating, and this silica gel zone of heating is through two tunnel heating channels, realize heating fast, and be connected between through temperature controller and the silica gel zone of heating, this temperature controller includes the display screen, after heating to the certain limit, the accessible temperature controller reminds, self-closing power stop heating simultaneously, and the accessible display screen carries out temperature display in real time, make things convenient for people to look over, can carry out the heat preservation of certain limit through the thermal insulation layer, prevent that the heat dissipation is too fast, can prevent to lead to syringe body to damage when falling through the elasticity inoxidizing coating, make things convenient for people to use.

title_clean: Dynamically controlled soft tissue manipulator
abstract_clean: This document discusses, among other things, systems and methods for robotically assisted positioning of an implant in a patient to alter position and shape of a soft tissue. A soft-tissue manipulator system includes an implantable positioning unit (IPU) to engage a soft-tissue implant, and an external control console to dynamically control the IPU to position the implant to interface with the target soft tissue. A user may use the external control console to remotely and transcutaneously control the position and motion of the implant, and to adjust shape and contour of the implant via a micro actuator array on the implant. The system may be used in a thyroplasty surgery to position and manipulate a thyroplasty implant to modify a vocal cord, such as to medialize or lateralize the vocal cord to restore or improve voice quality.

title_clean: Dyeing method for removing autofluorescence of single-cell sorting microfluidic chip and chip without autofluorescence
abstract_clean: The application provides a dyeing method for removing autofluorescence of a single-cell sorting microfluidic chip and a chip without autofluorescence. The dyeing method comprises the steps of fully soaking a single-cell sorting microfluidic chip in a dye solution for dyeing until the top layer of the chip is dyed into an opaque black top layer, and obtaining the single-cell sorting microfluidic chip without autofluorescence, wherein the dye in the dye solution is black dye, and the single-cell sorting microfluidic chip at least comprises a photosensitive dry film serving as a flow channel layer. The dyeing method provided by the technical scheme of the application can effectively solve the problem of autofluorescence of the single-cell sorting microfluidic chip prepared by the traditional photosensitive dry film, so that when the dyed chip is applied to fluorescence activated cell sorting, the identification of automatically screening fluorescent cells is facilitated, the operation difficulty of fluorescence activated cell sorting is reduced, and the accuracy and reliability are improved.

title_clean: Envelope detection
abstract_clean: In an embodiment an envelope detection device includes an input terminal configured to receive an amplitude-modulated radio frequency signal, a first resistive element and a first MOS transistor connected in parallel between the input terminal and a first node configured to receive a reference potential, a first capacitive element connected between a gate of the first MOS transistor and the first node, an envelope detection circuit connected to the input terminal and configured to supply a voltage representative of an envelope of the amplitude-modulated signal and a circuit for controlling the first MOS transistor configured to supply a first current to the gate of the first MOS transistor only when the voltage is smaller than a first threshold and draw a second current from the gate of the first MOS transistor only when the voltage is higher than a second threshold, the second threshold being higher than the first threshold.

title_clean: Method for transmitting uplink sounding reference signal, terminal, network side device, and storage medium
abstract_clean: A method for transmitting uplink Sounding Reference Signal, SRS, a terminal, a network side device and a storage medium are provided. The method includes determining a transmission manner for one or more uplink SRSs in a wideband system by a terminal according to a configuration from a network side device, wherein the wideband system is configured with a plurality of basic parameters; transmitting the one or more uplink SRSs to the network side device in the wideband system by the terminal according to the transmission manner.

title_clean: Method and system for reverse powering a multi-unit optical network terminal
abstract_clean: Techniques for powering a multi-unit optical network terminal (MU-ONT) located outside of a multi-unit building include obtaining reverse power from Power-over-Ethernet (POE) lines connecting the MU-ONT to terminal units (TUs) or customer premises equipments (CPEs) disposed inside the building. Reverse power may be injected into the PoE lines at the TUs, for example. Via an MU-ONT reverse powering device, the reverse power may be separated from services data provided via the PoE lines, and the services data may be delivered between the TUs and a Passive Optical Network (PON) via the MU-ONT. The reverse power obtained from the PoE lines may be aggregated to provide the MU-ONT with power commensurate with its power load. In some embodiments, the MU-ONT power load may be shared or distributed across PoE lines in a passive or actively controlled manner based on variations in the MU-ONT load and/or respective characteristics of the PoE lines.

title_clean: System and method for communication beam recovery
abstract_clean: A method for operating an access node comprising: generating a configuration message comprising information specifying a first reference signal type and a second reference signal type for identifying a new beam, and information specifying random access channel resources allocated for transmitting preamble sequences, wherein each random access channel resource is associated with a reference signal of the first reference signal type, transmitting the configuration message to one or more User Equipments (UEs), receiving a preamble sequence on one of the random access channel resources from a UE, and determining an identity of the UE from the preamble sequence and the one of the random access channel resources.

title_clean: Metal housing and electronic device including metal housing thereof
abstract_clean: An electronic device according to various embodiments of the present disclosure includes: a metal housing; a porous oxide film layer including a plurality of fine micro-pores formed on the outer surface of the metal housing; and a functional polymer layer stacked adjacent to the outer side of the porous oxide film layer in which the plurality of micro-pores are formed, wherein an organic dye aqueous solution may be colored in the plurality of micro-pores. In addition to this, various embodiments identified through the specification are possible.

title_clean: Semiconductor device with a plurality of semiconductor chips
abstract_clean: The present invention provides a semiconductor device, which is provided with a plurality of stacked semiconductor chips (11) and a control part (12), wherein each semiconductor chip (11) is provided with: a plurality of signal processing units (17, 18) that can be connected to each other; a plurality of on-chip signal lines (14, 15) that can be connected to each other; a connection state changing unit (13) that can change the connection state between the plurality of on-chip signal lines (14, 15) in accordance with an instruction from the control unit (12); and a plurality of non-contact communication units (16) connected to the plurality of on-chip signal lines (14, 15), respectively, wherein each non-contact communication unit (16) of each semiconductor chip (11) is capable of performing non-contact communication with the non-contact communication unit (16) of any one or more other semiconductor chips (11) in the stacking direction, and wherein the connection state changing unit (13) of each semiconductor chip (11) changes the connection state between the plurality of on-chip signal lines (14, 15) in accordance with an instruction from the control unit (12), thereby changing the connection state between the plurality of signal processing units (17, 18).

title_clean: Microwave-based reset of persistent current qubits
abstract_clean: Systems and methods are provided for resetting a qubit comprising a superconducting loop and a compound Josephson junction. A first bias flux is provided to the superconducting loop. A second bias flux is provided to the compound Josephson junction. Each of the first bias flux and the second bias flux are provided such that a given excited state of the qubit is near a top of a potential barrier associated with a potential of the qubit. A continuous microwave signal is generated having a frequency equal to a transition frequency between an other excited state of the qubit and the given excited state.

title_clean: Circuit board for reducing transmitting loss and electronic device therewith
abstract_clean: A circuit board is provided in which a transmission loss is reduced. The circuit board includes a first layer; a transmission line disposed on the first layer; and a second layer stacked with the first layer. The second layer includes a first region, which is constructed of a first material, corresponding to a position of the transmission line, and a second region, which is constructed of a second material having a permittivity that is different from that of the first material, corresponding to the position of the transmission line.

title_clean: Threshing and cleaning device suitable for irregular grain beans
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a threshing and cleaning device suitable for irregular granular beans, wherein the grain rods of a threshing part group are arranged into a plurality of groups at intervals on the circumference of a supporting inner cylinder, each group of long grain rods is arranged into a plurality of sub-modules which are closely arranged along the length direction, the plurality of sub-modules can be arranged on a long support in a reciprocating mode and are outwards ejected through respective elastic parts, the sub-modules and a screen keep an initial distance, when materials pass through the plurality of sub-modules and the screen, large-specification material extrusion enables the sub-modules to retract and compress the elastic parts so as to increase the distance for passing, the short grain rods are arranged into a plurality of groups on the circumference of the supporting inner cylinder, each group is provided with a plurality of intervals by taking the axial direction of the supporting inner cylinder as a reference, and the second gaps for passing materials are formed at the intervals. The threshing machine can adapt to the passing of beans with more specifications and irregular grains and performs extrusion threshing, and improves the applicability of the threshing and cleaning device.

title_clean: Microbial fertilizer production loading attachment
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to a microbial fertilizer production feeding device, which belongs to the technical field of microbial fertilizer production and comprises a base, a screening cylinder and a driving assembly, wherein the top end of the base is provided with a feeding assembly, the feeding assembly comprises a supporting seat, the supporting seat is connected to the top end of the base, one end of the screening cylinder is rotationally connected with the supporting seat, the inner side wall of the screening cylinder is connected with a spiral guide plate, one end of the spiral guide plate extends to the inside of the supporting seat, the top end of the supporting seat is connected with a feeding hopper, the inner side wall of the feeding hopper is rotationally connected with a rotating shaft, the outer part of the rotating shaft is equally connected with a plurality of separation plates, one end of the rotating shaft penetrates through the feeding hopper and is connected with a belt pulley, one end of the spiral guide plate penetrates through the supporting seat and is connected with the belt pulley, and the bottom end of the feeding hopper is provided with a through groove. The utility model has the advantages of avoiding equipment clogging, ensuring normal use of equipment, improving the processing effect of the equipment and reducing the maintenance and cleaning burden of a user.

title_clean: Methanotrophic engineering bacteria for producing phenazine-1-carboxylic acid, construction method and application
abstract_clean: The methanotrophic engineering bacteria integrate exogenous phenazine-1-carboxylic acid synthesis gene clusters into a methanotrophic host genome by a genome integration method, so that the construction of a host heterologous phenazine-1-carboxylic acid synthesis module is completed; synthesizing phenazine-1-carboxylic acid in methanotrophic bacteria by taking a carbon compound as a carbon source, and applying the compound to the production of microbial source phenazine-1-carboxylic acid and derivatives thereof; based on the agricultural and medical activities and the electron transfer function, the phenazine-1-carboxylic acid enhances and promotes the methane oxidation efficiency through the electron transfer process, thereby improving the yield of the phenazine-1-carboxylic acid and realizing the high-efficiency bioconversion of methane.

title_clean: Momordica grosvenori residue and silage corn stalk fermented feed and preparation method thereof
abstract_clean: The invention relates to the technical field of feed preparation, in particular to a siraitia grosvenorii residue and silage corn stalk fermented feed and a preparation method thereof, wherein the feed comprises, by weight, 40-50 parts of siraitia grosvenorii residue, 30-40 parts of corn stalk, 30-40 parts of concentrated feed, 0.1-0.5 part of composite probiotic preparation and 0.5-1 part of flavoring agent. The preparation method comprises the steps of S1, raw material pretreatment, namely screening fresh and sterile Momordica grosvenori residues, corn stalks and concentrated feed as raw materials, pouring the pretreated raw materials into a stirring device, S2, raw material fermentation, namely adjusting the internal temperature of the stirring device to 30-35 ℃, pouring a composite probiotic preparation into the stirring device, mixing the raw materials with the composite probiotic preparation by using the stirring device for 10-15min, standing for 5-7d after the mixing is completed, and obtaining the fermented raw materials, S3, obtaining finished products, namely stirring the fermented raw materials for 10-15min by using the stirring device, and S4, and checking and storing the finished products. The invention can improve the intake of the siraitia grosvenorii residue and reduce the preparation cost.

title_clean: Gas concentration detection system of ultrapure zero gas generator
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to a gas concentration detection system of an ultrapure zero gas generator, which is used for detecting various gas concentrations in zero gas generated by the zero gas generator and comprises an electric control unit, a quantum cascade laser gas measurement unit, an oxygen measurement unit, a hydrocarbon measurement unit, a pressure control unit and a display unit. The system is divided into three paths, wherein the first path can realize the concentration of carbon monoxide (CO), carbon dioxide (CO 2 ), nitric Oxide (NO) and nitrogen dioxide (NO 2 ) in zero gas, and the gas can realize the detection of oxygen (O 2 ) after flowing through the oxygen measuring unit; the second path can measure the total concentration of Hydrocarbon (HC) in the zero gas; the third path is capable of exhausting gas other than the gas entering the first path and the second path. The system can realize detection of various gas concentrations, meets different detection requirements, and has simple detection method and low cost.

title_clean: Gas transportation device
abstract_clean: A gas transportation device is disclosed and includes a main body and plural actuating units. The main body includes a base, a top cover and plural channel separating parts. The base and the top cover are assembled with each other to form an accommodation slot. A gas inlet is disposed on the base, and a gas outlet is disposed on the top cover. The accommodation slot is in communication with the gas inlet and the gas outlet. The plural channel separating parts separate the accommodation slot into plural sub accommodation slots that are in communication with each other. The plural actuating units are respectively disposed within the plural sub accommodation slots and are supported and fixed by the plural channel separating parts. When the plural actuating units are actuated, a tandem architecture is formed to transport gas. Thereby, the gas can be introduced into the plural sub accommodation slots through the gas inlet, pressurized by the tandem architecture formed by the plural actuating units, and then discharged out through the gas outlet.

title_clean: Accessory Support for An Archery Bow and Related Apparatuses
abstract_clean: A support for retaining an archery bow on a support surface includes a mounting block affixable to the archery bow and a member adjustably coupled to the mounting block. The member can be repositionable between two or more configurations relative to the mounting block. For example, the member can be rotatable between two or more orientations relative to the mounting block. In some examples, the member can be linearly repositionable relative to the mounting block. In some examples, the member can be a first member and the support can further include a second member adjustably coupled to the mounting block.

title_clean: Method for monitoring an automation system
abstract_clean: The invention resides in a method for maintaining a measuring location (ML 1 , ML 2 , ML 3 ) in an automated plant (A), wherein capability information (CI) of persons (P 1 , P 2 P 3 ) are registered and stored in a service platform (SP), wherein the capability information (CI) includes information concerning objects brought along by the person (P 1 , P 2 , P 3 ), health of the person (P 1 , P 2 , P 3 ) and/or safety equipment worn by the person (P 1 , P 2 , P 3 ), comprising: noting a case of service or maintenance of the measuring location (ML 1 , ML 2 , ML 3 ); creating a service or maintenance order (SO), which includes objects required for caring for the case of service or maintenance, health requirements and/or requirements regarding safety equipment; calculating a degree of suitability of persons (P 1 , P 2 , P 3 ) stored in the service platform (SP) upon noting a case of service or maintenance for the measuring location (ML 1 , ML 2 , ML 3 ), wherein the degree of suitability provides a measure of agreement of capability information (CI) for persons (P 1 , P 2 , P 3 ) stored in the database with the required objects, the requirements for health and/or the requirements as regards safety equipment contained in the service or maintenance plan; and delivering the service or maintenance order (SO) to at least one of the persons (P 1 , P 2 , P 3 ) stored in the service platform (SP), who has for the noted case of service or diagnosis a degree of suitability, which is equal to or greater than a predetermined degree of suitability.

title_clean: Hot device of burying of car light loading screw
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to the technical field of vehicle lamp assembly, in particular to a vehicle lamp loading screw hot embedding device which comprises a PLC control cabinet, a feeding device, a manipulator, a screw taking clamp, a heating device, a first sensor, a cooling device and a second sensor, wherein the PLC control cabinet is arranged on a rack, and a tool table surface is arranged above the rack; the loading device is arranged on the tool table top and used for loading screws; the manipulator is slidably mounted on the frame; the nail taking clamp is slidably mounted on the rack; the heating device is positioned on the tool table surface at one side of the feeding device; the first sensor is positioned behind the heating device; the cooling device is positioned in front of the heating device and used for cooling the embedded screw; the second sensor is located on the front side of the feeding device. The utility model can realize the detection of the hot burial depth and neglected loading of the screw, improves the working efficiency, reduces the temperature after the hot burial and is beneficial to the subsequent operation of staff.

title_clean: Vehicle control method and device, vehicle and storage medium
abstract_clean: According to the vehicle control method, the vehicle control device, the vehicle and the storage medium, the first coordinate information corresponding to the center point of the tail end of the trailer is obtained, and the second coordinate information corresponding to the target point on the expected reversing track of the vehicle is obtained; determining an expected hinge angle of the vehicle according to the first coordinate information and the second coordinate information; the current front wheel steering angle of the vehicle is determined according to the actual hinge angle and the expected hinge angle of the vehicle, so that the vehicle runs according to the front wheel steering angle. According to the method and the device for controlling the front wheel steering angle of the vehicle, the expected hinging angle of the vehicle is calculated in real time through the target point on the expected reversing track and the current coordinate of the vehicle, so that the front wheel steering angle of the vehicle is regulated in real time according to the expected hinging angle, the stability of the vehicle in the reversing process can be effectively improved, the trailer is prevented from deviating from the expected reversing track, and the safe and accurate expected reversing position of the vehicle is further ensured.

title_clean: Vehicle turn detection
abstract_clean: An turn detection system is configured to determine headings or a course of a vehicle over a period of time and evaluate whether the vehicle has registered a turn based on these headings/course. In some arrangements, upon detecting a turn, sensor data may be collected to determine one or more characteristics or attributes of the turn. Such data may indicate a loss event associated with the turn and be used to calculate a probability or risk of loss given the various characteristics of the turn. These probabilities may further be applied to determine various costs and premiums.

title_clean: Fault processing method, device, medium and equipment for electric vehicle thermal management system
abstract_clean: The embodiment of the application discloses a method, a device, a medium and equipment for processing faults of a thermal management system of an electric automobile. The method comprises the following steps: determining a fault electronic device in response to a fault processing request sent by a thermal management system, and determining fault information of the fault electronic device; wherein the thermal management system comprises at least two thermal management modules; the thermal management module comprises at least two electronic devices; determining a thermal management module to which the faulty electronic device belongs in the thermal management system, and taking the thermal management module as a target thermal management module; and determining a target fault processing plan in the candidate fault processing plans of the target thermal management module based on the fault information of the fault electronic device, and processing a fault processing request based on the target fault processing plan. The technical scheme provides a systematic fault processing method for the electric automobile heat management system, so that the reliability of the electric automobile heat management system can be improved, and the driving safety is ensured.

title_clean: Liquid crystal form aptamer biosensor, preparation method thereof and application thereof in detection of prostate specific antigen
abstract_clean: The invention relates to a liquid crystal form aptamer biosensor, a preparation method thereof and application thereof in detecting prostate specific antigen. The invention provides a new method for quickly detecting Prostate Specific Antigen (PSA), and the PSA liquid crystal type aptamer sensor has the advantages of good specificity, wide linear range, high sensitivity, no need of marking, convenience and quickness in detection and the like, and is beneficial to wide application.

title_clean: Nucleic acid compounds that bind to retinoic acid-inducible gene i protein
abstract_clean: Described herein are aptamers capable of binding to human retinoic acid-inducible gene I protein (RIG-I); compositions comprising a RIG-I binding aptamer with a RIG-I; and methods of making and using the same.

title_clean: Implantable electrical stimulation (ies) system and method thereof
abstract_clean: An implantable electrical stimulation (IES) system and a method thereof, is disclosed. The implantable electrical stimulation (IES) system may comprise an implantable electrode array having a plurality of electrode contacts, an electrical stimulus means, a sensor and a processing circuitry. The electrical stimulus means may be configured for applying the electrical stimulus to at least one stimulating electrode contact of the implantable electrode array. The sensor may be configured for sensing and determining a measured ECAP of the at least one stimulating electrode to generate data for determining a plurality of parameters for the at least one stimulating electrode of the implantable electrode array. The processing circuitry may be configured for processing the measured ECAP and plurality of parameters of the at least one stimulating electrode of the implantable electrode array to compute the corresponding parameters for the remaining electrode contacts of the implantable electrode array.

title_clean: Application of lycium barbarum glycopeptide in preparing medicament for preventing and/or treating amyotrophic lateral sclerosis
abstract_clean: The invention relates to the field of biological medicine, in particular to application of lycium barbarum glycopeptides in preparation of a medicament for preventing and/or treating amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Experimental results show that the medlar glycopeptide is applied to the preparation of the medicament for preventing and/or treating amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Specifically, the medlar glycopeptide slows down the weight reduction of the SOD1G93A transgenic mouse, prolongs the life cycle of the SOD1G93A transgenic mouse, prolongs the disease course of the SOD1G93A transgenic mouse, and down regulates the relative expression quantity of the lumbar spinal cord inflammatory factor of the SOD1G93A transgenic mouse.

title_clean: Charging management method and system for electric automobile
abstract_clean: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent energy management of electric vehicles and discloses a charging management method and system of an electric vehicle, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring vehicle data, user charging demand data and charging station data; according to charging station data, historical data of vehicle data are combined to calculate to obtain load data, the load data are compared with available upper limit data, charging demand data are combined to generate priority charging sequence data, idle charging piles are grouped, an integer programming algorithm is adopted to obtain an optimal power distribution scheme, a charging plan is generated according to the optimal power distribution scheme, real-time charging data are collected and updated in the plan execution process, according to the real-time charging data, historical operation data of the charging station are combined, a deep learning algorithm is adopted to optimize intelligent scheduling strategies, and intelligent distribution of charging station resources is completed. The method can integrate the historical data and the real-time charging data to realize the dynamic optimization of the charging plan of the electric automobile.

title_clean: Battery piece series welding equipment and battery piece series welding method
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a battery piece series welding device and a battery piece series welding method, wherein the battery piece series welding device comprises a welding conveying device, a battery piece feeding device, a welding strip feeding device, a pressure welding strip tool and a welding device; the width of the welding conveying device is larger than the sum of the widths of at least two battery pieces so as to form at least two laying lines on the welding conveying device; the battery piece feeding device is positioned at a front station of the welding conveying device, and the battery pieces are paved on at least two paving lines; the welding strip feeding device is positioned at a front station of the welding conveying device, and welding strips are paved on at least two paving lines; the welding strip tool compresses the battery pieces and the welding strips stacked on the welding conveying device; the welding conveying device conveys the stacked and laid battery pieces and the welding strips to a welding station; the welding device is used for welding the battery piece and the welding strip which are positioned on the welding station. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, at least two battery strings can be welded in one welding process, so that the production efficiency of the battery strings is greatly improved.

title_clean: Aluminum production powered by geothermal energy
abstract_clean: A geothermally powered aluminum production subsystem includes a geothermal system with a wellbore extending from a surface into an underground magma reservoir. A hopper receives a bauxite ore that is crushed and provided to a digestor. The digestor is heated by a heat transfer fluid heated by the geothermal system, and a product of the digestor is used to prepare aluminum.

title_clean: Energy storage battery cell temperature control system
abstract_clean: The utility model provides an energy storage battery core temperature control system which can better realize cold and hot temperature control on an energy storage battery core, ensure uniform cooling, improve cooling efficiency and avoid larger temperature fluctuation of a battery core cold plate during heating operation; the condenser is provided with a condensing fan, the heat exchanger comprises a first inlet, a second inlet, a first outlet and a second outlet, the first outlet is connected with the inlet of the compressor, the outlet of the condenser is connected with the second inlet, the condenser further comprises a one-way valve and a primary throttling mechanism, the second outlet is connected with the primary throttling mechanism after passing through the one-way valve, the inlet of the cold plate is connected with a secondary throttling mechanism, the primary throttling mechanism is connected with the secondary throttling mechanism, the outlet of the cold plate is connected with the first inlet, the output of the compressed refrigerant of the compressor is divided into two paths after passing through a connecting control valve assembly, one path enters the condenser, and the other path is connected to a connecting pipeline between the one-way valve and the primary throttling mechanism.

title_clean: Methods of diagnosing and treating autism spectrum disorders
abstract_clean: The invention describes a method of diagnosing an individual as having an increased likelihood of having an autism spectrum disorder and in some instances, selecting a therapy. The invention is related to a system or a kit for performing such a method.

title_clean: Cluster generation device, cluster generation method, and cluster generation program
abstract_clean: A cluster generation apparatus includes: a user information acquisition unit that acquires position information and time information for a plurality of users; a cluster generation unit that generates a cluster based on spots visited by the users by using the position information for the users, the cluster being a classification of the users; and a route generation unit that generates, for each cluster generated by the cluster generation unit, a movement route based on a history of movement of the cluster between the spots, from the time information and the position information for the users belonging to the cluster.

title_clean: Pile-supported embankment multi-layer reinforcement body reinforcing technology based on numerical simulation
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a pile-supported embankment multi-layer reinforcement body reinforcing technology based on numerical simulation, which specifically comprises the following steps: establishing a numerical model of the pile-supported embankment with the multilayer reinforced ribs by using finite element software, and calculating and analyzing the working mechanism of the multilayer reinforced rib body; based on the stress-strain analysis result of each layer of reinforcement body in the reinforcement cushion layer, the strength grade of each layer of reinforcement body in the reinforcement cushion layer is optimized, and the fine design of the pile-supported reinforced embankment is guided. The invention deeply researches the cooperative bearing mechanism of the reinforcement bodies of each layer in the reinforcement cushion layer, can ensure that the strength of the reinforcement bodies of each layer is fully exerted, and effectively controls the vertical and horizontal displacement of the embankment, on one hand, the long-term stability of the pile-supported reinforced embankment can be maintained, and on the other hand, the material waste caused by the unreasonable design of the reinforcement bodies of multiple layers can be avoided.

title_clean: Efficient data compression and analysis as a service
abstract_clean: Data may be efficiently analyzed and compressed as part of a data compression service. A data compression request may be received from a client indicating data to be compressed. An analysis of the data or metadata associated with the data may be performed. In at least some embodiments, this analysis may be a rules-based analysis. Some embodiments may employ one or more machine learning techniques to historical compression data to update the rules-based analysis. One or more compression techniques may be selected out of a plurality of compression techniques to be applied to the data. Data compression candidates may then be generated according to the selected compression techniques. In some embodiments, a compression service restriction may be enforced. One of the data compression candidates may be selected and sent in a response.

title_clean: Method for synthesizing N-oxo-phosphazone compound by electrochemical driving intermolecular addition of aryl phosphine oxide and diazo compound
abstract_clean: The invention provides a method for synthesizing N-oxo-hydrazone compounds by electrochemical driving of intermolecular addition of aryl phosphine oxide and diazo compounds, which relates to the technical field of preparation of N-oxo-hydrazone compounds, wherein a compound 1 is used as a nitrogen-terminated electrophile, a compound 2, an electrolyte and a solvent are added into an electrochemical reaction tank, and then a constant current is introduced to drive the compound 2 and the compound 1 to synthesize a compound 3 by intermolecular nucleophilic addition; therefore, the preparation method realizes the intermolecular nucleophilic addition of aryl phosphine oxide to the diazonium compound through a green and efficient electrochemical synthesis way, efficiently constructs an N-oxo-phosphohydrazone skeleton, has mild reaction conditions, does not need to use heavy metal catalysis and an oxidant/reducer, ensures that the reaction flow is concise, the reagent is easy to obtain, and greatly reduces the operation complexity.

title_clean: Method for improving secretory expression swollenin of bacillus subtilis and application of method
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a method for improving secretory expression of swollenin by bacillus subtilis and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of biology. According to the invention, firstly, bacillus subtilis G600 capable of successfully secreting and expressing bacillus subtilis source swollenin BsEXLX1 is constructed, the expression level of swollenin protein is enhanced in the strain through a strong promoter P 21 , and secondly, the optimal RBS and signal peptide combination is screened, so that the high-efficiency secretory expression of swollenin is optimized, and finally, the secretory expression level of BsEXLX1 is improved by 3.5 times. The transformation method provided by the invention can realize the secretion expression of the swollenin, lays a foundation for the metabolic engineering transformation of bacillus subtilis to promote the biosynthesis of the swollenin, and has good application prospect. The recombinant strain constructed by the invention has stable expression of the produced swollenin protein and high extracellular secretion, and the construction method is simple and convenient to use, thereby laying a foundation for further large-scale industrial production of swollenin.

title_clean: Paediatrics is with preventing playing by device
abstract_clean: The invention relates to the technical field of medical instruments, in particular to a pediatric quilt kicking prevention device which comprises a base, wherein two rotating shafts which are correspondingly arranged are rotatably arranged on the upper surface of the base along the length direction of the base, a cross rod is fixedly arranged at the top ends of the two rotating shafts, one end of a pull rope is respectively fixed at two ends of each cross rod, pull rope guide mechanisms are fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the base at two sides of each rotating shaft, the pull rope guide mechanisms are arranged in a one-to-one correspondence manner with the pull ropes, a quilt fixer is fixedly arranged after one end of each pull rope passes through the corresponding pull rope guide mechanism, and a limiting mechanism corresponding to one end of each cross rod is arranged on one side of each cross rod. The quilt can prevent the quilt from being kicked off, and can accelerate the discharge of hot air in the quilt, so that children can sleep with high quality.

title_clean: Genetic engineering of fungi to modulate tryptamine expression
abstract_clean: Provided herein are methods for modulating the psilocybin biosynthesis pathway in fungi or other organisms. Also provided are genetically modified fungi and organisms with induced and/or increased expression of psilocybin and psilocin and psilocybin and/or psi!ocin compositions generated by the provided methods.

title_clean: Method for manufacturing a double-skinned plate incorporating circulation channels and plate obtained thereby
abstract_clean: The invention relates to a method for manufacturing a double-skinned plate (1) incorporating channels (2) constituting at least one fluid circulation network or circuit, the method essentially comprising a first step of providing two flat aluminium sheets (3 and 3'), followed by a step of joining them together by laser welding, according to a linear pattern (4) tracing the pattern of the circulation channels (2), the two flat aluminium sheets (3 and 3') into a double-skinned plate (1), and finally a step of forming the circulation channels (2) by injecting a pressurised liquid or gaseous fluid (LP) between the two sheets (3 and 3'). This method is characterised in that it also comprises a step of flattening the plate (1) consisting of the two sheets (3 and 3') joined together by laser welding before the step of forming, by pressure deformation, the circulation channels (2).

title_clean: Paste granule board production with pressing subsides device
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to the technical field of plate processing, in particular to a pressing device for producing a pressing particle plate, which comprises a machine body, wherein a top plate is welded at the top of the machine body, a hydraulic cylinder is connected to an inner bolt of the top plate, a movable plate is connected to an output end key of the hydraulic cylinder, a driving assembly and two groups of adjusting assemblies are arranged in the movable plate, one side of each adjusting assembly is meshed with one side of each driving assembly, and after the hydraulic cylinder is started, the output end of the hydraulic cylinder drives the movable plate to longitudinally displace. The pressing device for producing the pressing particle board is matched with the transverse plate through the swinging plate, and then the sliding block is pushed to displace in a mode of pushing the transverse plate when the swinging plate swings, and the position of the pressing plate is changed through the movement of the sliding block, so that the device can conveniently adjust the pressing working range, and further the device can adapt to particle boards with different sizes and different specifications, and the situation that partial areas are not pressed in place or uneven in pressure distribution is avoided.

title_clean: Ni, cr and Cu composite regulation low-alloy stress corrosion resistant anchor cable steel and preparation method thereof and anchor cable
abstract_clean: The application provides Ni, cr and Cu composite regulation low-alloy stress corrosion resistant anchor cable steel, a preparation method thereof and an anchor cable, and relates to the field of low-alloy steel manufacturing. The anchor cable steel comprises the following components in percentage by mass: c:0.50-0.65%, si:0.20-0.25%, mn:0.75-0.85%, P is less than or equal to 0.03%, S is less than or equal to 0.03%, ni:2.0-4.0%, cr:0.5-1.5%, cu:0.40-0.60%, and the balance being Fe. The preparation method comprises the following steps: smelting raw materials to obtain a steel billet, heating the steel billet to an austenite temperature, preserving heat to enable the steel billet to be completely austenitized, cooling the steel billet to a target temperature along with a furnace, and then carrying out hot rolling to obtain a wire rod; the wire is spray cooled and air cooled in sequence, cold drawing to obtain the steel wire. The anchor cable steel provided by the application has excellent corrosion resistance and fracture performance and mechanical property, and has important engineering practical value.

title_clean: Paper machine dryer scraper equipment for pillow-pack base paper processing
abstract_clean: The invention discloses paper machine dryer scraper equipment for pillow wrapping base paper processing, which comprises a dryer, a support plate and a scraper and is characterized in that a shaft lever is arranged in the middle of the dryer, the middle of the shaft lever is fixedly connected with the dryer, the support plates are respectively arranged on two sides of the shaft lever, one side top end of the support plate is respectively and movably connected with the shaft lever, a transmission motor is arranged on the other side top end of the support plate, one side of the transmission motor is fixedly connected with the support plate, a bottom plate is arranged at the bottom end of the support plate, two sides of the top end of the bottom plate are respectively and fixedly connected with the support plate, universal wheels are respectively arranged on the periphery of the bottom end of the bottom plate, the top ends of the universal wheels are respectively and movably connected with the bottom plate, bolts are respectively and spirally connected with the bottom plate, a base is arranged in the middle of the top end of the bottom plate, the bottom end of the base is fixedly connected with the bottom plate, grooves are respectively arranged in the base at equal intervals, and telescopic struts are respectively arranged in the grooves. The invention has simple structure and convenient operation.

title_clean: Method for calculating influence of overwater photovoltaic on water temperature of underlying closed water area
abstract_clean: The invention relates to a method for calculating the influence of overwater photovoltaics on the water temperature of an underlying closed water area, which comprises the following steps: collecting information; calculating solar short-wave radiation; calculating atmospheric long radiation received by the water surface under the photovoltaic shielding; calculating evaporation scattering; calculating the convection heat flux; calculating the outward long-wave radiant heat flux of the water body; computing t 0 Time of day free surface total heat flux; calculating influence of photovoltaics t 0 → t 1 The water temperature of the water body changes at any moment;computing t 1 The water temperature that is affected by the photovoltaic at all times. According to the method, the influence of the overwater photovoltaic power station on the water temperature change is quantitatively calculated according to local meteorological conditions and photovoltaic array layout parameters to be built aiming at the pile foundation overwater photovoltaic power station in the closed water area through a water body heat balance calculation method and a calculation formula of influence of each flux subentry influence factor on the photovoltaic array, the water temperature and the water temperature change calculated according to the method can be used as a basis for evaluating the influence of the photovoltaic power station on the water environment, and a scientific basis is provided for development and utilization of the water area after the photovoltaic power station is built in the future.

title_clean: Gas jet kitchen ventilator
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to the technical field of kitchen appliances, in particular to an air jet range hood. The negative pressure gas receiving cover of the device is internally provided with a jet pipe with a closed lower end, an air booster is arranged outside the negative pressure gas receiving cover, the air outlet end of the air booster is connected with an air pressure stabilizing device, the air outlet end of the air pressure stabilizing device is communicated with the inside of the jet pipe through a pipeline, the upper end of the negative pressure gas receiving cover is connected with a diffusion pipe, the upper end of the diffusion pipe is connected with a mixing pipe, the upper end of the mixing pipe is connected with a one-way valve, and the outlet of the upper end of the jet pipe extends into the diffusion pipe. The utility model realizes that negative pressure is generated by jet flow, the negative pressure difference is large, the adsorption force is strong, the efficiency is high, a fan is not adopted, the phenomenon that the rotating blades accumulate heavy oil stains to cause the oil fume adsorption effect is greatly reduced, an exhaust air flow channel is unobstructed, and the workload of cleaning the range hood is greatly reduced.

title_clean: Self-breaking cage anti-seepage agent and anti-seepage method
abstract_clean: A self-breaking cage anti-seepage agent and an anti-seepage method are disclosed, wherein the self-breaking cage anti-seepage agent comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 15-20% of main monomer, 3-8% of temperature-resistant and salt-resistant monomer, 0.5-3% of acid-sensitive monomer, 0.02-0.05% of water-soluble initiator and the balance of water. The proportion of different anti-seepage agents is adjusted by adopting the types and the using amounts of the different anti-seepage agents so as to change the degradation characteristics of the anti-seepage agents, and finally, the soil is recovered after the operation is finished. The formula can be adjusted according to the mining age of the ore body so as to change the cage breaking time node. By adopting the method, the problems of incapability of recovering functions of the soil after the mining and the selection, ecological environment damage and the like caused by a permanent impermeable layer can be effectively solved, and the green mine construction is powerfully promoted.

title_clean: Electric gas flow heater and vehicle
abstract_clean: An electric gas flow heater has a grid-like heating element through which exhaust gas can flow axially, and which forms an electrical resistance heating. The grid-like heating element includes radially successive layers of band-like material, wherein the layers, in an axial view of the heating element, are bent in an undulating manner and include valleys and peaks. The layers that are located between the radially outermost layer and the radially innermost layer are attached by their peaks and valleys to the respectively radially adjacent layer, so that flow-through openings are formed between the layers. The wavelengths of the layers are increasing radially outwards.

title_clean: Management method and system for solar photovoltaic power station using illuminance sensor and bigdata
abstract_clean: Various embodiments of the present invention relate to a solar power plant management system. According to various embodiments of the present invention, a solar power plant management system using an illuminance sensor and big data includes a plurality of solar panels; an illuminance sensor detecting an illuminance amount of the plurality of solar panels; a power generation amount detection unit for detecting the amount of generation of each of the plurality of solar panels; and an analysis device functionally connected to the solar panel, the illuminance sensor, and the generation amount detection unit. The analysis device may check the amount of illuminance by using the illuminance sensor, check the amount of power generated by each of the plurality of solar panels corresponding to the amount of illuminance, and compare the amount of power generation between the plurality of photovoltaic panels. As a result of the comparison, when there is a photovoltaic panel in which the amount of power generation of the plurality of photovoltaic panels is reduced by more than a first reference value, the analysis device may be determined that the photovoltaic panel is in a faulty state. Other embodiments may be possible.

title_clean: Acquisition circuit with selectable switching value judgment threshold
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses an acquisition circuit with an optional switching value judgment threshold, which comprises: the circuit comprises a first interface, a second interface, a first resistor, a second interface, a second resistor, a third resistor, a fourth resistor, an operational amplifier, a voltage dividing circuit and an optocoupler; the first interface is used for accessing an external sensor; the non-inverting input end of the operational amplifier is connected with the first interface, and the inverting input end of the operational amplifier is connected with an external switching value input interface; one end of the first resistor is connected between the non-inverting input end of the operational amplifier and the first interface, and the other end of the second resistor is connected with the second interface and then grounded; the second interface is connected with external 24V voltage through a second resistor, a third resistor and a fourth resistor respectively; the voltage dividing circuit is connected with the output end of the operational amplifier and the optical coupler; the optocoupler is connected to an external central chip. The utility model can easily adjust and adapt to the threshold value of switch detection, thereby better meeting different functional and performance requirements.

title_clean: Modulation method of diurnal rhythm spectrum
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a modulation method of a daytime rhythm spectrum, which comprises the following steps: providing a white light LED, a blue light LED, a green light LED and a blue-green light LED; regulating the luminous flux of each LED to obtain a daytime rhythm spectrum with preset luminous flux; the light fluxes of the white light LED, the blue light LED, the green light LED and the blue-green light LED respectively account for 62.32-75.9%, 1.74-1.91%, 1.5-20.27% and 15.5-22.8% of the preset light flux. By implementing the invention, the daytime rhythm spectrum with high rhythm stimulation and high color rendering index can be obtained.

title_clean: Impedance regulator
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to an impedance adjuster, comprising a first input port, an input filter, a current adjuster and a low-frequency filter; the first input port is connected in parallel with a radio frequency input port of the radio frequency power supply load and is used for accessing radio frequency input current; the input filter is electrically connected with the first input port and is used for filtering the accessed radio frequency input current; the current regulator is electrically connected with the first input port and is used for regulating the accessed radio frequency input current; the low-frequency filter is electrically connected with the current regulator and is used for low-frequency filtering. The impedance regulator solves the problem of adjustment of the input load current of the radio frequency power supply, and achieves impedance matching.

title_clean: Boron-containing resonance type organic compound and organic electroluminescent device comprising same
abstract_clean: The invention relates to a boron-containing resonance type organic compound and an organic electroluminescent device comprising the same, belonging to the technical field of semiconductors, wherein the structure of the compound is shown as a general formula (1): when the compound is used as a doping material in a luminescent layer material of an organic electroluminescent device, the compound can be used as a green doping material of the luminescent layer of the organic electroluminescent device, so that the service life of the device is prolonged.

title_clean: Ethylene-coated nano aluminum particle and preparation method and application thereof
abstract_clean: The invention belongs to the field of preparation of organic-inorganic composite nanoparticles, and particularly relates to ethylene-coated aluminum nanoparticles and a preparation method and application thereof. The ethylene-coated nano aluminum particle provided by the invention comprises a nano aluminum particle and an ethylene coating layer coated on the surface of the nano aluminum particle. The ethylene-coated nano aluminum particle provided by the invention is provided with an ethylene coating layer coated on the surface of the nano aluminum particle, and ethylene molecules are adsorbed on the surface of the nano aluminum particle to form the ethylene coating layer. The ethylene is uniformly coated on the surface of the nano aluminum particles, so that the agglomeration of the nano aluminum particles can be reduced. Ethylene has good compatibility with the propellant component, can make ethylene cladding's nanometer aluminium granule have better processing nature, and in addition, the ethylene cladding plays isolated effect to the oxidizing atmosphere in the external environment, can slow down the oxidation of nanometer aluminium granule, and in addition, ethylene ignition temperature is low, and the burning generates gas, all has the promotion effect to the ignition and the combustion behavior of nanometer aluminite powder.

title_clean: Blade made of composite material with at least partially ceramic matrix
abstract_clean: A blade made of composite material includes a fibrous reinforcement and an at least partially ceramic matrix, wherein the fibrous reinforcement includes a first structural portion formed by three-dimensional or multilayer weaving, and a second functional portion, distinct from the first portion, including short fibers.

title_clean: Fixed bed reaction device, synthesis system and synthesis method for methylamine synthesis
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a fixed bed reaction device, a synthesis system and a synthesis method for synthesizing methylamine, wherein the fixed bed reaction device comprises a tower body, a plurality of catalyst layers and a plurality of feeding pipes, wherein the catalyst layers are respectively arranged on cross sections of the tower body at different heights; the plurality of feeding pipes are arranged in parallel along the axial direction of the tower body and are uniformly distributed along the cross section of the tower body; the feeding end of the feeding pipe is arranged close to the bottom of the tower body, and the discharging end of the feeding pipe is arranged close to the top of the tower body; the synthesis gas outlet of the tower body is positioned at the lower end of the tower body. The inlet pipe can utilize reaction heat to heat the feed gas more fully, through the heat transfer, has improved the temperature of feed gas, because the synthetic reaction of methylamine needs to go on under certain temperature and pressure, consequently after improving the feed gas temperature, can make the reaction just can abundant catalytic reaction in one section packing of the top, can improve the utilization ratio of catalyst in the synthetic fixed bed reaction unit.

title_clean: Machine cabinet
abstract_clean: The application discloses rack relates to heat dissipation technical field. The cabinet specifically includes: the device comprises a base and a plurality of chassis stacked on the base in sequence; a heat dissipation structure is arranged on a shell of the case, a heat dissipation channel is formed by enclosing the heat dissipation structure and the shell, and the heat dissipation channels of the cases are communicated to form a circulating air duct; the circulating air duct comprises an air inlet arranged at one end of the circulating air duct and an air outlet arranged at the other end of the circulating air duct, and the air inlet is close to the base. In this application embodiment, circulation wind channel both can promote the heat-sinking capability of rack, can form the rack again and shelter from, improves the protective capacities of rack, can also promote the flexibility of rack dilatation.

title_clean: Gyration bearing structure
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a rotary supporting structure, which comprises a seat ring and a moving coil, wherein a lower shaft mounting hole is formed in the center of the seat ring, an upper shaft mounting hole is formed in the center of the moving coil, a lower shaft is mounted in the lower shaft mounting hole, an upper shaft fixed with the lower shaft through a bolt is arranged in the upper shaft mounting hole, so that the seat ring is connected with the moving coil, a thrust bearing and a radial bearing are arranged at the joint of the upper shaft mounting hole and the lower shaft mounting hole, and a ball and an isolation block group connected with the moving coil are arranged on the outer edge of the seat ring; meanwhile, the utility model has simple structure and easy manufacture, and greatly reduces the manufacturing cost.

title_clean: Alloy steel mechanical fitting fixed-position welding device
abstract_clean: The invention relates to the technical field of plasma arc welding and discloses an alloy steel mechanical accessory positioning welding device which comprises a welding table and a driving disc arranged on the top surface of the welding table, wherein a welding seat is fixedly arranged on the top surface of the welding table at the side edge of the driving disc, a plasma arc welding gun is arranged at the movable end of the welding seat, a plurality of uniformly distributed mounting holes are formed in the top surface of the driving disc, and a plurality of supports are arranged on the top surface of the driving disc. According to the invention, the position of the support is adjusted, the support is coaxially arranged in the mounting hole by matching with the limiting plate and the locating plate, the spring telescopic rod is attached to the outer wall of the workpiece through the spring telescopic rod and the pressing strip, the spring telescopic rod is fixed by the locking frame, multi-point adaptive clamping can be formed aiming at irregular shapes of the special-shaped workpiece, meanwhile, the angle locking design of the locking cone pulley and the locking cap is realized, the deviation of the workpiece in welding is avoided, the problem of difficult fixation of the special-shaped alloy steel fitting is solved, the accurate and firm positioning of the workpiece before welding is ensured, and a foundation is laid for high-quality welding.

title_clean: Method for producing a connecting element and connecting element
abstract_clean: The invention relates to a method for producing a connecting element (1, 30), in particular for the articulated connection of components arranged in a chassis, wherein the connecting element (1, 30) is formed by a profiled element (6, 31) having a hinge section (2) for receiving a hinge component (5), an intermediate section (4) and a connecting section (3), wherein the profiled element (6, 31) is formed by an assembly of at least one first profiled section (7, 32) and at least one second profiled section (8, 33), which assembly is held in its position by means of at least one fixing element (9, 10) by a form-fitting connection; a hinge member (5) is inserted into the hinge section (2); and the molding element (6, 31) and the hinge component (5) are partially encapsulated with plastic by injection molding.

title_clean: Optical storage and filling system load side energy router
abstract_clean: The utility model is suitable for the technical field of energy routers, and provides an energy router on a load side of an optical storage and charging system, which comprises a cabinet body, an exhaust groove formed in the upper end of the back of the cabinet body, an exhaust fan fixedly connected to the inner wall of the exhaust groove, a dust-proof plate movably connected to the inner wall of the fixed groove, a fixed plate fixedly connected to the inner wall of the cabinet body at equal intervals, a sliding plate movably connected to the top end of the fixed plate, and a communication unit, a control unit and an energy storage power unit fixedly connected to the top end of the sliding plate through bolts respectively. The optical storage charging system load side energy router that this scheme provided is through three fixed plates with communication unit, control unit and energy storage power unit modularization split type installation to utilize locating component, slide and spout, make when the follow-up maintenance, can take out communication unit, control unit and energy storage power unit split type slip, avoid at the internal inconvenience that leads to the maintenance of cabinet because of the space restriction, improve its practicality.

title_clean: Photodetection device, method for manufacturing photodetection device, and electronic apparatus
abstract_clean: The present disclosure relates to a photodetection device, a method of manufacturing the photodetection device, and an electronic device, which are capable of improving a light condensing effect of a microlens in units of pixels and improving optical characteristics. The photodetection device includes pixels each including a photoelectric conversion section that photoelectrically converts incident light, a microlens that condenses the incident light on the photoelectric conversion section, and a plurality of protrusions formed on the microlens. The pixels each include two or more of the protrusions in which at least one of a width, a height, or a density is different. The present disclosure can be applied to, for example, a solid-state imaging device or the like.

title_clean: Cross blood matching test combiner
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a cross blood matching test combiner, which comprises a mounting seat, wherein the upper end part of the mounting seat is slidably connected with an H-shaped bracket, the inner walls of the two sides of the lower end of the H-shaped bracket are movably connected with telescopic parts, one ends of two groups of telescopic parts are respectively fixedly connected with the two sides of a test tube rack, the bottom ends of the two sides of the test tube rack are slidably connected with hollow fixed blocks, the lower end of the inner part of the mounting seat is fixedly provided with a bottom plate, the two ends of the bottom plate are connected with first spiral lead screws, the outer surfaces of the two groups of first spiral lead screws are respectively sleeved with the two ends of a supporting plate, the bottom ends of the two groups of first spiral lead screws are respectively fixedly provided with first gears, the two groups of first gears are respectively movably connected with two groups of second gears, the two groups of second gears are respectively sleeved at the two ends of the second, can carry out steady reciprocating to test tube holder, effectively avoid the deviation that traditional moving means caused and the condition of weeping even to appear.

title_clean: Semiconductor device, manufacturing method thereof, and electronic device including the device
abstract_clean: The disclosed technology provides a semiconductor device, a manufacturing method thereof, and an electronic device including the device. An example semiconductor device includes a substrate; a first device and a second device on the substrate. Each of the first device and the second device include a first source/drain layer, a channel layer, and a second source layer that are sequentially stacked, from bottom to top, on the substrate, and a gate stack around at least a part of an outer periphery of the channel layer, with sidewalls of the respective channel layers of the first device and the second device extending at least partially along different crystal planes or crystal plane families.

title_clean: Rotor assembly with cooling channels separated by ribs for a rotary engine
abstract_clean: A rotor housing for an aircraft rotary engine includes a side housing body and a rail. The side housing body extends along an axis between and to an inner side and an outer side. The side housing body forms a fluid cooling passage and a plurality of ribs. The fluid cooling passage extends about the axis at the inner side. The plurality of ribs are coincident with and extend into the fluid cooling passage. The plurality of ribs are distributed about the fluid cooling passage as an array of ribs. The rail is disposed at the plurality of ribs. The rail extends about the fluid cooling passage. The side housing body and the rail form a plurality of fluid cooling channels connected in fluid communication with the fluid cooling passage.

title_clean: Multifunctional integrated mechanical arm
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a multi-functional integrated arm belongs to arm technical field, including support piece and slider, support piece includes the support, establish rotating electrical machines and plectane in the support, the bottom mounting of plectane has the stand, the bottom of stand is connected with the inner circle of fixing the bearing in the support, be fixed with on the stand with establish the driven gear at the epaxial driving gear adaptation of rotating electrical machines output, the top of plectane is fixed with the motor that just reverses, the output shaft of the motor that reverses passes through the shaft coupling and is connected with the lead screw, the slider is run through on the top of lead screw, construct in the slider two and fix the logical groove at the montant adaptation on plectane top, be equipped with the support on the slider, be equipped with the pneumatic cylinder on the support and the slide of being connected with the pneumatic cylinder, one side of slide is fixed with the hydraulic stem, the hydraulic stem is connected with splint. This multi-functional integrated arm, the convenient regulation, the convenient dismantlement.

title_clean: Device for preventing holes from being sprayed during drilling construction in underground coal mine
abstract_clean: The utility model belongs to the technical field of mining equipment, especially, be a colliery prevents device of orifice during drilling construction in pit, comprising a base plate, the lower terminal surface fixedly connected with universal wheel of bottom plate, the upside of bottom plate is equipped with the diaphragm, two support columns of lower terminal surface symmetry and fixedly connected with of diaphragm, and the bottom of support column all with bottom plate fixed connection, it is connected with the threaded rod to rotate between bottom plate and the diaphragm, the bottom fixedly connected with of threaded rod is from the driving wheel, the up end fixedly connected with support frame of bottom plate, the up end fixedly connected with motor of support frame. The utility model discloses a set up threaded rod, action wheel, from driving wheel, belt, motor, prevent spouting cover, rose box, filter screen and bin, the drilling construction of convenient to co-altitude prevents spouting, and the flexibility is better, and the convenient dust that produces drilling filters, and guarantee operating personnel's is healthy.

title_clean: Electromagnetic brake with locking device mounted in front
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a front-mounted electromagnetic brake with a locking device, which comprises a front-mounted assembly, wherein the front-mounted assembly comprises a front cover; the rear assembly comprises a rear cover; the front cover and the rear cover are respectively provided with a shaft hole when being placed on the axial central line; the front cover, the brake body and the rear cover are all provided with threaded through holes; the threaded through holes of the front cover, the brake body and the rear cover are linearly aligned; the bolt is sequentially connected with the front cover, the brake body and the rear cover; the front cover and the rear cover are provided with mounting holes; the axial center line of the brake body is provided with a shaft hole, a rotating shaft is connected in the shaft hole, and the rotating shaft sequentially penetrates through the rear cover, the brake body and the front cover; one end of the rotating shaft facing the rear cover is connected with a locking device. The utility model discloses an use a bolt to synthesize a whole with protecgulum, stopper body and back lid to set up the pivot on the axial direction line of protecgulum, stopper body and back lid, realize brake motor pivoted purpose, hold motor shaft tightly when making pivot and motor shaft be connected, solve the problem that the reliability is low.

title_clean: Aryloxy phenoxy propionate compound and application thereof
abstract_clean: The invention discloses an aryloxy phenoxy propionate compound and application thereof, wherein the compound is shown as a general formula (I): Wherein: x is selected from O or S; r 1 is selected from a direct bond or C 1 -C 6 alkyl; r 2 、R 3 is independently selected from a direct bond or C 1 -C 6 alkyl; r 4 、R 5 is independently selected from halogen, C 1 -C 6 alkoxy, C 1 -C 6 haloalkoxy, C 1 -C 6 alkylthio, C 1 -C 6 haloalkylthio, C 1 -C 6 alkylsulfonyl, C 1 -C 6 haloalkylsulfonyl, C 1 -C 6 alkylsulfinyl, and, C 1 -C 6 haloalkyl sulfinyl, C 2 -C 6 alkenyl sulfonyl, C 2 -C 6 alkynyl sulfonyl, C 3 -C 6 cycloalkyl oxy, C 2 -C 6 alkenyloxy, C 2 -C 6 alkynyloxy, C 1 -C 6 alkylcarbonyloxy, C 2 -C 6 alkenylcarbonyloxy, c 2 -C 6 alkynyl carbonyloxy; Chiral carbon atom is R or S configuration, or the mixture of R and S in different proportions. The compound of the invention not only has excellent herbicidal activity, but also is safe for crops.

title_clean: Method for improving secretory expression swollenin of bacillus subtilis and application of method
