abstract_clean: The invention discloses a method for improving secretory expression of swollenin by bacillus subtilis and application thereof, belonging to the technical field of biology. According to the invention, firstly, bacillus subtilis G600 capable of successfully secreting and expressing bacillus subtilis source swollenin BsEXLX1 is constructed, the expression level of swollenin protein is enhanced in the strain through a strong promoter P 21 , and secondly, the optimal RBS and signal peptide combination is screened, so that the high-efficiency secretory expression of swollenin is optimized, and finally, the secretory expression level of BsEXLX1 is improved by 3.5 times. The transformation method provided by the invention can realize the secretion expression of the swollenin, lays a foundation for the metabolic engineering transformation of bacillus subtilis to promote the biosynthesis of the swollenin, and has good application prospect. The recombinant strain constructed by the invention has stable expression of the produced swollenin protein and high extracellular secretion, and the construction method is simple and convenient to use, thereby laying a foundation for further large-scale industrial production of swollenin.

title_clean: Cell lines, varieties, and methods for in vitro cotton fiber production
abstract_clean: The present disclosure provides in vitro methods for producing cotton fiber, including methods using cotton varietals the were discovered to be particularly amendable for use in the presently disclosed in vitro methods of cotton fiber production.

title_clean: Methods and compositions related to toxicity associated with cell therapy
abstract_clean: Provided are methods, kits and compositions related to toxicity associated with administration of cell therapy for the treatment of diseases or conditions, e.g., cancer, including methods for use in predicting and treating a toxicity. In some embodiments, the toxicity is a neurotoxicity or cytokine release syndrome (CRS), such as a severe neurotoxicity or a severe CRS. The methods generally involve detecting a parameter of a biomarker or individually a parameter of each biomarker in a panel of biomarkers, such as a concentration, amount or activity, and comparing the detected parameter to a reference value for the parameter to determine if the subject is at risk for developing the toxicity, such as neurotoxicity or CRS or severe neurotoxicity or severe CRS. In some embodiments, the methods further involve administering an agent or therapy for treating, ameliorating, preventing, delaying and/or attenuating the development of the toxicity, such as neurotoxicity or CRS, such as severe neurotoxicity or severe CRS.

title_clean: Reception apparatus, transmission apparatus, quantum key distribution system, and peak position detection method
abstract_clean: The present disclosure includes a reception apparatus performing homodyne detection of a first beam transmitted from a transmission apparatus by using a second beam transmitted from the transmission apparatus and having an optical intensity higher than the first beam, and detecting a peak position, which is a timing at which there is a local maximum or a local minimum in an amplitude of a signal obtained by the homodyne detection.

title_clean: Optical compensation device and method for display panel
abstract_clean: The invention discloses an optical compensation device and method of a display panel. The optical compensation device of the display panel comprises a bearing platform, a first measuring unit, a second measuring unit, a first data processing unit and a second data processing unit, wherein the bearing platform is used for bearing the display panel, the first measuring unit is used for acquiring first brightness data when the display panel displays a preset picture under a front view angle, the second measuring unit is used for acquiring image data when the display panel displays the preset picture under the front view angle, the first data processing unit is connected with the first measuring unit and used for receiving the first brightness data and generating first brightness compensation data according to the first brightness data to carry out brightness compensation, the second data processing unit is connected with the second measuring unit and used for receiving the image data and generating pixel-level brightness compensation data according to the image data to carry out pixel brightness compensation, and the first measuring unit and the second measuring unit are started to work simultaneously so as to compensate the brightness of the whole surface brightness of the display panel and brightness between pixels at the same time, and the compensation cost is reduced.

title_clean: Micro electrostatic speaker
abstract_clean: An acoustic device including a membrane having an edge. A membrane support is attached to the edge of the membrane. A central region of the membrane is unsupported by the support. A first electrode and the membrane support are manufactured as a single element. The first electrode is disposed parallel to the membrane. The membrane is configured to respond acoustically to a varying first electric field emanating from the first electrode when a varying first voltage is applied to the first electrode. A coating is deposited on a surface of the first electrode facing the membrane.

title_clean: Collimating lens and image sensor
abstract_clean: The invention provides a collimating lens and an image sensor, wherein the collimating lens comprises an aperture diaphragm, a first lens group, a second lens group and a third lens group which are sequentially arranged at intervals along the incident direction of light beams, the first lens group has negative focal power, the second lens group and the third lens group have positive focal power, and the focal lengths of the first lens group, the second lens group and the third lens group satisfy the following relational expression: 3< f2/f <5, and 0.5< f3/f <2, and f1< -0.5 xf 2, and 0.5< f/d < 0.6; wherein f1 is the focal length of the first lens group, f2 is the focal length of the second lens group, f3 is the focal length of the third lens group, f is the total focal length, and d is the spot diameter defined by the aperture stop. By the design, the numerical aperture of the collimating lens can be ensured to be larger than 1.35 in water, so that the requirement that the numerical aperture NA of the polarization aberration measurement transmission sensor of the immersion type projection objective is larger than or equal to 1.35 can be met.

title_clean: Method and device for analyzing charging load of electric vehicle in power distribution area
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a method and a device for analyzing charging load of an electric automobile in a power distribution station area, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting charging data of charging piles in a power distribution station area; processing the charging data to obtain the charging state distribution of the electric automobile; acquiring basic load data of a power distribution station area, and determining the electricity price of each time period in one day according to the basic load data; according to the electric vehicle charging state distribution and the electricity price of each time period, establishing a charging and discharging model with the minimum user charging cost and the minimum load variance of a power distribution station area; optimizing the charging and discharging model based on a particle swarm algorithm to obtain an optimal charging scheme of the electric automobile; the method can balance the load of the power distribution area and the charging load of the electric automobile on the basis of fully considering the charging desire of the user, saves the charging cost of the user, and is high in accuracy of an analysis result, more reasonable and strong in feasibility.

title_clean: Data report generation method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_clean: The embodiment of the application provides a data report generation method, a data report generation device, a storage medium and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining N data reports in a target time period, wherein the N data reports are tables for recording transaction data of a target product based on N recording angles, N is a natural number greater than 1, performing data processing operation on the N data reports to obtain the target data table, the data processing operation sequentially comprises data integration operation, data verification operation, data cleaning operation and data format conversion operation, and generating the data report of the target product according to the target data table, wherein the data report is used for representing transaction risk change of the target product in the target time period. The application solves the problem that the data report cannot be accurately generated in the related technology, and achieves the effect of accurately generating the data report.

title_clean: Painting skill assessment method based on painting handwriting analysis
abstract_clean: The invention relates to the technical field of image recognition application, in particular to a painting skill assessment method based on painting handwriting analysis, which comprises the following steps of collecting pen pressure and speed sequences, calculating displacement vector standard deviation mark turning points by a sliding window, and extracting interval product characteristics to generate a rhythm label, generating a bit map by four-dimensional compression coding of a direction included angle and a trend label, and calculating the rhythm segment bit density by density segmentation to generate a skill assessment matrix. According to the invention, pen pressure and speed data are acquired through the pressure-sensitive digital panel, a sliding window is used for judging a standard differential state threshold value of a displacement vector, an action turning point is accurately marked, a time sequence characteristic of a pen conveying track is captured, a trend comparison algorithm is used for quantifying the product change of pen pressure speed to generate a rhythm trend label, a four-dimensional compression fusion direction vector and a rhythm label are normalized into a binary bit map, a rhythm enhancement section is segmented by a density threshold value, a skill evaluation matrix is calculated, the problems of subjective evaluation dependence and dynamic deletion are solved, and evaluation objectivity and interpretation are improved.

title_clean: Data processing method, device, server and storage medium
abstract_clean: The disclosure relates to a data processing method, a data processing device, a server and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of information processing. The data processing method comprises the steps of receiving a data processing request for first data in a first data set; wherein the first data set comprises at least one encrypted data set; in response to the data processing request, in a case where it is determined that the first data includes encrypted data in the encrypted data group, acquiring a decryption key corresponding to the first data set; decrypting the encrypted data group corresponding to the first data according to the decryption key to obtain second data, and processing the second data to obtain target data; wherein the second data comprises at least part of the data in the decrypted data. By adopting the data processing method, the data processing device, the server and the storage medium, the problem that data processing cannot be effectively and flexibly carried out on the premise of ensuring data safety in the prior art is at least solved.

title_clean: Stochastically-aware metrology and fabrication
abstract_clean: A system for stochastically-aware metrology includes a controller to be communicatively coupled to a fabrication tool. The controller receives a production recipe including at least a pattern of elements to be fabricated on a sample and one or more exposure parameters for exposing the pattern of elements, identifies candidate care areas of the pattern of elements susceptible to stochastic repeaters including fabrication defects predicted to occur stochastically when fabricated according to the production recipe, selects one or more care areas from the candidate care areas by comparing one or more predicted likelihoods of the one or more stochastic repeaters to a defect likelihood threshold, modifies the production recipe to mitigate the stochastic repeaters within the one or more care areas within a selected tolerance, and directs the fabrication tool to fabricate at least one sample according to the modified production recipe.

title_clean: Real-time flow monitoring device for water supply and drainage pipe network
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to the technical field of drainage flow monitoring, and discloses a supply and drainage pipe network flow real-time monitoring device, which comprises a flowmeter installation pipeline, a meter, a stain blocking pipeline and a drainage pipe connection pipeline, wherein the meter is fixedly installed at the top of the flowmeter installation pipeline, a LED data display screen is arranged on the front surface of the meter, a working state flashing lamp is fixedly installed at the top of the LED data display screen, a protective cover is movably installed at the left side of the meter, a data connection transmission antenna is installed at the right side of the meter in a connected manner, and the stain blocking pipeline is installed at the left side of the flowmeter installation pipeline in a connected manner; through installing devices such as flowmeter installation pipeline, protective cover, spot filtering pipeline, spot filtering component, sealing rubber pad, spot filter screen, drain pipe connecting tube, rubber seal hose, installation tighrening ring, fastening screw, drain pipe joint pipeline, reached possess simple to operate, install sealed effectual, easily clear up the purpose of spot.

title_clean: Reducing peak out-of-vertical loads in a wind turbine
abstract_clean: A method of controlling a wind turbine is provided, comprising identifying an out-of-vertical load acting in a first direction on the wind turbine. A direction of a wind load acting on the wind turbine is determined. If there is a degree of alignment between the direction of the wind load and the first direction, the wind turbine is controlled to reduce the wind load.

title_clean: Method for calculating flow coefficient of regulating valve of refrigeration compressor performance testing device
abstract_clean: A method for calculating flow coefficient of regulating valve of a refrigeration compressor performance test device comprises the following steps: aiming at performance design parameters of the refrigeration compressor, a working condition operation diagram of the compressor is built in a two-dimensional coordinate system taking evaporation pressure as an abscissa and condensing pressure as an ordinate, and working condition inflection points on the working condition operation diagram are obtained; variable parameters and fixed parameters corresponding to the inflection points of all working conditions are obtained; and obtaining the maximum value of the flow coefficient primary upper limit values of the regulating valve to be calculated under different working condition inflection points as the flow coefficient upper limit value of the regulating valve to be calculated, and obtaining the minimum value of the flow coefficient primary lower limit values of the regulating valve to be calculated under different working condition inflection points as the flow coefficient lower limit value of the regulating valve to be calculated. According to the invention, the finally obtained flow coefficient adjusting range of the adjusting valve to be calculated can meet the requirement of any working condition inflection point, and support is provided for parameter selection of the adjusting valve of the refrigerating compressor performance testing device.

title_clean: Grabbing and clamping mechanism for aluminum template reinforcing ribs
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a grabbing and clamping mechanism for aluminum formwork reinforcing ribs, which comprises two groups of clamping assemblies which are oppositely arranged, wherein each clamping assembly comprises a linear driving device, a positioning plate is fixed at the driving end of each linear driving device, a sliding groove is formed in the surface of one side, far away from each linear driving device, of each positioning plate, a sliding block is connected in a sliding manner in each sliding groove, an elastic piece is fixed at the top of each sliding block, and one end of each sliding block is fixedly provided with a clamping plate for clamping the reinforcing rib. Compared with the prior art, after the reinforcing rib is clamped by the clamping plate, if the length of the reinforcing rib is too long, a larger reaction force is applied to the clamping plate on the inner walls of the two sides of the aluminum template due to contact of the reinforcing rib, so that the sliding block overcomes the elasticity of the elastic piece to slide upwards, the reinforcing rib can not continuously descend along with the descending of the mechanical arm, and the problem that the two sides of the aluminum template are outwards protruded due to forced clamping of the reinforcing rib into the aluminum template is avoided.

title_clean: Clamping conveying device for machining
abstract_clean: The application discloses a clamping and conveying device for machining, which relates to the field of clamping and conveying equipment and comprises a machining table, wherein two clamping rails are arranged above the machining table in parallel, first driving mechanisms for driving the two clamping rails to perform centering or separating movement are arranged on two sides of the clamping rails, elastic clamping assemblies for clamping workpieces are arranged on adjacent sides of the two clamping rails, lifting pieces for driving the first driving mechanisms to lift are arranged on two sides of the machining table, and a second driving mechanism for driving the elastic clamping assemblies to move with the workpieces is arranged on one side of the machining table. The application not only can carry out self-adaptive adjustment according to the small size difference of the same workpiece and stably clamp the workpiece, but also can adjust the clamping distance according to different types of workpieces, and has strong adaptability.

title_clean: Braiding apparatus
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to a braiding device, which comprises a fixed seat, a shaft core clamping assembly, a wire spool assembly, a first driving device and a second driving device, wherein the shaft core clamping assembly is arranged on the fixed seat in a longitudinally movable manner; the wire spool assembly comprises a wire spool bearing part and a wire spool, wherein the wire spool bearing part is fixedly arranged on the fixing seat, the wire spool can be rotatably arranged on the wire spool bearing part around the axis of the wire spool, and a shaft core hole for a shaft core to pass through and a plurality of threading holes for threading are formed in the wire spool; the first driving device is connected with the shaft core clamping assembly so as to drive the shaft core clamping assembly to move longitudinally; the second driving device is connected with the wire spool to drive the wire winding disc to rotate around the axis of the wire winding disc. Different medical blood vessels wound by multiple wires can be woven by staff according to different requirements, and automatic weaving of the wires can be realized, so that the weaving efficiency of the medical blood vessels wound by the multiple wires can be improved, and the workload of the staff is reduced.

title_clean: Conveying device for capacitor stainless steel shell production line
abstract_clean: The invention relates to the technical field of capacitor production and transportation, and discloses a conveying device for a capacitor stainless steel shell production line, which comprises a device base, wherein two groups of side baffles are symmetrically riveted at the upper end of the device base, four groups of first chain wheels are symmetrically distributed between the two groups of side baffles, the four groups of first chain wheels are respectively sleeved on two groups of first wheel shafts, two ends of each first wheel shaft are fixed through a first bearing seat and the side baffles, the two groups of first chain wheels on the same side are connected and driven through a first chain, and a conveying belt is arranged outside the two groups of first chains in a surrounding mode. According to the conveying device for the capacitor stainless steel shell production line, the first wheel shaft on the first synchronous chain wheel is caused to rotate by synchronous and same-direction transmission of the second synchronous chain wheel, and the plurality of groups of automatic dispensers on the second chain wheel are driven to do rotary motion by the connection transmission effect of the second chain wheel and the second chain wheel, so that the purposes of saving energy and reducing cost are achieved by sharing one power source.

title_clean: Perovskite-based thin film solar cell
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a perovskite base film solar cell in solar cell technical field, which comprises an outer shell, a set of first damping spring of bottom surface fixedly connected with in the shell body, a set of first damping spring top fixedly connected with protection bottom plate, protection bottom plate top surface fixedly connected with solar cell body, outer shell inner wall sliding connection has two cardboards, the equal fixedly connected with card strip in two cardboard surfaces, the equal fixedly connected with pinion rack in two cardboard surfaces, outer shell inner wall rotates and is connected with drive gear, drive gear week side and pinion rack meshing, two fixed plates of outer shell inner wall fixedly connected with, a set of reset spring of the equal fixedly connected with in two fixed plate surfaces, two sets of reset spring other ends respectively with the pinion rack fixed connection who corresponds the position. An object of the utility model is to provide a perovskite base film solar cell to solve current solar cell because of there is not protective structure, thereby lead to solar cell to take place the problem of damage easily at the in-process of transport or transportation.

title_clean: Cover assembly with damping hinge
abstract_clean: A modular information handling system may include one or more information handling resources and an enclosure configured to house the one or more information handling resources, the enclosure comprising a topside cover comprising: a fixed portion mechanically fixed to a remaining portion of the enclosure, a movable portion, and a damping hinge configured to rotatably couple the movable portion to the fixed portion about an axis of rotation defined by the damping hinge, wherein the damping hinge is configured to dampen mechanical rotation of the movable portion relative to the fixed portion when the movable portion mechanically moves towards a closed position relative to the fixed portion.

title_clean: Clothing wholesale transport vechicle
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a clothing wholesale transport vehicle, and relates to the technical field of clothing wholesale. The clothing wholesale transport vehicle comprises a transport vehicle, a first box body, an auxiliary assembly and a fixing assembly, wherein the first box body is arranged on the transport vehicle, a second box body is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the inner side of the first box body, and a group of rectangular cavities are formed between the first box body and the second box body. The utility model discloses a sawtooth slot, barrel, spring, stretching rod and trapezoidal inserted block's cooperation is used, can adjust the height of framework and riser, framework and riser can be placed in the rectangle cavity, also can pull out and then increase its accommodation space, can retrieve in the rectangle cavity when not needing to use, avoid occupation in space, through the cooperation use of rotation post, mounting panel, lead screw and holding down plate, can compress tightly fixedly in the dress that is located the top, the condition that drops appears in avoiding the transportation, causes the dress to become dirty or lose.

title_clean: Adjustable mobile phone support
abstract_clean: The invention belongs to the field of mobile phone fixing equipment, and provides an adjustable mobile phone support which comprises a base, a three-dimensional adjusting component, a telescopic clamping plate and a telescopic clamping plate, wherein the base can be placed on a platform, a magnifying glass is arranged on the base, one end of the three-dimensional adjusting component is rotatably connected with the base, one end of the telescopic clamping plate is rotatably connected with the three-dimensional adjusting component, the telescopic clamping plate is used for fixing a mobile phone, and when the three-dimensional adjusting component works, the relative positions of the telescopic clamping plate on an X axis, a Y axis and a Z axis can be changed. Compared with the prior art, the mobile phone bracket has the advantages that the telescopic clamping plate can clamp the mobile phone, the three-dimensional image adjusting assembly can change the relative positions of the mobile phone on the X axis, the Y axis and the Z axis according to the requirements of a user, so that the mobile phone bracket can be suitable for more scenes, the practicability of the mobile phone bracket is improved, and the use requirements of the user are met.

title_clean: Method for preparing electrocatalyst from electrolytic aluminum overhaul slag waste cathode carbon
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a method for preparing an electrocatalyst by using electrolytic aluminum overhaul slag waste cathode carbon, which comprises the steps of mixing overhaul slag waste cathode carbon powder with a mixed salt, carrying out heat treatment, removing part of ash content in the electrolytic aluminum overhaul slag waste cathode carbon by using the mixed salt, pore-forming, and then washing and drying a series of the porous carbon electrocatalyst. The mesoporous carbon material prepared by the method can be applied to the field of electrochemical synthesis chemicals, realizes the harmlessness and recycling of the electrolytic aluminum overhaul slag waste cathode carbon, and shows great green and environment-friendly benefits and application prospects.

title_clean: A reaction mixture for manufacturing an inorganic-filler based closed-cell rigid polyurethane or polyisocyanurate containing foam with low water content
abstract_clean: The present invention relates to a reaction mixture for manufacturing an inorganic-filler based closed-cell rigid polyurethane or polyisocyanurate (PU or PIR) containing foam having a calorific value below 6 MJ/kg, preferably below 4.5 MJ/kg, more preferably below 3 MJ/kg, measured according to EN ISO 1716, the reaction mixture comprising: - At least one polyisocyanate-containing compound; - At least one isocyanate-reactive compound; - An inorganic filler composition; - At least one physical blowing agent; characterised in that said inorganic filler composition has bulk density ranging from 1 to 2 g/cm 3 , preferably from 1.5 to 2 g/cm 3 , characterised in that said reaction mixture further comprises an added amount of water by weight lower than 1.5 parts per hundred isocyanate-reactive compounds present in the reaction mixture and wherein the total amount of inorganic fillers in the reaction mixture is at least 70 wt % calculated on the total weight of said reaction mixture, without taking into account the weight of said at least one physical blowing agent.

title_clean: Retortable gluten-free pasta
abstract_clean: A gluten-free pasta product that survives retort may be formed by preparing a dough mixture with gluten-free flour and water. The dough can be extruded at a temperature and with an amount of mechanical energy effective to form an extruded pasta product having a bi-continuous matrix of protein and starch. The extruded pasta product can be incorporated into a closed retort container and subsequently retorted. The resulting retorted food product may contain gluten-free pasta that has the structural integrity and textual firmness consistent with that exhibited by traditional wheat pasta after having undergone retort despite the absence of binding gluten molecules.

title_clean: High-surface-bonding-strength zero-VOC aldehyde-free back coating adhesive for impregnated paper and preparation method thereof
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a high-surface bonding strength zero-VOC aldehyde-free back coating for impregnated paper and a preparation method thereof, belongs to the field of new materials, solves the problem of formaldehyde release caused by melamine-formaldehyde glue for the traditional impregnated paper, and realizes real aldehyde-free home decoration; according to the formaldehyde-free impregnated back coating prepared by the invention, the functional group for the combination reaction of the paper and the hydroxyl on the plate is increased by introducing the monomer for improving the adhesive force on the resin structure, so that the adhesive strength of the pressed and pasted paper and the plate is improved, and the problem of poor adhesive property of the pressed and pasted plate of the impregnated paper is solved; the back glue of the impregnated paper does not contain any solvent, so that real zero VOC is realized; the invention introduces the cross-linking technology after high-temperature pressing and pasting, and solves the problems that the curing is not completely affected with damp and sticky, and the curing is completely pressed and pasted, and the bonding force is poor, so that the balance is difficult; based on the high surface bonding strength of the formaldehyde-free back coating adhesive, the invention meets the requirements of steam resistance and cold and heat cycle resistance after subsequent impregnation of a paper plywood.

title_clean: Secure reconstitution device
abstract_clean: A reconstitution device comprising a cartridge (212) containing a first substance, the cartridge having a plunger (238) at one end and a piercable septum (222) at a second end, a vial (218) containing a second substance, the vial having a piercable septum (224), a housing (210), a cartridge needle hub (226), the cartridge needle hub (226) having a needle (228) protruding therefrom, a vial needle hub (229), the vial needle hub having a needle (222) protruding therefrom, the vial needle hub (229) and the cartridge needle hub (226) being releasably securable together, cartridge latches (240) holding the cartridge needle hub (226) within the housing, vial needle hub latches (231) extending to engage the housing, and a plunger rod (232), the plunger rod having an inner portion (234) engageable with the plunger (238) of the cartridge, the plunger rod (232) having an outer portion (236) which is adapted to engage the vial needle hub latches (240) to release the vial needle hub (229) from engagement with the cartridge needle hub (226), whereby the vial (218) and the vial needle hub (229) may be released from the housing.

title_clean: Auxiliary medical instrument on-site supply system
abstract_clean: The invention relates to an auxiliary medical apparatus on-site supply system, comprising: the negative pressure urine receiving structure is arranged below the sickbed and consists of a male negative pressure urine receiving device and a female negative pressure urine receiving device; the double-arm driving mechanism is connected with the negative pressure urine receiving structure and comprises a first mechanical arm, a second mechanical arm and an alternating current driving motor, wherein the alternating current driving motor is used for driving the first mechanical arm to stretch the male negative pressure urine receiving equipment to the side face of the hospital bed when receiving a first driving signal, and is also used for driving the second mechanical arm to stretch the female negative pressure urine receiving equipment to the side face of the hospital bed when receiving a second driving signal. The auxiliary medical appliance on-site supply system is compact in design and has certain compatibility. The auxiliary medical apparatus of the same sickbed can meet different requirements of patients of different sexes, so that the auxiliary function of the sickbed is effectively expanded.

title_clean: Handgun cartridge with shear groove bullet
abstract_clean: A rimless cartridge comprising a case and a bullet mounted therein. In embodiments, the bullet comprises a jacket having a cylindrical body portion, an ogive portion, and a plurality of longitudinally extending paths of weakness formed in the ogive portion and defining petals there between and extending rearward from the mouth. The bullet includes a malleable core mounted within the jacket. The bullet further comprises a circumferential groove between forward and rearward circumferential indentations imparted in the body portion of the jacket.

title_clean: Clinical examination analytical instrument
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a clinical examination analytical instrument, which comprises a carriage body, the inner wall fixedly connected with space bar of automobile body, the bottom of space bar is provided with the battery, the equal fixedly connected with slide bar in position in the top four corners of space bar, four the common cover of surface of slide bar is equipped with the adjustable shelf, the top central point of adjustable shelf puts and is provided with the examination analytical instrument. The utility model discloses in, the second thermovent can dispel the heat to the device with first thermovent, and inside second dust screen and first dust screen can prevent dust access device, first pneumatic cylinder and second pneumatic cylinder can promote to carry out the centre gripping to inspection analytical instrument fixed, and first spring can carry out the shock attenuation to inspection analytical instrument with the second spring, and simple structure can be convenient for carry out the centre gripping to the device fixed, has better shock attenuation effect simultaneously.

title_clean: Estuary coastal wetland ecological vulnerability assessment method and model calculation system
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a method for evaluating ecological vulnerability of a estuary coastal wetland and a model computing system, which comprise the steps of obtaining vegetation coverage real-time data and satellite cloud layer real-time data through satellite monitoring, obtaining hydrologic real-time data and sediment real-time data through monitoring of an estuary coastal wetland ecology through surveying equipment, carrying out initialization setting on a preset estuary coastal wetland ecology coupling model according to the vegetation coverage real-time data, the satellite cloud layer real-time data, the hydrologic real-time data and the sediment real-time data, inputting water area reclamation data and pollutant emission data into the estuary coastal wetland ecology coupling model, carrying out landform dynamic deduction to obtain ecological landform information with set time by the estuary coastal wetland ecology coupling model, carrying out ecological vulnerability evaluation based on the ecological landform information, and comprehensively considering influence of human activities and hydrologic-hydrodynamic processes on the estuary coastal wetland ecology, and improving the prediction accuracy of the ecological vulnerability.

title_clean: Techniques for precoding air-to-air sidelink communications
abstract_clean: Methods, systems, and devices for wireless communications are described. A first user equipment (UE) may receive a message indicating geographic location information related to beamforming an air-to-air sidelink message via a sidelink channel. In some examples, a second UE may transmit the message or a base station may transmit the message. The message may be the same or different as a message scheduling the sidelink message. The geographic location information may be geographic location information associated with the second UE, geographic location information associated with one or more directions to avoid when beamforming the sidelink message, or a combination thereof. The first UE may identify one or more precoding parameters based on the geographic location information. The first UE may transmit the air-to-air sidelink message to the second UE. The sidelink message may be precoded for transmission via a transmission beam using the one or more precoding parameters.

title_clean: Korean pronunciation correction system based on big data mining technology
abstract_clean: The invention relates to a Korean pronunciation correction system based on big data mining technology, which utilizes a sensor to detect the formant frequency and the position changes of the tongue and the chin in the pronunciation process to determine the chin pronunciation parameters related to the pitch, and also utilizes magnetic resonance imaging and palate electrogram data to capture the three-dimensional sound channel geometrical characteristics of near consonants in the pronunciation process, and guides the dynamic adjustment of the movements of the lower jaw, the tongue and the throat of a learner according to the actual phoneme string and standard pronunciation.

title_clean: Method for proximity communication between terminals and apparatus thereof
abstract_clean: A proximity communication method between terminals and a terminal like that are provided. A communication method between terminals, according to an embodiment of the present invention, comprises the steps of: establishing a connection between a first terminal and a second terminal via a first communication channel using a first protocol; transmitting, by the first terminal, a first message comprising a public key of the first terminal to the second terminal through the first communication channel; storing, by the second terminal, the public key of the first terminal; transmitting, by the second terminal, a second message comprising the public key of the second terminal to the first terminal through the first communication channel; and storing, by the first terminal, the public key of the second terminal.

title_clean: Automatic gluing device for building glass
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses an automatic gluing device for building glass, which comprises a rack, a bearing frame, a transmission case, a storage table and a control panel, wherein the storage table is arranged at the bottom of the rack, a glass body is placed at the central position of the top end of the storage table, the transmission case is arranged at the top of the rack, a strip-shaped groove is arranged at the central position of the bottom of the transmission case, the bottom end of the strip-shaped groove extends to the outside of the transmission case, a lead screw is arranged at the central position of the inside of the transmission case, one end of the lead screw is rotatably connected with the inner wall of the transmission case, a nut is in threaded connection with the central position of the surface of the lead screw, a bearing rod is fixed at the central position of the bottom end of the nut, and one end, far away from the nut, of the bearing rod penetrates through the strip-shaped groove and is fixed with the bearing frame. The utility model not only improves the convenience and the precision of the gluing device during use, but also ensures the integrity of the glass body of the gluing device during use.

title_clean: High-quality laminating device
abstract_clean: The invention belongs to the technical field of printing equipment, and particularly relates to a high-quality laminating device which comprises a laminating platform, a printed matter unwinding mechanism arranged at the front end of the laminating platform, a protective film unwinding mechanism arranged above the laminating platform, a product winding mechanism arranged at the tail end of the laminating platform, a laminating mechanism arranged on the laminating platform and used for coating a protective film on a printed matter, a gluing mechanism arranged between the printed matter unwinding mechanism and the laminating mechanism and used for gluing the surface of the printed matter, and a static removing mechanism which is arranged corresponding to the protective film unwinding mechanism and used for removing static on the protective film. The invention provides a high-quality film coating device which can avoid the defects of film coating wrinkles, bubbles, unevenness, infirmity and the like and effectively improve the film coating quality of the device.

title_clean: Pouch-type liquid color makeup container
abstract_clean: A cosmetic container is manufactured as a pouch type to accommodate a small amount of liquid cosmetics. The pouch-type liquid color makeup container facilitates confirmation of whether the container is initially opened and exhibition and selling of the container in a vending machine and the like while enabling cosmetic materials to be conveniently carried and used indoors/outdoors through the attachment/detachment of a cap and the entrance/exit of cosmetic tools. A cap attachment/detachment and cosmetic tool entrance/exit and rail movement guide are provided in a discharge member of a pouch manufactured so as to receive and portably carry a small amount of liquid cosmetics, such as lip gloss, mascara, and eyeliner; enabling detailed application by being stably held, thereby enabling various demands of young people sensitive to color to be satisfied.

title_clean: Image Recording Device
abstract_clean: To inhibit decrease in the operating rate of the image recording device.SOLUTION: In a printer 100, a conveyance path 440B connects a supply tray 410B with a platen 470B and a recording head 480B. A conveyance path 440A is arranged on an inner side of the conveyance path 440B and connects a supply tray 410A with a platen 470A and a recording head 480A. An outer cover 540 closes the conveyance path 440B at a closed position P2a on an outer side of the conveyance path 440B, and moves away from the closed position P2a to an open position P2b where the conveyance path 440B is open. An inner cover 530 closes the conveyance path 440A at an outer mounting position on an outer side on the conveyance path 440A, and moves away from the mounting position so as to open the conveyance path 440A. The inner cover 530 is located at the mounting position when the outer cover 540 opens the conveyance path 440B.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_clean: Wafer edge temperature correction in batch thermal process chamber
abstract_clean: A process kit for use in a processing chamber includes an outer liner, an inner liner configured to be in fluid communication with a gas injection assembly and a gas exhaust assembly of a processing chamber, a first ring reflector disposed between the outer liner and the inner liner, a top plate and a bottom plate attached to an inner surface of the inner liner, the top plate and the bottom plate forming an enclosure together with the inner liner, a cassette disposed within the enclosure, the cassette comprising a plurality of shelves configured to retain a plurality of substrates thereon, and an edge temperature correcting element disposed between the inner liner and the first ring reflector.

title_clean: organic electroluminescent element
abstract_clean: The present invention addresses the problem of providing a material for an organic electroluminescent element, the material having outstanding positive hole injection/transport performance, electron blocking ability, as well as stability and durability in the form of a thin film; and also providing an organic electroluminescent element which has high efficiency, low drive voltage, and a long lifespan by combining the aforementioned material and various materials for an organic EL element, the various materials having outstanding positive hole injection/transport performance, electron blocking ability, as well as stability and durability in the form of a thin film, in a manner in which the characteristics of the respective materials can be exhibited effectively. Focusing on the fact that a triarylamine compound having a specific structure has outstanding positive hole injection/transport performance as well as stability and durability in the form of a thin film, an organic electroluminescent element was produced by selecting a specific arylamine compound as a material constituting a second positive hole transport layer, and the present invention was achieved.

title_clean: Automatic control method and system for lithium carbonate production
abstract_clean: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing. In particular to an automatic control method and system for lithium carbonate production. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring the temperature in the hydrogenation reactor, thereby acquiring a temperature data sequence; determining the most preferable extension length of the temperature data sequence, and marking the most preferable extension length as the optimal extension length; decomposing the temperature data sequence by adopting an empirical mode decomposition method so as to obtain an IMF component; denoising each IMF component, and reconstructing the denoised IMF component to obtain a denoised temperature data sequence; acquiring temperature data closest to the current moment from the denoised temperature data sequence, and recording the temperature data as the current temperature; and PID control is carried out on the temperature in the hydrogenation reactor according to the difference value between the current temperature and the target temperature. The method can greatly improve the accuracy and efficiency of temperature control in the hydrogenation reactor in the production process of preparing lithium carbonate.

title_clean: Method for manufacturing substrate coated with electroconductive material, multi-layer material, and substrate coated with electroconductive material
abstract_clean: The present disclosure provides: a method for manufacturing a substrate coated with an electroconductive material; a multi-layer material; and a substrate coated with an electroconductive material. The present disclosure pertains to a novel conductor structure and a method for manufacturing the same. More specifically, the present disclosure pertains to: a method for manufacturing a substrate that is coated with an electroconductive material; the manufactured substrate or conductor; and a specific solvent used in the manufacture thereof. The present disclosure makes it possible to freely manufacture an electroconductive material containing a desired combination of electroconductive component and substrate.

title_clean: Double-fed fan control parameter identification method based on LSTM neural network
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a double-fed fan controller parameter identification method based on LSTM, which utilizes RT-LAB to obtain double-fed fan controller hardware-in-loop test data, utilizes a Person correlation coefficient method to extract characteristic quantity with higher correlation and is used for neural network training, identifies control parameters of a voltage outer loop and a current inner loop, and tests feasibility, effectiveness and practicability of an algorithm through hardware-in-loop test data. Compared with the prior parameter identification method, the method can simulate the operation characteristic of the fan control system by training the historical sample data, and input the measured data to the LSTM neural network under the condition of not operating the fan model to carry out the off-line identification of the control parameters.

title_clean: Power management chip and operating method thereof
abstract_clean: A power management chip includes a gate driver configured to output a first gate signal driving a first power switch and a second gate signal driving the second power switch, a multiplexer configured to receive an error detect signal from a first error amplifier and a first gate signal from the gate driver, and drive the first power switch with either of the error detect signal or the first gate signal in response to a mode select signal; an inductor detection logic configured to receive the inductor detect signal, output a comparison detect signal and a pulse signal for detecting an external inductor, and output the mode select signal corresponding to a result of the detecting, and a comparator comparing an internal output voltage of an output node and an output voltage of the feedback node in response to the comparison detect signal.

title_clean: High-temperature-resistant heavy-load fluorine-lined magnetic pump
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to a high-temperature-resistant heavy-load fluorine-lined magnetic pump which comprises a pump cavity mechanism, a transmission mechanism and a magnetic driving mechanism. The pump cavity mechanism comprises a pump cavity, a PEEK impeller and a PEEK pump cavity liner; the transmission mechanism comprises a silicon carbide pump shaft and a sliding bearing which is fixedly embedded in the bearing body and sleeved on the silicon carbide pump shaft, one end of the silicon carbide pump shaft is in transmission connection with the PEEK impeller, and the other end of the silicon carbide pump shaft penetrates through the bearing body and extends out; the magnetic driving mechanism comprises an inner rotor assembly, a PEEK isolating sleeve covering the outer part of the inner rotor assembly, an outer rotor assembly arranged outside the PEEK isolating sleeve and corresponding to the inner rotor assembly, and a driving motor in transmission connection with the outer rotor assembly, wherein the inner rotor assembly is sleeved on the extending end of the silicon carbide pump shaft. Compared with the prior art, the utility model adopts PEEK as the materials of the impeller, the lining and the isolation sleeve, can raise the temperature resistance to 200 ℃, enables the corrosion resistance and the mechanical strength of the magnetic pump to be higher, and is beneficial to expanding the application range of the pump.

title_clean: Acquisition circuit with selectable switching value judgment threshold
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses an acquisition circuit with an optional switching value judgment threshold, which comprises: the circuit comprises a first interface, a second interface, a first resistor, a second interface, a second resistor, a third resistor, a fourth resistor, an operational amplifier, a voltage dividing circuit and an optocoupler; the first interface is used for accessing an external sensor; the non-inverting input end of the operational amplifier is connected with the first interface, and the inverting input end of the operational amplifier is connected with an external switching value input interface; one end of the first resistor is connected between the non-inverting input end of the operational amplifier and the first interface, and the other end of the second resistor is connected with the second interface and then grounded; the second interface is connected with external 24V voltage through a second resistor, a third resistor and a fourth resistor respectively; the voltage dividing circuit is connected with the output end of the operational amplifier and the optical coupler; the optocoupler is connected to an external central chip. The utility model can easily adjust and adapt to the threshold value of switch detection, thereby better meeting different functional and performance requirements.

title_clean: Apparatus for supplying liquid and apparatus for treating substrate
abstract_clean: Provided is a liquid supplying apparatus including: a trap tank for receiving a liquid from a storage bottle in which the liquid is stored and accommodating the received liquid; a pipe for connecting the storage bottle and the trap tank; and a valve installed on the pipe and for opening and closing a flow path of the pipe, in which the valve is installed closer to the storage bottle than the trap tank.

title_clean: Gas jet kitchen ventilator
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to the technical field of kitchen appliances, in particular to an air jet range hood. The negative pressure gas receiving cover of the device is internally provided with a jet pipe with a closed lower end, an air booster is arranged outside the negative pressure gas receiving cover, the air outlet end of the air booster is connected with an air pressure stabilizing device, the air outlet end of the air pressure stabilizing device is communicated with the inside of the jet pipe through a pipeline, the upper end of the negative pressure gas receiving cover is connected with a diffusion pipe, the upper end of the diffusion pipe is connected with a mixing pipe, the upper end of the mixing pipe is connected with a one-way valve, and the outlet of the upper end of the jet pipe extends into the diffusion pipe. The utility model realizes that negative pressure is generated by jet flow, the negative pressure difference is large, the adsorption force is strong, the efficiency is high, a fan is not adopted, the phenomenon that the rotating blades accumulate heavy oil stains to cause the oil fume adsorption effect is greatly reduced, an exhaust air flow channel is unobstructed, and the workload of cleaning the range hood is greatly reduced.

title_clean: Concrete mixing arrangement for building energy conservation
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a concrete mixing arrangement for building energy conservation relates to building energy conservation technical field, support the stake including mixing arrangement main part, concrete input ware, power take off and device, the left side of mixing arrangement main part is provided with power take off, power take off's left side is provided with the concrete input ware, the bottom of mixing arrangement main part is provided with the device and supports the stake. The utility model discloses an possess solar heat energy board, the heat energy board connecting rod, the transfer box, power take off, the heat collector, the support column, heat energy conversion mechanism, electric power storage ware, solve current mixing arrangement when using, generally all use the electric energy to operate, it is too big to lead to consuming the electric energy, problem of not enough energy-concerving and environment-protective, combine to make mixing arrangement when using through above structure, can convert heat energy into the electric energy through solar device, avoid consuming electric power, make the device can be energy-concerving and environment-protective, improve the practicality of device.

title_clean: Hydrogen storage tank and application thereof
abstract_clean: The application discloses a hydrogen storage tank and application thereof, wherein the hydrogen storage tank comprises a tank body, a heat exchange system and a control system; the tank body adopts a multilayer composite structure and comprises an inner layer, an intermediate layer and an outer layer, the heat exchange system comprises a cooling pipeline, a radiating fin and a circulating pump, and the control system comprises a pressure sensor, a temperature sensor and a central control module. The hydrogen storage tank adopts the tank body with a multi-layer composite material structure, thereby improving the durability and the safety under high pressure and complex environment. The novel hydrogen storage material with high hydrogen storage capacity is adopted, so that higher hydrogen storage density is realized, and the hydrogen storage effectiveness is greatly improved. The heat exchange system is arranged in the hydrogen storage tank, so that the heat and mass transfer efficiency of the hydrogen storage tank is improved, and the hydrogen absorption and release process is faster and more uniform.

title_clean: Freeze-drying system
abstract_clean: Embodiments of the present application provide a freeze drying system. The system comprises a base, at least one heat exchange module, a main air inlet pipeline, a main air outlet pipeline and at least one refrigeration module. The top of the base is provided with a first area and a second area, the second area is positioned at one side of the first area in the first direction, at least one heat exchange module is arranged in the first area and distributed along the second direction, the main inlet pipe and the main outlet pipe are arranged above the at least one heat exchange module and are respectively connected with the air inlet and the air outlet of each heat exchange module, at least one refrigeration module is arranged on the base along the second direction and is connected with the at least one heat exchange module through a refrigerant conveying pipeline, and at least part of structures of each refrigeration module are arranged in the second area. The freeze-drying system is regular in arrangement and compact in layout, and is beneficial to reducing the size and the occupied area of the freeze-drying system.

title_clean: Fertile for production fermenting installation of liquid of adaptation various environment
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses a fermentation device for producing liquid fertilizer, which is suitable for various environments and comprises: the upper side of the left end of the fermentation box is fixedly connected with an upper bin in a Z-shaped structure, the inner side of the upper bin is connected with a first spiral conveying rod in a clamping manner, and the upper side of the first spiral conveying rod is connected with an output shaft of a first motor; the water containing tank is positioned on the inner sides of the lower ends of the fermentation tank and the upper storage bin, and a water suction pump communicated with the water containing tank is arranged on the front side of the water containing tank; and the temperature sensor is embedded and installed on the inner side of the upper left end of the fermentation box. This adapted to various environment's fermenting installation for liquid fertilizer production is convenient for go up unloading to the device, and is convenient for add water, heat and add oxygen to the fermenting case, makes the fertile production of liquid of the adaptable various environment of device, is convenient for carry out even heating and even stirring to the fertile raw materials of liquid, makes it ferment effectually to and be convenient for filter the liquid fertilizer after the fermentation.

title_clean: Intelligent storehouse fire-fighting system
abstract_clean: The utility model discloses an intelligent storehouse fire-fighting system, which comprises a fire-fighting box, wherein sliding grooves are symmetrically formed in two sides of the interior of the fire-fighting box, a first sliding block is connected to the interiors of the two sliding grooves in a sliding manner, a second tray is fixedly connected between the two first sliding blocks, sliding rods are symmetrically and fixedly connected to two sides of the interior of the second tray, and a first spring is sleeved on the outer sides of the two sliding rods, so that the intelligent storehouse fire-fighting system has the beneficial effects that: through adding a tray, No. two trays, the spout, a slider, a spring, No. two sliders and pressure sensor, be convenient for to staff's warning inspection after the fire extinguisher uses, prevent the dry powder in the fire extinguisher with light, cause danger when putting out a fire, through adding the chamber door, the pull rod, the sloping block, the clamp plate, No. three springs and dismantlement button, be convenient for open the chamber door fast, improve the efficiency of opening the door, through adding No. four springs, fixture block and draw-in groove, the fixture block joint of being convenient for is in the draw-in groove, increase the closed stability of chamber door.

title_clean: Environment-friendly rice processing is with edulcoration device
abstract_clean: The utility model relates to the technical field of screening, in particular to an environment-friendly impurity removing device for rice processing, which comprises a bracket and a filtering component; the filter assembly comprises a first filter screen, a second filter screen, a shell, a feed hopper, a collecting box, a vibrating mechanism and a guide plate; when using, start vibration mechanism, drive first filter screen and second filter screen and begin to make a round trip to slide, pour into rice from the feeder hopper, when first filter screen, dust and small granule impurity fall into the collection box, the rice flows to the second filter screen along the baffle, the rice passes the second filter screen and falls down, big granule impurity is intercepted, fall down from the opposite side along the second filter screen, filter respectively small granule impurity, dust and big granule impurity through first filter screen and second filter screen, thereby solve the not good enough problem of current edulcoration device edulcoration effect.

title_clean: High-permeability double-component primer and preparation method thereof
abstract_clean: The invention provides a high-permeability double-component primer, which comprises a component A and a component B which are matched for use, wherein the mass ratio of the component A to the component B is 10:1; the component A comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 20-30% of aqueous acrylic emulsion, 10-20% of aqueous hydroxyl acrylic emulsion, 10-20% of aqueous polyurethane emulsion, 0.8-1.0% of defoamer, 1.2-1.8% of dispersant, 1.5-2.5% of matting powder, 0.1-0.2% of anti-settling auxiliary agent, 0.3-0.5% of anti-sagging auxiliary agent, 4.0-6.0% of film forming auxiliary agent, 0.6-1.2% of wetting leveling agent, 2.0-3.0% of wax auxiliary agent, 0.1-0.5% of thickener and the balance of deionized water; the component B adopts modified HDI polyisocyanate. The high-permeability double-component primer paint prepared by the invention solves the problems of poor wetting, round eyes, no third dimension and the like of a base material with smaller surface tension, meets the requirements of environmental protection standards, and can permeate open pores on various different base materials to reflect the third dimension.

title_clean: Solid phase 3-hydroxypropionic acid oligomer resin
abstract_clean: The present invention relates to a solid phase 3-hydroxypropionic acid oligomer resin having a thermal decomposition temperature (Td), as measured by thermogravimetric analysis (TGA), of 290 °C or higher. The solid phase 3-hydroxypropionic acid oligomer resin according to the present invention exhibits excellent morphological stability and stability of physical properties at room temperature and can be easily converted into a monomer or into a polymer.

title_clean: Hydrogen separation, recovery and purification device and purification method
abstract_clean: The invention discloses a hydrogen separation, recovery and purification device and a purification method, in particular to hydrogen separation equipment, which comprises a shell, wherein a first extraction opening is respectively arranged in the shell and is used for discharging separated hydrogen; the device comprises a first separation bin, a second separation bin and a first separation device, wherein the first separation bin is provided with a first separation membrane, the second separation bin is fixedly communicated with the first separation bin and comprises a plurality of water drop channels which are sequentially communicated, each water drop channel comprises a bending channel and an inclined channel symmetrically arranged on the bending channel, and the second separation membrane is arranged on the bending channel. After the compressed gas is introduced into the first separation bin, the pressure in the first separation bin is reduced along with the permeation of the hydrogen along the first separation membrane, and then the gas is separated along two inclined channels and is intersected at the connecting point of the water drop channels so as to increase the resistance of the output gas of the curved channel, thereby increasing the pressure of the curved channel part and improving the efficiency of separating the hydrogen by the second separation membrane.

title_clean: Aromatic hydrocarbon alkylation reaction system and method with more than eight carbon atoms
abstract_clean: The invention relates to an aromatic hydrocarbon alkylation reaction system with more than eight carbon atoms and a method thereof. The system comprises: the reactor comprises a feed inlet and a discharge outlet; the circulating flash evaporator comprises a feed inlet, a vapor outlet and a discharge outlet; wherein, the feed inlet of the circulating flash evaporator is connected with the discharge outlet of the reactor; the discharge port of the circulating flash evaporator is connected with the feed port of the reactor and is used for recycling part of flash evaporation liquid-phase products back to the reactor. The adoption of the reaction system for carrying out the alkylation reaction of aromatic hydrocarbon with more than eight carbon atoms solves the problems of overhigh reaction temperature, short service life of catalyst and low reaction conversion rate which are easy to occur in the traditional process.
